dab zha gcag pa' dkar chag norgyud/ 90/ (78)2403 dkyil 'khor gyi chos mdor basbus pa/ nango bo 3dbye ba/ 4nges tshig 4gnas thabs/ 5rang bzhin don dam dkyil 'khor/ 5rang bzhin kun rdzob dkyil 'khor/ 5yum dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor/ 7skyon/ 8yon tan/ 8dpe/ 8don rtags/ ༷ 81

(stecad /) 1 cad (1sgyunabasgyu/ 8brten pa lha'i don rtags// ༷ 12slo ba dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po sangs rgyas gsang bas/dbas ma4 shrī dang / bran ka mu ti ta gnyis la brdzangs pa// bod yu la du lo tsā ba khre ba dpal brtsegs la sogs pas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(13) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(14)2404 gzhal yas khang gsal bar byed pa'i mngon rtogs mun sel rjesgocad cam /ba/nucan25 shes// 15lus don tshul du bstan pa/ 15(1thag nga//re mdocad thab/gcad ngas/ ༷ ༷ ༷ 15zhi ba'i ga'a' yas khang gi don bstan pa/ 15khro bo gzhal yas khang gi don bstan pa/ 17slo ba dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(18) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(18)2405 dzasal gsum bye) sgron ma/ ༷ 19slob dngo/na chen po mtho btsun ji pi ṭa 7ma la'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po pad+mā 7 ra warma dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slo nga rin chen bzang ngo/sa bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bci ra mchan/(67) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(70)2

2406 de kho na nyid grub pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/ ༷ ༷ 71slo ba dpon zhi ba 'tsho'i zha' snga nas kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ 7 ra shrī dz+nyā na dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dache slong rin chen bzang ngo/sa bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/slad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta ku mā ra sa la sha dang / 'bro dge slo nga shākya 'od kyis tshad ma/'i skabs bcos r+shang gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(103) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(105)2407 de kho na nyid la 'jug pa zhes bya ba bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' ma lus pa mdor bsdus te bshad pa'i rab tu /byecad /ba/ 106le'u dang po/ dbye ba'i rnam par nges pa/ 106le'u gnyis pa/ slob dpon gyi tshul zhes bya ba'i rnam par nges pa/ 110le'u gsum pa/ thun mong bstan pa zhes bya ba/ 112/smo 1 bgyur /ba/sto/na /pa/ 11ba/gsang sngags kyi sgo'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyi dbang du byas te bshad pa/ 117dbang po rab kyi dbang du byas te bshad pa/ 117dbang po 'bring gi dbang du byas te bshad pa/ 147dbang po tha ma'i dbang du byas te bshad pa/ 152pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par brtson pa rnams kyi dbang du byas te /bsdogatshod /pa/ 1ga ga dbang po rab kyi dbang du byas te bshad pa/ 155dbang po 'bring gi dbang du byas te bshad pa/ ༷ 180dbang po tha ma'i dbang du byas te bshad pa/ 1813

'dod chags dang bral ba sngon du 'gro ba'i lam la lhag par mos pa'i dbang du byas te bshad pa/ 182slob dngo/na dpal ye shes grags pas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po pad+mā ka ra warma dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(196) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(202)2408 gsang sngags kyi tshul gyi snang ba/ 203rdo rje slob dpon chen po mtho btsun btso yags kyi zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po pad+mā ka ra warma dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(210) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(210)2409 de kho na nyid kyi snying po bsdus pa/ 211slob dpon chos kyi dbang pos mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dza nar dā na dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(262) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(265)2410 theg pa gsum rnam par gzhag pa zhes bya ba/ 266theg pa gsum gyi rnam par gzhag pa/ 266nyan thos kyi theg pa'i rnam par gzhag pa/ 266

rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i rnam par gzhag pa/ 268zab cing rgya che ba dang ldan pa'i theg pa'i rnam par gzhag pa/ 268theg pa'i gcig gi rnam par gzhag pa/ 275slob dngo/na mkhas pa/ chen ngo/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛṣ+ṭa pa dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slo nga chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(277) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(278)2411 rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi don la 'jug pa bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ rten409spyor theg pa mdor bsdus te bshad pa/ 279bye zag tu ྾ par legs pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa bshad pa/ 280nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi jeg pa bshad pa/ 280byang chub sems dpa'i jeg pa bshad pa/ 281sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa bshadapa/ 281'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zag pa bshadapa/ 282ne+eg ga gzhan 2sa khyad gan du 25gas tshu2 dasnyan ga/ 282gsad sdags zhabe+es du sdeg ga 2 skodug puzhi sgo gasnyan ga/ 282(1 ngab:re /photshod /ba/gcad ngas/ 283spyod pa'i rgyud bstan pa/ 284rnal 'byor gyi rgyud bstan pa/ 2845

rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud bstan pa/ 284rang bzhin gyi byud bstan pa/ 284brtag pa'i byud bstan pa/ 285thabs dang shes rab kyi rgyud kyi dbye ba bstan pa/ 285thabs dang shes rab kyi rgyud de dag mdor bsdus te bstan pa/ 286shā2 bsnyan ga/ rtenazad(3kablas gu ba//na ga/ rtenardo dzu rgyu'i rna2 2rgyan bsnyan ga/ 292slob dpon shran+d+ra ka ra warmas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po shra— ka ra warma dang /lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(306) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(307)2412 rdo rje jeg pa'i mtha' gnyis sel ba bzhugs/ 308gsang sngags kyi theg pa lung rigs gnyis kyi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bka' 6)na pa brtagan pa/ 308gsang sngags kyi che ba nyid brjod pa'i mtshan bstan pa/ 309thabs kyi che ba de nyid bstan pa/ 309thabs kyi che ba'i dbye ba bstan pa/ 309thabs kyi che ba bcu gcig so sor phye ste bstan pa/ 310thabs kyi che ba bsdus te bstan pa/ 318gsang sngags kyi theg pa mdor bsdus te bstan pa/ 319slob dngo/na tshwa na shrīs bkod/bsdur mchan/(32༷) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(321)2413 de nyid mthong ba'i lam zhes bya ba/ 3226

le'u dang po/ mtshan nyid kyi de nyid mthong ba'i lam gyi rim pa/ 222jeg pa chung ngu'i sdom pa/ 322gso sbyong bya ba/ 322bslabapabasrung ba/ 324ten/ 32zhes gasmug ga dados/ 325rten gyi khyad par kyis bslab pa/ 325babe+eb par bya ba'i ngo bo 325nyes pa'i tshad/ 326bcos pa'i thabs 327nges par skyes pa/ ༷ 327dus ma nges par bslab pa/ 330(6cad tacad/ 330thob pa'i dus/ 331chos la bslab pa/ 336spyod 2na/ 336bsnyen gnas pas spyad pa/ 336dge bsnyen kyis spyad pa/ 336dge tshul pas spyad pa/ 337dge slong pas spyad pa/ 338lta da/ rten5rtenagasgon ga/ 3547

(sgothab pa (1 ba/ 393ces can 393bsnyen pa'i cho ga 393slob ma'i bsnyen pa/ 393lha'i bsnyen pa/ 394dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 394dkyil 'khor rgyu'i bya ba/ 394lhag gnas/ 395sazhi lha sko lhag gnas/ 395kaṣen rgo lhag gnas/ 395saka ga lhag gnas/ ༷ 396skog na lhag gnas/ 396dkyil 'khor gyi ngo bo/ 399cho ga dngos/ 400guka dgad / 400dgad sgod na gsuka/ zhes02dbangabaskur ba'i cho ga 402gzhug pa/ 402nad du ga/ga ga/ 'ju02gsad ba gasgo ba/ zhes 02daspyi2 2sdon du gzhug ba/ 403dbang bskur ba/ 403slob dgon munyes gar byu ba 403dbad bskun ga/ 404dbang gong ma gsum dang rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ 405/bsresaspyad /sa /pho jub/ 4029

phyag rgya bzhi'i don shes par bya ba/ 406dgad gi dkos ga shes gar byu da 406rgyud kyi skon shes gan byu ga 406dgyi2 zhaṣen gyi cho ga shes gar byu ba 410sgra 'ab shegs par (1 ba/ 410don gyi khyad par la shes par bya ba/ 410lngas don jang drang don du shes par bya ba/ 410drang don lngas don du sgrub pa/ 422/ba11sbub /ba /rgya /ba/ 'am29bsrubang bar sbyo1 ba/ 43215tshad /babab shārgya /ba/ ༷ ༷༷ ༷ 435dpal ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal de nyid dang /lo tsā ba rngog burtse pā las bsgyur te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(436) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(445)2414 bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ 446rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i grub mtha' mdor bsdus te bstan pa/ 446theg pa chung ngu mdor bstan pa/ 446nyan thos dbang po tha ma bstan pa/ 446nyan thos dbang po 'bring bstan pa/ 448nyan thos dbang po rab bstan pa/ 449rang sangs rgyas bstan pa/ 4zhenatheg pa chen po mdor bstan pa/ 450dbang po tha ma mdo sde pa bstan pa/ 45010

dbang po 'bring po rnal 'byor spyod pa bstan pa/ 452rnam pa dang bcas pa bstan pa/ 452rnam pa med pa bstan pa/ 453dbang po rab dbu ma pa bstan pa/ 455sgyu ma lta bu gnyis su med par smra ba bstan pa/ 455chos thams cad rab tu mi gnas par smra ba bstan pa/ 457'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa bstan pa/ ༷ 460bskyed pa'irim pa bstan pa/ 460rjags pa'i rim pa bsnyan pa/ ༷༷ ༷ 474slob dpon chen po badz+ra pā ṇi'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po rnyi ro 1 dz+nyā na'i zhabs dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba 'brog mi jo sras kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(go4) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(go7)2415 theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rim pa/ go8le'u dang po/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam kyi rim pa phye ba/ go8bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ 499de nyid rgyas par bstan pa/ zhen9shin /1 rgyas par bstan pa/ 500le'u gnyis pa/ sngags kyi lam kyi rim pa phye ba/ 513bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ 513:de nyitshad sbyo/sa pazab bstan pa/ 51zhesashin tu rgyas par bstan pa/ 515slob dpon skal ba bzang ngo/'i rdo rje zhes bya bas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang / sgra 11

bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(525) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(527)2416 bkathagapa ྅rngobakabs (ba par/rgyabaka nga / 528slob dpon tshwa na ā ka ras mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta tshwa na ā ka ra nyid dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(535) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(535)2417 gsang sngags 'ab 'jugag pamadze 'gre'ab pa/ 536paṇ+ḍi ta ā tsar+ya 1 na ā ka ras mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po 1 na ā ka ra nyid dang /lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(565) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(567)rgyud/ sh+tsa (79)2418 ——ga pa byebyezug nges bsdogs pa6) 11na can/ 571slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛṇ+ḍa pa de nyid dang lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(591) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(592)12

2zhes19 /ba ma lnga /bcu /pa/ 593slo ba dpon chen po rta dbyangs kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po pad+mā ka ra warma dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(598) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(599)2420 bla ma'i bsnyen bkur gyi dka' 'grel/ 600rgya gar shar phyogs kyi mkhas pa chen po dpal nags kyi rin chen gyi bsa' drin la sa legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyi cha shas rig pa gzhon nu dpal gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(659) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(666)2421 spyi'i dam tshig mdor bsdus pa bzhugs so// 667dpal sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad/bsdur mchan/(679) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(680)2422 tshul khrims dang sdom pa dang dam tshig mi 'gal ba zhes bya ba 6ma //slob dngo/na mkhas pa chen po ye shes dpal bzang ngo 'i zhal snga nas mdzad/kha che'i mkhan po dz+nyā na shrī bha dra de nyid dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong blo gros snying po dang / dge slo nga rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(688) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(689)13

2423 2)mas byidzig tham sa cad baX/sa pa cesas byu1 ba/ 690mkhas pa chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī tshwa nas mdzad/rje btsun bla ma chen po de nyid kyi zhal snga nas dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(704) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(705)2424 las dang po pa'i dam 11ga mdor bsdus pa/ 706slo ba dngo/na tshwa na bo rnyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gup+ta dang / lo tsā ba bsod nams rgyal bas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(718) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(719)2425 sdom/ gas/ma tshe/da spyo) phreng ba cesas (ma ba 720so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa 'thob tshul gnas tshul gtong tshul bshad pa/ 720sdom pa gnyis ldan sum ldan 'thad pa'i tshul bshad pa/ 722sdom pa de dag las 'gal na nyes dmigs bshad pa/ 725sdom pa de dag bsrung ba'i phan yon bshad pa/ 726rgya gar shar phyogs dzā ga ga la'i pa/ṇ+ḍi ta chen ngo/ bi khyu ti tsan+d+ras mdzad de rang 'gyur du mdzad/bsdur mchan/(727) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(727)2426 rdo rje jeg pa rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i las kyi cho ga 728bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan ngo/ a bh+ya ka ra gube+e dang bod kyi lo tsā ba tsa mi sangs rgyas grags pa sa bsgyur/14

bsdur mchan/(733) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(733)2427 cesacad /yobaka 1sgozug zug ngab(1bkabs/ 734slob dngo/na mkhas pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(7rga) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(7go)2428 rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs/ 750slob dpon chen po 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta te dza de ba dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong 'phags pa shes rab kyi bsgyur cing zhus/bsdur mchan/(755) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(756)2429 rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi las brtag pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs rtegeg rtegeslob dpon chen ngo 'gro bzang snying ngo/sa mdzad/rgya gar dbus kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po te dza de ba dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong zangs da7ra 'phags pa shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(763) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(764)2430 gnod sbyin rgyal po sgrub thabs/ 765slo ba dpon dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad/bsdur mchan/(770) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(771)2431 rgyal po chen po lus ngan po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 772grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen ngo/ dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad/sgra pa chen po rgyal ba'i snyan la legs par zhus 15

shing bstan bcos kyi skad cung zad shes pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slo nga nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos legs par bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(774) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(775)2432 rnam thos sras kyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ 776slob dpon shu re ga barmas mdzad/ paṇ+ḍi ta te dza de ba dang / lo tsā ba zangs da7ra 'phags pa shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus/bsdur mchan/(779) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(780)2433 bai shra ba ṇa6) sa/gas pa ba(1gas/ 781bsdur mchan/(783) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(784)2434 byedacan/ sdusathag rtestebakathag pa/ rngab(1bkathag/ 785bsdur mchan/(788) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(788)2435 chos skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos sras la bstod pa bzhugs so rte /ma / slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta te dza de ba dang / lots+tsha ba 'phags pa shes rab kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(795) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(kye95)2436 bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 796bsdur mchan/(798) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(798)16

2437 tshogs kyi bdag po gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 799dpal dngos grub brnyes pa/'i pa/ṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ras mdzad/slad kyi mkhan ngo dī paṃ kā ra shrī dz+nyā na dang lo tsā ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(802) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(803)2438 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po chags pa rdo rje'i dam tshig :go ngab/stespyad nga cesathag (5 ngab 804paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ sa ra shrī tshwa nas ma/dzad/paṇ+ḍi ta chen po de nyid dang / lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(806) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(8༷6)2439 sprin gyi sgron ma tshogs kyi bdag po sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ 807slob dpon bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad/rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ 7 ra shrī dz+nyā na dang lo tsā ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(810) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(810)2440 dpal tshogs kyi bdag po 'jur gegs sel ba zhes bya ba'i (1/ba 17/ba/ma /sgo25 /byu /ba/ 811pe slo ba dpon chen ngo in+d+ra byu tis mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dri paṃ sa ra shrī dz+nyā na dang 'o tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ges legs pa/ra bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(814) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(814)17

byed— —— ——byed—— — — dbye ba rang bzhin ting 'dzin dang / /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum/ /rang bzhin don dam kun rdzob gnyis/ /don dam rnam min rnam grangs can/ /dang po rnam grangs min pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems / /bla na med pa rtogs 1gyur pa/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang / /de ni dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs/ /de ltar rgyud rgyal kun las bshad / /rnam grangs can gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /phung khams skye mched rten 'brel rnams/ /lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du/ /ngang gis chos mthun de ltar gnas / /rang bzhin kun rdzob dkyil 'khor ni/ /'og min bla med gnas mchog na/ /'bras bu rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams/ /don dam mtshon phyir rtags su snang / /ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor rnam gsum ste/ /rang bzhin de la bsgom 2pa dang / /gzugs de la ni bslab pa dang / /rab kyi rtsal gyis bskyed pa'o/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor gnyis yin te/ /gzugs brnyan lhag pa'i gzugs brnyan no/ /dang po rnam pa drug yin te/ /gser dngul lugs dang dung rdo 'bur/ /rwa shing bzhogs ras bal ris dang / /sa myag lder dang rdul tshon gcal/ /lhag pa'i gzugs brnyan rnam gsum ste/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o/ /phyi ni lus dang yan lag lnga/ /nang ni 'khor lo dngas ma lnga/ /gsang ba rdo rje pad+ma sbyar/ /de dag spyi yi dbye ba'o// //nges tshig dkyil ni gtso bo ste/ /'khor ni de yi sprul pa yin/ /yang na 'das pa'i dkyil yin te/ /'khor zhes 'jig rten pa la bya/ /47byed/

gnas thabs dkyil 'khor rnam gsum las1/ /rang bzhin don dam dkyil 'khor ni/ /ci yang ma yin ji lta'i tshul/ /dang po'i gnas lugs nyid du gnas/ /rang bzhin kun rdzob dkyil 'khor ni/ /rten dang brten pa rnam pa gnyis//rten yang gzhi dang gzhal yas khang / /gzhi ni 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan/ /gzhal yas dngos dang gdan yin te/ /gzhal yas dngos la rnam pa brgyad/ /dbyibs dang kha dog rtsig pa dang / /shing dang longs spyod ra ba 'obs/ /rgyan dang mtha' yi zhing khams so/ /dbyibs la rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /phyi dang nang dang sgo dang bzhi/ /phyi dbyibs mchod rten mkhar thabs dang / /rgyal khab ri bo'i gur du 'dod/ /nang dbyibs rigs dang phrin las rnams2/ /so so'i rgyud bzhin shes par bya/ /sgo la 'og dang steng yin te/ /'og ni sgo dang sgo khang can/ /steng ni skas dang glang rgyab sogs/ /ji ltar mdzes pa'i tshul du bzhengs/ /gzhi yi dbyibs ni tshad med de/ /rgya ma chad de phya le ba'o//kha dog rnam pa mang yod kyang / /rigs dang ye shes phrin las dang / /spyi mthun lhun po'i tshul nyid du/ /sngags rgyud rnams nas tshul bzhin 'byung / /rtsig pa rmang dang logs dang rtse/ /rmang ni nang du rkyang pa dang / /phyi ni rin chen lnga ru brtsegs6/ /logs ni rmang bzhin bzhengs pa las/ /phyi ni 7rtse la pha gus bstod/ /sgo phugs gong du bstan pa bzhin/ /shing la sgo phugs rnam pa gnyis/ /phugs na ka ba brgyad po yis/ /gdung chen bzhi yi rtse nas bteg/47—pya

——gdung chen bzhi yi re mig kyang / /phyam rtsa nyi shu brgyad kyis bkab1/ /de bzhin gral thog ci rigs pa'o/ /sgo khang phyi zur bzhi po la/ /ka ba bzhi bzhis gdung sna ni/ /brgyad brgyad bteg pa rta babs rmang / /ka gdan ka zhu ci rigs pa'o/ /longs spyod 'dod yon snam bu la/ /gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri mchog dang / /ro zhim yid 'ong chos rnams kyi / /lha mo rnams kyis dgyes par rol/ /ra ba rdo rje'i mu khyud de/ /'obs ni me 'obs khor yug yin//rgyan ni bla rgyan 'og rgyan dang / /rtse rgyan dang ni logs rgyan dang / /sgo rgyan dang ni rnam pa lnga/ /don rtags skabs su shes par bya/ /zhing khams sku gsum 'dul tshad kyang / /so so'i rgyud las bstan par zad/ /gdan gnyis seng ge glang sogs khri/ /nyi zla pad+ma rin chen gdan/ /gtso 'khor rnams la ci rigs par/ /rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin du bsham/ /brten pa lha yi dkyil 'khor la/ /sku dang sku mdog mtshan dpe dang / /phyag rgya phyag mtshan bzhugs stabs 5tshul/ /rgyan chas 'od kyis bsdus pa'o/ /sku ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang / /zhal gsum phyag drug de bzhin du/ /pho dang mo yi dbang po can/ /de la sogs pa'i mtha' yas mchog /sgu mdog nyi ma zla ba dang / /gser dang pad+ma rā ga dang / /in+d+ra be+e la la sogs pa/ /'dres dang ma 'dres kha dog can/ /mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis te/ /dung dang mdzod sru spyi gtsug dang / /thun mong mtshan ni nyi shu dgu/ /bsod nams khyad 'phags mdo bzhin bshad/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ste/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang / /phrin las khyad par gnas skabs las/ /dpe byad bzang po mdo bzhin brtse / /phyag rgya phyag gi 'du byed de/ /bcings dang dgrol dang bsgyur ba las/ /47—6

—byed———byed——byedabyed — — byedadam tshig las su phye ba yang / /byang chub mchog la sogs pa yin/ /phyag mtshan phyag na bsnams pa ste/ /'khor lo rdo rje rin po che/ /pad+ma ral gri la sogs pa/ /don rnams mtshon phyir rtags su bsnams/ /bzhugs stabs 1rdzogs dang sems tshul dang / /bzhengs dang stang stabs la sogs pa/ /gtso bo nyid ni kun du zhal//'khor rnams gtso bo nyid la blta/ /yum dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /yum rnams g.yon nas yab la blta / /sgo ba yab yum ldan pa rnams/ /pho mo g.yas g.yon zur kyis gnas/ /tshul ni rnam pa dgu yin te/ /lha dang lha mo'i dkyil 'khor rnams/ /mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul can/ /gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi byin no/ /rgyan ni rnam pa bdun yin te/ /dbu rgyan snyan cha mgur chu dang / /do shal dpung rgyan se mo do/ /phyag dang zhabs kyi gdu bu'o/ /chas ni rnam pa lnga yin te / /stod g.yogs dang ni smad dkris dang / /ze khab dang ni chos gos dang //gtsang gos rnam pa lnga ru bshad/ /'od ni 'gyed dang bsdu ba dang / /ngo bo gzugs brnyan rnam pa dang / /las rnams 5lnga yi dbye ba yis/ /snang ba gtan la dbab par bya/ /'gyed pa thun mong thun mong min/ /bsdu ba bye brag bcu gnyis te/ /ngo bo gsal ba yon tan can/ /gzugs brnyan sku gsung thugs su snang / /las ni snod sbyang bcud smin byed/ /de ltar mdo sde dag las gsungs/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ji lta bur/ /lhag ma rnams kyang de bzhin gnas/ /rnal 'byor lam la gnas pa yis/ /de ltar yid la goms par gyis/ /

— — —————byed——rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ma rtogs na/ /chos nyid lta ba'i don dang 'gal / /bdag med lta ba ma rtogs na/ /bla med byang chub thob mi 'gyur//ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor ma bsgoms na/ /rtog pa'i dbang bsgyur ting 'dzin la1//ma bsgoms lam la bgrod med cing / /yun gyis 'bras bu 'byung mi 'gyur/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor ma mtshon na/ /rmongs pas don ro mi tshor te/ /gzhan don mthar ni mi phyin pas/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid dang 'gal/ /skyon bzlog pa ni yon tan te/ /dkyil 'khor gsum la gnas byas nas/ /bdag gzhan don rnams ma lus pa/ /thabs la mkhas pas myur du 'grub/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i mdzad spyod kyis/ /'dod la zhen pa'i gdul bya rnams / /mi spang lam du drang ba'i phyir/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal chos bzhin mdzad / /zhing khams dang ni pho brang dang / / btsun mo sras dang 'khor rnams dang / /longs spyod rgyan dang dam khrims rnams/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal dag dang mtshungs/ /don rtags rnam grangs bstan pa ni/ /gzhi lam 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos / /yon tan rnam grangs ji snyed pa/ /dkyil 'khor gsum la yongs su rdzogs / /rgyas par rten dang brten pa gnyis/ /rten la gzhi yi don rtags ni/ /mkha' rlung me dang chu dang sa/ /yum lnga'i rtags te ri rab dang //(7—8

——— ————— — byed—byed— ——— —ri phran gling dang gling phran rnams/ /yab kyi rtags/ te pho brang spyi/ /gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i tshul/ /gzhan yang dbyibs kyi don rtags rnams/ /ma chod rten brgyad so/gas bstan pa ni/ /sbug bsngal brgyad sgol mdzad pa brgyad/ /mkhar thabs rgyal khab ri bo rnams/ /bdud dpung 'joms dang 'dod spyod dang / /bsrung ba'i don du shes par bya/ /'khor lo rdo rje rin chen dang / /pad+ma rgya gram rigs/ kyi rtags/ /zlum pa'i pad+ma le tse bzhi1/ /gru bzhi 'khor lo rin chen rgyas/ / /zla gam gru chad gzhu dbyibs dbang / /gru gsum bha ga khro zhal drag /sgo ni ye shes bzhi dag dang / /bsnyu ba tshad med rnam thar bzhin / /lam stegs brgyad ni 'phags lam dang / /theg pa brgyad dang rnam thar brgyad/ /sgo khang sgo srung khang pa ste/ /steng ni ma rig mun pa la/ /ye shes dkar mthongs dbye ba'i phyir/ /bcu gcig rdo rje'i —re mig can/ /skas dang glang ngo/'i rgyab 'dra dang / /gdugs can la sogs steng dbyibs ni/ /gdul bya yid 'ong bya ba'i phyir/ /ji ltar mdzes par bstan pa yin/ /chos dbyings mu med brdal ba'i phyir/ /gzhi dbyibs tshad med bstan nga/ yin/ /kha dog don rtags bstan pa ni/ /dkar dmar ser ljang mthing ga rnams//sku gsung yon tan phrin las dang / /thugs kyi rtags te go rims bzhin/ /me long ye shes so sor rtog5 /mnyam nyid bya ba nan tan dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyang go rims brtags6/ /yang na spyi mthun ldun po bzhin/ /yang na zhi dbang rgyas pa dang / /sna tshogs drag po gong ma bzhin/ /rtsig pa'i don rtags bstan pa ni/ / rkyang pa rang byung ye shes te/ / 47byed9

— — — —— ———— — byedabyed—lnga rim ye shes lnga yi rtags/ /sum rim sku gsung thugs su sbyar/ /pha gu yon tan spags pa ste/ /rtse la rnam pa mang yod kyang / /re zhig byang chub chen po la/ /dran dang yang dag rdzu 'phrul dbang / /bang rim bzhi yi don du bzhed/ /bum rten stobs te bum pa ni/ /byang chub lam yin bre dag ni/ /'phags pa'i lam du shes par bya/ /sgo gtan rta babs bzhi po ni5/ /gsum ni khams gsum bzhi pa ni/ /'phags lam pad+mas mtshan ma can/ /shing gi don rtags bstan pa ni/ /phugs kyi shing gi gnas tshul ni/ /ka gdan bsnyen gnas klu chen brgyad/ /ka ba 'phags lam lha chen brgyad/ /ka zhu rnam thar gza' chen brgyad/ /gdung ni mi 'jigs rgyal chen bzhi/ /phyam rtsa stong nyid pha rol phyin/ /des mtshon rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad/ /phyam ni gnod sbyin nyer brgyad kyis/ /stobs bcu ma 'dres bco brgyad mtshon/ /gral 7thog yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /sgo khang phyi zur bzhi po na/ /ka gdan ka ba ka zhu ni/ /dran dang spang 9dang rdzu 'phrul rkang / /go rims bzhin du sbyar bar gsungs / /gdung bzhi snol mar btang ba ni/ /bden bzhi bsam gtan bzhi dang ldan/ /longs spyod rnams kyi don rtags ni/ /bsod nams tshogs ni rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos kyi / /lha mo rnams kyis mnyes par bsam / /ra ba 'obs kyi don rtags ni/ /rdo rje ra bas bdud dpung bzlog /me yi 'obs kyis nyon mongs bsreg /chu dang rlung la sogs pa yang sa/ /ci rigs nyid du sbyar bar bya/ /gzhan yang rgyan gyi don rtags ni/ /bla rgyan chos nyid bla re ni/ /77byed/0

thabs dang shes rab nyi zla dang / /ye shes phra men skar tshogs gsal/ /'og gzhi rgyan gyi don rtags ni/ /gdan gyi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur/ /rtse rgyan rnam gcig 1mchod rten la/ /srog shing sku gsung thugs su bstan/ /'khor lo shes pa'i khyad par ni/ /char khebs thugs rje chen po ste/ /'phan ni mchod pa'i lha mo la/ /dril bu stong pa nyid kyi sgra/ /zla tshes thabs dang shes rab yin/ /tog ni mi nub rgyal mtshan no/ /logs rgyan phyam mgo 'dzi pa tri / /kha nas rin chen phreng ba ni/ /dra ba dra ba phyed gyur pa/ /dbyibs dang ye shes brda yin no/ /sgo rgyan rnam pa mang yod kyang / /re zhig dbang gi rtags bcu dang / /rgyan dgu dang ni rdzas brgyad dang / /rin chen bdun dang brda drug go / /bzlog ste brda drug bshad pa las/ /steng gi chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /gtso bo'i rtags te 5ri dwags ni/ /'khor gyi brdar ni shes par bya/ /'og gi dbus kyi gcod chen ni/ /nges don sgra ste gaṇ+ḍi ni/ /drang don sgra zhes gsungs pa'o/ /thabs dang shes rab mtshon pa ni/ /rdo rje dril bu gnyis yin no / /rin chen bdun ni 'di yin te/ /dbang gi 'khor lo rin chen dang / /lha mo btsun mo rin chen dang / /sgo ba dmag dpon tshul dgu dang / /mngon shes blon po bya ba ste/ /stobs bcu glang po rin po che/ /rdzu 'phrul ri dwags rta yitshul/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen no/ /rdzas brgyad bdud 'joms rgyal mtshan dang / /thugs rje'i gdugs 6dang dpal bo'u'i thugs/ /bdud rtsi'i bum pa mi snyems nya/ /chos kyi dung dang dgos 'dod skong / /chos kyi 'khor lo de ltar ro/ /sgo khang nang gi rgyan dgu ni/ /smad na nyon mongs zil gyis gnon—/ /glang dang seng ge ngang pa dang / /stobs dang mi 'jigs tshad med 7/byed/ /

byed ———— ———— —— —byed—————— ———byed—de / /sā la'i shing gi tshal yin no/ /bar na lam rnams so sor 'byed/ /ri dang mi dang srang khram dang / /g.yo dang 'byed dang bstab pa ste/ /blon po rin po che bzhin no/ /steng na sbug bsngal dang du len/ /klu dang chu srin ga ru ḍa / /ye shes thugs rje'i byin rlabs te/ /khyung gis klu rgyal bslang ba bzhin/ /dbang gi rtags bcu 'di lta ste/ /dbu rgyan cod pan phreng ba dang / /go cha rgyal mtshan phyag rgya dang / /gdugs dang bum pa bza' btung dang / /snying po lnga yis ye shes dang / /chos mos rdzu 'phrul smon lam dang / /skye las tshe dang longs spyod dang / /sems la dbang ba go rims so/ /gdan gyi don rtags mi 'jigs stobs/ /rdzu 'phrul dbang dang las kyi khri/ /thabs dang shes rab skyon med dang / /dgos 'dod tshul du mtshon pa'o/ /brten pa lha yi don rtags ni/ /lha dang lha mor bstan pa yang / /gzhi ni gzung dang 'dzin pa ste/ /lam 5ni thabs dang shes rab yin/ /'bras bu dbyings dang ye shes so/ /sku dang sku mdog phyag rgya dang / /phyag mtshan bzhugs stabs tshul dang ni/ /rgyan chas don gyi rnam grangs rgo/ /grub pa rtags kyi phyag rgya dang / /mtshon pa thabs kyi phyag rgya dang / /mdzad pa las kyi phyag rgyar sbyar/ /de yang rgyud rgyal ma lus kyi/ /dgongs pa mdor ni bsdus pa yin/ /mtshan dang dpe byad 'od dang gsum/ /bsod nams rdzogs shing yon tan mtshon/ /sems can don rnams mdzad pa ste/ /rgyas par mdo sde'i dgongs pa bzhin/ /don rtags rtags kyi chos mthun ni/ /gzhung 'dir 'di ltar spyor mod kyi/ /gzhan du chos mthun mtha' yas pa/ /77—/2

rgyud dang rtog nga/ rnams las byung / /dkyil 'khor dbang dang dam tshig gsu/ma/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi srog shing pas/ /rnal 'byor gsang sgor zhugs/ rnams/ kyis/ / gces spras 1yid kyi gzhung 'di spyad/ /dkyil 'khor don bsdus rgyud kyi man ngag 'di/ /nongs su nges kyis lha la bzod pa/ra gsol/ /'di brtsams dge bas sems can ma lus kun/ /dkyil 'khor gsum gyi klong du gnas gyur cig/slo/ba dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi chos mdor basbus pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po sangs rgyas gsang bas/ dbas mañju shrī dang / bran ka mu ti ta gnyis la brdzangs pa/ bod yul du lo tsā 5ba ka ba dpal brtsegs la sogs pas bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/ /1 1ma tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod ska da du smos pa ltar bkod/4 1〈〈pe 〉lkeg/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉oṃ ma/ 〈〈pe 〉lker/5 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉la/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sum̐s/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke sa / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brkyang ba/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉masags/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/6 1〈〈pe 〉thatab/ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉d+kuzhu/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lkes/ 〈〈pe 〉7sung gdul / 〈〈sna ra 〉thasu nga 'dul — 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thabs/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartsi/7 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thabs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdzangs/ 〈〈pe 〉ragur/ (〈pe 〉thazug 5(〈pe 〉〉〈〈smar 〉〉rnam — 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉yu nga bcud sbyin/8 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉ra sa/ 〈〈pe 〉thatsun mo'i/ 〈〈snar 〉thartsun mo'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha sa ba'i/9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a/ 〈〈pe 〉7'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉srungs/ 〈〈co 〉lke/ 5〈〈pe 〉lkebs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉thartag 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7rkyang pa rang byung ye shes te//77byed/3

༄ga /gzhal yas khang gsal bar byed pa'i mngon rtogs mun sel sgon ma bzhugs so// 1༄4/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin lhun grub 'og min gzhal yas dang / /bris pa rdul tshon bskyed pa ting 'dzin gyis/ /bde gshegs bzhugs gnas gzhal yas gsal byed pa/ /ting 'dzin mun sel sgon ma bstan par bya/ /de yang lus don tshul du bstan pa ni/ /tshad dbyibs rgyu dang rtse mo'i gnas lugs dang / /nang dang sgo yi gnas lugs bstan pa dang / /rgyan gyi bye brag rnams kyis mdor bstan pa'o/ /tshad ni 'di zhes nges par bstan du med/ /blos 'khyud sgom bde 2gang du gnas pa'o/ /dbyibs ni pho brang snying po bum pa zlum / /gru chad lha rnams rgyas phyir gru bzhi'o/ /rgyu ni zhi khro gnyis las dang po ni/ /ye shes rgyu las rin 47—15
