— — — —— ——— —— —byed—byed—byedabro / /nyon mongs dam rdzas sha dang ni/ /phyogs dang kha dog 'gro ba dang //snyigs/ ma bag chags lnga lnga'o/ /bdun cu 2la sogs 'khor ba'i chos ye shes sku rigs yab yum sogs/ /rang gzhan ngang gis skur dag la/ /blo la nyams su lo/na nga/ ni/ /spyod yu'/ yang 4dag rnal 'byor pa'o/ /thun mong dam tshig ma/dor basbu na/ /bdag gzhan don du shes par bya'o/ /rgyan 'gyed lus mdzes 'du lta dang / /chang dang dregs spyod khengs sems dang / /che dag dge smod spyig spyod dang / /le lo ser sna gnyid g.yeng 5dang / /khro gtum ye shes sngon mi gtong / /bka' bcag sdig pa'i grogs bsten 6dang / /bag med spyod dang dam chos 'dor/ /chog mi shes dang rngom la dga'/ /spang bya nyi shu gcig bzlog pa/ /bdag don mchog tu gyur pa ste/ /kun gyis bdag nyid bkur bar gyur/ /pha rol phyin drug chos spyod bcu/ /rnam bzhi 9las kyi spyod pa dang / /mthun 'jug las kyi spyod pa ni/ /theg pa dgu dang mu stegs dgu/ /'gro ba drug gi spyod pa rnams/ /'dzin dang nyam nga med par spyod/ /don 'gyur ci yang nyams su blang / /bzhi bcu bzhi la sogs pa yis / /gdul bya gang yang dor mi bya/ /bsrung ba de dag grangs btab pa/ /dran dang shes bzhin gyis spyod pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen por gsungs/ /nyams par gyur pa'i rgyu dag ni/ /mi chos blon po las byed dang / /bdag bstod 11gzhan smod gzung 'dzin mkhas/ /khengs dregs gnyis phyir 'du ba ste/ /rdzas la chags sems rang phyogs che/ /chang sadang rang mthong lta spyod snyems/ /chos la phyogs ris ngoms skyen dang / /gsang chung le lo gtsang sme che/ /sgro sgur grogs kyi nyams len dang / /'khor ba'i rigs rgyud spel 'dod cing / /77—67/

— — — —————— —————— — — —— —————— —— —— ——— — — —gcig ru/ra mi dga' 'du la dga'/ /nyi shu nyams/ nga/'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /snga rtags sngon du 'byung ba ni/ /nyam/ nga ba yi nad rnams dang / /dgra babe+egs/ gnyis/ la bde mi 'jug /'khor dang longs/ spyod yid 'ong 'bra'// /ya ga ma nyes la sogs 'byung / /brtsams pa'i las la 'bras med cing / /yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs 'byung / /gal te nyams la rtags med par/ /legs nga/ra snang na mi rung ste/ /bde ba zad med gtan du sdug /gal te nyams la rtags byung na/ /sngon gyi rnam smin zad 'gyur phyir/ /bskang ba'i las rnams brtson byas na/ /ngan song sdug bsngal myong mi 'gyur/ /nyams par gyur pa'i skyon bshad pa/ /byang sems dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /bskal par dge ba ci bsags kyang / /gzhi rten med par gyur pa yis/ /'khor ba'i khams gsum zag par 'gyur/ /sgu yi dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /ya nga'i nad sogs sdug bsngal 'byung / /dus min tshe zad bar chad mang / /bskal par rdo rje dmyal bar ldung / /bde bas rab tu brel bar 'gyur/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /bgegs rnams thogs med 'ong ba dang / /rkyen dang ye 'drog mang ba dang / /chos la byin rlabs 1med 'gyur zhing / /bskal pa gnyis su dmyal bar thong / /sgrub pa'i dam las 'das par 'gyur/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams gyur 2na/ /smyo 'bog dbang po nyams dang 'chal/ /myos shing sgur pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /gang yang bsgrubs —la rtags med cing / /lce la zhing rmo la sogs pa'i/ /dmyal bar bskal pa gsum la gnas/ /rtsa ba kun nyams phal pa dag /gso la 5nye bar mi brtson na/ /rdo rje dmyal bar de ldung ste/ /dmyal ba phal pa thams cad kyi/ /sbug bsngal gcig tu bsdoms 4/byed675

—— ——byed—nga sa/ ni/ /de yi 'bum gyi char mi phod/ /sangs rgyas stong gi 'od zer dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i phrin 1las kun/ /rgyun du mdzad kyang phan mi 'gyur/ /bskal pa jer 'bum la sogs su/ /de ni thon par mi 'gyur te/ /'jig rten 'jig na'ang gzhan du 'pho/ /se gol gcig gis phyin par byed/ /de bas shin tu nan tan kyis/ /yan lag dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /longs spyod mang du 'phel ba med/ /theg pa che la 'phyas dogs 2shing / /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub rnams/ /shin tu ring bar gyur pa dang / /gdul bya'i don rnams yal 'gyur zhing / /lta spyod ya char gyur pa yis/ /theg pa phyi nang 'dres pa nyid/ /bka' yi byin nyams 'grub par dka'/ /srung —ba'i lha rnams g.yel ba dang / /zab mo'i chos las ring 'gyur zhing / /bskal par ngan song ltung bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor sngo skams nyid du 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor skyes bu chen ngo/ yis/ /dam tshig ma nyams gzhung mthun dang / /lus la nad nyung mtshan ldan zhing / /thun mong nyes byas dag par 'gyur/ /srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing / /jeg chen zab mo'i don thob gyur/ /gsung gis lha mnyes rgyud 'phel zhing / /mthu dang byin rlabs 5bsam mi khyab/ /las rnams dus su 'grub par 'gyur/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /thugs kyi spyo dub med pa dang / /man ngag snod gyur dngos grub nye/ /dgongs zab don la mkhas pa dang / /lha rnams kyis ni dbang bsgur 'gyur/ /yan lag dam tshig ma nyams na/ /skyon bzlog pa nyid yon tan 'gyur/ /bdud bzhi bcom zhing ngan song skyob/ /theg chen lta spyod gzhung bsrang bas/ /lha rnams 'go zhing bsam 7pa 'grub/ /don gnyis yongs su rdzogs par (7 —676

༄khya/ /tshul dze+ems dang sdom pa dang dam tshig mi 'gal ba zhes bya ba/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shī la salba ra sa ma ya a bi ru dhe nā ma/bod skad du/ tshul khrims dang sdom pa dang dam tshig mi 'gal ba zhes bya ba/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal tshogs kun mkhyen dam pa'i dbang phyug snying rje'i mchog gi bdud rtsis brlan pa'i blo gros can/ /gzhan don yon tan dri med bden pa'i rin chen rin thang sked pa mang po 'thob pa'i mchog /'gro ba nyon mongs ha la ha la'i dug zos rnams la chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char pa yis/ /mya ngan 'das pa dam pa'i don byed pa yi dpal ldan gang yin khyed kyis rtag tu srungasan/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral zhing / /bde gshegs byin rlabs med pa dang / /mang du thos pa dang bral zhing / /thos pa nyung ngus chog shes pa/ /mkhas pa nyid du rlom byed rnams/ /rgyud dang sngags dang phyag rgya sogs/ /sbyin la sogs dang 11—68/

byed byedabyed byedabyedabyed —— ——byed — — —byed—— —sangs rgyas yum/ /lung nod ji bzhin ma rtogs/ pas/ /dang/la ldan sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sdom/ /dang ngo/ra bzung nas de 'og tu/ /rab tu byung nas dge slong ngam/ /dang por rab tu byung brten nas/ /sngags dang pha rol phyin lam nas1/ /phyi nas de rnams/ rmongs sogs kyis / /'dul ba yi ni bstan bcos las/ /nyan thos 'a/ sogs sdom gnas pa/ /so sor thar dang lo drir gnas/ /der bstan pa yi bslab pa rnams/ /phal cher bsrung bar ma nus pas/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang / /'gal ba nyid du gnas bzung nas/ /de ltar de spangs rnam par gnas/ /de dag mi shes bsal phyir dang / /bstan pa 'khrul pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /rig 4'dzin gyi ni dam tshig rnams/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang / /so sor thar gsungs sdom pa ni/ /rgyu 'bras ltos 'brel grub rnams la/ /mi 'gal 'brel pa gsal bar bya/ /sgrub pa lung bzhin bya ba ni/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal snga nas/ /yang dag shes rab pha rol phyin/ /mngon par rtogs pa brgyad rnams dang / /dam tshig dbang bskur thob pa yis/ /shin tu man ngag dang ldan pas/ /dpal ldan 'dus sogs rgyud kyi don/ /rim pa gnyis ni rnam dbye ba/ /thob pa nges bsam snying rje yis/ /bdag dang gzhan kyi byang chub phyir/ /byang chub tu ni sems baphyed de/ /kun las phyir mi ldog brtan bya/ /thabs kyi rang bzhin bya ba 'am / /bsgom 5pa yi ni lam dag ste/ /sbyin la sogs pa'i bslab pa la/ /yang na sngags spyod rim pa las/ /rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /bsten pa yongs su gtang 6mi bya/ /mdo sde chos mngon 'dul ba yi/ /(7—682

—gtsug lag gi ni bstan bcos dang / /gtsug lag ma yin lo dri sogs/ /slob dang rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi//so sor thar sogs sdom pa ni/ /dge slong blo dang ldan pa yisarta/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang dag bsten2/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi byang chub dang / /dpal ldan 'chi bdag las rgyal ba'i/ /bstan pa yang ni bsrung phyir dang / /de bzhin 'jig rten gsum gnas pa'i/ /mi dang lha sogs 'jig rten rnams/ /sems sun 'byin pa gzhom phyir ro/ /sdom pa'i rnam par dbye ba ni/ /dpal ldan rgyal bas gang gsungs pa/ /phan tshun 'gal ba dag tu ni/ /gang yang nam du'ang gnas ma yin/ /chos 'dul las ni bcom ldan gyis/ /so so/ra thar pa'i sdom pa ni/ /rnam pa brgyad gsungs 'di lta ste/ /dge slong dang ni dge slong ma/ /dge slob dge tshul dge tshul ma/ /de bzhin dge bsnyen dge bsnyen ma/ /bsnyen gnas la ni gnas pa'o/ /de rnams bslab pa'ang rnam dbye ba/ /dpal ldan thub pa'i dbang chen bo/ /snying rje ldan nga/sa gsungs pa ni/ /dge bsnyen pho mo dag gi sdom/ /rnam pa lnga ru rab bstan te/ /'di ltar srog gcod spong ba nas/ /myos 'gyur chang mi 'thung ba'i bar/ /dge tshul pho mo'i sdom dag ni/ /mgon pos rnam pa bcur gsungs te/ /srog gcod pa la sogs pa nas/ /ji srid gser dngul la sogs pa/ /len pa spong ba'i bar du'o/ /de bzhin gzhan ni bar slob ma'i/ /'dul las bcu gnyis nyid yin te/ /chos dang rjes su mthun pa rnams / /thar pa'i lam ni dag phyir gsungs/ /thub pa thugs rje chen po yis / /spang bya thams cad spangs pa ni/ /dge slong dge slong ma rnams kyi//47—683

byed—byedasdom/ pa yin par gsungs nga/ yin/ /thub pa thugs/ rje chen ngo/ yis/ /glu dang gar sogs phreng ba sogs/ /gcig byas phyed dang dus min zas/ /bar gye spang bya brgyad spangs pa/ /bsnyen gnas/ kyi ni sdom par gsungs/ /sbyin la sogs nga/'i sangs rgyas chos/ /bya ba thabs kyi bdag nyid gnas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin nga/ ru/ /bstan pa rgyal ba'i dbang po yis/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi/ /sdom pa nyid du gsungs pa yin/ /phyag rgya sngags/ sogs rnal 'byor gyi/ /rim pa gnyis la brten pa las/ /rdo rje ye shes lus ngag gi/ /lha yi rnam pa 1rab bsgoms pa/ /thabs dang ldan par sgrub pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab 'grub pas/ /so sor thar sdom kyis de 'grub/ /gsang sngags sbyin sogs dbye ba las/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dbye ba yis/ /dge slong la sogs dbye bya ste/ /dge slong sogs sdom dbye ba med/ /dge slong nyid sdom gcig yin te/ /de bzhin len dang bsgrub pa'ang gcig /rab byung sdom pa btang nas ni/ /sngags kyi sdom dang sbyin sogs kyi/ /sdom pa yang ni gzung mi bya/ /gsang sngags kyi rgo sdom pa dang / /sbyin sogs sdom pas bsdams pa dang / /rnyed dang bkur ste'i rgyu yis sam/ /gnas kyi 'tsho ba 'grub don du/ /rab byung sdom pa len 'dod na/ /dge slong min pas sdom mi bya/ /gsang sngags sbyin sogs ldan pa ni / /rab byung sdom pa bsgrub pa'o/ /'phags pa mgon po byams pa yis/ /'di ltar mkhyen te gsungs pa ni/ /rab tu byung ba'i phyogs dag ni/ /yon tan tshad med rnams dang ldan/ /de ltar sdom brtson khyim pa yi/ /byang chub sems las khyad par 'phags/ /gsang sogs lam dang sbyin sogs kyi/ / 17byed684

lam nyid dag ni dge slong gis/ /dge slong mkhas las blang bya yi/ /gzhan nyid las ni ma yin no/ /sngags dang sbyin sogs la gnas pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni/ /tshul khyems pha rol phyin rnam gsum/ /dang po sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / /dge ba chos sdud tshul khrims dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims te/ /des bsgrubs 'di 'grub 1nges pa yin/ /rgyal bas 'dul ba'i sde snod las/ /dge slong sdom gang gsungs de ni/ /dge slong byang chub sems dpa' yis2/ /tshul khrims sdom pa'i cha ru 'gyur/ /dpal ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dang / /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /dbugs dbyung dag la brten nas ni/ /rdo rje'i lam ni gnyis su gnas/ /de la bde gshegs dbugs dbyung ba/ /dge slong rnams la zhi sems kyis/ /ma lus spyos pa dang bral ba/ /gsungs pa dbang spyod sogs rim bya/ /phyi rol shes rab spangs nas ni/ /rtag tu rang snang shes rab ldan/ /de la 'dul las gsungs pa yi/ /sdom pa yis ni byang chub sgrub/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid thob pa yi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rol pa ni/ /dge slong bdag nyid gyur pa yi/ /dpal ldan rnam par snang mdzad sogs/ /gos dkar sogs dang stoms 'jug pa/ /do shal dpung rgyan gdu bu yis/ /rnam par brgyan cing gos dag ni/ /shin tu bzang po bsnams 4pa ru/ /dpal ldan 'dus sogs las byung bas/ /sems can kun gyi don 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dbugs dbyung ba/ /rtag tu khyim pa sbyang bya'i 5phyir/ /dbang bskur la sogs rim pa ni/ /spros dang bcas pa de la gsungs/ /sems sogs 'os su gyur pa la/ /phyi rol rig ma'i dbang bskur bya/ /spros pa med pas rab 47—685

— ———— —zhe———————byedabyed—byedabyedabyed— —byed—byung la/ /dge slo/nga rnams kyis de spyin te/ /'dul la sogs pa'i sdom pa ni/ /thams/ cad ldan pa'i slob ma la/ /rtag tu rang snang shes rab kyis1/ /bsgom pa gsal bar bya phyir ro/ /sbyin sogs spyod dang sngags sogs spyod/ /rnal 'byor gnas pa'i bdag nyid dag /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sangs rgyas chos//rang dang gzhan la rab bsgrub par/ /rab tu 'jug pa'i dge slong gi/ /dngos gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /bse ru nyan thos nyid gnas pa'i/ /zhi ba 'dod pa'i dge slong gis/ /'dul las gsungs pa'i sdom pa yang / /phra mo tsam yang gtang mi bya/ /khyem pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang / /gang tshe tshangs spyod nyid bsrungs 2na/ /rab byung byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /rang gi tshul khrims ji ltar dor/ /dpal ldan mgon po byams pa yis/ /rtag tu tshangs par spyod nyid dang / /'tsho ba rnam par dag nyid do / /byang chub sems dpa' la gsungs so/ /dge slong byang chub sems dpa' yis4/ /sbyin sogs bya ba'i lam gyis sam/ /yang na sngags kyi sdom pa yis/ /gnas te de nyid sgrub byed pas/ /'dul las gsungs pa'i sdom pa ni/ /ji srid 'tsho yi bar du bsrung / /dpal ldan thub pa'i dbang po ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa gang yin des/ /jeg pa gsum gyis nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 5'bras bur gnas/ /zhes bya bar ni gsungs pa yin/ /sdom pa rnams ni sdom pa yin/ /gong nas gong du rjes 'jug ste/ /'di ltar dge bsnyen sdom pa ni/ /dge tshul gyi ni rjes su 'jug /gang de dge slong rjes su 'jug /gang dag nyan thos dge slong gi/ /sdom gsungs byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /rjes su 'jug ste kun ldan pas/ /dge slong shin tu khyad par 'phags/ /bya ba 47—686

thabs kyi sbyor ba ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ste/ /sngags pas sbyin la sogs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni 'jug par bya/ /gal te sdom pa 'gal gyur na/ /dge slong gis ni 1sdom pa rnams/ /phul bar gyur na dge tshul dang / /dge bsnyen yang ni mi gnas 'gyur/ /sems can don la ltos pa yis//so sor thar gsungs sdom gtong zhes/ /gal te de ltar rjod byed na/ /de dag nges par rmongs pa yin/ /blo ldan khyad par 'phags pa yi/ /dge slong byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /thabs la mkhas pas thams cad du/ /rmi lam du yang 'gal mi bsam/ /sbyin la sogs pa bya ba 'am/ /yang na de nyid bsgom bya yin/ /dge slong sems can don bsgrub pa'am/ /byang chub sems dpa' snying rje che/ /gzhan don byed par 'dod rnams kyis/ /'dul la sogs pa'i dge slong gis / /bya— ba tshul khrims khyad 'phags phyir/ /tshul khrims lhag par bsten 4par bya/ /'dul ba las brjod tshul khrims ni/ /dge slong nyid du bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /ji srid 'tsho bar bsten 5bya ba/ /sems can don yin gtang 6mi bya/ /sngags sogs bsgom pa 7gnas pa dang / /sbyin pa sogs la gnas pa yi/ /dge slong byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /so sor thar gsungs bslab pa ni/ /nam yang gtang 9bar mi bya'o/ /btang na dmyal sogs 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de ltar ma gyur rnam nges na/ /yang dag byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /dge slong sdom pa yang dag pa/ /so sor thar la gnas par bya/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams 7la/ /gus pas lung dang rigs 1 pa yis/ /shin tu dri ma med cing mi 'gal sdom rnams byas pa las/ /bdag gis zla 'od lta bu'i dge ba bsags pa gang yin des/ /'jig rten ma 77/byed687

——lus dpal ldan rgyal ba'i dbang po myur 'grub 1shog /tshul khrims dang sdom pa dang dam tshig mi 'gal ba zhes bya ba/ slob dpon mkhas pa chen po ye shes dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //kha che'i mkhan po dz+nyā na shrī bha dra de nyid dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong blo gros snying po dang / dge slong rab zhi bshes gnyen kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o // //bsdur mchan/681 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉masal khrims dang sdom/ pa/ dang dam tshig mi 'gal ba ye shes dpal gyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra srungs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉tharlabs/682 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zlog 4〈〈pe 〉〉sdegs/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsā ma/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatang /683 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ 2〈〈pe 〉tharten/ 〈〈pe 〉shesang /684 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ra/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/685 1〈〈pe 〉〉ste/ /des bsgru ba 'di 'grub/ 〈〈snar 〉〉te/ /des bsgrub 'di bsgrub/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/4〈〈pe 〉rdzabs/ 〈〈snar 〉rnamanabs/ 5〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pad pa'i/686 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sum̐/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasrung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du// 4〈〈pe〉ye 5〈〈pe〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉sngags/687 1〈〈pe 〉tha/ 〈〈snar 〉tha ni/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7don/ — 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉8/ ce〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thartan/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharten/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatang / 7 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatang /kho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7rnams/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'ag688 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yib/ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉tsa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra /47byed688
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2349)41wa 689

༄khya/ /dam tshig thams cad bsdus pa zhes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba sa ma ya saṃ gra ha nā ma/ bod skad du/dam tshig thams cad bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ ā hūṃ/ rdo rje mi phyed gsum bdag nyid / /dpal ldan bde chen rdo rje la/ /btud de gsang sngags theg pa'i gzhung / /rgyud las gsungs pa bri bar bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pas 'di ltar shes par bya'o/ /theg pa chen po'i yang chen po 'di 'og ma rnams las khyad par du 'phags te/ ji ltar zhe na/ 'di skad du 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas thams cad chos kyi skur rtogs pas kun du bzang po'i rgyas jebs pa dang 'jig rten gyi lha chen po dam tshig can 'khor dang bcas pas bkur gnas byed pas byin gyis brlabs dang ldan pa dang /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pas thugs la dgongs shing byin gyis 41byed690

brlabs pas dngos grub myur ba dang / bde bar gshegs pa rnams dang spyod yul gcig pas 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa dang bral zhing dbugs phyin pa dang / rdo rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan zhing sku dang gsung dang thugs mi phyed pas bar du gcod pa gang yang med pa dang / phyi nang thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par yid ches pas dam tshig nyams par mi 'gyur ba dang / gal te nyams na yang rang bzhin gyis skong bar 1'gyur ba'i khyad par ro zhes gsungs so/ /yang slob dpon chen po in+d+ra byu ti'i zhal snga nas bla ma'i khyad par dang snod kyi khyad par dang cho ga'i khyad par dang las kyi khyad par dang dam tshig gi khyad par dang / lta ba'i khyad par dang spyod pa'i khyad par te bdun gyis 'phags so zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon chen po ye shes zhabs kyi zhal snga nas sngags kyi theg pa ni rnam pa gsum gyis thun mong ma yin te/ 'di ltar sgrub pa po dang lam dang 'bras bu gsum mo zhes gsungs so//slob dpon tri pi ta ka ma la'i zhal snga nas ni/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon ḍo bi he ru ka'i zhal cenas kyang 'di 5ni snod kyi khyad par dang snod du byed pa'i cho ga 6dang gzhung dang / lam kyi khyad par dang 'bras bu'i )khyad par gyis sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang rdo rje dril bu pa'i zhal nas kyang gsang sngags kyi theg pa ni theg pa chen po'i yang chen po yin te/ 'di ltar rten gyi gang zag gi khyad par dang / 'jug pa lam kyi khyad par dang / mthar thug pa 'bras bu'i khyad par dang /47byed691

mngon par 'byung ba'i khyad par ro zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon rat+na ā ka ra shādhi pa'i zhal snga nas 'dir/ dmigs pa rnam par dag pa dang / /grogs kyi mthu dang spyod pa yis/ /blo ldan rnams kyi theg pa 'di/ /chen po'i chen po nyid du bsgrags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bdag gi bla ma rje btsun dam tshig rdo rje'i zhal nas ni pha rol 1phyin pa'i jeg pa las theg pa 'di gong du gyur pa yin te bla ma dang dbang bskur ba dang dam tshig dang man ngag dang brtson 'grus kyis khyad par du 'phags so zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'dir dam tshig 'ba' zhig brjod par bya ste/ dam tshig ni sngags pa rnams — kyi gnas su gyur pa dang jeg pa chen po'i chos kyi lo tog skye ba'i sa gzhir gyur pa yin pas de bri bar bya'o//dam tshig rnams 4kyang gang zhe na/ rten dang rgyu dang rtsa ba dang ngo bo dang nges pa'i tshig dang dbye ba dang ming gi rnam grangs dang rkang grangs dang brda dang bdud dang dgra dang nyams pa'i tshad dang skong ba 5dang / ma nyams pa'i rtags dang bskang ba dang 6bsngo bgrang bya ba dang bskangs pa 7dang bsdus pa'i dam tshig dang nyams pa'i nyes dmigs dang ma nyams pa'i phan yon dang 'bras bu rnams so/ /des na rten ni theg pa chen po'i rigs can skyabs su 'go ba gnyis sngon du song ba bla na med pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang bskur ba thob pa'o/ /de la rgyu ni byang chub kyi sems so/ /rtsa ba ni snying rje'o/ /ngo bo ni ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa dang / snying rje dang shes rab mtshungs par ldan pa shes pa'i rgyun no/ /nges tshig ni rtogs pa'i phyir ram/ mnyam pa nyid du 'gro ba'i phyir ram/ thob cing mi 'da' ba'i phyir ro/ /de la dbye ba ni rtsa ba dang sbom po dang 8yan lag gi sgo nas dbye ba 4 1—692

dang bsrung ba dang bsgrub pa'i sgo nas dbye ba dang spyod pa dang lta ba'i sgo nas dbye ba dang spyi dang khyad par dang lhag pa'i sgo nas dbye ba dang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas dbye ba dang / rags pa dang phra ba'i sgo nas dbye ba dang / bsrung bar bya ba dang nyams su blang ba dang spyad par bya ba dang spyod lam dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas dbye ba'o/ /de la ming gi rnam grangs ni dam tshig dang sdom pa dang brtul zhugs dang spyod yul dang dka' spyad dang spyod pa dang shī la la sogs pa'o/ /de la rkang grangs ni thun mong gi rtsa ba'i thong ba bzhi dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu gnyis dang kṛ ya'i rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu gsum dang / spyod pa'i rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi dang / rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i thong ba bcu bzhi dang / yang lnga dang yang bzhi dang / rtsa ba'i rtsang ba bdun cu lkutham pa'o/ /de la yan lag gi dam tshig rnams ni 'di rnams so zhes bgrang bar mi nus te/ mdo sde dang mngon pa dang 'dul ba dang rgyud sde rnams su blta bar bya'o/ /de la dam tshig gi brda ni ji skad du/ mi shigs pa ni seng ge ste/ /gcan gzan rgyal po yin pas so/ /za ma tog ni rgyal mo'i chomadzod/ /dug spyod pa ni der mi rigs/ /rat+na myu gu lcug phran dag /bregs 5te 'byung rgyun gcad mi bya/ /gangs kyi zhu chu phal pa yang / /mkhas pas btung bar mi bya'o/ /pad+ma'i ze'u — 7'bru kha ma bye7/ /zla zer ma yin dbye mi bya/ /ma brtags kyebug rdol can snod du/ /bdud rtsi sman blugs zags par 'gyur/ /don med bcos pa'i tshul rtags 9can/ /bsrel zhing spyad par bya ba min/ /shel dkar rat+na sgo nga dang / /'dam rdzab khung du nub mi bya/ /41byed693

seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma dag /gser snod ma yin blugs 1mi bya/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /bsreg par bya ba yod ma yin/ /khyung chen gshog pa gar brkyang ba/ /de dag bcag 2par bya ba min/ /gnam lcags me yi dur mo dag /brdab par bya ba ma yin no/ /rdo rje brag chen gtams pa'i gzhi/ /gzhig par bya ba ga la yin/ /bud — shing bsregs pa'i sgron me de / /'thor 4rlung drag pos zhebaskyod mi bya/ /rdo rje tshig gi chu rgyun dag /'ol ka 6bkag par bya ba min/ /rgyal po 7bka' rtags phyag rgya dag /nam yang bshig par mi bya'o/ /gtsug gi yid bzhin nor bu de/ /rgyal mtshan rtse las dbrog 8mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ zla ba'i dam tshig kyang brdar gsungs te/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje las tsa'u sa ma ya/ kaspu /ra/ sih+la/kadru rarka/ bā la zhes pa dang / snyoms 'jug gi dam tshig kyang bo la/ ka k+ko 11la / kun du ru zhes gsungs so/ /rtsa ba'i thong ba bcu bzhi yang brdar gsungs te/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las/ ri bong can dang mig dang yon tan rig byed dang / /mda' dang dbang po ri dang bkra shis gza' dang phyogs / /drag po nyi ma yan lag sa rnams yin/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de la dam tshig gi bdud ni rnam rtog 'khrig sapa'i bdud dang / btang snyoms le lo'i bdud dang / longs spyod g.yeng ba'i bdud dang / tshig rtsub mtshon cha'i bdud dang / khro gtum 'khrug pa'i bdud do/ /de la dam tshig dgra ni gsang ba 'phel bas bcos dkar r+ṣasong ba'i dgra dang chos log par spyad pas bar chad 'ong ba'i dgra dang rtsa ba byung bas chad pa chen po 'byung ba'i dgra dang / sgrub pa mi brtson pas dge ba 'phrog pa'i dgra'o/ /de la 47byed694

dam tshig gi nyams pa'i tshad ni nyams pa che chung gi tshad dang dus kyi tshad do/ /de la nyams pa 1che chung gi tshad ni kun du nyams pa chen po dang rtsa ba nyams pa dang / yan lag nyams pa dang zlas nyams pa dang zhar la nyams pa'o/ /de la dang po bla ma'i dam tshig ni de bsgongs pa dang de la mtshon la sogs pas brgyab pa dang sku la smad pa dang 'khus pa dang brnyas pa dang 'khon pa dang bka' bcag pa dang ngan sems dang 'phya ba la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje srun pho mo'i dam tshig ni de bsad pa dang 'khus pa 4dang brdegs pa dang nor rdzas dang chung ma la sogs pa phrogs pa dang / shog kha dang ngor kha dang man 5dur dang brnyas pa dang mtshang 'dru 6ba dang ngan sems dang 'khon 7pa dang brtse gdung med pa la sogs pa'o/ /gzhan yang byang chub kyi sems gtan spangs pa ni kun du nyes pa chen po'o/ /de la rtsa ba'i thong ba bdun cu las bla ma dang rdo rje srun dang byang chub kyi sems ma gtogs pa drug cu rtsa gsum nyams pa dang / gzhan yang rang gis dbang ma thob par gzhan la bskur ba dang mi shes par dkyil 'khor 'dri ba dang / rab gnas dang sbyin sreg dang tshogs kyi 'khor lor zhugs pa dang /gsang sngags rang shes su bla ma med par spyod pa dang thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor chags 8pa dang lha dang bla ma la mchod pa dus su chags 9snapa dang mi dge ba bcu dang mtshams med pa lnga dang nye ba'i mtshams med pa lnga dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba dang 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa dang rang gi gsang ba bzhi po bag sked par gzhan la smra ba dang ngo tsha med pa dang khrel med pas sdig pa ci la yang mi 'dzem pa rnams ni rtsa ba'i thong ba zhig ral du 'gyur ro/ /de la rtsa ba'i yan lag tu gyur pa yan lag gi ldung ba bdun dang bco lnga la sogs pa spyir bzhi/41—695

bar skabs bzhi/ gsang ba nye bar gtad 1pa bzhi/ gsang bar 'os pa'o /sngags kyi rgyud la sogs pa nas gsungs pa ji snyed pa rnams dang / gzhan yang gzugs sku dang po ti dang rdo rje dril bu dang phur bu 'joms pa dang 'tshong ba dang 'gom pa dang mchog tu yi dam lha'i sku dang / glegs bam dang phyag rgya rnams sbyin pa dang 'tshong ba la sogs pa rnams ni yan lag gi thong ba zhig ral du 'gyur ro/ /de la byang chub kyi sems gtan spangs te rtsa ba mang du byung ba ni kun du nyon mongs pa chen po'o/ /de ma shor yang rtsa ba'i nyes pa gcig gam 'ga' byung ba ni rtsa ba nyams pa'o/ /rtsa ba ma shor ba yang nyes pa gzhan byung ba ni yan lag nyams pa'o/ /bla ma ngan pa dang grogs zhe ngan pas nyes pa byung na ni zlas —nyams pa'o/ /mi shes pa dang ma gus pa dang bag med pa dang nyon mongs pa che bas nyes pa byung ba ni zhar la nyams pa'o/ /de la dus kyis 4 nyams pa ni brtson pa rab kyi rab kyis ni nyes pa byung ba'i rjes 5nyid la ma bskangs na nyams so/ /rab kyi 'bring gis snga dro nyi ma phyed dang phyed kyi phyed dang dgongs ka dang de bzhin du dus su ma bskangs na nyams so/ /rab kyi tha mas ni nyin par nyes pa mtshan mo la/ mtshan mo'i nyes pa nyin par ma bskangs na nyams so/ /'bring gi rab dang 'bring gi 'bring dang 'bring gi tha ma ni zhag bdun dang dus khyad par can dang zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tshun chad du ma bskangs na nyams so/ /tha ma'i rab dang tha ma'i 'bring dang tha ma'i tha mas ni zla ba gcig dang zla ba bdun dang zla ba bcu gnyis tshun chad du ma bskangs na nyams so/ /shin tu dman pas kyang skye ba 'di la nyams pa lus pa las 'chi kar skong 7 na de bskangs pa las de ma bskangs na nyams so/ /de la dam tshig ma 7nyams pa'i 41—696

rtags ni gdung sha rī ram dang khrel ma khrel dang rmi lam dang bar chad mang nyung las brtag par bya'o/ /de la dam tshig bskang ba ni so so dang thun mong gi'o/ /de la so sor 7bskang ba ni spyod pa rlabs po che tsha tsha dang sbyin sreg dang gtor ma dang yan lag bdun pa dang chos spyod bcu dang tshogs kyi tsakra dang nye'u 'don pa dang dge 'dun la chos ston yon dang bcas pa dang / sgrub pa chen po'i gzhi bzung ba dang gzugs khyad par can dang rang gi lha'i snying po bzlas brjod bya ba ni 'bum phrag lnga dang khri phrag gsum dang khri phrag lnga dang 4stong phrag gsum 5dang stong phrag lnga dang brgya phrag gsum dang brgya phrag lnga dang bcu phrag gsum dang bcu phrag lnga dang nyi shu rtsa gcig ste nyams pa chen po la sogs pa lnga dang rim pa bzhin du sbyar ro/ /gzhan yang rdo rje slob dpon gyi nyams na be+er yang dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bya ba dang / rdo rje spun kyi dam tshig nyams pa na tshogs kyi tsakra la sogs pa ste nyes pa so sor bskang ba'i thabs so sor ji ltar 6 bshad pa bzhin du bskang bar bya'o/ /de la thun mong gi bskang ba ni bshags pa dang sbyang ba dang slar blang ba'o/ /gzhan yang gong du bshad pa'i dge ba'i las kyis bskang ba dang rdzas kyis bskang ba dang don gyis bskang ba dang ting nge 'dzin gyes bskang ba dang gsang ba'i thabs kyis bskang ba'o/ /de la dang po gong du bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni bla ma spyan drangs nas rin bo che dang rdzas dz+wakhyad par can phul nas nyes pa bshags te/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas rdzas de dag slar slu ba'i tshul du bla ma las dam tshig bslang 3bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar rnam par dag pas bsgom pa dang chos zab mo nyan pa dang bsam pa dang bklag pa dang / kha ton r+shabya ba de la brtag pa dang bri ba 4 1—697

dang gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /de la bzhi pa ni sdig pa bkru ba dang sdig pa sreg pa dang sdig pa gtor ba dang dam tshig rdo rje bsgoms nas de'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bskang ba'o/ /de la lnga pa ni bla ma la rdzas dang rang gi chung ma phul te/ gsang ba'i dbang dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang bzhi pa'i dbang zhu bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang yi dam lha'i ting nge 'dzin dang bzlas pas shin tu yang bskang ngo 7/ /khyad par du rdo rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms nas bskang du mi btub pa yang bskang ste2/ mdzod kyi mdo la sogs pa la blta /bar bya'o/ /de la dam tshig rnams bsngo bgrang bya ba ni mdor bsdu na dran pa'i tshul gyis bsngo bgrang bya ba dang / kha thon dus gsum du bsngo bgrang bya ba dang / dus drug tu yi dam nar ma'i dus su bskang zhing bsngo bgrang bya ba dang / glegs bam bltas 5pas bsngo bgrang bya ba'o6/ /de la dam tshig bskangs bam̐pa dang ma nyams pa'i rtags sngar bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de la dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes dmigs ni ji skad du dpal sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud las/ dam tshig nyams pas dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur dngos grub 'thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas dang po dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang bskur ba thob nas dam tshig sdom pa mnos nas phyis ma bsrungs na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub mi 'byung la/ mi 'dod pa sna tshogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang / dam tshig med pa'i mi rnams la/ /sngags dang phyag rgya mi sbyin zhing / /de dang 'grogs par mi bya ste/ /snying rje bskyed la spang bar bya/ /zhes pa dang / dang por bla ma rje btsun las/ dam tshig thob nas mi bsrung ba/ /mkha' 'gro srin pos bsad nas su/ /ngu 'bod la 41—698

sogs dmyal bar 'gro/ /shes rab snying rje mi ldan pa/ /gsang sngags la ni 'jug mi bya/ /yan lag dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /rdo rje 1dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur—/ /de bas dam nyams sdig can de'i/ /nyams pas grib ma 'go bas na / /lhan cig gnas par mi bya zhing / /de la snying rje bskyed par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / dpal sangs rgyas thod pa las kyang / re zhig dam tshig nyams pa las/ /dngos grub thob pa lta zhog gi/ /mi yi skye ba'ang rnyed par dka'/ /gang yang bla ma brgyud pa yi/ /rims 'ongs de nyid man ngag ni/ /de yis ji ltar 'grub mnyam dgongs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang /gzhan yang rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams na dper na shing chen po rtsa ba tshig pa'am skams pa'am byegs pa dang 'dra ste/ 'jig rten dang de las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /sgom po'i nyes pa ni sngar bshad pa bzhin du shing chen po'i rīsdong po dang 'dra ste/ 'jig rten gyi dngos grub chen po brgyad mi 'byung ngo / /yan lag gi ltung ba ni shing gi yal ga dang 'dra bar phrin las bzhi'i dngos grub kyi bar du gcod do/ /gzhan yang 'di la g.yel ba dang mchod pa dang gtor ma chags na byin rlabs thuchung ba dang rnal 'byor sngo skams so/ /bla ma'i thugs ma zin zhing bka' bcag na bgegs ldang ngo / /spyod pa rtsing ba dang / bag med na 'byor pa brlag par 'gyur ro/ /gal te dam tshig ma bsrungs kyang bkra shis pa 'dra na yang 'phral du tshe 'di 3la gnod pa med kyang de nyid chad pa chen po 'byung ba'i rtags yin te/ dper na rgyal po'i bka' chad byung na de la zan dang chang mang po blud nas bzi 8bar byas na phyis gsod do/ /dam tshig kha cig legs par bsrungs pa las sdug 41byed699

bsngal dang bar chad mang ba ltar 'dug kyang de tshe rabs snga ma'i las kyi lhag ma lus pa 1yin pas des ni myur du phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro / /gzhan yang dam tshig nyams pa ni tshe 'dir yang bkra mi shis pa mang po 'byung la/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba —brgyad dang / gshis ngan du 'chi ba bcu gnyis kyis 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas shi nas kyang rdo rje 4dmyal bar skyes nas de nas thon pa'i dus med do/ /de la dam tshig ma nyams pa'i phan yon ni/ tshe ring ba dang longs spyod che ba dang ci bsams 5pa 'grub pa dang /mthu dang byin rlabs 6che ba dang bkra shis par 'gyur ro/ /bsgom pa dang bzlas pa dang mchod pa la brtson pas rnal 'byor pa sngo ma skams par longs spyod che ba dang bla ma'i bka' ma bcag cing gus pas bar chad med pa dang rdo rje spun la brtse gdung byas pas mi ma yin rnams kyis bkur snyi byed do/ /g.yo sgyu med pas mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags 'chol bar ma spyad pas 'byor ba brtan pa dang bkra shis so/ /'chi ba'i dus su yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bsu nas rig 'dzin gyi gnas su 'khrid 7do/ /gzhan yang des skye ba 'di dang phyi ma dang skye ba bdun dang skye ba bcu drug tshun chad kyis 'grub pa la the tshom med do/ /de la dam tshig thams cad bsdu na gnyis te/ snying rje rus pa'i gting nas skye ba dang shes rab tshig tsam ma yin pa gting nas go ba'o/ /'di gnyis rgyud la brten na dang po nyid nas nyes pa mi 'byung la gal te byung na yang myur du bskangs par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang dam tshig thams cad ni byang chub kyi sems su 'dus te de yang rnam pa bzhi'o8 / /byang chub kyi sems dang bla na med pa byang chub kyi sems dang kun du bzang po'i 47—700

sems dang rdo rje byang chub kyi sems so/ /de la so sor 1thar pa'i sdom pa ni las dge sdig gtsor ston to/ /mdo sde'i sdom pa ni snying rje gtsor ston to/ /gsang sngags kyi sdom pa ni sku gsung thugs kyi mi phyed pa gtsor ston to/ / de la so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po las skye'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni lhag pa'i bsam pa bzang po las skye'o/ /gsang sngags kyi sdom pa ni rdo rje byang chub kyi sems las skye'o/ /de la so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni spong ba bdun no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni spong ba bcu'o/ /sngags kyi sdom pa ni spong ba gcig go/ /so sor 4thar pa'i gzhung du ni kha na ma tho ba gnyi ga brjod do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzhung du ni rang bzhin 'ba' zhig brjod do/ /sngags kyi gzhung du ni de gnyi ga'i tha snyad ma brjod do/ /yang so sor 5thar pa'i sdom pa ni rdzas kyi bdag nyid du yod par 'dod do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni brtag pa tsam du yod par 'dod do/ /sngags su ni de gnyi ga'i tha snyad ma brjod do/ /yang nyan thos kyi sdom pa la bar chad kyi chos mang du yod do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la bar chad kyi chos nyung zad cig 6go/ /sngags kyi sdom pa la ni bar chad kyi chos bshad pa med do/ /yang sdom pa dang po la ni pham pa byung na phyis blang ba'i skal ba med do/ /bar ma la ni pham pa byung na phyis blang ba'i skal ba yod do/ /tha ma ni rdo rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan na nyams pa med do/ /de la sdom pa dang po la ni mkhan po dang slob dpon dgos so/ /bar ma'i sdom pa la ni bla ma gcig pu'am 3yang na med pa'o/ /tha ma de la ni bzhi ste/bla ma'i zhal nas byung ba'i dbang dang / ye shes lha'i byin gyi rlabs kyi dbang 41byed701

dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan pa'i dbang dang / rang nyid kyi sems kyi rtsal gyis thob pa'i dbang dang ngo / /yang snga ma ni gzhan la gnod pa byed pa las ldog go/ /bar ma ni de'i steng du gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'o/ /phyi ma ni de'i steng du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad spyod nyams su len pa'o/ /yang dang po'i sdom pa ni dgra bcom pa rnams kyi rjes su slob pa'o/ /bar ma'i sdom pa ni sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rjes su slob pa'o/ /sngags kyi sdom pa ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi rjes su slob pa'o/ /yang dang po'i sdom pa ni bdag 'ba' zhig gi don to/ /bar ma'i sdom pa ni gzhan 'ba' zhig gi don to/ /phyi ma'i sdom pa ni gnyi ga'i don to/ /yang dang po'i sdom pa ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mnos 17so/ /bar ma'i sdom pa ni snying po byang chub kyi bar du'o/ /phyi ma'i sdom pa ni nam mkha' ji srid gnas kyi bar du'o/ /sdom pa dang po'i 'bras bu ni mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis so/ /bar ma'i 'bras bu ni sa bcu'am sa bcu gcig pa'o/ /tha ma'i 'bras bu ni sa bcu gnyis pa'o/ /gzhan yang sgom sgrub dang chos spyod yi dam gyi lhas ma khrel ba dang / dad pa dang bsnyen bkur bla mas ma khrel ba dang / dam tshig dang sdom pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis ma khrel ba dang / brtse gdung phan gnod rdo rje spun pho mos ma khrel ba dang / bzlas brjod dang gtor ma dang cho ga'i nus pa dang byin rlabs 4mtshan mo rgyu ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs kyis ma khrel ba dang / rdo rje bla ma'i man ngag zab mi zab rang gi slob mas ma khrel ba dang / lta ba zab mi zab mkhas pa rnams kyis ma khrel ba dang / ji ltar dam bcas pa'i don rang gi sems kyis ma khrel ba dang / spyod pa bzang ngan grogs pos ma khrel ba dang / gtong phod 41—702

dang / gsal 1gshog dang / ro tshong dang / zhi des dang / mthun 'jug 'jig rten gyi mi rnams kyis ma khrel pa'o/ /mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i ting 'dzin bsgom/ /spyod lam rnal 'byor dus su ni/ /phyi nang thams cad gzhan min te/ /sems nyid lha nyid sgyu ma nyid/ /'od gsal yin te mnyam nyid gzhi/ /dag pa bzhi 4yang de nyid yin / /nyin dang mtshan mo rtag 5par ni/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la/ /de ltar mos pa yang yang bya/ /rdo rje shugs dang mi ldan yang / /snang 6ba byin kyis brlabs pa yin/ /de lta bu yi sngags pa ni/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i dogs pa med/ /r+ghaṃ ga lar skyes dge slong ni/ /mar me mdzad dpal ye shes kyis/ /gzhung dang bla ma'i man ngag gis/ /dam tshig thams cad bsdus nas bris/ /dam tshig thams cad bsdus pa zhes bya ba mkhas pa chen po dī paṃ ka 7ra shrī dz+nyā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun bla ma chen po de nyid kyi zhal snga nas dang / lo tsā 8ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //41—703

bsdur mchan/69༷ 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉stanam tshig thams cad bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/691 1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sta ngas 2424༄༅/ /las dang po pa'i dam tshig mdor bsdus pa/3 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ karma pra ma tha sa ma ya sru tra saṃ gra ha/ bod skad du/ las dang po pa'i dam tshig mdor bsdus pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags kyi rnam par thar pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i las dang po pa rnams kyi dam tshig mdor bstan pa/ hūṃ rdor las byung mthing ga'i mdog 'dra ba'i/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas/ /sngags 'chang rnams kyis bsrung ba'i dam tshig ni/ /mdor bsdus brtse ba'i yid kyis bshad par bya/ /sdug bsngal tshogs kyis bsregs pa'i sems can la/ /snying rjer ldan pas 4yongs la khyab pa dang / /g.yo dang mi g.yo'i chos rnams ma skyes par / /rtog 5pa'i shes rab snying rje'i gzhir bya'o/ /rtag tu dad dang brtson 'grus dran pa dang / /shes bzhin ting 'dzin mchog la gnas par bya/ /dang por sngags pas srog gcod rku ba dang / /'khrig dang brdzun 6smra chang 'thung la 41—706

sogs pa'i/ /tshul khrims sngags kyi rtsa bar sangs rgyas gsungs/ /de bas srog bzhin bslab pa bsrung bar bya/ /zhes so/ /yul gangs ri'i rtsa na gnas pa'i slob dpon dz+nyā na bo dhi'i 1mdzad pa'i gsang chen sgon ma'i dam tshig las/nyan thos tshul khrims theg chen sdom pa dang / /sa bdag khrims las 'da' bar mi bya'o/ /zhe'o/ /rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las/ byang chub sems 'dzin gyur nas ni—/ /lha gzhan dag la mi mos dang / /dkon mchog gsum la dad pa dang / /de la gzhol zhing 'bab pa yis/ /gsod dang rku dang 'khrig pa dang / /brdzun dang chang ni rnam par spang / /khyim pa'i tshul du gnas nas ni/ /rig sngags rgyal po bsgrub par bya/ /gal te de ni rab byung na/ /sdom pa gsum la gnas par bya/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'o/ /zhes 'byung bas sdom pa dang dam tshig mtha' dag la gnas par bya'o / /de lta bas na rnal 'byor pas thog mar rig sngags gzung 4ba'i dam tshig la gnas par bya'o/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni sdom pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /de bzhin brtan por gzung 5bar bgyi—/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum / /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi sna/ /slob dpon nyid kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po las/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re 41—707

bzhin du lan drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa las/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po las/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bkyi//mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bkyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gye phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma rgal 1ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba ni bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /mya ngan 'das la sems can dgod/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su / /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag ni rab tu gnas par bgyi/ /lus dang ngag dang yid dag gis / /mi dge ba ni rnam bcu dang / /bag med pa yi gnas byung ba/ /'bru chang bcos pa'i chang dag dang / /theg pa dman la 'dod pa dang / /de bzhin lha dang lha min dang / /gsang ba pa rnams brnyas pa dang / /phyag rgya mtshan ma bzhon 4pa dang / /mtshon cha la sogs 'gom pa rnams/ /dus 'di nyid nas bzung 5nas ni/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag ni rab tu ldog par bgyi'o/ /zhe'o/ /gal te rig sngags gzung ba nyid du nges pas ni/ sdom pa dang dam tshig tshul bzhin 6ma bsrungs na/ 'phags pa rnams bslus pa/ bdag nyid la 'khu 7bar byed pa/ dngos grub chen po la rgyab kyis phyogs pa/ de ni g.yon can shing rul ba lta bu yin no/ /dam tshig la mi gnas par gsang sngags tshig tsam gyis bdag dang gzhan gyi don du las sna tshogs byed pa'o/ /dper na mdze can nang na 'bus rnyings pa la phyi rol 47—708

gyi gos dang rgyan kyis bkab pa lta bu yin no/ /des ni bdag gi don yang bya bar mi nus na gzhan gyi don lta ci smos/ de ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis smod cing bshung ba yin no/ /gsang sngags kyi dngos grub sgrub pa dang /gzhan gyi 1don du dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i las byed pa ni/ dus yun ring por bdag gi sems kyi rgyud sbyangs pa dang / sdom pa dang dam tshig la sngags spyod pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas/ dbe+en par tshul bzhin du las byas nas dngos grub tu yang 'gyur la gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa yang 'grub bo/ /dam tshig spangs te gzu lums su gsang sngags dgongs pas bshad pa'i don/sgra ji bzhin du bzung nas snod min pa'i slob ma dang / grong la sogs par log par spyad na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' rgyud khyad du bsad pas slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / in+d+ra bhū ti 4la sogs pa'i zhal snga nas kyi tshig gi bdud rtsi spangs pa yin pas bdag bde cholegs su 'dod pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis zas dug dang bcas pa bzhin du spang bar bya'o/ /de bas na dngos grub kyi snod du rung ba'i sgrub pa pos/ dang por dam tshig mnos pa nyid nas bzung nas byang chub kyi snying po'i bar du mi nyams par bya'o/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang thob pas ni dam tshig gnyis bsrung 7ste/ bza' ba'i dam tshig dang / bsrung ba'i dam tshig go/ /de la bza' ba'i dam tshigadā /ga bur mtshal 9dang pi pi ling / /tsan+dan dmar dang gur gum sogs/ /man ngag bzhin du sgrub pa pos/ /rtag tu bsten snacing bza' bar bgyi/ /bsrung ba dag gi dam tshig ni/ /rang lus phyag rgya nyid bsgoms la/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i tshogs bsam bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon rdo rje rnams/ /rdo rje de ni spun rnams la/ /gtso dang sems 41—709

dpa' bskyed par bya/ /'di ni sku yi dam tshig ste/ /tshul khrims bsrung la brtson par bya/ /sred 'byung ngag gi skyon spangs te/ /rig sngags lha yi snying po dang / /rdo rje phra sogs rtse gcig pas/ /rgyun mi 'chad par bzlas par bya//de ni gsung 1gi dam tshig ste / /rtag tu 'di las 'da' mi bya/ /rgyun du ting 'dzin gnyis po dang / /spyod bzhin dran pas zin par bya/ /thun mong ma yin gsang chen dang / /man ngag gzhan du mi spel lo/ /lta dang spyod dang lha dag dang / /slob dpon mchog gnyis gsang ba ste/ /'di dag gsang chen gzhan du min/ /'di dag thugs kyi dam tshig go/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba 'di/ /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo / /rgyal bas dgongs te gsungs pa yi / /dam tshig bzhi la gnas par bya/ /ji bzhin don ldan bcu bzhi ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu bsgrags/ /spang zhing 'dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i thong bar shes par bya/ /slob dpon la ni brnyas pa dang / /bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa dang / /sdang bas spun gyi sngags 4min smra/ /byams pa chen po rnam spong dang / /byang chub sems ni 'dor ba dang / /theg pa gsum la smod pa dang / /skal min gsang ba sgogs pa dang / /rgyal ba'i bdag nyid phung po smod/ /dam pa'i chos la yid gnyis za/ /gdug la byams dang chags bral dang / /chos la gnyis su 'byed pa dang / /dad pa'i sems la rab tu smod / /dam tshig bsten pa ji snyed pa/ /brtags pa'i rig ma smod pa ste/ /rtsa ba'i ltung bar 'gyur ba des/ /sngags pa'i dam tshig zad par 'gyur/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin ni bzla bar bya/ /gal te nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /dam tshig dang ni 41—710

mi ldan pa'i/ /rig ma bsten par dga' ba dang / /tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod pa dang / /gsang ba'i chos ni ston pa dang / /sems can dad dang ldan pa la/ /dam chos gzhan du ston pa dang / /nyan thos dag tu zlas byed pa'i/ /nang du zhag bdun 'dug kyipa dang / /sbyor ba nges par ma byas pa'i/ /snod min gsang ba ston pa rnams/ /kha na ma tho bcas 'gyur te/ /sngags pa de yi dam tshig zad/ /zad pas 'grub par mi 'gyur zhing / /bdud dang sdug bsngal rab tu 'phel/ /zhe'o/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang thob pas kyang dam tshig rnams/ dang po thob pa nyid nas byang chub chen po'i bar du yang dag par gzung ngo / /gal te nyams par byas na don dam par bsrung du med pa dang /dgongs pa'i don gyi tshig gi gzugs brnyan la brten nas dam tshig mi bsrung bar gzu lums su dkyil 'khor la sogs pa byed pa ni 'phags pa dang 'gro ba kun bslus pa ste/ yon tan de gsang sngags seng ge'i 'o ma lta bu skye bo snod dang mi ldan pa'i mi la bstan pa dang / dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i las byas pas sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i 'gro ba'i skye ba dang / bdag dang gzhan rlag par byed pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la rgyab kyis phyogs pa de nam du yang dngos grub kyi snod du mi 'gyur ba yin no/ /de lta bas na dam tshig rnams lus dang srog la ltos pa med par bsrung bar bya'o/ /dam tshig nyams pa gso ba ni gnang ste/ thun mtshams sbyor ba las gyur na/ /bde gshegs las rigs bsam gtan gyis/ /de yi nyes pa bsal bar bya/ /gser sbyangs dri med lta bur 'gyur/ /sbyor ba'i yan lag sbom nyams na/ /mchod pa la sogs tshul bzhin bya/ /'phags la bzod gsol dam bcas na/ /41—711

phyin chad bsdams te gus par blang / /rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid las/ /dang por rigs bdag dkyil 'khor du/ /tshul bzhin yang dag blang bar bya/ /de ltar ma bshags par blangs pas nyams pa khyad du gsod cing de'i nyes pa 'phel ba dang bcas par gyur na skyon che ste/gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /de bzhin chos kyi sems dpa' dang / /rmongs pa 'gal bar byas nas 1ni/ /tshal par 'gas par gdon mi za/ /zhe'o/ /de lta bas na sangs rgyas dbu 'gas na mi rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ dam tshig nyams pas thuni bdag nyid dang / gzhan phyogs su yang nyes pa sna tshogs su 'byung la/ phyi mar yang bskal pa gsum la sogs par ngan 'gor 'gro'o/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhes bya ba shes rab kyi rgyud chen po las/ dam tshig med cing ngan spyod pa/ /bslus 'gyur ngan pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis zos nas kyang / /de las nga ni skyob mi byed/ /gsang ba pa yi nang nas ni//sgrub pa po de phyugs dang 'dra/ /zhe'o/ /bla ma lnga bcu pa las kyang / slob dpon la ni smod pa de/ /yams dang 'tshe ba'i nad rnams dang / /gdon dang rims dang dug rnams kyis/ /rmongs chen de ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po me dang sbrul gdug dang / /chu dang mkha' 'gro rkun po dang / /gdon dang log 'dren rnams kyis kyang / /bsad nas sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /nam yang slob dpon dag gi ni/ /kun du sems dkrugs mi bya ste/ /gal te rmongs pas byed 'gyur na/ /dmyal bar nges par 'tshed par nges/ /mnar med la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i/ /dmyal ba bsten pa gang yin pa/ /slob 4 7—712

dpon la ni smod pa dag /der ni gnas par yang dag bshad/ /zla gsang thig le'i rgyud las kyang / /dam tshig sdom pa nyams pa las/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /byin gyis brlabs par mi mdzad de/ /spos dang me tog la sogs pa/ /phul yang bzhes par mi 'gyur te/ /nad dang dug dang dgra rnams kyis/ /bsad nas sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhe'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par spyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog las kyang / dam tshig 'di las 'das gyur na/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje 'dzin/ /lha rnams dang ni mi dag dang //sgrub pa po dang rnal 'byor bcas/ /de dag la 1ni snying ring nas/ /snying nas khrag chen drangs nas 'thung / /zhe'o/ /yang de nyid las/ dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang / /dam tshig rnam par spangs pa dang / /gsang ba yang dag mi shes pas/ /bsgrubs kyang ci yang mi 'grub po/ /zhe'o/ /phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba spyod pa'i rgyud las/ dam tshig 'di las su 'da' dang / /sdang sems ldan pa de dag ni/ /mgo ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje rnams kyis rtag tu 'gems/ /zhe'o/ /yang mtshams med lnga byas pa'i sdig pa ni bla'i/ gsang sngags log par spyod pa ni de lta ma yin no/ /gzhan las ni / dam tshig 'di las su 'da' ba/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du ni/ /mnar med shin tu mi bzad sogs/ /bcu drug dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur/ /zhe'o—/ /ye shes grub pa las ce/ dam tshig nyams pa sdug bsngal zhing / /lus dang de bzhin yid dang ni/ /de yi yon tan nyams 'gyur zhing / /myur ba nyid du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /shi nas dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ /bskal pa 41—713

bye ba brgya phrag tu/ /myong nas gnas las 1'pho 'gyur bas/ /gdol pa'am dman pa'i rigs su skye/ /lpags par skye 'am yang na 'on par skye/ /zhe'o/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud las/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed/ /ce'o/ /dpal mchog dang po'i rgyud las kyang /drag po'i dam tshig mdung rtse dang / /ma mo rnams kyis rgyas 'debs pas/ /gal te 'das na khyod kyi snying / /rtag tu 'jigs par byed par 'gyur/ /zhe'o//gal te dam tshig 'di las 'das gyur na/ /pha gsod 'gro ba yin pa dang / /ma gsod pa yi 'gro ba gang / /'gro ba der ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas/ dam tshig nyams na skyon che bas na lus dang srog gi phyir yang mi gtang bar bsrung bar bya'o/ /sdom pa dang dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung ba yang don che ste/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud las kyang /'gro ba'i don dang de don du/ /dam tshig sdom pa bsrung byas nas/ /bsod nams gtsang sbra las byung gang / /bsgrub pa'i yon tan rgya chen po/ /stong phrag brgya yi kha min par/ /kha cig gis kyang brjod mi nus/ /zhe'o/ /gzhan las ni/ dam tshig sdom pa 'di rnams kun/ /tshul bzhin bsrung dang sgrub pa yis / /rgyal ba thams cad mnyes gyur nas/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhe'o/ /dam tshig rnams ni rdo rje ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid yin/ /zhe'o/ /phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba spyod pa'i rgyud las kyang / sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcas pa yis/ /brtul zhugs dang ni tshul khrims dang / /spyod pa bzlas pa'i gzhi rnams la/ /gal te gnas na de yi tshe/ /sngags pas 'di ltar sngags bsgrub po/ /zhe'o/ /slob dpon rdo 47—7/4

rje bzhad 1pa'i sgrub thabs las/ sngags pas rnam pa 'di dag gis/ /dam tshig sdom pa bsrung byas na/ /tshe 'di nyid la dngos grub kyis/ /rdo rje gsung nyid thob par 'gyur/ /zhe'o/ /gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las kyang / gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed kyi bskal par byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 'bad cing btsal yang byang chub sems dpar mi 'gyur te/ gsang ba 'dus pa la dga' zhing de'i dam tshig la gnas shing bsgrubs na tshe 'di nyid la mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul dra ba zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las/ dbang po gnyis ni mnyam spyor te/ /lus dang ngag dang sems bsdus nas/ /nga yi snyam pa'i gzi bskyed gzugs/ /rnam pa kun gyis rnam brgyan na/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa de tshe 2la/ /ye shes rdzogs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhe'o/ /gzhung gzhan las thabs kyi dam tshig thams cad la spyod cing mi nyams par bsrungs la/ shes rab kyis bsrung du med par shes pa ni rnal 'byor pa mchog ces bya'o/ /gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las/ rnam par mi rtog las byung ba'i/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rigs/ /theg pa mchog 'di bla med pa/ /mchog tu blar gyur sgrub par byed/ /rigs ngan sme gesha can la sogs/ /gsod pa don du gnyer ba rnams—/ /theg pa bla na med pa yi/ /theg mchog 'di la 'grub par 'gyur/ /mtshams med pa la sogs pa yi zhi/ /sems can dag gis bsgrubs 6na 'grub/ /srog gcod pa yi sems can rnams/ /brdzun du smra bar dad pa dang / /gzhan gyi nor la chags pa dang / /rtag tu 'dod la spyod pa dag /de dag bsgrub pa'i snod du 'gyur/ /zhe'o/ /ye shes grub pa las/ de ltar gnas 41—715

pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /yar ngo'i zla ba ji bzhin du/ / rim gyis 1yang dag 'phel 'gyur gyi / /nam yang 'grib par mi 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus dman pa la la zhig /sangs rgyas thob par ma gyur kyang / /'khor los sgyur rgyal bde ba ni/ /skye ba kun du thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bsod nams ni/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum yod pa rnams/ /de yi ba spu'i khung bu zhes//rgyal ba mchog gis rab tu gsungs/ /zhe'o/ /le'u brgyad pa las/ sems can kun kyi gnyen gcig pas/ /rnam pa slu ba med pa'i sems/ /de bas brtan pa bskyed par bya/ /'di byas pa yis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dgyes pa'i bdag nyid can kun mnyes/ /bdud dang bgegs la sogs pa yang / /glags skabs tshol bar mi byed cing / /phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa/ /dgyes pas 4rtag tu bsrung ba 5mdzad/ /ce'o/ /gzhan las ni/ stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che sna bdun gyis bkang ste 'phags pa rnams la phul ba bas/ gang gis dam tshig la yang dag par gnas te 'du 'dzi spangs te dgon pa la gnas nas skad cig tsam ting nge 'dzin gnyis kyis 5mnyam par gzhag 7na de gnyis las mnyam par gzhag bhepa de bsod nams kyi phung bo dpag tu med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dang / dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po mtshan gyis brgyan pa ni gling bzhi la dbang ba'i mthu yod cing chos kyi 'khor lo shesnasgyur to/ /de bzhin du rgyal ba'i sras dam tshig dang sdom pa la yang dag par gnas pa'i mtshan gyis brgyan pa ni ring por mi thogs 1 par skye ba bdun la sogs pas 1 'tshang rgya zhing / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad byed pa yin no/ /yang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po ni su'i spyi gtsug na yod pa la 41—716

'gro ba gang gis kyang bar mi chod snado/ /de bzhin du sngags pa gang zhig sdom pa dang dam tshig gi nor bus sgo gsum brgyan pa la bdud la sogs pa gang gis kyang bar du mi chod do/ /yang skyes bu mig dang rkang par ldan pa ni gang 'gro ba'i gnas su phyin cing dgos pa thams cad sgrub par byed do/ /mnyam pa'i dam tshig mig dang 'dra ba dang spyod pa'i dam tshig rkang pa dang 'dra ba la brten te ye shes kyi lam drang 1du zhugs pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i nor bu blangs te/bdag dang gzhan kyi don lhun gyis grub par byed par 'gyur ro/ /yang dper na ri'i rgyal po gangs la sman 'bral bar dka' ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de gang gis rnyed pa de ni dug dang nad la sogs pa rtsa ba nas 'byin cing tshe ring ba yang 'grub bo/ /de bzhin du rdo rje slob dpon gyi thugs nor bu rin po che'i nor bu blangs te/ las dang skal ba dang ldan pa gang zhig dam tshig rnams kyi sman thob pas 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i bag chags dang nyon mongs pa'i nad thams cad zhi zhing byang la bla na med pa'i byang chub ma thob kyi bar du mi 'chi ba'i tshe yang 'thob bo/ /dper na ded dpon bsod nams kyis 4gzi brjid dang thabs dang ldan pas rgya mtsho chen por zhugs te/ rin po che'i gling du phyin te nor bu rin po che blangs nas bdag dang gzhan la phan 'dogs so/ /de bzhin du dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'gro ba 'khor ba las 'don pa'i ded dpon la brten te/ tshul khrims dang dam tshig tu sbyar nas thabs la mkhas pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi skya ba bskyod nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral te/ dngos grub rnam pa gsum gyi nor bu blangs te/ bdag dang gzhan la phan 'dogs so/ /de lta bas na 5rnal 'byor pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes bsgrub par 'dod pa 41—717

dag gis dam tshig dang sdom pa mtha' dag tshul bzhin bsrungs la/ rgyud dang sgrub thabs dang mthun par dgongs pa'i gnas su nam lhun gyis grub pa'i bar du/rdo shing ngam ri dwags shi ba'i ro bzhin du gnas te bsgrub par bya'o/ /bdag nyid dran gso rnal 'byor pa la phan gdags phyir/ /rgyud dang sgrub thabs dag las dam tshig mdor bsdus pas/ /'phags dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gnong ste bzod par gsol/ /des ni 'jig rten gsum bcas rdo rje 'dzin thob shog /dbang pos mtshan pa'i yul gyi 1rtsa na gnas pa'i slob dpon dz+nyā na bo dhis mdzad pa / las dang po pa'i dam tshig mdor bsdus pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar kyi mkhan po ka ma la gup+ta dang / lo tsā ba bsod nams rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //bldur mchan/7༷6 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ra las dang po pa'i dam tshig mdor bsdus pa ye shes byang chub kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pa// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'i/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉staXgs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skadan/7༷7 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga twas/ 〈〈snar 〉ra 'i/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stab/ zu zhe〈〈snar 〉ra zung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ 7〈〈snar 〉thazung /7༷8 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgral/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tham/ ཿ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/ sngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazhom/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 du/ 7(〈pe 〉torakhru/7༷9 sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ — sna〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra / —〈〈pe 〉7pa'i/ 5〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉shes rnyi/ de〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7bde/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ 7〈〈pe 〉thasrungs/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ni/ (〈〈pe 〉skaratshal/ 〈〈snar 〉tharten/71༷ 1〈〈pe 〉sngagasungs/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag/ snye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thader/ je(〈pe 〉〉〈'a ra 〉thasngags/41—718

711 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torajug 2〈〈pe 〉〉srung /712 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉nga/713 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉drang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 babs ni/714 1〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉rgyu/ da〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉btang / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 par/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉(pe05—/715 1〈〈pe 〉togazhad/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉za de/ 〈〈pe 〉〉bsrungs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉(spub/ / 6〈〈/dibasdo 〉〉ba/sdib/716 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rims kyis/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ ni〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉par/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ )8〈〈co 〉〉bzhag 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sor/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉thog11〈〈bya/bang 〉〉pa/717 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cad/ lha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gsang / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉bon/718 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma'i yul gyithab/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2351)41wa 719

༄/ /sdom gsum 'od kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ sgo༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ tri sasba ra pra bhā mā khā nā ma/ bod skad du/sdom gsum 'od kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag zab yangs shes bya'i rgya mtsho las/ /bstan pa'i gru dang bdag blo'i ded dpon gyis/ /mkhyen pa'i dar 'phyar brtse ba'i rlung bskyod nas//sdom gsum yid bzhin nor bu kho bos blang / /ding sang bstan pa'i gsham 'di ru/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag la/ /mkhas pa'i rgyu skar 'ba' 2zhig gis/ /phyogs re'i cha tsam rtogs 'gyur mod/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa la/ /'thob tshul gnas tshul gtong ba'i tshul/ /gnyis ldan gsum ldan 'thad pa'i gzhung / /nyes pa phan yon rim pa dag /bdag blo nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs las rgyal bar byas te dgod/ /gling gsum skyes pa bud med kyis/ /rang nyid 41—720

'khor ba bsgral don du/ /mkhan slob cho ga tshad ldan las/ /ji srid 'tsho yi bar dag tu/ /gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las/ /gtso cher lus ngag sdom pa de/ /nyan thos bye brag smra ba'i sdom/ /gang zag glang bu 'dra ba la/ /sdom pa khal dang 'dra ba zhig /thob pa'i thag pas sbrel bas na1/ /so sor thar pa'i gnas tshul yin/ /bslab pa phul dang shi 'phos dang / /mtshan gnyis 2dag ni byung ba dang / /rtsa ba chad dang mtshan 'das las/ /so sor thar pa'i 'dul ba gtang / /gsungs so pham pa spyad pas kyang / /so sor thar pa'i tshul yin no/ /lha mi la sogs gang rung gis/ /'gro ba ma lus bskyab 4pa'i phyir/ /slob dpon cho ga tshad ldan las/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /smon dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can/ /lus ngag yid gsum rang don dang / /gzhan don thabs ma yin las sdom/ /kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi'o/ /de nyid snang la rang bzhin med/ /'jigs 5sogs bzhin du goms pa las/ /yul dang yul can gnyis las grol/ /don dam byang chub sems yin no/ /sems dang sems byung sems bskyed gnyis/ /rang don gza' 7dang bral bas na / /nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin/ /de dag gnas pa'i tshul yin no/ /rang don blangs dang nag po yi/ /chos bzhi la sogs zhugs pa dang / /'bras bu dag ni thob pa na/ /tsha grang grub 8bzhin sems bskyed gtong / /rigs bzhi la sogs bsod 9nams ldan/ /rang gzhan dgos 'dod phun tshogs don/ /bla ma cho ga tshad ldan las/ /nam mkha' ji srid gnas bar du/ /lhan skyes ye shes brda don sprod/ /rnam rtog dri ma kun las sdom/ /11—721

/de ——rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rgyal mtshan la/ /rim gnyis yid bzhin nor gyis spras/ /'dod yon lnga yis kun nas mchod/ /dgos 'dod kun gyi 'byung gnas sa/ /rig 'dzin sdom pa'i gnas tshul yin/ /dgos 'dod med do skyon rnams 'byung / /dpag bsam shing bu 'gyel ba ltar/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung ba na/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa gtong / /rgyud ni sum brgya pa las ni/ /'khor bzhi po la rjes su gnang / /rang gi bslab pa dang yang ldan/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bya/ /gsungs so dus kyi 'khor lo las/ /rten ni gsum las dge slong mchog /'bring ni dge tshul yin par 'dod/ / khyem na gnas pa tha ma'o/ /1gzhan yang rdo rje rtse mo las/ /gal te de ni rab byung na/ /sdom pa gsum dang yang dag ldan/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'o/ /gzhung 'bum pa las 'di skad du/ /rdo yi rigs kyi bye brag bzhu/ /lcags dang zangs dang dngul du 'byung / /gser 'gyur rtsi yi dngos po yis/ /kun kyang gser du 'gyur ba bzhin/ / de bzhin sems kyi bye brag gis/ / rigs can gsum gyi sdom pa yang / /dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes bya'o/ /gsungs pa'i don la 'ga' zhig ni/ /sdom gsum gnas gyur ngo bo gcig /gong ma'i rtsa lhang byung ba na/ /'og ma gtong zhes sgogs pa yod/ /de la cung zhig brtag par bya/ /gsum ldan gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'i don/ /gcig ldan spong ba'i dgongs pa min/ /rigs pas kyang ni shin tu gnod/ /bud med la smod ltung ba yis/ /reg srung sdom pa 47—722

gtong ngam ci/ /gal te gtong na ha cang thal/ /mkha' la sprin chen 'khrigs rtapa yis/ /sa yi lo tog skam zhes bsgre/ /gzhan yang sdom pa gtong thob rgyu/ /sangs rgyas gsung las gzhan pa yi/ /cho ga mkhan du byed rigs sam/ /gzhan yang 'gal ba ltag sprod la/ /gnas gyur brtsi ba'i rigs ma yin/ /rigs na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /gaṅgā'i chu las gyur zhes bgre/ /des na rang gis brtags la blang / /sdom gsum ldan zhes gsungs pa de/ /shes rgyud gcig la brtsi na ni/ /gcig tu 'dod kyang gsum du 'gyur/ /ldan chos rdzas gzhan tha dad phyir/ /'on te snga phyi la brtsi na/ /gsum ldan zhes pa'i sgra don med/ /'on te sdom gsum rdzas gcig tu/ /shes rgyud gcig la ldan zhe na/ /gtong thob cho ga gcig tu 'gyur/ /des na so sor thar ldan pas / /byang chub mchog gi sems blangs na/ /dang po de ni kun gzhi la/ /bag la nyal ba'i tshul du gnas/ /rig 'dzin sdom pa thob pa na/ /'og ma gnyis ka bag la nyal/ /dper na mkha' la skar ma shar/ /cung zad snang bar byas gyur mod/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shar ba'i tshe/ /skar 'od nyams mod 'jig rten gsal/ /rta bdun tsha zer byung ba na/ /zla ba'i 'od nyams 'jig rten gsal/ /gal te rig pa 'dzin pa yis/ /gdul bya gang la gang don du/ /'og ma'i sdom pa blangs pa na/ /gong ma zil gyis mi non mod / /sdom pa cho gas 'thob pa yin/ /mkha' la nyi ma gnas gyur mod/ /zla 4skar 'char ba bkag pa med/ /des thob tshul dang gtong ba'i tshul/ /rang rang cho ga bzhin du gnas/ /kun gzhi bag chags mang po can/ /yin yang shes rgyud tha dad med/ /'og ma'i be+eng ba byung gyur mod/ /gong ma ji 41—723

srid gnas kyi bar/ /rnam par smin pas gos pa med/ /dper na zla skar nub gyur mod/ /nyi ma mkha' la gnas kyi bar/ /cung zad 'grib par byas pa med/ /gong ma'i ltung ba byung ba na/ /'og ma ji ltar gnas gyur kyang / /cung zad phan gyi skyob mi nus/ /rta bdun tsha zer nub pa 1na/ /zla skar gnas kyang mun pa'i bag /gser 'gyur rtsi zhes gsungs pa'i don/ /zil gnon yon tan mchog la dgongs/ /zla skar gnyis kyi 'od zer yang / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gnas kyi bar/ /nyi ma'i 'od ces kun gyis sgogs/ /gzhan yang kha cig sdom pa gsum/ /sa chu gru 'dra gzhi rten du/ /'dod ces sgrogs pa 'khrul pa yin/ /de yi 'khrul gzhi kho bos bstan/ /mkhas pa chen po rta dbyangs dang / /slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje sogs/ /sdom gsum de nyid rig pa yis/ /don de ldog pa du mas phye/ /khyab bya khyab byed gsungs pa la/ /rten dang brten par byed na 'khrul/ /byang sems sdom pa'i don gcig la/ /phan sgrub sgrub pa'i ldog pa dang / /gnod spong dgag pa gnyis 'dug mod/ /phan sgrub ngo bo gang yin la/ /gnod pa spong ba khyab pas na/ /khyab bya khyab byed dzas gcig tu/ /ba lang rjis kyang mi go'am/ /des na rig 'dzin gcig pu la/ /gsum ldan sbyor ba 'thad ma yin/ /gal te 'thad na 'og ma gnyis/ /cho ga mi dgos skye bar 'gyur/ /sdom gsum cho ga thun mong du / /thub pa chen pos gsungs pa med/ /phrag dog nor 'dod gti mug can / /rang bzo byed pa su yis khegs/ /mdo rgyud srungs kyang phyogs su 'phen / /sgra tshad byung na gtam gzhan sgyur/ /bstan pa'i byi dor ji ltar bya/ /rig 'dzin sdom pa kho na bas/ /gsum ldan sngags —pa'i dgongs pa ni/ /41—724

'bras bu'i sgo nas ma yin te/ /yin na kun mkhyen mchog dman 'gyur/ /des na lam dus gdul bya'i don/ /gcig dang gsum gyi khyad par dang / /sdom pa rdzas chos gzhan nyams mod/ /gzhan yod pa yi khyad par yin/ /sdom gsum gang yang mi ldan na/ /lha mi'i lus kyang rnyed par dka'1/ /nyams na mthong chos rnam smin gyi/ /rim pa gnyis kyis bstan par bya/ /de las so thar nyams gyur na/ /rang gis rang bslus gnod pa nyung / /rgyal dang de sras thams cad kyis/ /cung zad khrel gyi shin tu min/ /pham pa lci yang bye brag gis/ /lo grangs ngan song gsum du gnas/ /byang sems nyams na 'gro ba kun/ /bslus pas gnod pa shin tu mang / /rgyal dang de sras thams cad dang / /'gro ba kun kyis shin tu khrel/ /pham pa lci yang bye brag gis/ /bskal pa'i grangs kyis dmyal bar gnas/ /rig 'dzin sdom pa nyams pas ni/ /yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs can/ /rgyal dang de sras kun brnyas pas/ /mi 'jig mnar med gnas dag tu/ /sdug bsngal chen po de yis myong / /rtsa ba kun nyams phyal ba dag /gso la nye bar mi brtson na/ /rdo rje dmyal bar de ltung ste/ /dmyal ba phal 2pa thams cad kyi / /sdug bsngal gcig tu bsdoms pa bas/ /de yi 'bum gyi char mi phod/ /'jig rten 'jig na gzhan du 'pho/ /se gol gcig gis phyin par byed/ /sangs rgyas stong gi 4'od zer dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i phrin las kun/ /rgyun du mdzad kyang phan mi 'gyur/ /bskal pa ther 'bum la sogs su/ /de ni thon par ma gsungs so/ /47—725

so sor thar pa'i phan yon ni/ /gnas skabs lha mi mthar thug gisna / /dgra bcom 'bras bu nges par 'thob/ /byang chub sems kyi phan yon ni/ /gnas skabs bde mang ring mo na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'grub/ /rgyas par mdo sde blta bar byos/ /rig 'dzin sdom pa'i phan yon ni/ /gnas skabs kun mkhyen bde longs spyod / /gal te bsgom pa dang bcas na/ /tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /ma bsgoms gyur kyang ltung med na/ /skye ba bcu drug nyid na'o/ /mkhyen brtse dung phyur ldan pa yi/ /phan chen blo yi rgya mtsho las/ /sdom gsum nor bu'i phreng ba blangs/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus kyi/ /blo gros gtsug la legs gnas te/ /kun mkhyen dgos 'dod spyod par shog /rgya gar shar phyogs dzā ga ta la'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bi bhū ti tsan+d+ras mdzad de rang 'gyur du mdzad pa rdzogs so// //47—726

2426༄༅/ /rdo rje rjag pa rtsa ba'i 1nga ba'i las kyi cho ga 1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yā na mū lā pat+t+waṃ karma bi byeḥ / bod skad du/ rdo rje theg pa rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i las kyi cho ga /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor pa yis dpyad bya ba/ /las kyi cho ga 'di ltar mdzod/ /spyi bo nyi zla pad steng du—/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bsams 5byas te/ /rtag tu dran dang gsol gdab bya/ /srog gcod brdzun dang ma byin len/ /'dod pas log par g.yem pa ni/ /ci la bab kyang bsrung bar bya/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba ni/ /lus grib bzhin du 'bral mi bya/ /bum pa'i dbang thob gyur nas ni/ /lha dang bzlas pa rnal 'byor dang / /phyag 'tshal mchod dang sdig bshags dang / /rjes su yi rang bskor 6dang gsol/ /dge bsngo sdom pa byul ba dang / /sbyin pa bla ma dran dang chos/ /dam tshig rnam pa bco lnga 'di/ /47—728

nyin re thebs re ma byas na/ /zhag gsum 'das na bum dbang gi/ /dam tshig nyams pas bshags par bya/ /de yang brgya pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ /bzlas te phyis ni mi nyams bya/ /gsang ba'i dbang thob rnal 'byor pas/ /mi 'chi lnga dang sgon ma lnga/ /rlung dang lta stangs 'khrul 'khor dang / /tshogs dang gtor ma brtul zhugs dang / /glu dang gar dang ni ram̐ shu/ /dam tshig rnam pa bcu gcig po/ /zla ba phyed du bral gyur na/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig nyams par gsungs—/ /nyams na tshogs 'khor sbyin sreg bya/ /gsum pa'i dbang thob rnal 'byor pas/ /bde ba thig le rtsa gnas dang / /mi 'dzag bde ba skad cig dang / /phyag rgya ma dang sbyor ba dang / /zla ba gcig bral nyams par gsungs/ /dbang dang sbyin sreg bshags pa bya/ /bzhi pa'i dbang thob rnal 'byor pa/ /spang blang rtsol dang dngos dang zhen/ /skad cig skyes kyang nyams pas na/ /mi dmigs bde chen spros bral gzhag /dbang bzhi spyi yi dam tshig ni/ /rgya mtsho'i dkyil du gzings mi bshig /btsan dug gar ma bza' mi bya/ /'thab khang rtse nas dbab mi bya/ /za ma tog tu sbrul mi gzhug /pad+ma sad kyis bsad mi bya/ /g.yos legs gzhan la drang mi bya/ /de drug rdo rje dmyal ba'i rgyurte/ /rgyal khrims bshig par mi bya zhing / /chung ma nyams par mi bya'o/ /pha ma btsongs nas rin mi bza'/ /me mdag 'gam par mi bya'o/ /'di bzhi ngan song gsum gyi rgyu/ /spu gri'i sbrang rtsi bldag mi bya/ /g.yos 'gyed bza' ru phyog mi bya/ /sman zos mi gseb sgyug mi bya/ /ri rab rtse nas brnyil mi bya/ /gnyen la snying ring twemi bya'o/ /de lta sems can dmyal ba'i rgyu/ /ma bu 'bral ba'i las mi bya/ /gdung 41—729

sems thag pa rgyun mi gcad/ /chu zla bden par gzung mi bya/ /sbrang rtsi'i ro la chags mi bya/ /'di bzhi khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyusna/ /dug chu khol mar lus mi bkru/ /rtsi dug sbyar ba'i dug mi bldag /rdza snod seng ge'i zho mi bzho / /chang rdza'i jem bu gtang mi bya/ /de bzhi byol song phag gi rgyu/ /'dir yang tshe thung dngos grub 'gyang / /mthon po'i kha nas ldang mi bya/ /chags mi gseb bcag mi bya'o3sna/ /ga zha gzhan la brjod mi bya/ /lam du tsher ma dgram mi bya/ /'di ni rang ngan sgrub pa'i rgyu/ /lce thog zas zhim bskyur 4mi bya/ /mdzod phugs dgra la bstan mi bya/ /rkun 5nor gzhan la bstan mi bya//ser ra'i ro tshogs mi bya zhing / /mi la nga ba mi shes min/ /khyi rgod pang du blang mi bya/ /'di drug dngos grub yal ba'i rgyu/ /lha khang dud pas mi bdug cing / /mchod rten bshig par mi bya'o/ /'di gnyis dman pa'i byang chub rgyu/ /me long g.ya' yis mi bsgo zhing / /khab rtse gnyis pas btsem mi bya/ /'di gnyis bdud kyis 'khyer treba'i rgyu/ /dug gi phyag tshang mi bya zhing / /stag la zhum 7bu mi bya'o/ /'di gnyis mkha' 'gros za ba'i rgyu/ /nam mkha' tshos kyis bsgyur mi bya/ /ri bong rwas phug 'jigs byemi bya/ /'di gnyis 'khor bar sdod pa'i rgyu tsho/ /myu gu than par bskur mi bya/ /lcug phran rtswa gug byeg mi bya/ /'gro ba'i lam sna dgag mi bya/ /'di gsum ngan song bsgyur 6ba'i rgyu//mchog la dman par gzung mi bya/ /byams tshig khyad du gsad mi bya/ /dgos pa yal bar dor mi bya/ /'di gsum gtan gyi bar chod yin/ /bde la skur pa gdab mi bya/ /ma la ngan tshig smra mi bya/ /bu mo sring mo skyi mi bya/ /'di gsum mkha' 'go 'khrug pa'i rgyu/ /las kyi cho ga 'di rnams las/ /'gal na 41—730

rtsa ba'i thong bar 'gyur/ /ltung ba chen po byung gyur na/ /dbang sgogs bdun dang sbyin sreg khri/ /tshogs 'khor brgya rtsa brgyad dang ni/ /'khor gsum yongs su dag pas bshags/ /ltung ba bzhi po byung gyur na/ /dbang bsgur gcig dang sbyin sreg brgya/ /tshogs 'khor bdun dang mchod sbyin gcig /smre sngags drag bos bshags par bya/ /ltung ba chung ngu byung gyur na/ /lus la tshab ma smre bshags bya/ /maṇ+ḍal gcig dbul bzod gsol bya/ /brgya pa bdun nam nyi shu gcig /bzlas pas de las ldang ba yin/ /ngag la rgyal dang smre bshags bya/ /maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing bzod gsol bya/ /brgya pa brgya rtsa brgyad dang ni/ /lnga bcu nyer gcig bdun dag dang / /lan cig 1brjod pas 'dag par gsungs/ /yid la 'gyod dang maṇ+ḍal dang / /brgya pa gong bzhin bzlas pas 'dag /kun kyi kha skong gtor ma dang / /maṇ+ḍal bdun po rnam dag shis/ /brgya pa rtag tu bzlas par bya/ /yan lag dam tshig ces bya ba/ /sngags med btsan dug bza' mi bya/ /rtsi med ri mo bkru mi bya/ /stobs med ral kha sprad mi bya/ /tshod med zhal che 2bcad mi bya/ /dpung med skyel ma mi bya ste/ /rgyus med sa mkhan mi bya'o/ /yang rtsal med par mchong mi bya / /dga' ba'i sa ru shags 'gyed min/ /bye ma'i ri la mkhar mi brtsig /rgya mtsho'i gling du yul mi gzung / /tsan+dan nags la me mi gzhug— /me tog ldum sar 7sad mi bsad/ /rgyal pos zhwa'abangs kyi g.yog mi bya/ /rang gi las la g.yo mi bya/ /rgyal po btsun mo brdeg mi bya/ /'dod la mi ster spang bar bya/ /mi 'dod ster ba spang bar bya/ /lcags sgog 7bcing bar mi bya'o/ /byes pa rnams dang 'dris mi bya/ /mgyogs ne+epo 'gran bang mi bya'o/ /g.yang 41—731

lug 1rtag tu 'go mi bya/ /stan la 'dug pa spang bar bya/ /mtshon cha'i snod kha dam par bya/ /rtag tu mda' ni bsrang bya zhing / /rtag tu gzhu ni bdung bar bya/ /rtag tu phub gzugs bya ra bya/ /mkhar dpe stod kyin 'obs btsang bya / /shi ba'i ro la yang yang brtag /rang gi srog zon dus drug bya/ /mdor na de la sogs pa yi/ /dam tshig dpag tu med mod kyang / /rang sems drang por bsrang byas te/ /rtag tu bla ma dran byed cing / /sgo gsum tha mal ma lus na/ /dam tshig sdom pa thams cad ni/ /gdon mi za bar bsrung bar nges/ /bag yangs chen po ci bder spyod/ /dam tshig dang sdom pa'i rnam par bshad pa rdo rje theg 4pa'i rtsa ba'i las kyi cho ga rnal 'byor gyi srog ces bya ba bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po a bh+ya ka ra gup+ta dang bod kyi lo tsā ba tsa ltami sangs rgyas grags pas glen skad du bsgyur ba'o//6 //11—732

rak+ṣa/ /mchod gnas dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo chos la 'jug thabs don 'di brtan 2par bya/ /gang zhig bdag gzhan sdug bsngal spang 'dod cing / /bde ba 'dod pas dam chos spyad par bya/ /mi rtag chos la bye brag bsam las 'das/ /ci phyir 'jig rten 'di dag mi rtag ste/ /sno da kyi 'jig rten ri rab lhun po dang / /gser gyi ri bdun rol mtsho chen po bdun/ /gling bzhi gling phran lcags ri mu khyud yang / /'jig pa'i dus na bskal pa'i me byung bas4/ /thal ba'i lhag ma tsam yang mi lus te/ /tha mar chu dang rlung gis 'jig pas na/ /brtan zhing nges pa 'dra ste brtag mi bzod / /lo zla tshes grangs shol ni mi jebs pas/ /lo zla 'das 'ing 'jig pa'i dus dang nye/ /dus bzhi 'khor ba sdod pa med pas ni/ /dbyar dro skye 'a/ dgun grang skam pa dang / /lo legs lo nyes than zhod nges pa med/ /rtsi 11—73 /

thog ljon shing lo 'dab rgyas pa 'dra/ /dus kyi drod bral rlung gis mi rtag go/ /rtag pa lags na ci phyir 'gyur zhing 'gro/ /de la sogs pa mi rtag dgongs nas gda' / /bcud kyi 'jig rten 'di yang mi rtag ste/ /nyin zhag 'das shing shi dang phar phar nye/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gsum gyis rtag tu 'khor/ /skye rga na 'chi rang thag ri mo 'dra/ /'chi bdag bdud ni so bya nya sdod 'dra/ /'jig rten 'di na che chung phyug dbul kun/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi lag tu mi 'gro med/ /snga ma shi ba'i mi rnams kun gyis kyang / /rtag tu re zhing bu dang nor bsags kyang/ /rang ni dge sdig gnyis dang 'gogs te 'gro/ /bu nor phyir lus bdag la phan med pas/ /de phyir bu nor zas la chags mi bya/ /yod pas dge ba'i las la mi 'bad na/ /de ni 'jig rten 'di yi gter bsrung 1yin / /shes pas dam pa'i chos la mi spyod na/ / rtag pas gcam bu don med glen pa yin/ /de bas nor med dbul lo bsnyen dga' dang / /bram ze ldan pa phul ba dag la spyod/ / 'jig rten 'di yi pha ma bu tsha dang / /phu nu mdza' bshes —bran khol nor rnams kun/ /sdug bsngal skal len 'ga' yi 5mi 'ong ste/ /'chi ba'i phyir ni gcig kyang mi 'ong ngo / /don de ma rig sems can mang po kun/ /tshe 'di'i 'khor ba'i nye bshes ched dag tu/ /sdig pa'i bye brag rnam pa mang po spyod/ /phan med rang ni ngan song gsum du thong / /de tshe 'akyod kyang phan med nyon mongs snon/ /tshe 'dir phrad pa'i las mthun nye bzhi rnams/ /'gron po gnas mthun tsam ste so sor 'gro/ /sdig dang bsdos nas zas dang nor 4bsags kyang/ /sdig pa'i rnam smin rmongs pa bdag gis khur/ /bsags pa'i nor ni phyir lus bu tshas khyer/ /sbrang bus 41—735

—sde——— sde— —— — ——————— —sde—— — —————byed———'bad de sbrang rtsi bsags pa 'dra/ /de bas longs spyod med cing dbul ba yang /rgyu 'bras mi slu chos la yid ches pa/ /mos pas dge ba dad pa'i yon phul nas/ /dge slong gser 'byig lta bur gyur pa yod/ /de phyir 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang du blang / /dad dang tshul khrims gtong dang thos pa dang / /1ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod shes rab ni/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun lags par thub pas gsungs/ /dper na nor gyi nang na chog shes pa/ /rab mchog lags par lha mi'i ston pas gsungs/ /kun du chog shes mdzad cing chog mkhyen na/ /nor mi bdog kyang yang dag 'byor par 'gyur/ /bdag la shin tu phangs 2pa'i lus 'di yang / /gos rnying lam du bor ba bzhin du 'gro/ /da lta sa stengs 'di na gnas pa kun/ /lo brgya tshun chad gcig kyang mi lus so/ /brgya thub 'bum la gcig kyang mi 'byung na/ /brgya la srid kyang phal cher yengs 'gyur te/ /mtshan mo nyal bas brgya phyed gnyid dbang du/ /song ste de la dran med shi dang 'dra/ /lhag ma lnga bcu yod du zad kyang ni/ /ra ro nyal dang 'du byed rnams kyi rkyen/ /lnga bcu phyed ni der yang zad pas ni/ /legs par dran pa nyi shu rtsa lnga yod/ /de yang rang la dbang byar ma mchis te//de ring do nub 4'chi'am gtol med 5kyi/ /da lta nyid du brtun te 'bad la bya'o / /tshe 'di zil pa 'dra ste med la khad/ /dbugs ni na bun 'dra ste yal la khad/ /lus ni sgyu ma 'dra ste snang la med/ /sems ni glog dang 'dra ste skad cig ma/ /phung po mi rtag 'chi zhing 'gyur ba ste/ /dar ba'i mdog ni nyon mongs nad kyis 'phrog /'chi ba'i srog ni 'chi bdag bdud kyis 'phrog/dper na chu 'gram g.yang sa'i sdong po 'dra/ /ring por 6mi thogs bya khyi ngur pa 47byed736
