pas ma gsungs zer/ /man ngag zab mo'i don la skur btab pas/ /'bras bu mnar med dmyal ba'i yang steng 1du/ /skye bar gyur pas rmongs pa snying re rje/ /ston pa'i zhal nas nges par gsungs pa yi/ /man ngag don dam gsang sngags zab mo la/ /bka' babe+ed 2gzhung bzhin dang du mi len par/ /mtshan nyid chos spyod dag la blo zhen pas/ /bskal pa gsum du sangs rgyas zhal mi mthong / /skal ba chung zhing shes rab zhen pa dang / /blo ngan don la rmongs pa'i gang zag gis / /zab mo'i don la ma zhugs skur pa btab/ /rnam smin dpag gis mi lang brjod las 'das/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i don la yid ches nas/ /lta spyod dam tshig gzhung du ldan pa dang / /sgrub la shin tu brtson pa'i gang zag ni / /sangs rgyas sa la the tshom med par 'gro/ /skye bo ma rig chos la gzud pa dang / /chos pa chos dang mi ldan pa rnams kyi/ /don du bdag gis yi ge 'di brtsams pas/ /kun kyang dad cing don la 'jug par smon/ /zhen log sgon ma zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa sdogs so// //41—747

༄༅/ /rgyal po chen po rjam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā rā dza bai shra ba ṇa 2sā dha rgo/ bod skad du / rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' ba/ /gnod sbyin kun gyi nor 'chang kun gyi rje/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal te / /ngal bso 5dge ba stobs po che/ /sgom 6zhing seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs/ /phyag gnyis be+e con rgo'u le bsnams / /de sgrub cho ga bshad par bya/ /ga bur la sogs lci ba yis/ /sngags brjod sa gzhi legs par byug /tshom bu dgur ni me tog dgod7/ /dam tshig bdun dang ldan pa yis/ /rgyal po'i rten gsum gzugs par bya/ /bdag nyid cho ga rdzogs byas la/ /sngags brgya bcu pa gsum bzlas pas9/ /phyogs mtshams kun du bsang 7gtor bya/ /snying gar sa bon bsams pa las// 47byed750

sdesde—byang phyogs 'od zer rab spros te/ /gnod sbyin bye ba 'bum gyi gtso/ /rgyal po rnam thos spyan drangs 1te/ /mdun du legs par bzhugs par bsam /de la bsang gtor nas brtsams te/ /rgyal po 'khor bcas legs par mchod/ /oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ de la mchod pa'i yi ge la/ /yi ge gsum dang ldan pa yis/ /so sor legs par sbyar te dbul/ /spyi gtsug shog ma snying ga yi/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gi —'od zer gyis/ /rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams—/ /'od zhu stong pa'i rang bzhin bya/ /de nas mdun du zlo 5las ni/ /rin chen khang pa brtsegs mar bsgom/ /zur bzhi rim gsum khang brtsegs pa—/ /dbus ma'i pho brang sum 7brtsegs te/ /rtse mo rin chen nor bus brgyan / /dra ba dra ba phyed pas bskor/ /shar phyogs shel dang bai ḍūr+ya/ /pad+ma rā ga gser gyi ni/ /ka ba stong phrag bcu yis brgyan/ / de yi 9 phyi rol phyogs mtshams su/ /bum pa bzang po dpag bsam shing / /rin chen rdzing bu 'dod 'jo ba/ /brgyad brgyad lnga yis rab tu mdzes/ /rin chen 'bar bas yongs su bskor/ /dbus su sa bon yi ge las/ /'od zer sna tshogs rab 'phros nas/ /don byas be+er 'dus bai la thim/ /de las rgyal chen 'khor bcas rdzogs/ /rin chen pho brang dam pa dang / /mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan steng na/ /bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal bso dge ba stobs po che/ /g.yas na rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon na gter kyi ne+e'u le 1 bsnams/ /sku ni gser gyi 'od pas mjes/ /zhal nas rin chen char pa 'bebs/ /thugs rjes phongs pa las sgrol mdzad/ /sku la rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /phrag gong g.yas g.yon nyi zlas brgyan/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi mgazi mdangs can/ /41—751

byed—— ———byedabyedadabu la rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /gnod spyin bye ba'i 'khor rnams dang / /nam mkha'i sprin tshogs bzhin du bsam/ /nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes 1pa / /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /de nas rgyal po spyan drangs te / /mgon po kun gshegs dam tshig can/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /mtshams med lnga ni kun spyod cing / /thams cad nyon mongs 'dam bying sar / /gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya seng ge'i spyan sngar khyod/ /thugs dam gang bzhes de dgongs la/ /'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /sems can kun la sman slad du/ /byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa rnams/ /sems can don phyir gshegs su gsol/ /phyag na rdo rje thugs gnas pa'i/ /hūṃ las spros pa'i 'od rnams kyis/ /rang bzhin rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /gnod sbyin 'bum bcas bkug nas ni/ /nor bu'i gong khyer de dbus su/ /mdun gnas rgyal po de la bzhugs/ /rin chen dbang bskur byin brlabs nas/ /de nas bsang gtor nas brtsams te/ /rin chen bdun dang bkra shis brgyad/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis mchod/ /gu gul dud pa dbul zhing bstod/ /de nas thugs ka'i zla ba la/ /sa bon sngags kyis yongs bskor te/ /lce la —rdo rje spu gur bsam/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa spro bsdu 5ni/ /so so'i thugs kar dmigs la bzlas / /tar+ya thā/ oṃ hi li ma ṇi 7bha dra/ ti li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/tu ru tu 9ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e bye nyi tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha a ba ta 47—752

——byed— —ra tiṣ+ṭha a ba ta ra tiṣ+ṭha 1me tsa ya/ tar+ya thā/ budha ni su te ne+e/ su ra me ne+e / su pa de re/ su su bye/ hi li mi li swā hā/ hūṃ bai shra ba ṇa ye swā hā/'di brjod bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bcu/ /zla ba yar ngo'i bco lnga la/ /tsan+dan dkar po'i dkyil 'khor byas/ / der ni rgyal po la dmigs nas/ /a ka ru bsregs sngags bzlas bya/ /'dir ni brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzlas/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan drug tu/ /rgyal po la dmigs sngags bzlas na/ /rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar bgyid/ /dpag tshad brgya ni tshun chad du/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis srung 4bar byed/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs shing / /kha na ma tho med pa yi/ /zas dang skom 5dang bca' ba dang / /nor bu dbyig dang gser sprul dzibagyid/ /rin po che yi gter la sogs/ /bsod nams tshad med 'grub par 'gyur/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'grub/ /de la sogs pa ma lus 'grub/ /ngal bar gyur na gshegs su gsol/ /mchod bstod bzod par gsol ba dang / /dkar gtor btang 7la phrin las bcol/ /zlo la sogs pa'i snod bskyed la/ /khaṃ las zhal zas bskyed par bya/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhas+thā rde ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta oṃ āḥhūṃ9/ sangs rgyas spyan gyis spel byas la/ /sngags rgyal bcu gsum pa bzlas bya/ /hūṃ bai shra ba ṇa ye i rda ba li kṛt+nabye sa sam ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma se dhim+me pra yats+tsha / ma ma sarba karma 2sā dhu a mo gha swā hā/ so so'i sngags la btags la dbul/ /hūṃ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes nas kyang / /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bu sdug bzhin du bskyang bar mdzod/ /bdag la gnod par sems pa sayi/ /log par zhugs pa'i sems can kun/ /47—753

byedasde ——ke— — byed—byedade yi phru ma gzhom pa dang / /gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bai yig sum cu rtsa gnyis bsring / /snying ga'i lcags kyu bkrol la gshegs/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun 1pa'i dngos grub sprul //byang phyogs gnas su gshegs nas kyang / /be+er yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol / /dam tshig sems dpa' 'od zhu 4bya/ /rgyal po'i gzugs brnyan byas pa la/ /rang bzhin rgyal po bkug la bstem/ /zhabs kyis mnan la dbang du bsdu/ /hūṃ bai shra ba rja ya 5a nu ra tsa ku ru hūṃ6/ de ltar rdzogs par byas 7gyur na/ /rgyal po rnam thos sras bcas kyis/ /'dod pa thams cad skong 8bar byed/ /nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes 'gyur/ /slob dpon chen 9po 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa'i rnam thos sras kyi 7bde byed kyi brtag pa rdzogs so // //rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta te dza de 1 ba dang bod kyi lo tsā 1 ba dge slong 'phags pa —shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa'o// //47byed754

sngag /rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi las brtag pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs 1༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā rā dza bi rū pa kā ya karma kalpa sā dha rna2/bod skad du/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi las brtag pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs / dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs gtso phyag na rdo rje yis / /dngos su lung bstan byin brlabs pa'i/ /spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rjes ni/ /grags 'dzin la sogs pha rol te / /cho gas bsad sogs las rnams ni/ /bla ma brgyud pa las byung ba'i/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po gtsor gyur pa'i / /stong phrag brgyad dang gnyis lhag pa'i/ /de sgrub 5cho ga bshad par bya / /dpal ldan khro rgyal rdo rje can/ /sngon 'gro rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas//lha tshogs 6gdug pa gzhom pa'i phyir/ /dang por cho ga la 'jug bya/ /ske tshe nyungs 7kar dug sna tshogs/ /bong bu'i chu dang sbangs 8sogs dang / /tsha dang gdug pa'i tsher sbangs chus9/ /hūṃ brjod sa gzhi legs par byug / 47—7pya7

kho ra 1tsher ma can gyi shing / /nam phyed byang bltas 2me tog blang / /tshom bu dgur ni legs par dgod4/ /khrus byas bsrung ba bdun byas la/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung bde stan 5la/ /byang du mngon phyogs 'jug par bya/ /de nyid rigs kyi me tog dang / /sna tshogs dug phye mi rus phye/ /legs par sbyar ba'i de bzhin spos/ /mi rkang las byung mar me dang / /sā lu dmar po sha lnga sogs/ /gcig tu byas pa'i lha bshos dang / /mi dang bong bu'i dri chu dang / /rma bya'i sgro dang ku shar bcas/ /bsang gtor dri yi chu dang ldan/ /sngags rgyal bcu gsum pa bzlas bya/ /phyogs mtshams 7kun du bsang gtor bya/ /de nas bdag nyid rnal 'byor pa/ /gdong bkrus nas brtsams sgrub 8thabs gzhung / /bdag nyid cho ga rdzogs byas la/ /yi ge bcu gsum bzlas pa ni/ /'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas byas la/ /snying gar yi ge bsams 9pa las/ /'od zer byang du rab 'phros te/ /gnod sbyin bye ba 'bum gyi gtso/ /klu chen brgyad kyis bskor 7ba yi/ /rnam thos rgyal po spyan drangs te/ /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /rim pas legs par bzhugs par bsam/ /de la bsang gtor nas brtsams te/ /gong gi mchod pa'i rim pa yis yi ge gsum dang ldan pa rnams/ /rgyal po 'khor bcas legs par mchod/ /oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ de la mchod pa'i yi ge ni/ /so sor legs par sbyar te dbul/ /spyi gtsug kilkog ma snying ga yi/ /yi ge gsum gyi 'od zer gyis/ /rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /'od zhu sa bon rang bzhin bya/ /de la rang sngags bskor ba dmigs/ /'od kyis gdug pa bcom byas te/ /slar bsdu hūṃ sogs la thim nas/ /rgyal chen 'khor bcas 41—758

yongs su sdogs/ / klu rnams yi ge phuḥlas bskyed/ /1de nyid rgyal po chen po ste / /sku mdog sngon po gzi brjid can/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa//khro gnyer mche ba cung zhig gcigs/ /cod pan sbrul mgo chun 'phyang lding //phrag gong g.yas g.yon nyi zlas mtshan/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ / seng ge snal sogs 'jigs pas mtshan/ /sku las nam mkha' gang bar 'phro//g.yas na rdo rjes rīrab mtshan pa'i/ /dbyug pa ba dan bcas pa 'dzin/ /g.yon pa phyag na sku gdung 'dzin/ /klu rnams gdug pa'i rang lus 'chang / /gnod sbyin srin po'i gzugs rnams ni/ /nam mkha'i sprin tshogs bzhin du bsam / /thugs ka'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i/ /'od kyis 5rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /'khor dang bcas pa bkug nas ni/ /mdun gnas dkyil 'khor dag la bsnyim/ /de nas bsang gtor nas brtsams te 7/ /gong gi sngags kyis mchod pa dbul/ /gong gi gtor ma'i cho ga chobazhin/ /legs par byin kyis brlabs nas ni/ /oṃ badz+ra bi ru rā ga /ku be+e ra āt+ma /ka /ma hā yak+ṣa rā dza/ aṣ+ṭa nā ga snabi ra be+e sha sarba yak+ṣa pa ri wā ra i rda ba bo kṛṇ+ḍin+tu 7—/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tulo/ ma ma sidhi 7pra yats+tsha/ ma ma sarba karma/ sā dha a mu ka mā 7ra ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ yi ge bco lnga sngags la ni/ /btags sate gtor ma dbul bar bya/ /de nas bdag nyid bsrung bar bya/ /gser la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams la/ /hūṃ ngam khro kyi phyi rol du/ /yi ge bcu gsum bskor bar bya/ /nyungs ( snakar dang bcas spyi bor gzhag /gla 18rtsi ba yi rnam lnga la/ /gos sngon can gyi sngags bzlas te/ /mgo lus khyab par byugs — —la bsrung / /de nas rten 'brel sngags kyis ni/ /lus la go cha 41—759

dgod par bya/ /spyi bo shog ma snying ga ru/ /kha dog gsum ldan yi ge bsam/ /so sor sngags kyis bskor bar 1bya/ /thugs kar zla ba la gnas hūṃ/ /de la sngags kyis yongs bskor te/ /lce la rdo rje sbu gu bsam/ /spro bsdu'i sngags kyi bzlas pa ni/ /rgyal po'i thugs kar dmigs la bzlas/ /dal min myur ba ma yin dang / /gsal min mi gsal ma yin par/ /rtse gcig sems kyis 4 bzlas par bya/ /oṃ nī khāsba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā yak+ṣa rā dza ku be ra bi ru rā ga sid+dhim+me 5pra ya ts+tsha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 'di brjod zhwabasnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig /rdzogs nas rmi ltas 'byung ba ste/ /chu bo skams dang sbrul mthong ngam / /sbra khyim nags la me mched mthong / /sog po srin pos bskor ba yi//dbus na gnas pa mthong ba 'am/ / seng ge 9la sogs gcan gzan tshogs/ /mdun 'dus gus 1 par mthong ba na/ /de nas las sbyor brtsam par bya/ /gnas gsum thig le byas nas su/ /gong gi bsrung ba'i cho ga rnams/ /bsrungs te byin kyis brlab sapar bya'o/ /dur khrod rdo 1 leb thog tu ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bris byas la/ /steng du dug dang lan tshwa dang / /khrag dang chu 'gram gnyis kyi sa/ /rkang rjes sa la sogs pa la/ /bsgrub bya'i gzugs sam gdug pa'i gzugs/ /rang gzugs mtshan nyid ldan par bya/ /dgug dang bcing ba —la sogs pa'i/ /bsad sapa'i cho ga byas nas ni/ /de la sbyin sreg slobartsam par bya/ /me thab gru gsum thab khung la/ /zur la khru re'i tshad yod de/ /zabs su khru phyed la sogs la/ /sbyin sreg 5cho gar gsungs pa bzhin / /thab kyi mtshan nyid shes par bya/ /de yi dbus shāsu mchod rten ni/ /dur khrod tshon ni nag pos bris/ /de 1dbus rdo rje dbyug pa ni/ /ba dan rtse 41—760

————lngas mtshan par bya/ /de yi phyi rol phyogs mtshams su/ /kha dog nag po sbrul brgyad bri/ /gzhan dag dkyil 'khor phyag mtshan rnams/ /sbyin sreg 1cho gar shes par bya/ /tsher ma dug shing khru gang la/ /dbus su zur gsum brtsig bya ste2/ /mi skra'i skud pas bcing bya yis / /tsher ma khru gang dbus su gzhag /de nas mngon spyod rdzas rnams gzhag /sreg rdzas liṅga gnyis su bya/ /dug dang khrag dang ske tshe dang / /yungs kar chu 'gram gnyis kyi sa/ /rkang rjes sa dang da du ra/ /bra'o 5sran ma mi rus phye/ /byang du mgo bstan shi ba'i skras/ /kun la bsreg pa byas nas ni/ /dug shing tsher ma sor brgyad la/ /khrag dang dug chus sbags pa yi6/ /de yi yam shing dbul bar bya/ /rus phye la sogs mchod pa rnams/ /gong du gsungs pa bzhin du bya//de nas me ni sbar bya ste/ /dbus su rgyal po chen po ni/ /klu dang gnod sbyin tshogs bskor ba'i/ /sa 7cad rdzogs par bsam par bya/ /rang bzhin rgyal po bkug la bstem/ /sku stod 8khwa dang 'ug pa dang / /gcan gzan 'jigs tshogs spro bar bya/ /rked par gnod sbyin 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa spro/ /sku smad seng ge 1la sogs pa/ /gcan gzan 'jigs pa'i tshogs su spro/ /de dag gzugs kyis bsgrub bya dang / /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bkug byas te/ /gong gi liṅgar —bstim pa dang / /nam mkha' gludum bur gtubs ྾nas ni/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po'i zhal du dbul//dug dang khrag la sogs pa ni/ /bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig bar/ /gong gi rdzas rnams dbul bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra bi byu ra 1 ka ku be+e ra ma hā yak+ṣa rā dza/che ge mo a na la ha na sarba duṣ+ṭha na/ sarba bhasmi ku ru che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/‘7—76/

kyis brgyan 1pa'o/ /g.yas g.yon du dung 2rna/ bum rna/ rna gsum/rna ba che/ ser ljang / dmar ljang / ljang nag /dkar ljang gsus pa ldir ba mdung dmar dang / rgyal mtshan dang mdung dang dbyig to bcas pa dang ne+e'u le'o/ /mdun du yum rgyal po dang mthun 4pa la phyag g.yas pa bum pa / zhabs brkyang 5bskum mo/ /de lta bu 6legs par bris pa bzhugs par bya'o/ /de la dar ser po'am za 7'og gi gdugs/ dar dmar po'i yol ba/ dkar po'i rgyal mtshan/ ljang gu dang mthing ga'i ru mtshon bri bar bya'o/ /spos dang me tog gi phreng ba la sogs pa dgram par bya'o/ /de nas dri dang ldan pa'i steng du mchod yon dang / me tog dang / spos dang / mar me dang / dri chab 9dang / lha bshos dang / lha bshos khru gang ba gcig la smyug ma gtsang ma la rtse mo tsitra ka mdang snying zho sha /de'i 'og tu chu srin kyi rgyal mtshan/ de'i 'og tu rin po che sna lnga/ spos lnga/za 'og dang / dar sna dang / stag ras dang / bse'i me long / de'i steng du bu ram dang / sbrang rtsi dang / sman sna tshogs dang / mar dang thud dang / lug dang g.yag gi snying dang dkor cha rnams kyis brgyan te thad du gzhag go/ /de'i rtsar chang la rin po che dang ldan par bya'o/ /de nas byang du kha bltas te stan la 'dug nas7/ bdag nyid phyag na rdo rje sku gsung thugs su bskyed do/ /mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs te/ spos la sogs pa rang rang gi sngags kyis rgya che bar byin kyis brlab bo/ /rten gyi dkor cha swa 7yongs su gyur pa las rten rnams mang zhing mdzes par bya'o/ /chang 7a yongs su gyur pa las bdud rtsir bya'o/ /de nas rang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa yan 41byed766

byedachad yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /de nas nyams dga' ba nyid kyis 1chos skyong ba mnyes par bya ba'i phyir bsnyen pa byas te de la 'jug pa be+e/ oṃ sarba de wa maṇ+ḍal ye dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ e ma ho sa na ka ga nan+ta pa ka ra sle dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya swā hā/ mchod pa'i dus su gdags so zhes brjod pa'i don to/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ las brjod pa'i nyi zer ltar 'thon nas rgyal po'i thugs kar thim pas/des chos skyong ba'i thugs sngon bzhin du g.yos nas gdan seng ge'i shugs kyis rin po che'i khang pa dang nyid la so sor thim par bsams te stong brjod do/ /de 5nas mchod pa dbul te 6/ rtsa ba'i sngags sbyar ba dang bcas pas dbul te—/ oṃ ni ri te 7hūṃ khaṃ/ zhal du'o/ /badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ me tog spyi bor ro/ /oṃ badz+ra sgru pe hūṃ swā hā / dri thugs kar ro/ /oṃ badz+ra dīspru 9hūṃ swā hā/ mar me rgyab tu'o / /oṃ badz+ra gadhe hūṃ swā hā/ dri chab mdun du'o//oṃ badz+ra ne+e bibyemuhūṃ swā hā/ lha bshos phyag tu'o/ /dkor cha dag / thogs te sngags kyi tshig brjod/ rang gi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul te nyes pa ma lus pa dang bas mthol zhing rdzas gcig kyang 'jig rten gang bar sprul te/ nyes pa byang zhing rjes su mthun d+kupa'i tshig gis gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas bstod cing bskul ba ni/ /sngon tshe gsang lobadag spyan snga ru/ /dam chos bsrung bar zhal bzhes bzhin/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gdung 'tshob pa'i/ /sems bskyed ldan lapa'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /gnod pa'i bar chod mang po rnams/ /stobs ldan rgyal chen yab yum dang / /gnod sbyin pho mo sde brgyad bcas/ /bstan pa bsrung bar gnyer gtad bzhin/ /rdzu 'phrul bye ba sna tshogs kyis/ /gnod pa thams cad rdul du rlog — /dam bcas las la ma brtson na/ /sangs 41byed767

༄/ /rgyal po chen po lus ngan po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā rā dza ku be+e ra sā dha rna nā ma/ bod skad du/ rgyal po chen po lus ngan po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ ngal so rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por snod ldan gang zag gis/ /gnas rnams shin tu dben pa ru/ /rdo rje 'chang pa bsgrub par bya/ /de nas las rnams myur 'dod na / /bka' yi pho nya bsgrub par bya/ /de yang rang rgyud dag dang ni/ /gtso bo 'khor du gnas pa'o/ /thabs ni tshogs bsags tshad med bsgom/ /srung ba stong nyid ngang du 5bya/ /pad+ma'i gdan steng hūṃ las ni/ /mchod rten la ni sku bskyed do/ /ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas na mchod rten gdug pa sel/ /g.yon na nor ldan ne+e'u le 'dzin/ /rang bzhin gnas pa spyan drangs la/ /dbang bsgur byin brlab 6tshul bzhin bya/ /mchod pa rnams ni phul nas ni/ /bstod pa 'di dag brjod par bya/ /bstan 77—772

sheshe———— — ——— — — ——————byed—— —— ——— —————— — ——— ————— — —bsrungs rgyal po chen po ni/ /mchod rten gyis ni don rnams bsgrub/ /rin chen de'u le bsnams nas ni/ /dgos 'dod ster ba'i ljang gu bstod/ /bskyed rim 1sdogs nas bzlas pa bya/ /sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa la//'od zer spro bsnyu 'khor lo'i tshul/ /sgrub pa'i dus su spyo bsdu spang / /dgug sogs man ngag bzhin du bya/ /rtags ma byung bar 'phro mi gcod/ /sngags ni/oṃ nī khāsba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bai shra ba zla ya yak+ṣu dhi pa ta ye swā hā / a mu shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ dam tshig brtan 5zhing gtor ma sbyin/ /de nas rang rgyud sgrub 'dod na/ /gtso bo 'khor du bcas pa yang / /tshogs bsags la sogs gong ma ltar/ /'khor lo chen po'i lte bar gtso/ /mdun du rgyal po bskyed par bya/ /bka' bsgo 6la sogs las dang spyor/ /dgug dang bsad 7la sogs pa yi/ /bsgrub pa ci rigs shes bya ste/ /'khrul 'khor spyor ba dag tu shes/ /rnal 'byor sgrub par byed 'dod na/ /gnod sbyin g.yas su bskyed byas la/ /bka' bsgo rgyal por bya bar rigs/ /klu rgyal g.yon du bkol ba'i phyir/ /bde gshegs sprul pa sgrub 'dod na/ /mdun nam g.yon du pad+ma la/ /cho ga gsum mam skad cig las/ /sgu mdog dkar po sbrul zhags can/ /de 'dra'i klu rgyal spyan drangs bstem/ /mchod bstod gang 'dod bzlas pa bya/ /dam la ma thogs klu rnams ni/ /sgrub pa po la bar chad byed / /dang po zhi bas gdul bar bya/ /ma nyan drag po'i las rnams brtsams / /gsod na dong du gzugs brnyan gzhug /dgug la bsad sngags shes par bya/ /khro bo'am yang na mtshon cha yis/ /lus rnams gtub cing gsad par bya/ /yang na sbyin sreg 5rnams kyang bya/ /yang na 'khrul 7/7—773

'khor sbyor ba 1bya/ /yang na ma mo rnams kyang bskul/ /gnod na gro ga rnams la ni/ /gzugs bri 'od zer rnams kyis dgug /de nas zhing chen nang du gzhug /kha dgab mtshon bcing thal bas dgang / /yang na pha bong 4dug la sogs / /gong ma bzhin du shes par bya/ /bskrad sogs gzhan yang man ngag sbyar/ /rgyal po chen po lus ngan po'i sgrub 5thabs/ grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //sgra pa chen po rgyal ba'i snyan 6la legs par zhus shing bstan bcos kyi skad cung zad shes pa'i lo tsā 7ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal thar pa'i gling gi gtsug lag khang du legs par bsgyur ba'o//1— //bsdur mchan/772 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉phol po chen po lus ngan po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba dpa/'a bo rdo rjes mdzad pa bzhugs so// 〈〈pe 〉sngagaso/ 〈〈snar 〉she sa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉nas—/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasrung / 5〈〈snar 〉ras/ 6〈〈snar 〉7ra byin brlabs/ sgyu〈〈snar 〉ram lnga/773 1 〈〈snar 〉〉sdems/ 〈〈pe 〉lo gas/ 〈〈snar 〉thartseg 〈〈snar 〉7su/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉〉 ma ye/ 5〈〈pe 〉ra stan/6〈〈snar 〉skosgo/ 7〈〈snar 〉sngagasad/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge sa/ ( 〈〈pe 〉shes/ rka〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rtsam/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dngos su/ ki〈〈pe 〉rasad/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasad/ 〈〈snar 〉thasreg774 1 〈〈snar 〉thar/ 〈〈snar 〉thagug 〈〈pe 〉༅nga / 4〈〈pe 〉mdzang / 5〈〈snar 〉thasgrub/ 6〈〈pe 〉thasnyen/7〈〈pe 〉kho tsa/ 〈〈snar 〉7ts+tsha/ 〈〈pe 〉ṅkapa'i/ 〈〈snar 〉7/ / 〈〈pe 〉7sa'i steng du nyi zla ltar gyur cig/〈〈snar 〉ṅkas steng nyi zla ltar gyur cig/4 7—774

༄khya/ /rjam thos sras kyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ be+e shra ba ṇa sā dha 2rna nā ma/ bod skad du/rnam thos sras kyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba / bcom ldan 'das rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang / /'gro ba kun gyi don gzigs nas/ /drang srong rnam 4mang thos pa dang / /lha mo dpal tshul bzang mo yi/ /sras su smon lam btab 5pa yis/ /'gro ba'i bsam pa yongs rdzogs mdzad/ /lha rnams 'byor pa 'dod pa yi7/ /lha rnams kyis ni phyag byas pa'i/ /bcom ldan lha yi lha zhes bstod/ /de yi sgrub thabs brtsam par bya/ / rja las skyes pa'i 'khor lo la9/ /drod mtha' nga ro lnga pas brgyan / /steng du rjes 'jug dbyangs dang ldan/ /'od zer 'phro 'dus 'gro don mdzad pa yi/ /rang gi phyag mtshan las skyes gtso bo ni/ /phyag na rdo rje ljang ser 'gying bcas bri/ /bsod nams tshogs bdun don dam stong 41—776

nyid las/ /skyes pa'i rang bzhin sku gsung thugs ngo bo/ /ye 1shes sems dpa' gzhug dang dbang bskur dang / /gnas gsum byin brlabs dbang sdud rdo rje bskyed/ /rdo rje dril bu rgyan rnams bcu dang ldan/ /'od zer spro bsdus khams gsum lhar bskyed nas/ /gsal byed oṃ dang chu yi yi ge dang / /gsum pa me yi bu dang yang dag ldan/ /lnga pa'i thog ma bzhi pa'i tha ma la4/ /nga ro bzhi pa yis ni 5mnan pa la/ /gtum po chen po ma rungs tshig gis 7mnan/ /hūṃ gnyis phaṭa dang ldan pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /dus rnams kun du gtso bo'i thugs kar bskor / /rgyun mi 'chad par rtse gcig yid kyis 9bzlas/ /de yi mdun du hūṃ 7las ni/ /rin chen khang pa brtsegs pa bsgom/ /shar du shel gyi 1 ka bas brgyan/ /lho ru rin chen be+e ḍūr+ya/ /nub tu pad+ma rā ga ste/ /byang du gser gyi ka bas samadzes/ /zur bzhi rim gsum khang brtsegs dgu/ /dbus ma'i pho brang sum brtsegs ni/ /rtse mo rin chen nor bu bzang / /rnam pa bcu yis spras pa po/ /de dbus 'jigs —byed yi ge las/ /seng ge'i gdan sal legs bzhugs pa/ /ngal so sa dge ba'i lag pa na/ /g.yas na rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon na gter gyi ne+e'u le bsnams1 / /rin chen cod pan rna rgyan dang / /mgul rgyan 1 dang ni do shal dang / /dpung rgyan dang ni lag gdub bcas / /ske rags phreng ba do shal can/ /nying lag rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes/ /gsus khyim che ba skyil krung bzhugs/ /bum pa bzang po rnam brgyad dang / /dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing / /rdzing bu bzang po'i rgyan mdzes pa/ / me tog bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba/ / yid bzhin nor bu'i ra bas bskor/ /de yi dbus 17—777

na mgon po ni/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi 1ting 'dzin gyis/ /rin chen bdun gyi char pa 'be+ebs/ /de nas rgyal po spyan drangs te/ /mgon po kun gshegs thugs rje can/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ / mtshams med lnga ni kun spyod cing / /ri thams cad nyon mongs 'dam bying bar/ /gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya seng ge'i spyan sngar khyed/ /thugs dam gang bzhes de dgongs la/ /'dren pa'i bstan 3 pa bsrung ba dang / /sems can kun la phan slad du/ /byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa rnams/ /sems can don phyir gshegs su gsol/ /spyan drang 5nas ni mchod pa dbul/ /dbang bskur nas ni na gebaza' gsol/ /rin chen bdun dang bkra shis brgyad/ /phyag tu phul la dngos grub blang / /bza' btung 'dod yon la sogs pa/ /rtag bsten ༄ lha la dbul bar bgyi7/ /snying po chu yi (4yi ge la/ /dbyangs yig bcu gnyis pa yis brgyan/ /mig btsums sum cu rtsa gnyis bsring / /nye ba'i snying po ni/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇa ye swā hā/ 'bum phrag gcig gis mkha' la g.yo / /'bum phrag gnyis kyis sa rnams g.yo/ /'bum phrag gsum kyis phyogs rnams sreg /'bum phrag bzhi yis bza' btung 'thob/ /'bum phrag lnga yis nor dang ldan/ /'bum phrag drug gis 7'khor mang rnyedatsha / /'bum phrag bdun gyis rigs rgyud 'phel/ /'bum phrag brgyad kyis 7tshe 'phel zhing / /dgus ni bcud kyilen sman rnams rnyed/ /bcu yis mngon par shes pa 'thob/ /gshegs su gsol tshe bzod par gsol/ /smon lam btab cing phrin skyelas bcol/ /yang phyis 'byon par gsol ba gdab/ /sna tshogs rab tu sgrub rgyud dang / /gar mkhan mchog gi sargyud las ni/ /phan 41—778

༄spro/ /dang por bdag nyid yi dam gyi lhar bskyed la/ bcom ldan 'das rnam thos sras seng ge la bcibs pa/ mdog ser po lag na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan 'bar ba thogs pa/ gnod sbyin gyi bdag po brgyad kyis bskor ba/mdun na rmugs 2'dzin rin po che thogs pa ser po/ g.yas su gang ba bzang po bum pa thogs pa ser po/ rgyab tu nor bu bzang bo rin po che 'bar ba thogs pa dkar po/ g.yon du rta bdag ku be+e ra lag na ral gri thogs pa nag po gos sngon po can/ mtshams bzhir yang dag shes ser po lag na ral gri thogs pa/ 'brog gnas lag na mdung thogs pa nag po/ lngas rtsen ser skya lag na khang bu brtsegs pa bsnams pa/ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa 5li lag na ral gri dang phub thogs pa dkar po de rnams rta la chibs spyopa/ 'khor gnod sbyin 7bye bas bskor ba/ lag na mtshon cha 'phyar ba bsams te/ gu gul kyi dud 4 1—781

pa'am / 'bras kyi phye'i dud pa btang 1la/ dung dang rnga brdungs te spyan drang bar bya'o/ /oṃ bai shra ba ṇa sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ oṃ bai swā hā/ de mdun du byon pa'i rtags snying 'dar ba dang / mgo sbid pa dang /grogs la babs pa dang / mthong ba na bdug pa dang / me tog dang /gtor ma byin la phrin 4las bcol nas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /sgron 5ma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ swa bhā ba bi shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥrka swa bhā ba bi shurnyolha7haṃ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam/ de la gtor ma'i snod rin po che'i khang bu brtsegs pa dpag tshad kyi tshad tsam bsams la/ de'i nang du lha'i zhal zas ro brgya /bsams te/ oṃ āḥ9hūṃ gsum kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ a kā ro zhes bya ba'i sngags lan bdun bzlas la/ kha dog bzang po'i 'od dang bcas pa bsam 11par bya'o/ /de la bsngo ba ni/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa 7ye swā hā/oṃ dze+e bha la muye swā hā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra maye swā hā/oṃ ku be+e ra sloye swā hā/ oṃ saṃ pra dza na 7ye swā hā/ oṃ gu h+yasta 8na ye swā hā/oṃ pañci ka 1 ye swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ye swā hā/ de rnams la zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi phrin 1las bcol la/ snying ga'i lcags kyu dgrol/ oṃ be+e zhes yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi tshad du gdon/ nir ba natsa na bsreg pa bslab/ bar bar du gtor ma rgya chen po gtang / bai shra wa ṇa'i rtogs pa rdzogs so// //bstod pa ni/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /'jig rten skyong ba grags dang ldan/ /sde po che la stobs po che/ /pha rol dgra rnams 'joms par byed/ /gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog 41—782
