bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2360)4 7wa 784

ra༅/ /rnam sras rtogs pa bzhugs/1sngal/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas gsang ba bshad par bya/ /zla ba yar ngo'i bco lnga la/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /thun mong ma yin mchod pa ste/ /gang gis bdugs 2pa tsam kyis ni/ /dngos grub myur du thob byed pa'i/ /sgrub pos bdug spos bdug pa ni / /brtul zhugs 'dzin pas 'di ltar bya/ /'bras dkar btags pa'i phye ma ni/ /sardza ra dza 5dag dang ni/ /ga pur tsan+dan dkar dmar dang / /cha mnyam nas ni de dag bsre6/ /a ka ru nag gis bsgos nas/ /be+e ta dkar mo'i char rgyun gyis/ /rnam par sbrus nas rab bsngags te/ /rtsa ba'i rig pa gang de la/ /dbab pa'i gsang sngags rab tu sbyar/ /stong rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas ni/ /dngos grub phyir ni rdzas de yi / /de nas mkhas pas ri 7lu bya / /gang zhig mchod pa'i dus su ni/ /sems kyi dbang phyug ting 'dzin 17—785

gyis / /rnam par sbyangs pa'i sa gzhi la/ /rten sogs dgram par byas nas ni / /cho gas gter bdag mdun bkug nas/ /rdo rje can kyis 1bdug pa dbul / /gser sogs mdzes pa'i snod du ni/ /tsan+dan la sogs mdag 2me la / /sngar bshad pa yi ri lu bsreg /des ni rten la bdug par bya/ /sbyor nges skyob pa mnyes gyur na / /gter rnams de yi mod la ster/ /gal te de ltar ma gyur na/ /gter bdag nyams par gdon mi za/ /'di ni rab tu gsang ba ste/ /gsang ba'i gnas su spyad par bya/ /bdug spos kyi sbyor ba'o/ /de nas dam tshig bshad bya ba/ /rtag par khrus dang gtsang sbra bya/ /rnga dril la sogs rol mo'i sgra/ /sna tshogs me tog dri ldan dang / /sna tshogs 'bru yi chan dang bshos/ /mdzes pa'i dar snas rtag —mchod bya/ /chang rnams dbul bar mi bya ste/ /sha ni brtags te dbul bar bya/ /rtag tu sngon po'i gos 'chang zhing / /lung thang 'bras bu'i bgrang 'phreng 5bgrang / /myur 'gro sha yi bza' ba spang / /nyams shing chag 6pa'i snod mi bza'/ /rtsub cing nag po'i stan mi 'dug /bza' 7bral mas bstabs bza' btung rnams/ /rnam pa kun du mi spyod do/ /srog bral ba la reg pa spang / /bsrung bar bya ba'i dam tshig go/ /de nas rten ni bshad par bya/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bye brag gi 9//gter bdag brten pa'i rten yang ni/ /rnam pa gsum du mkhas pas brtag /phyi rten rta mchog rab sngo la/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan btags bye mgon la dmigs/ /rtag tu yang ni bcang bar bya/ /yang na gzugs legs rab tu gzung ma / /gsang rten gro ga'i shun sogs la/ /gur gum dri bzangs rab spel bas/ /be+e 5yig bris la sngags kyis bskor/ /rin chen dang bcas rin chen gzugs/ /41—786

'bru mchog btags nas bsnos 1byas la/ /mkhas pas byas te snying po gzhug /tshon byugs nas ni mdun gzhag go/ /gnyis pa bram ze'i ras 4dag gam/ /gzhon nu ma yis legs bkal ba'i5/ /ras la dri yis rab bsgos nas/ /gter bdag sku mdog phyag char ldan/ /lugs nas 7'byung ba'i rim pa yis/ /dam tshig ldan pas myur bris la/ /phyi rol shing 8sogs rgyan gyis mdzes/ /sngags rig 9pas ni mdun dgram bya/ /rten gzugs pa yi rim pa'o de nas gsang ba bshad bya ste/ /sgrub po gsang bdag phyogs bltas 1 te/ /gtor ma'ang de nyid phyogs su sbyin1snye/ /gsang rten ne+e'u le'i rlud 1 bur gzhug /sngon dmar kha spro rgyun 'chang zhing / /'bras sogs 'bru rnams der —gzhug bya/ /gzhan kyis mthong na dngos grub nyams/ /gtor sgrub pa la gsang ba shis/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /nam mkha' mdzod la rnam par rol/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi rtogs pa bde byed sacho ga sna tshogs pa'i mdzod ces bya ba jordob/ba cas// // la41—787

2435༄༅/ /chos skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos sras la bstod pa 'ab(1bkabs zab//1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā rā dza dhan+d+ra pā la bai shra ba ṇa stod tra/bod skad du/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras la bstod pa/dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang phyug chen po 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha / /bskal pa mang por rgyal ba'i lam sgrubs nas/ /srid shing drungs phyung nyes brgya rtsad bcad de/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i phun tshogs kun brnyes kyang / /smon lam stobs kyis gnod sbyin tshul 'dzin pas/ /drang srong rnam mang thos pa'i sras gyur nas/ /phongs pa'i ngal bso dbul ba dbugs 'byin pa/ /stobs chen rgyal ba'i sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dbang drang srong tshogs dang grub pa dang / /'jig rten mes po seng ge 'phrog byed dang / /snang byed la sogs lha tshogs thams cad kyang / /'jig rten bla ma khyod zhabs rtag tu 'dud//lha yul dang ni sa stengs thams cad tu/ /lha'i lha khyod bstod pa mang mod kyang / /17—789

bdag kyang mgon po khyod la gus pa yis/ /yon tan phyogs tsam bstod cing gsol 'debs na/ /gzhan don lhur len skyo ngal med pa yi/ /sgrib med ye shes snyan gyis gsan du gsol/ /gnas rabs lcang lo can gyi pho brang na/ /rgyal chen rnam thos sras de gser gyi mdog /dpal ldan rnam mang gter tshogs thugs mnga' ba/ /thub mchog bstan pa skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod sgu gser sogs rin chen rgyan gyis phyug /bzhin 'dzum spyan rgyas zla ba nya ba 'dra / /seng ge'i gdan bzhugs mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs/ /gzi brjid mtha' yas sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs las dang sdug bsngal bud shing rnams / /drang srong mchog gi sngags kyis sreg par byed/ /theg chen gsung rab seng ge'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs/ /bdag med gnyis ston gsung la phyag 'tshal lo / /lta ba ngan pa'i khri shing dra ba rnams/ /dri med ye shes blo kros rdo rje yis/ /spros pa kun bcad shes bya kun rtogs pa'i/ /chags thogs mi mnga'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin dbang po'i phrag gong g.yas g.yon na/ /thabs dang shes rab nyi zla'i 'od shar bas/ /'jig rten gsum dang dus gsum sa lir gzigs/ /shes rab spyan ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal srid 'khor los sgyur ba'i dbu rgyan mtho/ /thams cad zil gnon mdzes pa'i dar dpyangs 'dzin / /yon tan rgyas mdzad na bza' ser khra gsol/ /chos kyi rgyal srid brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag g.yas rin chen dbyug pas dbul ba 'joms/ /dgongs pa kun bsgrub g.yon pa ne+e'u le 'dzin/ /spyi gtsug nor bus nor gyi char 'bebs pa/ /dpal ldan bkra shis khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten 'das kyang 'jig rten tshul ston pa/ /gnod sbyin dbang po 'khor lo sgyur 41—790

ba'i gzugs/ /ting 'dzin nam mkha'i mdzod kyis 'gro ba kun/ /ci 'dod re ba skong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba gcig kyang yal bar mi 'dor med/ /nad kyis nyen pa'i bu sdug ma bzhin du/ /dman la rjes brtse 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster/ /'phongs pa bzlog mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid na bdag cag nyon mongs chom rkun gyis/ /bcom nas 'phags nor phrogs te sdug bsngal ba / /mgon po khyod dran tsam gyis zhi byed pa/ /pha rol dpung 'joms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam mang yon tan ldan pa'i sras rnams dang / /pho nya las mkhan sprul pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs ldan sna tshogs mtshan ma 'dzin/ /sna tshogs 'phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po yon tan dran tsam kyis mnyes pa/ /khyod ltar gzhan la brtse ba 'di na med/ /de phyir bsod nams mi ldan rab bkren pa/ /bdag gis sgo gsum spyod pa gzhan spangs nas/ /bcom ldan 'bad pa'i sgo nas btsal btsal nas/ /sgo gsum dang bas rtag tu dran byed cing / /mchod pa sbyar bas lus kyang dub pa dang / /rtag par ngag tu khyod sngags brtson par zlas/ /skad cig kyang ni khyod sku brjed mi 'gyur/ /sdom gnas dam tshig tshogs dang 'gal ma bgyis/ /de ltar byang chub grogs su khyod brten na/ /tshe rabs kun du thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /bdag bkren 'bad pas mchod pa bshams byas pas/ /bdag gi don slad 'di dag mi bzhes sam/ /mgon po'i thugs dang 'gal ba bshags bgyid na/ /thugs rje can khyod tshangs pa mi stsol lam/ /kho bo dbul phongs sdug bsngal gyis gdungs la/ /pad ltar yangs pa'i spyan kyis mi gzigs sam/ /phongs pas 'o dod 'bod cing gsol 'debs na/ /kun mkhyen sgrib med snyan gyis mi 41—791

byed—byedagasan nam/ /bdag gdong mchi mas g.yogs shing sdug bsngal ba/ /brtser ldan shes rab spyan gyis mi gzigs sam/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs me yis rgyud bsregs pa/ /skyon bral dag pa'i thugs kyis ma dgongs sam/ /bar chad bgegs dang dgra tshogs 'di dag kun/ /bde chen dpa' ba'i stobs kyis mi 'joms sam/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs su gsol 'debs na/ /thar lam 'dren pa'i ded dpon mi mdzad dam/ /tshul bzhin bsgrubs kyang grub pa mi ster na/ /sngon gyi dam bcas blo de ma nyams sam/ /gal te mgon khyod tshe 'dir 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /bdag la sngon gyi smon lam 'brel med pas/ /de phyir nyid kyis bdag la mi dgongs na/ /thugs rjes dgongs pa'i lha gzhan gang yin mos/ /kye ma'o bcom ldan srid 'joms thugs rje yi/ /sprin chen mnga' ba khyod la rten gyur kyang / /sdug phongs bzod dka'i tsha bas gdungs gyur kyang / /zhi ma gyur na 'di rgyu ci zhig lags/ /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs gang dang gang / /de kun sman slad nor bu rin po che/ /sna tshogs gter gyi char pa 'be+ebs zhes kyang / /phongs pa bdag la thigs tsam bab ma myong / /nyi ma'i 'od dang lhan cig mun 'khyams bzhin/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid mgon khyod brten bzhin du/ /sdug phongs me yis bdag gi rgyud gdungs ni/ /khyod kyi thugs rje che ba gang du thal/ /'jig rten skyong ba khyod zhal blta 'dod pas / /'khor bcas rtag par mngon du bsgoms byas kyang / /khyod sku phyogs gcig kyang ni mngon ma gyur/ /'gro don mdzad pa'i sku mchog med dam ci / /bum bzang yid bzhin nor dang dpag bsams shing / /de dag gis kyang 'gro ba'i re skong na/ /khyod blo bskal pa mang por skyed bskyed pa'i/ /47—792

——byed —gzhan don thugs rje'i rgyun de gang du thal/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i dbang phyug rnam thos bu/ /ngal bso dge ba'i stobs zhes khyod kyi mtshan/ /thos pa tsam mam skad cig dran pas kyang / /nyes pa kun zhi bde dpal rgyas 'gyur na/ /bdag gis yun ring khyod mtshan brjod byas kyang / /mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu thob ma gyur/ /gang tshe bdag cag 'dod ldan nyon mongs bcas /de phyir khyod kyis grub pa mi ster na/ /nyon mongs zad tshe longs spyod ci zhig dgos / /kun mkhyen/ thob nas gzhan la gsol ci 'tshal/ /gal te bdag mthus dbul phongs 'dor nus na/ /bcom ldan snyan la bzan bgyid mi rigs mod / /bdag la yus med mgon khyod skyon bral bas/ /'khrug med snying rje'i stobs la gsol ba 'debs/ /nad kyis ngal gyur phongs pas sems brgyal nas / /rmi lam tsam du mgon po ci zhig bsten/ /rab tu skyo bas bla bcol 'di dag rdol/ /bcom ldan thugs rje'i zhags pas gzung du gsol/ /bdag cag rtsod ldan sems can skyon mang bas/ /skyon bral khyod la smra bar mi rigs kyang / /skyabs su chags sdang bral dang mgon khyod la/ /nyams thag dus na 'bod cing gnas ma mchis/ /brel zhing phongs pas cho nges btab byas kyang / /'di na bdag la gdong sdebs gzhan ma mchis/ /sdug phongs dus na mgon po khyod 'bod na/ /sngon kyi dam bcas blo de rjes dran nas/ /ma byams bu sdug bzhin du 'dir gshegs la/ /mdzes pa'i sku mchog bdag la bstan du gsol/ /dbul phongs sdug bsngal nyes pa'i bud shing rnams/ /khyod sngags bzlas pa'i mes ni bsreg par mdzod/ /rtse gcig thugs rjes brtse gdung shugs phyung ste/ /nor gyi dbang phyug gter gyi dngos grub stsol/ /47—793

bsod nams bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rnams dang / /rnam par sdang bas log zhugs dgra tshogs kun/ /sde chen 'khor mang g.yog dang pho nyar bcas/ /gnod sbyin dbang po'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol/ /de ltar mgon po nyes pa'i tshogs 'joms la/ /bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i bsod nams des/ /gnod pa'i rkyen bral 'dod pa'i 'bras smin nas/ /khyod bzhin phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas thob shog /chos skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos sras la bstod cing gnad nas bskul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa thugs rje'i ba 'jo zhes bya ba'i snyan sngags kyi phreng ba slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogasto// //paṇ+ḍi ta te dza de ba dang / lots+tsha ba 'phags pa shes rab kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //41—791

༄༅/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/1༄4/ /dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa 2la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs ni/ /lha mo skal ba bzang mo nyon/ /ma mo'i khyim dang nyams dga' bar/ /bsgom pa bzang po bya ba nyid/ /'bar ba'i bris skur dmigs nas ni/ /sngar mchod blo gros ldan pa yis/ /gar stabs 'gying bas stan gnas pa/ /sgu mdog dmar po 'od zer dmar/ /zhal gcig pa la spyan gsum pa/ /ral pa'i cod pan dag gis brgyan/ /dmar po 'bar 'khyil 'jigs pa ste/ /mche ba gcigs 5pa yang dag bri/ /dgra sta gtun shing nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin du yang mda' gzhu nyid/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ 6ga dang lcags kyu dang / /khrag gis gang ba'i thod 7pa dang / /rdo rje ral gri de bzhin gzhan/ /sha chen thod pa 'dzin pa dang / /phub chung ba dan rtse gsum dang / /'phang mdung dang ni bcu gnyis so/ /oṃ gaḥgaḥsirnyi sidhi/41byed796

sarba arba ye 1bra sā dha ya 2hūṃ hūṃ dz+dzaḥswā hā/ dgug pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/ bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /stong phrag brgya 4yis 'grub 'gyur bas/ /phyi nas las ni yang dag brtsam/ /lan cig yongs bzlas thig le bya/ /sngags pa skal 5bzang mthong na dga'/ /rgyal po'i sgo ru ches mchod cing / /dgra rnams thams cad 'jigs par byed/ /bgegs rnams nye bar sgod /byed yin/ /'dod pa kun gyi 'bras ster bar/ /the tshom med pa nyid du 'gyur / /de lta'i cho gas sgrub pa nyid/ /ma mo rnams ni sgrub pa'i mchog /de dbus khro bo chen po ni/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /zhal ni mche ba cung zad gcigs/ /khros bcas zhal ni bzhad pa dang / /sku mdog sngon po 'jigs chen po/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /yi dwags zhon zhing nyi mar gnas/ /gar stabs sum cu 'jigs par mdzad/ /stag gi pags pa'i gos 'dzin cing / /spyan gsum bzang po'i gzugs can te/ /ba dan gsum par rdo rje dang / /thod pa dang ni mtshan mo 'dzin/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag dag na/ /de bzhin mda' dang gzhu nyid do / /7sgrub thabs 'di rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro las phyung ba'o// //41—797

༄ / /tshogs kyi bdag po gsang ba'i sgrub thabs jes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga ṇa pa ti gu h+ya sā dha rgo 2nā ma/ bod skad du / tshogs kyi bdag po gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro don phyogs med spyod pa la/ /bsod nams tshad med bskyed dgos pas/ /tshogs kyi bdag po bsgrub par bya/ /mi skad khyi skad mi thos pa'i/ /gangs sam ri bo mthon po'i rtse/ /lha chen gnas pa'i sa yin pas//sgrub pa'i gnas su shes par bya/ /zangs kyi maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi'i steng / /bum pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor bri/ /de steng 4ka ra wa di 5gzhag /chu dang 'o ma bsres 6pas dgang / /bskyed pa'i sa bon shel rdo gzhug /ga bur dzā ti tsan+dan gdab/ /de steng 7tshogs bdag bzhugs pa'i rten/ /byang shar kha bltas lung pa yi/ /sa chu bsres 8pa'i 'dag pa la/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgu bzhengs te/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog dmar/ /g.yas pa srid pa'i mes po la/ /g.yon 71—799

pa ra nu'i mtshan ma rnams/ /phyag gnyis thal sbyor spos sdong 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum mjug 1ma can/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /ka ra wa di'i steng du gzhag /khong par spre snying dum gcig dang / /yig 'bru bcu pa'i gsang sngags gzhug /de yi mdun du mchod pa dang / /gtor ma bzang po bsham par bya/ / de nas bdag nyid lhar bskyed la/ /stong pa'i ngang las gaḥde las/ /spre'u phyag bzhi bskyed bsams te/ /de yi thugs kar gaḥl ni/ /sngags kyis bskor bar bsam bya ste/ /rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis / /tshogs bdag bkug la sku la bstem/ /sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab/ /hūṃ rang bzhin dag pa'i lha yul nas/ /lha chen yab yum bshos pa'i sras/ /nor bu dri ma med pa ni/ /gzhon nu stobs kyi rgyan gyis spras/ /phyag bzhi gling bzhi khyab par nyul/ /lha dmag dkar po'i kha lo bsgyur/ /gang gis khyod kyi mtshan 'dzin pa/ /de la nor gyi char pa 'be+ebs/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul spyan 'dren na/ /thugs rjes dgongs la gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ga ṇa pa ti ā kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ/ de nas mchod pa'i tshogs rnams dbul/ /de nas bsnyen pa bskyal bar bya/ /tshogs bdag thugs kar zla ba la/ /rtsa ba'i sngags dang gzungs kyis bskor/ /sngags bzlas spro bsdu'i spyor ba bya/ /oṃ ga ṇa ma ga ṇa dz+nyā ya swā hā/ oṃ rat+na rat+na rah+pho rah+pho ga ṇa pa ti ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ṇa pa ti swā hā/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ma nu pa tra/ tu ru tu ru/ gha gha ta ya ga ṇa pa ti swā hā/ rtsa sngags gzungs sngags bcas pa la/ /zhag bdun bar du bsnyen pa bskyal/ /de dus ting 'dzin rim pa ni/ /rang las 'od 'phros mchod pa'i tshogs/ /spros nas tshogs bdag sgu la 'bul/ /— tshogs bdag sku 47byed800

las 'od zer 'phros/ /stong gsum nor gyi bcud bsdus nas/ /lha chen tshogs kyi zhal du gsol/ /khong du zhu nas gsang bar 'dzags/ /'og gi 1bum pa khengs par bsam/ /bum chu skabs su lto chu bya/ /de nas las la sbyar bar bya/ /pho dang mo yi dbang po dang / /'khor lo las la sbyar bar bya/ /zangs las srid pa'i mes po bya/ /lto bar skyes pa'i pho mtshan gzhug /rtsa ba'i sngags la las sngags gdags/ /sham bu kha sgyur shes par bya/ /de ltar zhag gsum las la sbyar/ /srid pa'i mes po dar snas brgyan/ /yul 'khor mthong sar g.yugs byas na/ /lha mo rnams kyang 'du bar 'gyur/ /yang na ra nu'i mtshan ma la/ /las sbyor sngags de zhag gsum gdab/ /gsal shing rtse la phyar byas nas / /skyes pa 'du ba'i sar phyin na/ /lha rnams 'tshogs 2par gyur pa na/ /brgya byin mdzes pa lta bu ru/ /skyes pa thams cad sems 'dus nas/ /bkur sti phun sum tshogs par byed/ /yid 'phrog sngags ni 'di yin no/ /o ga na ma ga ṇa dz+nyā ya swā hā/ oṃ ba ba/ se se/ khang khang / yer yer/ rab rab ghur mi/ ha sa mang kha mi/ skyes pa'i tshogs wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ 'khor lo las la sbyor ba ni/ /mdun du zangs kyi maṇ+ḍal khar/ /mda' bzhi btsugs la 'khor lo brgyad4/ /yul dang grong dang rgyal blon tshogs/ /'khor lo 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ /rang dbang med par 'gugs par bsam/ /sngags kyi 'od zer zhag gsum mo/ /srid gsum dbang sdud las sbyor yin/ /de nas gtor ma phul byas la/ /bstod pa bya zhing bzod gsol dbul/ /ye shes gshegs la dam tshig bsdu/ /mis ma mthong bar sba bar bya/ /skar ma rgyal la bab pa'i tshe/ /mchod bstod gtor ma gtang bar bya/ /de ltar brtson 'grus ldan gyur na/ /gang bsams pa ni 'grub 'gyur 47—801

zhing / /yid du 'dod pa char du 'bab 1 / /'di brtsams dge ba ci yod pas/ /byang chub spyod pa la zhugs nas/ /sems can rnams kyi don byed shog /tshogs kyi bdag po spre'u yi mgo can gyi sgrub thabs/ dpal dngos grub brnyes pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //slad kyis mkhan po dī paṃ kā ra shrī dz+nyā na dang lo tsā ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o/ /tshogs bdag gi phyi sgrub gri sta dkar po/ nang sgrub chags pa rdo rje/ gsang sgrub spre'u'i dbu can rnams dang / gzhan yang tshogs bdag dmar po phyag bcu gnyis pa/ tshogs bdag sprin gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba sngon po phyag bzhi pa rnams bla ma chos dpal bzang pos bdag la gnang ngo // //bsdur mchan/799 1 ma/tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈snar 〉tshor mi bzhugs pa/sa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉zodang dpe bci ra byas yod/ 〈〈pe 〉〉tshogs kyi bdag ngo/ gsang ba'i sgru ba thabs a mo gha badz+ras mdzad pa/ bzhugs so // 2 〈〈pe 〉7rgo/ 〈〈pe 〉〉sgrub/ 〈〈pe 〉skabangs/ 〈〈co 〉〉sted/5 〈〈pe 〉〉ti/ 6 〈〈pe 〉rabasros/ 7 〈〈pe 〉skabangs/ 〈〈pe 〉rabasregs/ (〈〈pe 〉7)/8 ༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉skorajug 〈〈pe 〉rabaḥl sa tshogs kyi bdag ngo bskyed/ /de nas bdag nyid lhar bskyed la/ /snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od phros te/ /sum cu rtsa gsum̐ lha yu la nas/ /tshogs kyi bdag po spyan drangs te/ /mdun gyi sku la bstem par bya/ /hūṃ rang bzhin dag pa/'i lha yul nas/ /lha chen yab yum bshos pa'i sras/ /nor bu dri ma med pa ni/ /gzhon nu stobs kyi rgyan gyis spras/ /phyag bzhi gling bzhi khyab pa/ra nyul/ /lha dmag dkar ngo/'i kha lo bsgyur/ /gang gis khyod kyi ma/tshan 'dzin pa / /de la nor gyi char pa 'be+ebs/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul spyan 'dren na/ /thugs rjes dgongs la gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ga ṇa pa ti a kasgo yang dzaḥdzaḥ de 77 byed802

nas mchod pa'i tshogs rnams dbul/ /de nas bsnyen pa bskyal bar bya/ /tshogs bdag thugs lar zla ba la/ /rtsa ba'i sngags dang gzungs kyis bskor/ /snga gas bzlas spro bsdu'i sbyo ra ba bya/ /oṃ ga ṇa ma ga ṇa dz+nyā ya swā hā/oṃ rat+na rat+na rasmo racho ga ṇa pa ti ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ṇa pa ti swā hā/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ma nu pa tra/ tu ru tu ru/ gha gha ta ya ga ṇa pa ti swā hā/ rtsa sngags gzungs sngags bcas pa la/ /zhag bdun bar du bsnyen pa bskyal/ /stong pa'i ngang las ga de las/ /spre'u phyag bzhi bskyed bsams te/ /de'i thugs thar ga la ni/ /sngags kyis bskor bar bsam bya ste/ /rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis/ /tshogs bdag bkug la sku la bstim/ /sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab/ /8༷1 〉〈〈pe 〉tha/ du 〈〈pe 〉thedzags/ na 〈〈pe 〉posar/ 18 〈〈pe 〉mugang dang /8 ༷2 tu 〈〈pe 〉torabeb/ 〈 〈〈pe 〉thadzad madz+rad/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2364)41 wa 803

2438ra༅/ /'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po chags pa rdo rje'i dam tshig gi bstod pa zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ga ṇa pa ti rā ga badz+ra sa ma ya stod tra nā ma / bod skad du/ 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po chags pa rdo rje'i dam tshig gi bstod pa zhes bya ba/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan tshogs bdag dgyes/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan zhi ba skye/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan khro bo che/ /tshe 'di nyid la dngos grub ni/ /ci 'dod par ni stsol bar mdzod/ /lha yi rgyal po'i mnga' thang ni//sgrub pa po la stsol bar mdzad/ /shin tu thugs rje'i bdag nyid pas2/ /tshogs bdag chen po thugs rje che/ /thugs rje chen pos dbul ba skyob / /nor lha 4chen po khyod nyid la/ /bdag nyid gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal ldan tshogs bdag chen po ni/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ /glang chen byi la spre'u'i zhal/ /la phug ral gri rin chen dang / /chang snod la tsho 11byed8074

du dgra sta 'dzin/ /brkyang bskum skyil krung yum steng 1bzhugs/ /zhal nang rin chen char pa 'be+ebs/ /sgrub pa po yi dbul ba sel/ /gsus che rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan 2tshogs bdag la'o/ /chang dang la du la phug dang / /'bras chan khur ba'i gtor ma bzhes/ /tshe dang longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /nad dang 'byung ba zhi bar mdzod/ /mi dang 'byung po gnod sbyin bdud/ /thams cad bran du 'gyur bar shog /lha yi longs spyod mang po las/ /'dod pa'i yon tan 'byung bar shog /dngos grub sgrub pa'i dbang phyug can/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis skur sprul pa/ /lha chen tshogs bdag chen po ste/ /'jig rten 'dir yang bsrung ba dang / /byang chub thob pa'i grogs mdzod cig /ces bstod la gsol ba gdab pa ste bzlas pa thon nas gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /tshogs kyi bdag po chags pa rdo rje dam tshig gi bstod pa paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po de nyid dang / lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o / / //41—805

bsdur mchan/8༷4 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈snar 〉〉pa mi bzhugs pas 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉stanang dpe bsdur byas yod/ 2 〈〈co 〉〉pas/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉skyabs/ 4 〈〈pe 〉〉pa/8 ༷5 1 〈〈pe 〉〉stengs/ ge 〈〈pe 〉〉waldan/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2365)41 wa 806

༄ga /sprin gyi sgon ma tshogs kyi bdag po sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ me gha a lo ka ga ṇa pa ti sā dha rgo 2nā ma/bod skad du/ sprin gyi sgron ma tshogs kyi bdag po sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/tshogs kyi bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro rgyal khyu mchog phongs pa sel/ /mdog sngo de la bdag btud de/ /gter gyi sgon ma zhes bya ba'i/ /sgrub thabs bdag gi legs rtogs dang / /rgyud dang man ngag legs dran pas/ /yang dag bdag gis bshad par bya/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos/ /yid 'ong legs pa'i gnas dag tu/ /sngar langs khrus byas me tog gtor/ /tsan+dan chu yis maṇ+ḍal bya/ /me tog dri zhim tshom bu dgram/ /de nas rang nyid yi ge saṃ/ /de las 'od 'phros spyan drangs la/ /mchod cing gu gul nag po'i spos / /btang zhing 'od kyi ngo bor bzhu/ /rang nyid nang du legs par gzhug /de yi stobs kyis bdag nyid kyang / /zhal gabyug pa la phyag 47—807

bzhi pa/ /sgu mdog sngon po spyan gsum pa/ /dbu la ral pa'i cod pan te/ /zla tshes dang ldan sbrul gyis brgyan/ /phyag g.yas dgra sta mche ba dang / /g.yon pa rtse gsum zhags pa bsnams/ /stag gi pags pas smad dkris shing / /klu rgyal dkar po'i do shal can/ /'od zer tshogs ldan de bsgom bya/ /rin chen rten la ye shes gzhug /mchod pa bya zhing yi dwags 'jigs/ /de yis de la bdag 1nas ni/ /sku yi sa bon dang po ste/ /bzhi pa'i lnga pa 2e yis brgyan / /dang po'i gsum pa de 'og ste/ /de 'og dbyangs yig dang po'o/ /drug pa'i gsum pa'i sa bon la/ /o yig mgo bo legs par brgyan/ /dang po'i dang po de 'og gnas/ /rlung gi sa bon de 'og ste/ /zhi ba'i yi ge'i gdan du ni/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa steng du sa/ /khro bo'i skad gdangs rjes la brjod/ /ā li kā li legs par rtogs/ /de ltar btus pa'i rig pa de/ /nyin re khri tsho re re dang / /gu gul nag po'i ri lu la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi spyin sreg bya/ /de ltar 'bad pas zla re la/ /dong tse 'bum 'bum rnyed par byed/ /rgyal gyi nyin par sngar langs nas/ /mchod pa dang ni gtor ma dang / /dri zhim spos kyis legs par mchod/ /rten ni gtsang ma'i gzhi'am ni / /khyu mchog pags pa'i gzhi la ni/ /sgrub pos mtshon gang gong gzugs bri / /rgyal gyi nyin par rdzogs pa la/ /rmugs 'dzin rgyal po khyod kyis mdzod//zhes brjod gar yang bcang bar bya/ /za ma tog gi nang du ni/ /me tog bzang dang dri bzangs kyis/ /legs par bsdams nas der gnas bya/ /rtag par de la mchod bya ste/ /rgya chen tshogs kyis legs par mchod/ /de ltar rgyun du byas pa yis/ /gter chen thams cad thob pa dang / /'byung 11byed808

ngo/'i tshogs kyang 'dun par 'gyur/ /kun la gtsang 1zhing gtsang sbrar ldan/ /'di ni 'di yi dam tshig go/ /'di la 'bad gyur thams cad la/ /gter gyes re ba skong ba dang / /dus rnams kun du khyod kyis gzigs/ /zhes ni legs par rtogs par mdzod/ /tshogs bdag gzigs 2gzugs gsal ba yi/ /sgrub thabs gter gyi sgon ma 'di/ /'gro rnams phongs las grol ba dang / /spyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /tshogs kyi bdag po sprin gyi sgron ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang lo tsā ba nag tsho tshul khyems rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //41—809

2440༄ / /dpal tshogs kyi bdag po 'jur gegs sel ba zhes bya ba'i sprub thabs zhes bya ba/ 1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī adz+nyā 2bi ni ba tra ga ṇa pa ti sā dha rgo nā ma / bod skad du/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po 'jur gegs sel ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba / 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can kun la snyoms pa'i thugs rje yis/ /rtag tu 'dzin byed de yi sprul pa no / /tshogs kyi bdag la gus pas phyag 'tshal te/ /gsang ba'i sgrub thabs bdag gis bshad par bya/ /dang po tshogs bdag rten bzhengs pa/ /rta yi khru 'am ras bzangs 4la/ /'phags pa sku mdog gangs ltar dkar/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ /glang chen byi la spre'u yi zhal/ /phyag g.yas la phug rin chen dang / /ral gri g.yon pas la du dang / /chang gi thod 5pa dgra sta'o/ /zhabs g.yas brkyang ba g.yon pa bskum/ /gnyis kyis skyil krung legs par bzhugs/ /'og tu lha mo dkar mo ni/ /spre'u yi zhal du 'phags 41—81 1

pa yi1/ /gsang ba phyed tsam nub par bya/ /zhabs rten pa yi lha mo gnyis/ /yum kyi kha nas rin chen 'bab/ /bum pa zed cing sgrub pa po'i/ /dbul ba sel zhing re ba bskong / /skar chen dag la bri bar bya/ /de yi logs bzhir gi 2wang gis/ /tar+ya thā/ na maḥstu te ga ṇa ba ti/ kaṣ+ṭa kaṣ+ṭa/ maṣ+ṭa maṣ+ṭa/raṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa/ da ha da ha/ kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍa/ bañja bañja / na maḥstu ste/ga ṇa pa ti ru ru tsa na ya swā hā/ oṃ a bhu 4tra bi na bu kha nābye dha ra bh+ra ma gats+tsha ti/ha ha ya/ ma byu ha 5ti k+ṣi ta nan pra ye ba ye mi/ ku ru ku ru/ tsu ru tsu ru / mu ru mu ru/ na mo na ma swā hā/ tshar re ming dang spel ba bri/ /de rgyab gzungs 6ring bri bar bya/ /rab tu gnas pa de yi mdun/ /maṇ+ḍal dkar po 'dab brgyad la/ /tsan+dan chu yis byugs pa'i steng / /me tog dkar po sil mar bkram/ /chang dang la phug la du dang / /'bras chan khur ba la sogs pas/ /'phags pa mchod la bdag nyid ni/ /yi dam byas la sngags 'di bzlas/ /oṃ ge ga ṇa pa ti ma 7ma rat+na sed+dhi ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ṇa pa ti swā hā/ zhes pa grangs kyi rtags dang sbyar/ /zla ba gcig gis nges par 'grub/ /de nas sgu gzugs mchod byas la/ /dar du dril la mi yi rkang //dbus su bcug la tho rangs khar9/ /lags pas btsugs te gtor ma sbyin/ /oṃ shaṃ ga ṇa pa ti rat+na sid+dhi ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ṇa pa ti swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ ga ṇa pa ti ba bo ta khā nyi khā hi/ bdun gyis sngags la dbul bar bya/ /de nas bstod la sngags 'di bya/ /oṃ ga ṇa pa ti rat+na rat+na 1sid+dhi mā ma rodha rodhe sag ṇa pa ti ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga 1 ka ṭa ka ṭa swā hā/ ga ṇa pa ti rad+ma na puṣ+ṭi —ku ru ma ṭa ma ṭa swā hā/ ga ṇa pa ti sidhi wa shaṃ 'aku ru ra ṭa ra ṭa swā hā/ ga ṇa 47byed812

pa ti rat+na bo ṣaṭa kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi swā hā/ brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas pa yis/ /yid la re ba rdzogs par 'gyur/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal nyid thob nas/ /'bad pa med par nor rnyed 'gyur/ /spogs mi dgos par 'grub 'gyur te/ /de'i phyir gtor ma 'bad par bya/ /'phags pa 'jur gegs kun sel ba'i/ /sgrub thabs 'di brtsams dge ba des/ /'jig rten nor la dbang byed cing / /bla med 'bras bu thob par shog /'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs 'jur gegs sel ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po in+d+ra bhū tis 1mdzad pa sdogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ges yam bu karta rir legs par bsgyur ba'o// //41—813

2441dag /'chol ba'i grub thabs/1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ u tsuṣ+ṭha sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ 'chol ba'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa dzam+bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi bskyod —pa'am tha mal snying gar ni/ /a las zla steng hūṃ nag 5gser 'od can/ /las byung rdo rje rtse dgu'i 6lte ba la/ /zla steng hūṃ gi 7'od kyis lha spyan drangs/ /mchod pas mnyes te rang gi snying gar zhugs/ /tshad med bzhi dang byang chub sems bskyed la—/ /rdo rje 'od kyis dngos kun lhar bsgyur thim/ /oṃ ās 8spyan drang 9der bstem lhar gsal bya/ /pad+ma nyi mar nor bdag rgyan spras pa/ /nor skyug mgo rkang gnon pa khro bo'i gzugs/ /mi bskyod dbu mdzes thod khrag ne+e'u le 'dzin/ /klus brgyan thugs kar zla ba sngar bzhin bsam/ /dbu zhal dpung pa g.yas g.yon thugs ka dang / /g.yas g.yon brla dang gsang gnas byin gnyis la/ /zla bar yi ge bcu pa gser 'od 'phro/ /'od kyis mchod dang lhar bsgyur nor 41byed815

— ——— — ———— —zhe— byed— —bsdus skyug /'a/ga mthil bam̐ las/ gser bum rin chen sgyug /ma/dzub mo gung mo ming med mthe'u chung dang / /mthe bong nor 'chang g.yas g.yon yi ge bcu/ /oṃ in+d+ra ni nu/ khaṃ bh+ra ma ri swā hā/ oṃ dza 1rlu swā hā/ rim bzhin byin kyis brlab dang dbung/ sngags so/ /phyag dang zhal dang gsang gnas nang 2nas phyag /de nas zhal du dmar ser chu rgyun 'jug /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha dā ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ lo phyed thun drug chu phu'/ 'byor chen 'grub/ /spogs na dh+ri mdzad khros pas dug khrag dang / /tsha ba ske tshe mar khus byugs te bskam/ /ram̐ las khong par gru gsum me bsams dbul— / /sa'am rdo las mkhyid 5gang sku gzugs bya/ /lha bstem thab khyang gzhug ste mchod par bya/ /rtsibs brgyad 7'khor lor sku'am sngags bris te/ /lha bstems dril te rin chen 'bar gzugs 'chang / /sna tshogs rgyun du zhabs nas chu 'dzag pa'i/ /'og tu lha sku ye shes bsnyims pa gzhug /mal logs sngas sam sku bri ye shes gzhug /gzugs brnyan snod nang 'chang byas chu dbul lo/ /u tsuṣ+ṭha sgrub pa'i thabs thun mong ma yin pa slob dpon sgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dā na shī las bsgyur ba'o// //47byed8/6

bsdur mchan/815 1ma tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i ma/tshan bod skad du smos nga ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉shes ba dpon sbeg nga rdo rjes mdzad nga/'i spu ba thabs bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉tsu ṭ+wā/〈〈snar 〉〉tsushā/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉rdza bha/ 〈〈snar 〉〉'dzam/ bha 4〈〈pe 〉〉skyod/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉sto da nag po/ (7〈〈snar 〉gdagu/ snye 〈〈snar 〉〉ses / 〈〈snar 〉to/6sa /9〈〈snar 〉〉drangs/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉g.yon dang / 1〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/816 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dzu/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉wanang / 〈〈snar 〉skabu/ 4〈〈snar 〉stanabus/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'khyid/6〈〈pe 〉〉bzhugs te/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉brgyan/ 8〈〈snar 〉〉bstem/ ‘ 〈〈pe 〉〉bcang / 〈〈sna ra 〉〉bcas / 7〈〈pe 〉〉bstim pa gzhug 〈〈snar 〉〉bstim pa bzhugs/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉snga gas sngags sam spu bri/ 〈〈snar 〉〉snga las sam sku bris / sa〈〈pe 〉〉tsu tha/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tsushā/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2368)41wa 817

༄ / /rmyags 'dze+en 'chol ba'i sgrub thabs jes bya ba/1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ u tsuṣ+ṭha dzam+bha la sā dha rgo nā ma/ bod skad du/ rmugs 'dzin 'chol ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan rmugs 'dzin 'chol ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig spyan gsum grags pa'i gtsug phud kyi/ /rgyan gyi nor bu la reg zhabs ldan pa/ /thub pa'i gzhon nu des ni thub dbang sras/ /rnams kyis 4phun tshogs mchog mang rgyas mdzad gyur / /bla med yon tan gnyis med pa'i/ /rin chen grong khyer 'dren pa ste/ /'gro ba rang gis 5phun tshogs la/ /myur du len 'dod 'di bstan spyobya/ /de la dang po re zhig bdag gis dzam+bha la mnyes par byas nas/ sa rtogs pas de'i bdag nyid du gyur te/ 'gro rnams mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i phun sum tshogs pa la rab tu dgod par bya'o zhes bya ba'i bsam pa dang ldan pas snying gi nang gi bu gar thig le dang bral ba'i yi ge a 8dkar po 41—818

'od zer 'phro ba de las skyes pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /der hūṃ yig dbus sngo ba phyi rol kun nas cung zad ser ba/ 'od zer gyi tshogs 'gro ba mgo 1gyen du bstan pa ste/ de las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ kha dog dang bya ba hūṃ yig dang 'dra ba ste lte ba'i nang du son pa'i zla ba la gnas pa'i rtsu de lta bu dang ldan pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ a zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas hūṃ yig dang rdo rje dag las 'od zer 'phros te/ phyogs bcu nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i dzam+bha la'i gzugs mtha' yas pa rnams mar me blang ba'i tshul kyis spyan drangs nas mdun du de'i sku gcig tu rnam par bsgoms la/ 'od zer rnams kyis mchod pa lngas mchod pa dang / sdig pa bshags pa nas btang snyoms kyi bar du bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su hūṃ dang rdo rje'i 'od zer rnams la lus mtha' dag bstems la spros pa thams cad dang bral ba nyid kyis stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin zla ba dang rdo rje dang / sa bon gyi 'od zer rnams la oṃ a 4zhes bya ba 'di dang / 'od zer spros pas bcom ldan 'das spyan drangs la gzhug zhepar bya'o/ /gzhug 6pa'i mjug thogs su skad byug gis zla ba la sogs pa rnams kyis rdzogs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rmugs 'dzin 'chol ba gzhon nu lo lnga lon pa lta bu mi'u thung gi 7rnam pa can sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba'i steng du nor sbyin ser po rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa rin po che'i dbu rgyan ne+ecan/ zhal nas rin po che sgyug cing gan rkyal du nyal ba'i dpral bar zhabs g.yas pa dang rkang pa gnyis kyi steng du g.yon pas mnan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi gom stabs can/ gcer bu rtags 9gyen du 'greng ba / gsus pa 'phyang 1ba thugs kar phyag g.yas na thod pa 41—819

khrag gis gang 1ba bsnams pa la g.yon du phyogs nas gzigs pa/ brla g.yon pa la brten pa'i phyag g.yon pas ne+e'u le kha nas 'og tu rin po che'i tshogs sgyugs 2pa bsnams pa snyan ma phug cing gug pa/ zhal mche ba zla ba phyed pa lta bur gcigs pa/ spyan dmar la zlum pa/ dpral ba'i dbyes su khro gnyer byas pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'greng ba/ dbu la thub pa mi bskyod —pa sngon po sa gnon gye phyag rgya can gyis rgyas btab pa/ mtha' yas 5sngon po ta ma la'i lo ma lta bus dbu skra bcings pa/ 'jog po dmar pos rna ba dkris pa/ pad+ma chen po pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar dkar bas do shal byas pa/ stobs kyi rgyu ljang gu drur 6ba lta bus tshangs skud byas pa/ nor rgyas dkar pos ske 7rags byas pa/ pad+ma me tog kun+da ltar mdzes pas rkang gdub byas pa/dung skyong ser pos lag gdub byas pa/ rigs ldan du ba'i mdog can khra bos dpung rgyan byas pa/ sgu mdog sngon po 'od zer ser po'i tshogs 'phro ba bsgoms 9nas dpral ba dang / kha dang dpung pa g.yas g.yon dang / snying ga dang / rdo rje'i steng dang / brla g.yas g.yon dang / zhabs g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i nang gi rtsa'i —bu gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu rnams la/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā zhes bya ba'i yi ge ser po rnams ni 'od zer rtaser po can du blta bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la sna'i rlung phyir 'byung ba'i dus su oṃ yig la sogs pa'i 'od zer rnams dang thugs ka'i hūṃ dang / rdo rje'i 'od zer rnams phyogs thams cad du spros te reg pa tsam gyis sems can thams cad kyi sems dang sems las byung ba bcom ldan 'das kyi ngo bor gyur pa rnams rlung 'jug pa'i dus su hūṃ yig la bcug la sems brtan par byed pas brtan par bya'o/ / 47byed820

'jig rten kyi khams thams cad na gnas pa'i 1rin po che sna tshogs pa rnams kyang klu dang / ne'u le dang / nor sbyin kha rnams su gzhug par bya'o/ /slar rlung 'byung ba na klu la sogs pa rnams kyis med pa'i rin po che rnams mdun du skyugs par bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar yang dang yang du spro ba dang bsdu ba la sogs pa yang ngo / /de'i rjes su dal bar gyur na/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya / na mo ma ṇi bha dā ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags sam/ yang na dgod pa'i 5sngags yi ge bcu pa bzla bar 6bya'o/ /chu sbyin pa'i dus su ni lag pa g.yas pa gan rkyal gyi dbus su baṃ yig gi 'od zer rnams kyis lag pa bum pa bzang po lta bur byas la/lag pa'i rtsa bar oṃ yig gi 'od zer rnams kyis gdu bu'i rnam pa dang ldan pa dang / baṃ yig gi dbus su rdza dang / mdzub mo dang / gung mo dang /7ming med dang / mthe'u chung dang / mthe bo rnams kyi rtse mo la dzam+bha 9la dza len+d+ra zhes bya ba'i yi ge rnams rim pa ji lta ba dang / oṃ dang baṃ gyi yi ge dag gi bar du ya yig dang / ya yig gi g.yon dang g.yas ngos dag tu swā hā zhes bya ba'i yi ge dag ste/ oṃ yig la sogs pa 'di rnams rang rang gi gnas kyi bu ga rnams su zla ba la gnas pa ser po can du bsgoms nas/ lag pa'i nang du me tog chu dang bcas pa kha dang nye bar byas la/ oṃ in+d+ra ni mu khaṃ bh+ra ma ri swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis lan bdun du mngon par bsngags par bya'o/ /de'i rjes lag pa brkyang bas sbyin par bya ba'i chu rang gi kha nas zhugs pa dze+e yig gi 'od zer rnams dang / thugs kar gnas pa'i rdo rje dang / hūṃ yig gi 'od zer rnams kyis kha dog ser por 7byas pa rdo rje'i kha nas 'thon 7nas lag par 41—821

son 1pa skad cig gis mdun du bcom ldan 'das zhal mngon du phyogs par bsgom pa'am/ sku gzugs kyi zhal gyi nang du oṃ dh+ri swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis lan brgya rtsa brgyad dang / na mo rat+na tra yā ya zhes bya ba la sogs kyis lan bdun du dbul bar bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya zhes —bya ba la sogs pa lan cig 4brjod pas 'bras rngos pa bu ram dang bsres pa la sogs pa rnams kyi gtor ma bcom ldan 'das la dbul bar bya'o/ /de ltar ji ltar nus par 5thun gsum mam/ thun gcig la rjes su bsgrubs 6te bstod pa dang smon lam gdab par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la bsgoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes bya bas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang smin drug gi zla ba dang /dpyid zla ra ba dang / dpyid zla tha chungs dz+wadang / dbyar zla 'bring po rnams gang yang rung ba'i nya'am/ dge ba'i nyi ma gzhan la yang rdo ma gas pa la skad byug gis bcom ldan 'das kyi ngo bor bsgrubs te yang dag par mchod nas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /bzo bo bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa bzung 8bas nyin zhag gcig nyid 9la dpa' bo'i yon gyis sku gzugs byed du gzhug go/ /byas pa la yang bdag nyid la bkod pa bzhin du rim pa ji lta bar bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs la 1 yi ge dgod pa dang bcas pa rnam par bsgoms 11nas/chu sbyin pa la sogs pas mnyes par bya'o zhes bya ba ni man ngag go/ /de'i tshe ni gshegs su gsol bar mi bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das sku gzugs kyi rnam par rtag tu bzhugs pa la bkur khusti dang mchod par bya'o/ /paṇ+ḍi ta a bha ya ka ra gup+tas mdzad pa'i u tsuṣ+ṭha 1 dzam+bha la sgrub pa'i thabs rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta a lo ka de ba dang / lo tsā snyeb shākya'i dge 41—822
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2369)

sngag /dzam+bha la'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 1༄go/ /na mo u tsuṣ+ṭha 2dzam+bha la/ oṃ a zhes byas pas 4spyan drangs5/rang gi snying gar a 6yig yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje rtse dgu pa de'i dbus su in+d+ra go ba dang mnyam pa'i 7dza yig las/ sngar brjod pa'i spyan 'dren pa'i sngags kyis/dzam+bha la'i mgon po rang gi snying gar gzhug ste/ u tsuṣ+ṭha 9byis pa'i gzugs rna ba ma phug pa/ sku mdog nag po skra gyen du brdzes pa/ mi thung gi rnam pa khro gnyer can/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu rgyan can/ phyag g.yon pas rin po che sgyugs pa'i rke'u le 'dzin pa/ g.yas pas khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ lho phyogs su mgo bstan pa'i gser gyi mdog can/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa / nor gter gan rkyal du bsgyel ba zhabs gnyis kyis mnan pa/ rin po che'i phreng ba skyugs 1 pa'i bdag nyid las 'od zer gyi phreng 47—825

ba'i tshogs 'phro bar bsam/ u tsuṣ+ṭha'i phyag g.yas na 1oṃ yig las skyes pa'i gdu bu'o2/ /baṃ yig las skyes pa'i bum pa bzang po dang 'dra ba 'phro bzhin pa / lag pa'i dbus su dze+e yig go/ /mdzub mo la bha 4yig go/ /gung mo la la yig go/ /srin lag la dza yig go/ /mthe 5chung la len 6yig go/ /mje bo la dra yig go/ /mkhrig ma la ya yig go/ /de nas swā hā'o9/ /'di ni sngags dgod —pa'i rim pa'o/ /kha sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs la chu skyor sbyin no/ /oṃ lja swā hā chu skyor sbyin 1 pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ in+d+ra 7ni mu khaṃ bh+ra ma ri swā hā/ lag pa nas kha dang / kha nas lag par de dbe+en par sbyin no/ /'di ltar snying rjes sems can thams cad phongs pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad gcod pa'i don du dzam+bha la bsgom par bya'o/ /u tsuṣ+ṭha 1 dzam+bha la zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rgyal po ār+ya ma tis mdzad pa sasdogs so// //dge slong dar ma grags kyis bsgyur ba'o// //41byed826

2444ra༅/ /'phags pa rmyags 'dzin 'chol ba nag po'i sgrub thabs/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya u tsuṣ+ṭha dzam+bha la kṛṣ+ṭa sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin 'chol ba nag po'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun dzam+bha la'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal gyi dbang phyug dbang chen bcu gnyis 3rin chen rnam pa mang ldan pa/ /thabs mang stobs chen dri med thugs rje drang srong lha mi'i sras gyur de'i/ /sras gcig mtshungs med ma lus srid dang zhi ba'i nor bdag gter chen ni/ /mi'u thung cha byad thod khrag ne+e le 'dzin mdzad khyod kyis bdag la srungs4/ /re zhig sgrub pa po dam tshig can gzhan la phan par brtson pas 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin la mi phyed pa'i dang ba thob pas skyabs su song la/ pad+ma'i 'dab 5ma mchog gi snod dang / gnod sbyin mo kun du rgyug gi lus liṅga chen po'i rdzas dang ldan pas nor bu brtsegs pa lta bu'i gnas su 'dug ste/ thog ma kho nar mi bskyod pa'i rgyal po'i cho ga ji lta ba 47—828

bzhin mnyes par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu de'i nga rgyal gyis bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba byas la/ rang gi snying gar a 1las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig nag po gser gyi mdangs can las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse dgu pa gyen du langs shing rnam par 'gyur ba'i ngang tshul can/ dbus kyi rwa rtse rnam pa dkar po nor bu'i tog gis mtshan pa dang / rwa gzhan gnag cing kun nas bgrad pas 'jigs par byed pa de nyid kyi lte bar zla ba 4dri ma med pa la hūṃ yig bai 5ḍūr+ya'i 'od 'bar bas mtshan pa blta bar bya'o/ /yi ge de'i 'od kyis nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par bkang nas zhing gi dkyil 'khor yongs su spyor ba'i 6don gnyis byas te/ tshur 'dus pa las rje btsun rmugs 'dzin nag po sras dang bcas pa rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa spyan drangs la/khrus gsol ba sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa'i yan lag bcu gsum yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /mnyes pa'i 'od kyi 7phreng ba bdag gi snying la zhugs te bsgul ba'i yid kyis tshad med pa bzhi spel zhing / byang chub kyi sems brtan pa yang dag pa goms pa bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i 'od zer chen pos brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dngos po mtha' dag rnam par bzhu nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor thim pa dang / yang ches cher 'bar bas 11rang gi lus kyang nye bar bsregs 1 nas gzi brjid kyi phung po sgyu ma lta bu'i bdag nyid du bsam mo/ /de'i 'og tu oṃ a 7zhes skad gsang bstod de —sbran pas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi mgon po byang phyogs kyi tshal 7rdo rje'i ri bo'i zom nas spyan drangs tes/ kun nas dang zhing sim la gdung ba'i yid kyis rgyu'i sems dpa' de 1—'od zer gyi phreng 1‘ba 'bar ba la bstem par bya'o/ /47byed829

de dag yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das nor kyi dbang phyug /lha dang klu dang mi'i nor thams cad 'dzin pa mthing nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs can mi'u thung gi cha byad rigs ngan gyi rnam pa/ rna ba ma phug pa/ lhag ma za zhing mi srun 1pa/ gsus pa cher 'phyang zhing rab tu brjid pa'i bdag nyid/ khye'u lo drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ gcer bu mtshan ma 'greng ba/ zhabs gnyis 'dor 2stabs su nye bar gnas pas nor 'dzin ser po kha nas nor bu skyugs pa'i mgo g.yas su rnam par mnan pa/ mche ba cung zad gcigs shing /ljags rkan phugs su nye bar 'dril ba/ zhal dang spyan gsum 4me'i phung po ltar 'bar zhing / spyan kun nas zlum zhing bzlog ltal rnam par bsgyur ba can / dpral ba la rin po che 7mig gsum pa'i gzugs can gyi khro gnyer gyi rim pa dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra dang —smin ma rnams kyi sru kham pa re re nas gyen du langs shing 'od 9'phro ba'i me stag thur du 'dzag pa/ phyag g.yas dang g.yon gyis pad+ma'i snod du ti ras bkang ba dang / ne+e'u le'i rkyal pa lha dang klu dang mi'i nor bu rin po che'i rigs mi 'dra ba du mas khengs par byas pa'i kha nas rin po che'i rgyun sna tshogs sgyugs pa 'dzin pa/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa'i cod pan gyi rgyan can/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang / 'jog po dang /pad+ma chen po dang / stobs kyi rgyu dang / rigs ldan dang / dung skyong dang /nor rgyas dang / pad+ma rnams nag po dang / dmar po dang / ཿ dkar po dang / ser po dang / sngon po dang / khra bo dang / ser po dang /dmar po rnam pa brgyad kyis go rims nyu)ltar thor tshugs dang / rna ba dang /do shal dang / tshangs skud —dang / dpung pa dang / lag pa dang / rked 41—830

pa dang 1/ rkang pa rnams la brgyan pa'o/ /thugs kar zla ba la ji skad bshad pa'i snying po can gyi mtshan ma bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i yi ge bcu'i go cha bgo bar bya ste/ dpral ba dang / zhal dang / dpung pa g.yas pa dang / g.yon pa dang / thugs ka dang / zhabs ngar g.yas —g.yon dang / chu so dang / zhabs bol gong g.yas dang / g.yon dang /grangs bzhin du/ oṃ dang / rdza dang / bha dang / la dang / dza dang / len dang / dra dang / ye dang / swā dang / hā rnams kyi yig 'bru rnams zla ba'i gdan dang / rdo rje phyed pa la gnas pa nyi ma'i snying po 'bar ba'am gser gyi mchod sdong rnam par dag pa ltar bsam par bya'o/ /thugs dkyil snyemi phyed yi ge las 'phros phyogs bcu'i 'dren pa kun mchod sbung / /go cha bcur bcas skyob dbang nyid 'phros ma lus 'gro rnams rang 'drar byas/ /ne+e'u le klu dbang nor bdag 'od ldan lha klu mi yi nor rnams bsdus/ /zos shing 6zos te 'grangs gyur btsir bas de sgyugs dngos grub yang yang blang / /de nas chu sbyin par bya ste/ lag pa'i mthil du baṃ ser po las gser gyi bum pa bzang po rin po che 7sna tshogs sgyugs gapa kha phyir bsgyil ba'i / yi ge baṃ de nyid kyis mtshan par blta'o/ /baṃ gyi /nang du dze+e yig go/ /mkhrig nyu ma la ni oṃ mo/ /mdzub snyamo la ni bha'o/ /gung mo la ni la'o/ /srin lag la sadza' mthe'u chung la len nothu/ /mthe bong la dra'o/ /nor bu mching kyiba'i gnas su ye'o/ /lag mthil gyi lto —g.yon du swā'o —/ /de'i g.yas su hā'o/ /thams cad kyang zla ba la treganas shing / gser 'od dri ma dang bral ba lhag par 'tsher ba ltar bsam mo/ /de nas yang chu khyor ba gang kha la nye bar gtugs te/ oṃ in+d+ra 41—831

ni mu khaṃ 1blu ma ri swā hā zhes bya 2bas sor mo lnga la lan re re dang / kha dang lag pa byin gyis brlab pa la gnyis te bdun gyis byin gyis brlab bo/ /de'i 'og tu nag po chen po mdzes pa'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa zhig mdun kyi pad+ma'i rin po che'i 4snod du zhugs 5te/ rang gi thugs ka nas ci 'dra ba'i sku tre gzugs phyung ste bstems la/ rin po che'i bum pa rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa yongs su gang bas 7rgyun mi 'chad pas chu sbyin par bya'o/ /'di ltar bya ste/oṃ dh+ri swā hā zhes bya bas rin po ches brgyan pa'i lag pa nas zhal du'o/ /zhal nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo ru'o/ /de 9nas slar lag mthil du 'bab pa'i rim pas mthar chu'i bdag po'i zhal du 'jug par bsams skyete/ cho ga de nyid kyis khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad 'khrul pa med par sbyin par bya'o/ /de'i tshe phyag gi 8mthil gyi bum pa dang / ne+e'u le dang ltos 'gro rnams kyi kha dang sna'i sgo la sogs pa bu ga'i rnam pa thams cad las rin po che'i rigs mi 'dra ba sdug cing yid du 'ong ba rnam pa du ma'i char chen po phab pas gnas khang la sogs pa mtha' dag yog cing nor gyis gang 1 bar gyur par bsam mo/ /de'i rjes la yi ge bcu pa la mchod pa rnam pa —lnga'i sngags sbyar bas mchod cing / thun mong dang khyad par gyi sgo nas bstod do/ /sngags de dag nyid kyis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te dbul bar bya'o/ /na mo rat+na mutra yā ya/ oṃ tshim ṇi bha dā ya7/ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye 8/ oṃ rdzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun nam brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du bzlas te ji ltar 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab po//de nas yang mchod pas gtang rag phul te me tog dbu la bzhag — /nas yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang la rten spyi bo dang chu'i phud srin lag gis reg ste lce la sgyu11—832

bzhag 1cing / chu'i tshogs rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i ngogs 2su dor bar bya'o/ /de ltar zla ba drug la sogs par nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du bar ma chad par chu sbyin pa la brtson par byed na/ des ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i 'byor pa thams cad gdon mi za bar 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dbang phyug snying po gter bum las/ /be+egs kyus lcag btab zas nor ster/ /bram ze'i tshangs skyogs lnga tshan lngas/ /bkang 4te bcud bsdus dngos grub len/ /rin chen snying po nyi zla dang / /pad+ma rab sbyangs bde chen thob/ /rim bzhin gnod sbyin ne+e'u le mo/ /thod khrag pur ling sbyor bar bshad/ /dbyar dgun ston zla tha chungs 57dang / /dpyid zla 'bring la 5rten bzhengs nas/ /'di nyid rgyal ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /dam tshig ye shes mnyam spyor bya/ /rna ba mnan dang mdangs 'phrog dang / /dgra bo byis pa'i gzugs 'jigs pas/ /rigs ngan gdug 7pa'i las gsum byed/ /khro zhal phrin 8las bgegs skyod yin / /klu rgyal gdon 'grol char 'be+ebs byed/ /nor bdag gzir bas nor rnams 'phrog /rig 9'dzin dgug dang gter 'byed dang / /'jigs skyob rkun po srung ba nyid/ /bu ster tshe ni bsring ba dang / / phyugs skyong bskyed cing 11gzugs pa dang / /dbang bsgur bkra shis gsol ba stes/ /rim bzhin oṃ nas swā hā'i bar/ /'od dang lhan cig rjes 'gro dang / /slar bzlog yi ge bcu yis so/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad khros pa yis/ / tsha ba dug 2dang khrag ske satshe/ /mar khus 7lus byugs pur ling gdung / /bdun phrag gcig gis spogs na 'grub/ /ye ya dha na me 18dhe baṃ swā hā/ snyigs dus sgrub rnams rab dbul nyen rnams kyis/ /phan 'dod bzhin yang rang gzhan don nyams 41—833

par / /mthong nas rmugs 'dzin cho ga tshul bzhin bris/ /dge bas kun la 'dod sbyin ster 1gyur cig /dpal rmugs 'dzin 'chol ba nag po'i sgrub thabs gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba sbas pa'i bum pa 'khyel ba zhes bya ba/slob dpon nor sbyin gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //dpal chos kyi rje sa'i steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i paṇ+ḍi —ta chen po shākya shrī 5bha dra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis/ bod yul gyi dbus / ngam shod kyi mthil/ bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang rgyal po'i pho brang yid bzhin nor bu'i mdzod dbu rtse rim gsum lha khang gi steng du bkra shis pa'i nyi ma la bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o3// //babe+er mchan/828 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa/ ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉thaphags pa rmugs 'dzin 'tshol ba nag po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// 2 〈〈pe 〉〉tsutha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganas/ 4〈〈pe 〉ra srungs/〈〈snar 〉thasrungs/ 5 〈〈snar 〉thamadab/829 1 〈〈snar 〉mas 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ra/ 〈〈snar 〉tha/'i/ 4〈〈snar 〉7zla ba/ 5〈〈snar 〉8/ 6〈〈snar 〉〉sbyong bas/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)sa/ 〈〈snar 〉mnas/ 9 〈〈snar 〉ra gos/ pa 〈〈snar 〉〉gidag 〈〈snar 〉marabs/7〈〈snar 〉thasreg sa〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mas 2〈〈snar 〉ltod da/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉pagon tshe la/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉ste—/ 7〈〈snar 〉7)/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gide/ 9〈〈snar 〉〉'phreng /83༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉thasrun/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rar/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyug 4〈〈snar 〉ras/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉zlog6〈〈snar 〉skadar pa/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 / ༷ 〈〈snar 〉7sma ra dang / 9sna〈〈snar 〉7zer )〈〈pe 〉7 kha na rin po che'i rgyun sna tshogs skyug 〈〈snar 〉mi kha na ri chen po'i rgyun snod skyug 13〈〈pe 〉〉skyod/mu〈〈snar〉〉—dmar po dang / 〈〈pe 〉d+ku sgo rim/ 〈〈snar 〉kyi ko rims/ 7〈〈snar 〉gas/831 rngo〈〈snar 〉7dang / — 〈〈pe 〉thas mtshan pa// 〈〈pe 〉ṅkadang / nga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkadang / 7〈〈snar 〉〉41byed834

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dzam+bha la kṛṇ+ḍa sā dha māṃ/ bod skad du/'phags pa dzam+bha la nag po sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'phags pa dzam+bha 4la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa dzam+bha la bsgrub par 'dod pas/ yid dang mthun 5pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub 6sems dpa'i go 'phang thob par byas te/ sems can thams cad mtho ris dang thar pa'i bde ba la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du dzam+bha la la chu phul la 7mchod par bya snyam du sems bskyed la/ gnas dang bdag dang rnal 'byor srung — ba ni gzhan dang mthun9/ rang gi snying gar yi ge a ri dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas 1rkapa yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ nang nag la phyi saser ba/ 'od zer ser po 'phro ba bsams la de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse dgu pa hūṃ dang kha dog mtshungs pa bsgom/ de'i 41byed836

lte ba'i nang du hūṃ bsamahūṃ/ hūṃ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros shing /ngag tu oṃ a snazhes brjod pas/ phyogs mtshams thams cad nas sems can gyi don byed pa'i u tsuṣ+ṭha bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa la/ dad cing gus pas phyag 'tshal 4dngos su 'byor pa dang yid las byung ba'i mchod pa sngon 3du 'gro ba'i 6bdun rnam dag bya/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs sogs /7pa yin/ de nas yang rdo rje hūṃ/ zla ba rnams las 'od 8'phros pas snod bcud la phog /de 'od du zhu slar 'od kyi gnas la thim/ mdun 9gyi 'phags pa'ang oṃ a zhes brjod pas rdo rje dang hūṃ dang tha mi dad du gyur/ rang lus kyang 'od du zhu nas rdo rje la sogs pa la thim/ de rnams rmi lam sgyu ma ltar bsam/ de ye shes kyi tshogs sogs 1 pa yin/ rdo rje hūṃ zla ba u tsuṣ+ṭha hūṃ gi sa'od zer de lnga po yongs su gyur pa las/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rnam thos kyi bu sgu mdog ser po mgo g.yas su bstan pa/ gan rkyal du nyal ba/ kha nas rin po che sna tshogs sgyugs mupa/ dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis 2brgyan pa / de'i mgo thur du mnan pa/ 'od zer saphreng ba 'khrug cing 'phro ba'i gdan gyi lte bar/ dbang po sbas pa ltar gnag pa'i dza yig yongs su gyur pa las / u tsuṣ+ṭha ⑩byis pa'i gzugs can shin tu nag 1 pa/ rna ba ma phug pa/ rna ba 15thung ba/ skra kham pa gyen du badze+es pa/ lus thung ba mthug pa/gsus pa che ba/ mche ba gcigs pa/ spyan dmar ba/ khro gnyer bsnyer ba/spyan zlum pa/ phyag gnyis kyi 1g.yas pa na khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa nu ma g.yas pa la brten phyacing zhal du gsol ba'i tshul gyis bsnams pa/ g.yon pa 41—837

na 1rin po che sna tshogs sgyugs 2pa'i ne+e'u le pus mo g.yon gyi dasteng du bzung sngub/zhabs g.yas bsgum pas gdan gyi mgo bo mnan pa/ g.yon brkyang bas 5rkang pa mnan pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ gcer bu thor tshugs la klu mtha' yas nag pos dkris 7pa/ rna ba/ do shal/ tshangs skud/ dpung pa/lag pa/ rked pa/ rkang pa rnams la rim pa ltar/ 'jog po dmar po/pad+ma chen po dkar po/ stobs kyi rgyu sngon po/ rigs ldan khra bo9/ dung skyong ser po/ ba su ki dkar po/ pad+ma dkar po —ste klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ de'i lte bar zla ba'i gdan la hūṃ/ dpral bar oṃ/ lce la rdza/ dpung pa g.yas la bha / g.yon la la/ thugs kar dza1 / lte ba la mulen/ ngar gdong g.yas la dra / g.yon la ye/ bol gong g.yas la swā/ g.yon la hā/yi ge de rnams zla ba'i gdan dang bcas 7pa'o/ /kha dog gnag 7cing 'od ser po 'phro ba'o/ /yi ge de rnams dang thugs ka'i rdo rje'i 7lte ba'i nang gi hūṃ zla ba'i gdan rnams las 'od 'phros te/ sems can la reg pas thams cad dzam+bha lar gyur nas yid kyis hūṃ la bsdu/ yang de rnams las 'od 'phros1 / rin po che thams cad bsdus te rlung nang du rngubs pas klu chen brgyad dang / rnam thos bu dang / ne+e'u le'i kha nang du song / phyir rgyu bas 1nade rnams kyi kha nas skyugs nas — rin po che'i phung po chen po byung / yang zos yang skyugs pa lan mang du bsgom/ de rjes su rang gi lag pa g.yas par oṃ las ḍā 1ki'i gzugs kyi lag pa'i mthil du baṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas skyes bu'i bum pa bzang po'i lag par bsams pa'i bum nang du rdza/41—838

mkhrig lkum la oṃ/ mdzub mo la bha/ gung mo la la/ srin lag la dza/ mje'u chung la len/ mthe bong la dra/ mkhrig ma'i mtshams su ye/ g.yon la swā/ g.yas la hā/ re re la zla ba'i gdan re'o/ /de nas zangs gzhong la sogs pa'i 4nang du rten yod na bzhugs/ med na rang dang 'dra ba'i rten mdun 5du bskyed la/ chu khyor ba gang la6/ oṃ in+d+ra ni 7mu khaṃ dh+ra ma ri swā hā/ zhes pa lan bdun kyis byin kyis brlab / chu khyor ba gang khar blugs par bsams te phul ba khar song bas/ khong 7nang gi rdza gyis ser por gyur snying ga'i hūṃ la sogs pa'i nus pas bdud rtsir gyur pa slar gyen du log ste rang gi lag pa'i mthil du byung ba/ mdun gyi dzam+bha la'i zhal du phul bar bsam 7zhing / oṃ dh+ri swā hā zhes pa lan re dang chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad rim pa 'di gnyis so/ /mjug tu / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/sa na mo ma ṇi bha dru ya1 / ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye—/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā zhes lan bdun brjod la chu khyor ba bdun dbul / 'di nyid gtor ma'i sngags kyang yin/ de nas rten chu nang nas bton te logs su bzhugs/ bskyed pa yin na badz+ra muḥs gshegs2/ gtor ma gtsang sar gtang / rgyun du sngags zlos la/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā zhes pa dang na mo rat+na tra yā saya la sogs sngags phreng 'dam kha yin gsung / zla ba drug gis nges par 'grub par sathe tshom mi dgos gsung / rjes su bdag gzhan thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang / dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang / 'khor dang chab srid 'phel ba dang / 'dod pa'i don ci dang ci bsams /pa thams cad myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab 1 bsngo ba dang smon lam bya'o1 / /dzam+bha la nag po'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa paṇa chen 41—839

༄༅/ /'phags pa rmyags 'dzin chu'i dbang po la khyad par gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba/sna sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye bi she ṣa stod tra na ma/bod skad du/ 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin chu'i dbang po la khyad par gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' ba/ /lcags kyus lcag 4btab 'dod dgu sbyin par byed/ /nyi shu drug ldan gsang sngags yi ge yis/ /lha min lha dang mi'am cis 'dud 5rgyal/ /nyi shu lnga yi sman mchog gis gang ba'i/ /tshangs skyogs las grub 6dngos grub bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rab 'bab bcud kyi ril bu sbyin mdzad gang / /nor rgyun lha mos legs bsten khyed la 'dud/ /thabs chen shes rab zab sbyangs 7rin chen gyi8/ /snying po nyi zla'i sbyor ba las byung ba/ /dga' chen ye shes bzhi yi 9 sam bu ti/ /mchog brnyes rmugs 'dzin khyed zhabs rtag tu 'dud/ /dze+e yig las skyes lha chen yi ge bzhis / /legs 11byed842

drangs rdo rje'i thugs gsung skur ldan pa/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan brgya rab ldan pa/ /nyams dgu'i gar gyis brgyan 1la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bye pa ṇi ro dha'i 2rna ba mnan/ /phu brgyad kha yis dgra bo'i mdangs 'phrog byed/ /lugs bzlog lugs 'byung bzhi gnyis yi ge yis/ /byis pa'i srog dang gzugs 'jig mdzad la 'dud/ /klu brgyad rgyan gyis 5nor bu'i gdon 'grol zhing / /chu 'dzin sprin 'dra'i lus la char chen 'bebs/ /khyod ni nor bdag gzir bas sa gsum kyi/ /nor 'phrog zhal bzhis bgegs 'joms mdzad la bstod—/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod kyi shaṃyi ge bcus / /rig 'dzin dgug dang gter 'byed 'jigs las skyob/ /rkun po srung r+shadang bu ster tshe bsring dang / /phyugs skyong skyed shing dbang bskur shis mdzad 'dud/ /gang phyir sa gsum skye bo rmugs byed pa'i/ /nor 'dzin sa brgyad dbang phyug yud tsam zhig /mthong nas gus 'phel nyi shus bstod bgyis pas/ /sgrub rnams phrin las nyi shus rgyal gyur cig /'phags pa rmugs 'dzin chu'i dbang po la phrin las nyi shu'i sgo nas khyad par gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po nor 'dzin dpal gyi zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po budhe tshashrī dz+nyā na dang lo tsā /ba byams pa'i dpal gyis mang yul kyi grong du 'phags pa wa ti'i —pho brang du bsgyur ba'o// //41byed843

2447ra༅/ /'phags pa rmyags 'dze+en la bstod pa/1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dzam+bha la stotra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin la bstod pa/ bcom ldan 'das dzam+bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin brgya pa me lha gdong bzhi dang / /seng ge 'phrog byed nyin mor byed rnams kyis/ /zhabs gnyis la btud bcom ldan sdug bsngal ba/ /bdag la pad ltar yangs pa'i sbyan ras gzigs/ /bcom ldan chab khyor gang gis mnyes 'gyur na/ /thugs rje mnga' ba gzhan gang lags pa gsungs/ /de phyir mchod pa bshams la mi rtsi zhing / /khyod dang 'dra ba phal cher rnyed par dka'/ /brtse bas 'bad pa'i sgo nas btsal btsal nas/ /phongs 5par gyur pa bdag 4la bde mdzad na/ /kho bo mchi ma dag gis gdong sbags pa / /spyan sngar mchis kyang ci ste gzigs ma lags/ /e ma'o rab tu rgyas pa thugs rje yi/ /gzhu mo mnga' ba khyod lta bzhugs gyur kyang / /skye tshogs 41byed845

bzlog dka' 1 snyug bsngal chom rkun gyi/ /sde yis rnam par 'joms par 2ji ltar lags/ /sems can sman be+ed nor bu rin po che/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dgung char 'be+ebs drag na/ /kho bo khyod nyid gcig pu'i mthar thug pa/ /ci ste thigs pa yang —ni 'be+ebs ma lags/ /khyod bzhugs bzhin du me yis 'bar ba ltar/ /kho bo phongs pas shin tu cher bsreg 5na/ / khyod kyis 6lta zhig thugs rje 'jo ba'i ba/ /sa gsum khur du khur ba gang du thal/ /bum pa dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu sems dpa' 7dang ldan ma lags pa/ /de dag gis kyang sems can phan bgyid na/ /thugs rje'i bdag can bcom ldan smos ci 'tshal/ /gang zhig rmugs 'dzin chu yi dbang po zhes/ /skad cig kyang ni khyod kyi mtshan smos pa/ /de la pad+ma'i 'byung gnas legs bzhin du/ /pad rgyas dpal ni 'jug par bgyid 9pa lags/ /de ltar bcom ldan srid 'joms khyod spyan sngar/ /cho nges btab pa'i bsod nams 'byam —klas pa/ /gang yin de yis 1 skye bo khyod bzhin du/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'byin par shog /bcom ldan 'das rmugs 'dzin sal bstod pa slob dpon chen po btsun pa zla bas mdzad pa rdzogs so // //1 rgya gar gyi mkhan po mu ti ta shrī dz+nyā na'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis legs par bsgyur ba'o// //41byed846

2448༄༅/ /'phags pa rmyags 'dzin la bstod pa/1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dzam+bha la sto tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin la bstod pa/ 'phags pa dzam+bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan chu dbang mgon po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis brjid pa'i sku/ /sku mdog sngo nag 'od zer 'phro/ /mi bskyod sangs rgyas dbu la bzhugs/ /klu chen brgyad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan/ /dgos 'dod 'byung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag g.yas thod pa khrag bkang bsnams/ /g.yon pa gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin/ /'gro ba dbul bas rab gdungs pa'i/ /re 'dod skong la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khro bo'i cha lugs dbu skra gyen du badze+es / /mi'u thung byis pa gzhon pa'i sha rgyas pa / /nor bdag gdan la brkyang —bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mche ba rab gcigs hūṃ 5sgras ma rungs gdul6 / /dran pa tsam gyis ci bsams 'grub par 7mdzad/ /yid 41—848

༄༅/ /dzam+bha la'i bstod pa/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ dzam+bha la sto tra/ bod skad du/ dzam+bha la'i bstod pa/ dzam+bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang lha min dri za mi'am ci rnams kyi2 / /cod pan 'od kyis zhabs kyi khri ni gsal mdzad pa/ /byang chub mchog tu nges mdzad gnod sbyin dbang phyug la/ /sems can rnams la sman pa'i bsam pas bdag gis gsol/ /gang zhig brtse ba'i bdag nyid byang chub sbyin mdzad khyod/ /snying rje'i rtsa ba sems can don du rab tu grags/ /mgon khyod sems can rnams la brtse bar mi mdzad na/ /khyod kyis sangs rgyas dran par gang gi /'gyur te 'tshal4/ /shin tu mi bzad dbul ba'i sdug bsngal 5nang du ni/ /'gro rnams lhang ba khyod kyis mthong bar ma gyur tam/ /rin chen gter chen rnams kyi mtshan nas 6bzung byas nas/ /khyod kyis chu bo yang ni— sprung gis bcing bar mdzod/ /shin tu dbul ba'i byin za mi bzad drag bo 17byed850

yis—/ /'gro ba gang zhig nyin dang mtshan du sreg 1par byed/ /brtse ba nyid kyis ser sna rnam par spong mdzod la/ /rin chen bdud rtsi'i char gyi 4char rgyun drag tu phob/ /khyod ni rgod 5pas brgya byin gyis 6ni rgyal srid dang / /spyan zur tsam 7gyis khyab 'jug gis ni dpal mo dang / /mnyes pas dbang phyug gis ni gangs ri'i gnas kyang thob/ /mgon po sdug phongs 'gron bu tsam yang mi ster ram9/ /'gro ba'i dbang phyug rnams la dpag med bde ba rnams/ /rtag tu khyod ster sdug bsngal khecan la de lta min/ /khyod kyis sngon ma mthong ba snying rje'i yul gyur pa'i/ /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal can la ji ltar khyod 'jigs sam—/ /nor kyis nor slong gus ldan rnams la khyod 'gengs kyi/ /yang dag skal med sdig byas rnams la khyod min zhing / /nor gtong nor gyis nor ldan par ni 'dzin gyur te/ /mgon po slong ba'i tshogs rnams nges par spong byed dam / /gal te khyod kyis nor gtong rnams la khyod kyis ster/ /skye bo tsheg ngan rnams la ji ltar khyod 'jigs sam/ /rab tu 'bad pas nges par smra ba de yis mchog /gnod sbyin rgyal po bdag gis gsol ba gsan du gsol/ /rab tu 'bad byas de 'dra'i nor dang ldan gyur nas1 / /ji ltar dbul po'i sgra ni thos par ma gyur cig /dbul po'i me ni rab tu 'bar bas 'gro ba rnams/ /sreg 2par nges mthong yid kyis ngo mtshar nyid du gyur / /gang zhig bdag gis smras pa'i tshig rtsub tshig rnams ni/ /chu yi dbang pos snyebartse phyir 'di rnams bzod par mdzod7/ /gang zhig bstod pa 'di yis ni/ /rtag tu 'bad pas dze+e la bstod/ /des /ni dbul por mi 'gyur zhing / /shin tu mi g.yo'i dpal thob shog /mi'i dbang po nyi ma rnam par gnon pas dzam+bha la la bstod pa mdzad pa rdzogs so// //47byed851

༄ga /rmyags 'dzin 'chol ba'i man ngag gi bstod pa/1༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ u tsuṣ+ṭha dzam+bha la 2u pa de sha sto tra/ bod skad du / rmugs 'dzin 'chol ba'i man ngag gi bstod pa/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po nam mkha'i mdog can nor gyi char 'be+ebs pa/ /ma skyes rang bzhin dag pas sku mdog nag por bzhugs/ /khyod ni rdo rje sems dpa' nyid de bdag dran na/ /khyod la 'dud kyis thugs rjes ci yi phyir mi gzigs/ /lo drug byis pa'i gzugs la gzhon pa'i sha rgyas pa//'dzum la khro la byams pa'i mche ba dkar po gabyugs/ /khro gnyer dpral bar bsnyer zhing ral pa dmar ser langs/ /dbul ba sel mdzad spyan yangs snying rje can la 'dud/ /mi bskyod dbu la bzhugs pas thugs kyi rig 'dzin cing / /byams pas kun la khros te gcer bu sbrul gyis 4brgyan/ /oṃ a 5las skyes nor sbyin gdan la bzhugs shing 'gying / /re ba skong 6mdzad dpag bsam shing 17—853

'dra khyod la 'dud/ /phyag g.yas snying rjes 1don mdzad thod pa khrag gis bkang / /phyag g.yon nor spyin ma bzung ne+e'u les rin chen 'be+ebs/ /g.yas g.yon zhabs kyis 2rnam thos sras kyi rkang pa brdzis/ /nor bdag gan rkyal gnon cing brkyang bskum bzhugs la 'dud/ /rna ba ma phug rigs ngan cha lugs lhag ma za4/ /lag nas kha ru 'o ma'i bdud rtsi rtsa lam rdo rje nas byung ste / /gur gum mdog 'dra zhal du phul bas mnyes mdzod la/ /nyid kyis bdag gi 5bsam mkhyen re ba myur du skongasaspyo/ /yi ge bcu pas byin brlabs me tog dang bcas pas/ /oṃ las 'od 'phros gdub bu rin chen spras pas brgyan7 / /oṃ las byung ba'i bum pa bzang pos chu phul nas/ /bcom ldan mgon po ci phyir re ba mi bskong lags8/ /'gro drug kun la re bskong nor gyi 9char pa dag /ci 'dod mang po 'bebs pa'i thugs rje 7grags lags na/ /bdag gis mos pas khyod kyi yon tan rtag tu brjod/ /thigs pa gcig kyang mi stsol rta skal ba med dam ci/ /nyi ma re re bzhin du rtag tu khyod 'bod na/ /bdag ni yi chad sgyid lugs gdong pa dag mod kyang / /khyod kyi sngon gyi dam bcas thugs rje gang du thal/ /gter chen skal ba med kyang log 'tsho med tsam byin/ /bdag gis snying nas smras 5kyang da dung ma gzigs na/ /sa gsum kun la snyoms par dam ni ma bcas sam/ /bdag la skal ba med kyang thugs rjes cis sa mi gzigs/ /sems can min nam dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bral bar mdzod/ /bdag gis bos pas khyod kyi thugs rje'i zhags pa yis/ /srid 'dir dbul ba sol ba bde chen gnas su drongs/ /'jigs la /'jigs par mi byed khyod kyis byin brlabs te/ /'di dang pha rol gnyis kar rtag tu bskyab 41byed854

sngag /lha mo nor rgyun ma la bstod pa/1 ༄yo/ /rgya gar skad du/ de bī ba su dha rī sto tra/ bod skad du/lha mo nor rgyun ma la bstod pa/ lha mo nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo e ma bum pa rin chen gter ldan steng 4/ /de steng skyon bral nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la / /gdod nas dag pas sku 5mdog gser lta 6bu/ /ma bcos rang bzhin byis pa'i gzugs 'dra ba/ /snyan mgur phyag zhabs rin chen phreng bas brgyan/ /zla rgyas ltar mdzes 'phags ma'i sku la 'dud/ /brtse ldan sbyin pa grub pa'i tshul mnga' ba/ /pad+ma'i zhabs mnga' 'gag med seng ge'i sgras/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus sel byed ma/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyod 'dra'i gsung la 'dud/ /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sa bcu rim bgrod nas/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis sems can re 'dod skong 7/ /spros pa'i mtha' bral bde ba chen po'i ngang / /yang dag don rtogs lha mo'i thugs la 'dud/ /phyag g.yas mchod sbyin bī dza 47byed856

pha la yis/ /'jigs pa brgyad skyob 'gro rnams dbang du sdud1/ /dbul ba sel zhing log 'dren 'joms mdzad pa/ /g.yon pa thugs kar rin chen snye ma 'dzin/ /dgos 'dod re skong dpag bsam shing lta bu/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bdag gis khyod la rtag tu mchod byed cing / /gus dang bcas pa'i sems kyis rab bstod na/ /gdong la mchi mas rab tu gos gyur kyang / /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal ༄skad cig ma 'dor na/ /sngon gyi thugs rje'i smon lam gang du thal/ /las kyi 5'phro med sbyin shugs zad pa yis6/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i skal ba med gyur kyang / /tshe 'dir phongs pas log 'tsho spong tsam kyi/ /thugs rje'i thigs pa 'ga' tsam cis mi sbyin / /dus 'di nas bzung tshe rabs thams cad du/ /'phags ma nor rgyun ma la mchod byed cing / /theg chen gsang sngags chos la spyod pa dang / /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' nyan cing / /dbyer med phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs shog /rta dang glang po rin chen gos rnams 7dang / /khrus kyi rdzing bu rin chen bang mdzod dang / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang ma rmos 'khrungs rnams la/ /rtag tu chos dang ldan pa'i longs spyod shog /paṇ+ḍi ta dza mā ris lha mo nor rgyun ma la bstod pa rdzogs so// // 941—857

༄/ /dpal lha mo nor rgyun ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho gasgo༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ba su dhā rā de byā maṇ+ḍal l+ya bi byeḥ/ bod skad du/ dpal lha mo nor rgyun ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /oṃ bcom ldan 'das ma dpal ldan 'phags ma nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig kha la sogs pa dag par byas nas bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma nor rgyun ma'i brtul zhugs blangs te/ mgo bkrus shing gos gtsang ma bgos nas me tog dang bdug pa dang mar me dang dri dang zhal zas la sogs pa bshams te/ re zhig dang por me tog sbyar bar bya'o/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te pube+e ke tu rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā yārta te samyaspru bud+dhā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ puste puṣ+pe/ ma hā puṣ+pe su puṣ+pe/pusgor+bha be+e/ put+pa saṃ bha we/ put+pā ba tīrte swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyi me tog sbyang ngo / /oṃ badzā sa ne hūṃ/ stan byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags so/ /o badz+ra bā sa se hūṃ/ gos byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes 41—859

pa lus dang ngag dang sems byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags so/ /de nas oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+re ṇi ma hā pra ti sā re sarba bispyon ut+pā ra ya un+d+ra ra ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/zhes pas me tog spyi bor bzhag ste bsrung ngo / /de nas oṃ badz+ra byu mi hūṃ/ sa yongs su bzung ba ste 'dis sa'i steng du me tog ma nyams pa bzhag go/ /de nas oṃ bispyon+ta ka sarba bispyon u ra ya oṃ bispyon+ta ka sarba bismyon u ra ya hūṃ swā hā/zhes pas bgegs bskrad do/ /oṃ badz+ra re khe su re khe sarba ta thā ga ta a bye tiṣ+ṭhan+tu swā hā/ zhes pas re khā byin gyis brlab bo/ /de ltar rim pa 'di sngon du 'gro bas bla ma'i maṇ+ḍal bzhin du maṇ+ḍal byas nas/ phyis nor rgyun ma'i maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa bya'o/ /de nas dbus su me tog dgod de/ oṃ shrī ba su dhā re swā hā/oṃ shrī lakhye bhū ta la bā si be+e se swā hā/ de nas oṃ ma ṇi bha dru ya swā hā/ shar du'o//oṃ pūṇ+ḍi bha dru ya swā hā/ lho ru'o/ /oṃ dha na dā ya swā hā/ nub tu'o/ /oṃ bai shra ba shā ya swā hā/ byang du'o/ /oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ne+e swā hā/ me ru'o/ /oṃ ke li mā li ne+e swā hā/ bden bral du'o/ /oṃ mu khen+d+ra ya swā hā/ rlung du'o/ /oṃ tsa ren+d+ra 1ya swā hā/ dbang ldan du'o/ /slar yang nang du oṃ i lā de bye swā hā/shar du'o/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me swā hā/ lho ru'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dha ra sā ga ra nisgo ṣā ya swā hā/ nub tu'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dharme hūṃ swā hā/ byang du'o/ /oṃ ta bha de bye swā hā/ me mtshams su'o/ /oṃ gup+ta de bye swā hā/ bden bral du'o/ /oṃ sa ra swa tī de bye swā hā/ rlung du'o/ /oṃ tsan+d+ra kārnya de bye swā hā/ dbang ldan du'o / /oṃ phuḥshaṃ kha pā la nā ga rā dzā ya swā hā/ i khā ma'i rgyab tu'o/ /oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ya swā hā/ de'i g.yas su'o/ /de nas nyer spyod lnga'i mchod pa ste / oṃ ba su dhe swā hā/ me tog go/ /oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇi swā hā/ bdug 47byed860

t+ya ba ti swā hā/ oṃ shrī sha l+ya ba ti swā hā/ oṃ shrī dha na ba ti swā hā/ oṃ shrī dhā n+ya ba ti swā hā/ oṃ shrī pra bhā ba ti swā hā/ oṃ shrī a ma le swā hā/ oṃ shrī bi ma le swā hā / oṃ shrī nirma le swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma la nā sha ni swā hā/ oṃ shrī su rū pa bi ma le swā hā/ oṃ shrī a na naste swā hā/ oṃ shrī bi na naste swā hā/ oṃ shrī bi ma la naste swā hā—/ oṃ shrī su ke shi swā hā/ oṃ shrī bi shudhe na khi swā hā/ oṃ shrī bi shudhe shī le swā hā/ oṃ shrī saṃ ku re swā hā/ oṃ shrī mo ku re swā hā/ oṃ shrī pra dzha ku re swā hā/oṃ shrī a mo ghabyu re swā hā/ oṃ shrī dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥswā hā/ oṃ shrī ā kar+ṣa ṇi swā hā/oṃ shrī yā de bi swā hā/ oṃ shrī ri ri me swā hā/ oṃ shrī ru ru me swā hā/ oṃ shrī dhu dhu me swā hā/ oṃ shrī ta ra ta ra swā hā/ oṃ shrī ta ta ra ta ta ra swā hā/ oṃ shrī tā ra ya tu māṃ sarba sat+t+waṃsh+tsa bha ga ba ti ba su dhā ri ṇi ma hā mā ye rak+ṣa pa ra ṇa gubye ka ri swā hā—/ oṃ shrī badz+ra dha ra sā ga ra nisgo ṣa su tsa ta thā ga ta su tsa sa t+ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ oṃ shrī budhe 1sa t+ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ oṃ shrī dharma sa t+ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/oṃ shrī saṃ gha sa t+ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ oṃ shrī gurngi bhā su khe na pra sru tā ma hā te dzāḥdīḥswā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hā shārnyi ma ti swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hā poṣ+ṭi ma ti swā hā/ oṃ shrī sarba dza na ba shaṃ ka ri swā hā/ oṃ shrī sarba duṭ+wā ni kṛn+ta ni swā hā/ oṃ shrī sarba duṣ+ṭa sha tru bi nā sha ni swā hā/ hūṃ phaṭa oṃ snyaswā hā/ oṃ shrī ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ oṃ shrī ā ba ra ṇa ma nu sma ra swā hā/ oṃ shrī ā dhā ra ma nu sma ra swā hā/oṃ shrī byu ti ma nu sma ra swā hā/ oṃ shrī dza ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ oṃ shrī bi dza ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ oṃ shrī sarba sa twa sa ma ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ oṃ shrī ba sun+dha re swā hā/ oṃ shrī lasmri byu ta la ni bā si nī ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī ba sun+dha ri swā hā/ oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇi swā hā/ oṃ shrī ba su jo ri ṇi ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī shrī ka ra dha ni ka ri 41—863

de nas nor lha nyid bsgrub pa ni khang bu shin tu dben par dkyil 'khor gru bzhi la ba'i rnam lngas byugs te/ de la pad+ma 'dab 1brgyad lte ba dang bcas pa bri/lte ba dkar po 'dab ma brgyad ser por bya'o/ /de la rin po che'i me tog dkram / dbus su bum pa dgod/ steng du sku gzhag /mdun du zan dkar po'i gtor ma 4dkar gsum dang / mngar gsum satshod ma sna tshogs dang dri dang rtsi sman gyis brgyan te gzhag go/ /mchod pa'i rdzas dag kyang dgod 6 la / dang po byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ dpal phyag na rdo rje bskyed rim 7ji lta ba bzhin bsgoms pa'i mdun du paṃ las rin po che'i pad+ma'i lte ba la tweḥ8dkar dmar las skyes pa'i nor lha zhal gcig 9phyag gnyis pa/ dkar zhing dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa phyag g.yas pas rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin pa/g.yon kyis rin chen bai ḍūr+ya'o/ /rin po che'i gdan la 'bab bzhugs kyis skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ gsus po che byis pa'i gzugs lta bu can/ bzhin mdzes pa spyan 'bur 1 la che ba/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis kun du bklubs shapa'i dam tshig gi gnod sbyin chen po gzhan gyis mi thub pa bsams la/ bdag dang g.yog po'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par hri5/ snying gar phri/ lte bar hūṃ/gsang bar phaṭa kyis bsrungs te ye shes dgug gzhug bya'o/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po kun gyi —rgyal/ /gnod sbyin chen po gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /gnas 'dir mchod pa 'bul gyis myur du spyon/ /bdag la zas nor sprul sazhing bzhugs su spyon/ /e bye hi yak+ṣa a pa rā dzi slota sa pa ri wā ra ā gats+tsha ya ā gats+tsha ya hūṃ dza/ des 8ni mdun du byon par bltas te/ bdud bsal ba'i phyir rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya'am yungs kar 'phang zhing oṃ āḥbi spyon ta kṛta 1hūṃ 47—868

phaṭa ces pas rnam par phye nas mchod yon phul te/ dam tshig la mngon par bcug 1la mchod pa phul nas bstod pa byas te / oṃ gnod sbyin chen po gzhan kyis mi thub pa/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis byis pa'i gzugs 'dra can/ /phyag g.yon yid bzhin rin chen bai ḍūr+ya/ /thugs kar 'dzin mdzad mi zad nor gyi bdag /phyag g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin zhing rgyal po dang / /btsun mo la sogs dgug dang dbang du mdzad/ /dung cimadog 'od 'phro rin chen rgyan mdzes ldan/ /rin chen gdan la rgyal sras skyil krung bzhugs/ /'jig rten zas nor kun kyi 3bdag po ste/ /gang gis khyod bsgrub phongs pa'i 'jigs sel mdzod/ /nor lha'i rgyal po bkra shis 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'jam pa'i 7rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de'i rjes la rgyal ba sras bcas mchod la/ de dag gis lha mo mngon par sprul te bum pa lha'i bdud rtsis bkang bas mngon par bkrus par bsam mo/ /spyi bor dpal phyag na rdo rjes rgyas gdab bo/ /de nas snying po'i sngags 'di/ skad che bar ma yin chung bar ma yin myur bar ma yin bul bar ma yin par smra ba bcad cing rnam par g.yeng ba 9la sogs pa spangs te bzlas so/ /oṃ hri phri a pa ra dzi ta dza 11dza hūṃ phaṭa/ bzlas pa gtong ba'i dus su mchod pa phul la gtor ma yang sbyin te/ gtor sgod zlo salas rin po cher bsam/ gtor ma oṃ gyis sbyangs/ āḥyis sbar/ hūṃ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur te phyag na rdo rje la rang sngags kyis dbul/ gnod sbyin nor 5lha la sngags oṃ tri dza yak+ṣa a pa ra dzi ta sa pa ri wā ra a mṛ ta ba lo kha kha khā hi sa khā hi i rda ba bo bhak+ṣa 7yi/ ma ma ba su puṣ+ṭi ku ru sarba dza ga ba shid+ku ru ye 7swā hā/oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā t+t+waṃ ār+ya nut+pan na twata oṃ s+dzahūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes pa dang /41byed869

tshigs su bcad pas kyang bsngos la/ bstod pa bya chos bshad de phrin las bcol/oṃ bhū ta hri 1a pa ra dzi ta rat+na na ma 2sarba tri sadza ti swā hā zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te bskul lo/ /de nas dge ba bsngos la a pa ra dzi ta badz+ra muḥ 4 /zhes pas gshegs su gsol lo/ /thun gnyis pa la sogs pa la dam tshig chig rdzogs su bskyed la/ ye shes dgug pa la sogs pa sngar bzhin du bya'o/ /tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du bsgrub 5bo/ /bco lnga'i zhag gi dang po nas tho rangs kyi 6bar du sngags rgyun ma chad par bzlas/ lce pog dkar po'i bdug pa dbul/ tho rangs grub pa'i rtags snang ba ni rab 7gzugs mngon sum du ston te bdag gis ji ltar bya zer te sgrub 9pa pos bdag gi bka' nyon cig bya'o / /mna' bsgag dam chu blud 1 ci 'dod pa mubacol/ rgyal mtshan byu phyag rgya bstan te phan chad bka' nyan te de la zhon nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten mthong ngo / /lha'i gnas su bskyal nas lha'i dbang pos dbang skur ⑩bar byed do / / 'bring sgra dang dug chen 'ong /sa gzugs sgra gang byung yang skrag par mi bya'o/ /de lta bu'i mtshan ma ma byung na nam langs pa'i dus su rmi lam brtag /des ma grub na phyi ma'i zla ba la de bzhin du bsgrub/ des kyang ma grub na yang phyi ma'i zla ba la bsgrub bo/ /de nas dngos grub ni rab rig pa'i rgyal po'i dbang thob bo/ / 'dod pa'i don thams cad 'grub bo/ / /lha dang / mi dang /gdon 9thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ dgra dang nad thams cad zhi bar byed do/ /tshe ring ba bskal pa bdun thub par 'gyur/ nor mang ba zad pa med cing dpag tu med pa brjod kyis mi lang bar 'byor ro 1/ /gal te gnod par byed pa byung na yang khros pa tsam gyis de ma thag tu 'chi bar byed do/ /'bring ni 41byed870

lta sgom gyi 1nyams myong skye/ bud med thams cad dbang du 'gyur zhing nor gyis phyug par 'gyur/ bkra shis par byed pa dang dgra 'chi bar yang byed do//tha ma yang nor 'phel bar byed cing dgra 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /grub nas rtag tu bsten pa ni zla ba nya gang ba thams cad la gtor ma gtang bar bya'o/ /dngos grub gang byung ba de cha drug tu bgos te bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum spyi dang /sems can dag la cha re re sbyin/ phyed kyis sgrub pa po'i 'tsho ba bya'o/ /sgrub pa'i dus su zas dkar gsum bza' zhing gtsang sbra dang ldan par bya'o/ /rtag tu khrus la brtson par bya'o/ /'di grub 4na yon tan dpag tu med do/ /'di la gdeng 5bzhi dang ldan pas 'grub ste/ mgo 6gnon ye shes bsnyen pa'i gdeng 7/ yang dag lta ba'i gdeng re/ mi nyams pa dam tshig gi gdeng /the tshom 9med pa nges pa'i gdeng ngo / /de la lta ba ni chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur 1shes par bya'o/ /dam tshig ni bla ma mnyes par bya zhing gsang la sgrub stes/gzhan la thabs 'di bstan par mi bya'o/ /gnod sbyin chen po gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rgyud rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi bla 1ma dzā mā ris bsgyur ba'o// //4 1—871
