༄ga /de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i man ngag bzhugs/ 1 ༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo de la gang zag gcig gi nyin zhag gcig gi bya ba brjod par bya ste/ dang po tho 2rangs kyi cha nas brtsams te ji srid nyal ba la thug pa'i bar la bya ba bsdus pa ni rnam pa brgyad de/ gos dang khrus dang bla ma mchod/ /zas dang skom dang spyod lam dang / /ting 'dzin nyal ba'i mthar thug pa/ /brgyad po 'di ni bsdus pa'o/ /zhes sprin las grol bas gsungs te mdor bsdus pa'o/ /da ni de dag gi mtshan nyid re re nas rgyas par bshad par bya ste de la dang por gos dang zhes pa ni/ thog mar mal nas langs/ gos bgo ba'i phyir gos kyi rnal 'byor bya ste rang gis byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ ma brlabs pa yang rung ste gos cung zad stong pa nyid du bsams te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 47—997

'phros pas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gi thugs kar phog ste de las yi ge hūṃ dpag tu med pa bkug ste rang gi gos la bstem/ de zhu rdo rje rgya gram du gyur//rang gi sngags brjod gos gyur te/ /rang lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ /bgos pas bar chad rnams 1sel dang / /ma 'ongs — 7pa na rdo rje 'chang / /'gro ba'i don rnams byed par 'gyur/ /de phyir nan tan thams cad kyis/ /dang po dbang bskur dus dag tu/ /gos kyi dbang bskur bya ba gces/ /khrus dang zhes pa ni/ de nas khrus kyi dus dag tu/ /rang gi lha yi nga rgyal kyis/ /bum pa'am gzhan yang rung ba ni/ /chu yis bkang ste mdun bzhag nas/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /dbang bskur bla ma'i thugs kar phog /de las kyang 'od 'phros pa las/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /rang 'dod lha yi 1'od zer las sgra byung gsol ba btab par bsam/ /byang chub rdo rjes 4sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchod chen bgyis 5pa ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral slad du'o / /nam mkha' rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes bskul bas de dag gi thugs ka nas/bgegs rnams ma lus tshar gcod pa'i/ /rig 7pa'i rgyal po ma lus dang / /byang chub sems dpa' grangs med rnams/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka la sha a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shri —hūṃ/zhes brjod mkha' la sprin phung bzhin/ /lha mo phyag na bum pa ni/ /bdud rtsis gang ba pad kor 9gyi/ /phyag rgyas gzung ste glu 'di len/ /dbang bsgur 41—998

rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum kun gyis (/byephyag byas pa/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba 'di/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin pa yin/ /zhes pas bdag la dbang bskur bsam/ /lus kyi dri ma dag pa ltar/ /sgrib pa rnams ni dag par bsam/ /chu yi zer ma 'phros pa las/ /mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa'i—/ /sgrib pa rnams ni dag par bsam/ /rang gi khrus 3zin spyi bor ni/ /mi bskyod bsam zhing sngags 'di bzlas/ /oṃ badz+ra stu rnyin hūṃ/bla ma mchod ces pa ni/ de nas bla ma mchod pa ni/ /dad 4la maṇ+ḍal byug bya zhing / /byin gyis brlab zhepar bya ba ste/ /phyi ba chu dang bcas pa yis//badz+ra re khe zhes brjod cing / /ra ri ya yo med par byug /de nas rang snying sa bon las/ /yi ge t+t+waṃ 'phros maṇ+ḍal steng / /gnas la sngags 'di brjod par bya/ /oṃ t+t+waṃ rat+na maṇ+ḍal badz+ra re khe 7hūṃ/ lan bdun gsum mam gcig kyang rung / /brjod pas zhu ste sa gzhi ni/ /rin po che yi rang bzhin gyur/ /de yi steng du a dkar 'phros/ /sngags 'di bzlas la zla bar bsam/ oṃ tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal la badz+ra re khe tsuhūṃ/ de yi steng du tsan+dan gyi/ /chus sbyigator yi ge hūṃ gyur te/ /sngags 'di bzlas zhu dri zhim pa'i/ /rang bzhin maṇ+ḍal gyur par bya/ /oṃ hūṃ 1pa ra ya rat+na maṇ+ḍal badz+ra re khe sahūṃ/ de nas nor bu'am sman nam 'bru/ /me tog nyid kyis dgram bya ste/ /rang gi 'dod pa'i bye brag gis/ /ji snyed 'dod pa'i tshom bu bya/ /de dag paṃ bsam sngags 'dis zhu/ /pad+ma'i gdan du gyur par bsam oṃ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal badz+ra re khe snyahūṃ/ de yi steng du hūṃ yig bsam/ /oṃ hūṃ bi shwa 5bi 41—999

shud+dhi maṇ+ḍal badz+ra re khe rtehūṃ/ rin chen las byung gzhal yas khang / /mdzes pa nyid du gyur par bsam/ /de dbus bla ma yi dam lha/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sras dang bcas pa srun drangs la/ /dang por lus ngag yid kyis ni/ /gus pa yis ni phyag 'tshal te/ /phyi nang gsang ba bla med pa'i/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod par bya/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum po dang / /zhes pa la sogs tshig rnams kyis/ /sdog bshags sdom pa gzung bar bya/ /de yis 3rang rgyud dag 'gyur te/ /bdud rtsi'i snod de 'gyur ba yin/ /de nas yi ge brgya brjod cing / /bzod gsol oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥyis/ /gshegs gsol smon lam gdab par bya/ /zas dang zhes pa ni/ de nas zas kyi dus dag tu/ /sbyang ba rnam pa bzhi bya ste/ /zas sbyang gtor ma dang mthun no/ /de nas lte ba'i gog tu yo/ /zhu bas rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de steng ram̐ las tsaṇ+ḍa lī5/ /mar me'i rtse mo lta bur gsal/ /de ni lto ba sbyang ba'o/ /de nas rlung gis me sbar bas / /snying nas 6lha dang phung po khams/ /skye mched la sogs lhar gsal bya/ /de ni snying gar sbyar bar 'dod/ /gal te la la 'di skad du/ /snying ga'i lha nyid gsal ba ni/ /snying ga sbyang bar rigs mod dz+wakyi/ /phung po khams la sogs pa la/ /snying ga sbyang zhes ci yi phyir/ /zhe na de ni gtso bo ste / /dang po dbang bsgur dus na ni/ /ye shes lha ni du ma dag /lus la bcug cing byin brlabs la/ /snying ga gcig pur bcug pa ni/ /mthong dang thos pa med phyir dang / /rnal 'byor rgyud ni du ma las/ /41—1000

phung po khams dang skye mched sogs/ /lha nyid yin par lkugasungs phyir ro/ /de nas kha ni thab khung la/ /lce la me lha rnam par bsam/ /de nas lag gnyis dgang blugs kyis/ /zas za sbyin sreg byeyin par 'dod/ /yang na lce la rdo rje la/ /rkan la pad+ma rab bsams te/ /de 5gnyis sbyor ba byas pa las/ /byang chub sems byung lha rnams kun/ /tshim par byed pa la la 'dod / /de ni lce gog thusbyang ba'o/ /de nas lus kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /tshim par bya phyir ma yengs par/ /za ba 'di ni mchog yin no/ /skom dang zhes pa ni/ de nas skom gyi rnal 'byor ni/ /rang nyid lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /lag mthil g.yas par nyi ma ni/ /saṃ las skyes pa blta bar bya/ /de steng chang snod a las ni/ /thod pa chang gis bkang ba yi / /kha ni zla bas mnan pa'o/ /de nang ha zhu kha dog sbyangs/ /hos ni ro yi rtog pa sbyangs/ /byāḥs snyeni bdud rtsi chen por zhu/ /de nas ye shes dbab pa'i phyir/ /srin lag tshigs ni dang po la/ /mthe bo rtse mo sbyar byas te/ /sum̐ las srin lag ri rab bskyed/ /hūṃ las mthe bong sa gzhir bsam/ /bar du saṃ dmar 7bsam byas te/ /de las 'od 'phros 'og min du/ /rang 'dod lha yi smin mtshams phog /yab yum snyoms zhugs bdud rtsi dbab/ /thod par bab ste sa gzhi dang / /ri rab bcas pa 9 dkrugs pas ni/ /sa gzhi ri rab nyid kyang zhu/ /oṃ s+dzahūṃ ngam ha ho dīḥ /lan gsum bdun sogs bzlas par bya/ /de yi nang du chos 'byung dang / /zla ba lta bu bri bya la/ /de steng bla ma yi dam lha/ /gzhan sogs bsams 41byed1001

te mchod pa'am/ /yang na mdun mgyi bar snang la/ /de dag bsams la mchod par bya/ /rang rang sngags la bdud rtsi'i sngags/ /btags pas lus ngag yid gsum dang / /bla ma la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nas gong du bshad mchod bya/ /de nas ji ran gnod med par/ /tshod zin par ni btung bar bya/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa'i dus su ni/ /nad la gnod par gyur na yang / /thigs pa gsum ni dam tshig go/ /de ltar ma byas glang po che/ /smyon pa bzhin du 'thung byed na/ /skye ba lnga brgyar smyon par 'gyur/ /spyod lam dang zhes pa ni/ de nas spyod lam gyi dus su so sor brtag pa rnam pa gnyis te/ snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang / /bcud kyi sems can bye brag gi/ /lha dang lha mor mos par bya/ /rang gi bya ba ci byed kyang / /lha yi nga rgyal la gnas nas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin la sogs/ /po ti klog pa'i tshe bdag nyid/ /lce la rnga rdung bye rdo rje bsam/ /rkan la rnga chen rab bsams te/ /rdo rjes rnga la rab brdungs pas/ /sgra skad chen bos 4phyogs bcur khyab/ /mtha' yas sems can ma lus kyi/ /rna bar gang dang gang mos la/ /de dang de ltar rtogs khyepar bsam/ /yang na mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ma lus mdun du bkug byas la/ /bdag gi skad ni gang mos par/ /so sor go bar chos bshad pya la/ /rtag tu dag par bsgrag par bya/ /'dir mang smra bas ci zhig bya/ /gang byed lha yi nga rgyal gyis/ /bdag dang gzhan gyis sum̐byang chub ni/ /thob par bsam zhing bya ba'o/ /41—1002

ting nge 'dzin zhes pa ni/ de nas phyi dro'i thun dag la/ /rang gi rtog 1pa'i don la ni/ /blo gzhag lha yi nga rgyal ni/ /cho ga lnga'am cho ga gsum / /skad cig bsdus rgyas shin tu bsdus/ /gang mos pa la blo bzhag — la/ /thun mong dngos grub 'dod pa'am/ /ngag gi sgrib pa sbyong 'dod pas/ /bzlas pa gang mos las bzhi pyal/ /mi skyo'i bar du bzlas par bya/ /bzlas pas skyo na rdzogs rim d+nghani/ /steng dang 'og gi sgo dag la//bsten nas bsgom par bya ba'o/ /de nas gal te gtong 'dod na/ /man ngag bzhin du gtor ma ni/ /byin gyis brlabs te dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas bstod dang bshags pa dang / /phrin las bcol la gshegs su gsol/ /rang gi ye shes gshegs par bya'o/ /de nas smon lam gdab pa dang / /stong pa nyid kyi 5rgyas gdab bya/ /nyal ba'i mthar thug zhes pa ni/ /de nas nyal na rnam gsum ste/ /stong pa nyid kyis nyal ba dang / /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i nyal lugs dang / /'chi ba slu ba'i nyal lugs so/ /stong pa nyid kyis 7nyal ba ni/ /snod kyi 'jig rten bcud la bsdu/ /bcud kyi 8sems can yum la bsdu/ /yum yang bdag la bsdus nas ni/ /bdag nyid ye shes sems dpa' la'o/ /ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje la'o/ /rdo rje hūṃ ste hūṃ rim kyisashe/ /nā da'i bar du bsdu ba'o/ /nā da stong pa nyid la bsdu/ /de yi ngang la nyal ba'o/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i nyal lugs ni/ /ye shes lha rnams gshegs gsol te/ /dam tshig sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis/ /gnyid kyis dub pa bsal ba dang / /41—1003

༄ga /rgyud sna tshogs las btus pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga 1༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ nā nā tan+t+ra udh+ri to ba lo bi dhiḥ / bod skad du/ rgyud sna tshogs las btus pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /sku mchog rang gi snang bas 'khyud/ /skyob pa ma lus spro mdzad pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 4phyag 'tshal nas/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams rab ster ba/ /lha mo chos dbyings dbang phyug ma/ /ma lus rgyal ba rnams kyi yum/ /'gro ba skyob la rab btud nas / /gang gi sku drin chen po yis/ /gsung ni bla med thob 'gyur ba/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs pad+ma/ /chu skyes gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis reg pas 5'khor ba yi/ /gdung ba dag ni zhi 'gyur ba/ /bla ma'i zhal snga nas kyi zhabs/ /pad+ma dang 'brel rdul bstod nas/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /gtor ma'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi mtshungs/ /sna 47byed/007

tshogs rgyud kyi rgya mtsho las/ /yang dag btus nas bdag gis bshad/ /sngon gyi dus su bcom ldan gyis/ /zhal gyi man ngag gsungs par gyur/ /de tsam kho nas sems can rnams/ /grub gyur glegs bam dag las min/ /de nas gsum ldan dus 1gyur nas/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud rnams spel bar 'gyur / /de las don gyi 'brel rtogs nas/ /bsams te skye bos dngos grub thob/ /gnyis ldan du ni gtsor rgyal bas/ /bshad pa rgya chen mdzad par 'gyur / /de don rtogs pa nyid kyis ni/ /mkhas pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /rtsod pa'i dus gyur deng sang ni/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis po/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi mang du gsungs/ /'on kyang skye bo zhi mi 4gyur/ /ci phyir 'di ltar sems can rnams/ /rtag tu tshe dang brtson 'grus chung / /chags sogs nyon mongs gdung ba yis/ /rtag tu rang gi sems gdungs 5gyur/ /rang gi lto ba dag la brtson/ /'ba' zhig lhur len 6yid ldan pa/ /rgyal po mnyes sogs bya ba 7dag /tho rangs langs nas spyod pa byed/ /nang par bshang gcig dag gis te/ /nyi ma phyi 'phred zas skom gyis/ /tshim nas 'dod pas gnod 'gyur te/ /skye bo mtshan mo gnyid kyis so/ /re zhig lo ni brgya thub pa/ /tshe yi mchog tu brjod par bya/ /sems can de dag nyid kyis ni / /phyed ni yongs su zad par 'gyur/ /byis pa rgas pa nad rnams kyis/ /de las kyang ni phyed zad 1'gyur/ /tshe yi cha shas lhag ma yi7/ /nang du dge ba ji snyed byed/ /'on kyang gal te dge ba yi / /las la brtson 'grus dang bcas 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'thob —'gyur na/ /de min gzhan kyi dbang gyur pas/ /'dod ngan kha cig bud med kyi/ /dbang po'i chu sgo nyam 47byed1008

nga ru/ /lhung bar gyur na sna'akhor ba yi —/ /rgya mtshor rab tu nub par 'gyur—/ /chos kyi lam las yongs nyams shing / /skad cig longs spyod la bskul brtson/ /rang nyid nyams pa'i grogs ngan kyis/ /kha cig rnam par nyams par 'gyur/ /kha cig tshol ba'i sdug bsngal nyen/ /bza' btung dag ni btsal 4ba'i phyir/ /rmongs pa 'bad pa dang ldan pas/ /phyogs bcu dag tu 'khyams 5par 'gyur/ /nyin mtshan gnyid ni mi log 6cing / /rgyal po mnyes sogs nyon mongs kyis7/ /yongs snagadungs pa yi sems ldan pa/ /gzhan dag 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /de ltar sems can rnam dpyad nas/ /rtag tu mi khom pa yi tshogs/ /brtson 'grus mi ldan de bas na/ /bdag gis ngal 'di 'bras bur bcas/ /sems can la ni phan 'dod pas/ /rtogs par sla zhing gzhung nyung la/ /rab tu don mang yid 'ong ba/ /gtor ma'i las kyi cho ga batha/da/ /'di na kha cig phyogs snga ma/ /rab tu byed pa 'di lta ste//chos rnams dag ni ma skyes shing / /gnyis kyis stong la sngags rig 9pas/ /ji ltar gtor sbyin gang zhig la/ /yang dag par ni bgegs gang yod/ /byung nas rab tu zhig 'gyur na/ /sngags kyis gang zhig rab rgyas byed/ /rang bzhin gyis ni skal ba yi/ /lha tshogs rnams la gtor ma ni/ /de nyid rig 1pas ji ltar gtang / /de rnams de ni ji ltar za/ /mtshan ma gcig sogs gnas su ni/ /gtor ma ji ltar dor sabar bya/ /gzhan du min zhing der gtor yang / /de rnams kyis de ji ltar 'khyer/ /gzhan yang shin tu nyung ba yi / /chu dang bza' ba la sogs pas/ /nam mkha' dang mtshungs grangs med pa'i/ /'byung po kun ni ji ltar tshim/ /yi dwags la sogs gang 'ga' 47byed/009

zhig /khrag gi btung ba 'thung 1byed pa/ /sngags pas gtor ma tsam gyis ni/ /de dag ji ltar mgu bar 'gyur/ /gzod nas ma skyes rdzogs byang chub/ /thob pa'i skyob pa rnams dang ni/ /mkha' 'go ma dang de rnams la/ /gtor sbyin rigs pa ci zhig yod/ /de tsam kyis ni mnyes gyur nas/ /bskal pa mang por rnal 'byor pa / /thob 'gyur 'dod pa'i dngos grub gang / /mi rnams la ni ji ltar ster/ /'dir ni brjod bya rang bzhin gyis/ /chos rnams re zhig bdag med cing / /sgyu ma smig rgyu dri za yi/ /grong khyer 4dang ni rmi lam mtshungs / /'on kyang sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /'gro 'di bden pa gnyis su bstan/ /rnam rtog dang bcas 5cig shos las/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam mo/ /chos nyid la ni rab zhugs pa/ /gnyis med rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas / /re zhig gtor ma dag gi las/ /dam pa'i don du ji ltar bya/ /'on kyang kun rdzob phyogs brten nas/ /bsod nams tshogs ni 'phel bya'i phyir//de la dang po'i las can gyis/ /gtor ma'i las ni bya ba yin/ /de nyid kyi rgo rim gyis 'dir/ /bgegs rnams kun du 'byung ba yod/ /de bas de rab zhi bya'i phyir/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis 6gtor ma bsngags/ /dngos rnams skad cig nyid yin yang / /sngags rnams la ni nus pa yod/ /dug 'joms pa yi sngags bzhin du/ /de dag mngon sum nyid du 'grub/ /sngags rnams nus pa 'di 'dra ste/ /mi snang lha tshogs gang yin pa/ /de nyid re zhig spyan drangs pas / / mig gi mngon sum 7nyid du 'gyur/ /shing gcig drung la sogs pa yang / /dngos grub gnas su bcom ldan gsungs/ /des na rnam pa de lta bu/ /gtor ma'i gnas su gsungs par gyur/ /lha rnams rang mthus gtor ma las/ /47byed/0/0

ro dag myong bar byed pa nyid/ /des na snang bar gyur kyang ni/ /nyes pa yod pa ma yin no/ /gzhan yang dngos grub mchog thob pa'i/ /rnal 'byor lag nas gtor ma ni/ /blangs hūṃn lha rnams za bar byed/ /nags su klu yi byang chub bzhin/ /sngags kyis bdud rtsi lngar byas nas/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis gtor ma gtong / /de yi mthu yis lha tshogs rnams/ /mnyes 'gyur chung ba'i nyes pa med/ /zang zing la sogs rab dbye ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pas sbyin rnam bzhi/ /gsungs te de bas yi dwags kyi/ /gtor ma la ni chos bshad gyur//'di ltar 'dam gyis rnyogs pa dang / /bral ba'i chu bo dag gi rgyun/ /mthong nas kyang ni khyed rnams khrag /lag pa dag gis ci phyir 'thung / /des na ma byin blangs pa yis/ /'di yi rnam smin mi bzad yin/ /de bas tshim byed gtor ma 'di4/ /khyed rnams kyis ni blang bar gyis/ /de ltar rim pa 'di bzhin du/ /rnal 'byor pa 'dis yi dwags rnams/ /chos 'dod par ni de bas skyon/ /cung zad tsam ni yod ma yin/ /bcom ldan 'das dang ma mo la / /cung zad dogs pa med mod kyi/ /'on kyang bsod nams tshogs dag la / /dang po'i las can bskul bar bya/ /rim gyis ye shes tshogs dag kyang / /thob nas rnal 'byor pa dag ni/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sdod 5'gyur te/ /des na dngos grub cis mi 'thob6/ /grangs med bskal pas byang chub ni/ /thob 'gyur 'di ni bden mod kyang / /thabs dang ma tshang nyid gyur pa/ /rim 'di theg pa chen po yin/ /sngags tshul chen po'i 7rnal 'byor pas/ /skad cig gcig gis nges pa ru/ /rdo rje 'chang ni chen po'i gnas/ /thob 'gyur blo yi khyad par gyis/ /de ltar phyogs rnams brtsams nas ni/ /77byed/0/ /

gtor ma'i cho ga'i gzhung lugs 'grub/ /yang dag byang chub 'dod rnams kyis//de yang mgu bar bya ba yin/ /nyin dang mtshan du rnal 'byor pas/ /de thun gsum mam bzhi dag tu/ /bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes kyi/ /tshogs ni spel phyir bya ba yin/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga gang / /de ni gtor ma chen por bshad/ /gang phyir dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yi/ /rnam pa dang bcas rab mnyes 1 phyir/ /re zhig de yi rim pa 'di/ /ji ltar dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yi/ /phyi rol mkhas pas tshim bya ba/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis mnyes par gyis/ /re zhig dang po rnal 'byor pas /rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas dang po sbyor ba la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bar la langs te/ sngar bsdus pa pul+lī ra mā —la sogs pa gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma'i 'khor lo sna khung g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i srog dang rtsol bas bskul ba ji lta ba bzhin du rjes su 'od zer spro ba'i sbyor ba sa'i rdul tshon la sogs pas sprul pa'i phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lor so so'i gnas su rnam par spros te bkod la mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim pa bzhin du yang dag par mchod de gtor ma'i las bya'o/ /de la re zhig dang po dkyil 'khor kyi phyi rol na gnas pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / 'byung po rnams la rim pa 'dis gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /de la 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du rnam par dgod pa'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ nang gi dkyil 'khor las phyi rol gyi rdo rje'i 5ra ba las phyi rol gyi shar du dur khrod ma dang / dra mi tri dang / gtum mo bdud rtsi'i chu'i snod lag na thogs pa dkar mo dang / ser mo dang / dmar 77—/0/2

mo'i bdag nyid can dgod par bya'o/ /byang du drag mo dang / khrag ma dang /sha za ma lcags kyu lngas gang ba'i snod lag na thogs pa ser mo dang dkar mo dang /dmar mo'i mdog can rnams so/ /nub tu mi bzad ma dang / 'bar ma dang /'jigs rung ma lag na gtor ma'i snod thogs pa dmar mo dang / ser mo dang /sngon mo'i mdog can rnams so/ /lho ru thod pa mo dang / rdo rje ma dang /bum pa ma bza' ba dang btung ba la sogs pas 1gang ba'i snod thogs pa nag mo dang / dmar mo dang / dkar mo'i mdog can rnams so/ /dbang ldan gyi phyogs su sgeg mo dang / dri ma dkar mo dang / ser mo'i mdog go/ /me'i phyogs su pi wang ma dang / me tog ma dkar mo dang / nag mo'i mdog 4 can rnams so/ /bden bral gyi phyogs su glu ma dang / bdug pa ma nag mo dang / dmar mo dag go/ /rlung gi phyogs su gar ma dang / mar me ma dmar mo dang / ser mo dag go/ /de dag thams cad 'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab pa'i 'od dang ldan pa/ skra bshig 5pa sbrul rnams kyis brgyan pa/ gos dang rgyan 6sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas pa rnams so / /de nas phyi rol gyi sa gzhi'i g.yas phyogs nas bskor bar 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gtor ma'i sngags kyi rjes su 'brangs nas zhing skyong brgyad yongs su brtag ste/ phyogs brgyad du drag po nag po la sogs pa zhing gi bdag po rnams blo yis dgod par bya'o/ /de la rim pa 'di yin te/ shar du drag po nag po/byang du drag po chen po/ nub tu lha sbyin/ lho ru drag po/ dbang ldan kyi phyogs su gcigs pa/ me'i phyogs su 'jigs su rung ba/ bden bral kyi phyogs su rnon po/ rlung gi phyogs su log 'dren te de dag thams cad kyang mig 17— 0/3

gsum pa/ lag pa 1snabazhi pa/ gdong gcig pa/ ji skad bshad pa'i phyag mtshan dang gos dang rgyan kyis brgyan pa nag po dang ser po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i mdog can dang / dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams kyi ni dkar nag dang / dkar ser dang / dmar ser dang / dmar nag 4rnams te 'khor dang bcas pa dag go/ /nag po drag po'i mdun du tsā muṇ+ḍi/g.yon du drag mo/ rgyab tu 'jigs su rung ma/ g.yas su lha mo u 5ma bsam par bya'o/ /lha mo de dag kyang mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i mdog can mchod pa rnam pa lnga la sogs pas lag 6pa byel ba mchod pa rnam pa lnga kho nas yang dag par mchod par byed pa'o/ /de bzhin du byang du rgyal ma dang / rnam par rgyal ma dang / rgyal byed ma dang / gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhes bya ba drag po chen po'i 'khor rnams te thugs kyi 'khor lo'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi mdog can no/ /de bzhin du nub tu nag mo chen mo dang / nag mo sbom ma dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / lha sbyin gyi mkha' 'gro ma gsung gi 'khor lo'i mkha' 'gro ma'i mdog can rnams bsam par bya'o/ /de bzhin du lho ru dbang ma dang / zla ba ma dang / drag mo dang / gdug pa zhi byed ma dang / 'phyang ma dang / lha'i dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba nag mo'i lha mo sku'i 'khor lo'i mkha' 'gro 7ma'i mdog can rnams so/ /dbang ldan gyi phyogs su kam po dzi ma dang / 'bar ma dang /'jib ma dang / grong na kun du gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma gcigs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma khwa'i gdong can ma'i mdog can rnams so/ /me'i phyogs su drag po'i gzugs can ma dang / mche ba'i gzugs can ma dang / gabyugs ma zhes bya ba 'jigs su rung ba'i mkha' 'gro ma 'ug pa'i gdong can ma'i mdog 77—/0/ /

can rnams so/ /bden bral gyi phyogs su thod pa'i phreng ba can ma dang /phreng ldan ma dang / mgo can ma dang /1 mthu chen ma zhes bya ba rnon po'i mkha' 'gro ma khyi'i gdong can ma'i mdog can rnams so/ /rlung gi phyogs su lag na ral gri ma dang / lag na dgra sta ma dang / rdo rje ma dang / lag na gzhu thogs ma zhes bya ba log 'dren gyi mkha' 'gro ma phag gi gdong can ma'i mdog can rnams so/ /de nas shar kyi sgor khyab 'jug dbyig pa thogs pa/lhor tshangs pa rnga yab thogs pa/ nub tu drag po mtshan nas sgogs pa khrur len pa/ byang du dbang po gdugs thogs pa/ de bzhin du lho'i snam bu la dbang ldan gyi phyogs su brgya byin/ me'i phyogs su lus ngan po/ bden bral kyi phyogs su 'byung po'i bdag po/ klu'i phyogs su rlung gi bdag po'o/ /de rnams 4bu dang chung ma dang 'khor dang bcas pa ste/ kha dog dang lag pa dang phyag mtshan ni sgrub thabs gzhan gyi rjes su 'brang bar bya'o/ /de la phyi rol gyi khyams kyi shar kyi char rus gong 'jigs byed dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ldan pa'i tshogs kyi srin po dang / tshogs kyi dbang phyug dang / dril bu'i rna ba can zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i mdog can rnams bsam par bya'o/ /de bzhin du byang du gtum mo'i dbang phyug dang / 'dun sa'i lha dang / rgan 5po'i dbang phyug dang / sil sgras 'jigs byed ces bya ba la sogs pa'i mdog can 6rnams so/ /lho ru ni gtum bu 7ra'i dbang phyug dang / sgra chen dang /mche ba gabyugs pa dang / gzhu 'dzin zhes bya ba kam po dzi ma la sogs pa'i mdog can rnams so/ /de bzhin du nub tu ni 'dod pa drag po dang /gnas kyi dbang phyug dang / cang te'u 'dul ba dang / rnga'i sgras 'jigs 11—/0/5

byed ces bya ba 'jig byed ma 1la sogs pa'i mdog can rnams so/ /'di rnams kyang lag pa bzhi pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thogs pa lha mo la 'khyud cing lag na rtse gsum thogs pa mig gsum pa stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can sbrul kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa thod pa'i phreng ba can rnams so/ /de nas phyi rol gyi mu khyud kyi sa gzhi la 'byung po dang / sha za la sogs pa ca co'i sgra sgrogs pa rnams dang / de dag gi 'khor rnams kyang blta bar bya'o/ /drag po la sogs pa dang / rus gong 'jigs byed la sogs pa rnams kyi chos kyi 2yi ge ni rang gi ming gi dang po'i yi ge de kho na yin no/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te gung mo dang mdzub mo dag brkyang nas lcags kyu'i rnam par sbyar bar bya'o/ /oṃ ā kar+ṣa ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba ni 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams spyan drang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ yī swā hā zhes bya ba dang / rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya ni dur khrod ma la sogs pa rnams kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang sngags so/ /thal mo sbyar nas de nyid g.yas su phab ste gzung bar bya zhing / oṃ s+t+waṃ swā hā zhes bya ba ni drag mo la sogs pa rnams kyi'o/ /rdo rje thal mo bcings nas dbye bar bya zhing / oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā zhes bya ba ni gcigs ma la sogs pa rnams kyi'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa brkyang nas rgyab gnyis sbyar te sor mo rnams so sor bcings —zhing / oṃ be+e tā lī 5hūṃ swā hā zhes bya ba ni mi bzad ma la sogs pa rnams kyi'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te dku dag tu gzung zhing / oṃ hūṃ swā hā zhes bya ba ni sgeg mo'i 'o/ /g.yon pa 6brkyang ste mthe bong dang srin lag sbyar nas g.yas pas gzung bar bya zhing / oṃ su pri ya gabye hūṃ zhes bya ba ni dri ma'i 'o/ /pi wang 7gi zlos gar dang / oṃ hūṃ ho swā hā zhes bya ba ni pi wang ma'i 'o/ /thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor sgyu11byed10/6

gzhag nas/ oṃ shrī swā hā zhes bya ba ni me tog ma'i 'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas mdzub tshomo bsgrengs te khar bskyod nas hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swā hā zhes bya ba ni glu ma'i 'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis babyungs te lag pa bskyod pa'i tshigs su gzung zhing / oṃ i swā hā zhes pa ni bdug pa ma'i 'o/ /lag pa g.yon pas g.yas kyi rked pa'i char sgeg pa dang bcas par bzhag chonas g.yas phrag par gzhag cing /oṃ su nirte swā hā zhes bya ba ni gar ma'i 'o/ /thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor gzung zhing / oṃ hūṃ saswā hā zhes bya ba ni mar me ma'i 'o/ /g.yas pa khu tshur bcings nas mdzub mo dang gung mo dag bsgrengs te dpral bar reg par bya zhing / oṃ mu myu hūṃ swā hā zhes bya ba ni brgya byin gyi'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa bcings nas mdzub mo gnyis rin po che'i rnam par sbyar zhing / oṃ rasne gre swā hā zhes bya ba ni nor sbyin gyi'o/ /g.yas pa rdo rje 6khu tshur bcings te sdigs mdzub 7bsgrengs nas/ oṃ gā ta ni hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba ni 'byung po'i bdag po'i 'o/ /g.yas pa khu tshur bcings te/ oṃ bhur bhu ba swā hā zhes bya ba ni klu'i bdag po'i 'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur spyi bor bzhag cing / oṃ kha sa swā hā zhes bya ba ni khyab 'jug gi'o/ / g.yas pa'i ba dan gsum spyi bor bzhag 9nas/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā zhes bya ba 7ni drag po'i 'o/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur snying gar bskyod cing / oṃ swā hā zhes bya ba ni 1 tshangs pa'i 'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ste kha sbubs 7nas g.yon pa'i khu tshur gye khro bo'i sor mo brkyang ste dbus su sbyar zhing gdugs kyi rnam par byas nas/oṃ mu swā hā zhes bya ba ni dbang po'i 'o/ /drag po nag po la sogs pa rnams dang /rus gong 'jigs byed la sogs pa rnams kyi ni drag po'i dam tshig gi sngags dang phyag rgya kho na yin no/ /de la lha rnam par bkod pa'i rjes thogs la mchod pa 41—/017

rnam pa nyi shus yang dag par mchod de/ sgeg mo'i phyag rgya bcings te yi ge hūṃ gi sgra brjod nas/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ 1sum̐ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ bhe bhe ghi hūṃ/ oṃ bhe t+ya ghi t+ya hūṃ swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis shin tu mnyes par bya'o/ /de nas/ rdo rje de nyid kyis bzung nas/ /dril bu chos kyis dkrol bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas1/ /rgyab tu rgyab ni sbyar bar bya/ /mthe'u chung gnyis ni bcings byas nas/ /cung zad du ni bcing bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi 4ho/ de nas oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi5/ ra ṇa ra ṇa/ pra ra ṇa pra ra ṇa/ saṃ pra ra ṇa saṃ pra ra ṇa/sarba bud+dhi k+ṣe tra pra tsa ni te/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā māṃ sam+bha be+e/ badz+ra z-i da yi sarnyo ṣa 6ni hūṃ hūṃ swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis 7dril bu bzung ste/ dpal mchog dang po'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis yang dag par bstod la rdo rje'i glu blangs te/ de bzhin du rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i bstod pa dang mchod pa byas la/ yang dag par mnyes par bya ba'i phyir dril bu dkrol bar bya'o/ /de nas snying gar rdo rje thal mo bcings te snying gar gzhag la/ oṃ shudhe dharme hūṃ ā ā oṃ a zhes bya ba brjod pas lha'i nga rgyal brtan par byas la phyi rol gyi lha rnams la gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /ji skad bshad pa'i gos dang 9rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu thogs pa/ brgya byin la sogs pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa'i slob dpon rkang pa g.yas pa sems dpa'i skyil mo krung du gnas pa g.yon brkyang bas rol pa'i tshul du gnas pas 1 rdzas dri zhim po rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gru bzhir byas la/ kha dog dkar po la sogs pa'i me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de/ 'bras sā lu ) dri zhim po'i 'bras chan zho dang sha kha ra dang / sbrang rtsi dang / mar nag dag bsres pa zangs la sogs (1byed/0/8

pa las byas pa'i snod rnams su gzhag 1pas shar gyi sgor gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ bat+ta le ma hā bat+ta li/ t+t+waṃ hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥswā hā zhes bya ba'i 4sngags 'dis lha rnams dgug par bya'o/ /oṃ wa hi byā ma hā wa hi 5ni srur+ya tsan+d+ra sibye mu khi/ dza ya ra dzi sau ma dzi u ma de bi ga ga su ru pi ta ra ya/ sa tod gra ha ga ṇa sarbe ga ṇa pa ti karti ka 7shri sha shri de bī de ga lo a su ra sa ro tse/ puk+ka sī9/ ma hā puk+ka sbo hūṃ he ho/ ā kār+ṣa ya ā kāste rta ya/ sa ma ya de bī sohūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya mdzub mo 1 gnyis bsgreng ba dang / oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya/ sa ma ye tiṣ+ṭha dz+re hri ba hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ /zhes bya bas mnyes par byas te se gol gsum brdabs sal gtang bar bya'o/ /de nas shar gyi phyogs su sa —gtsang mar dor bar bya'o/ /de ni lha'i gtor ma'o / / 8de nas sngar bshad pa'i cho ga bzhin du byas pa'i dkyil 'khor 'o ma la sogs pa las byas pa'i lha bshos kyis yongs su bskor bar mngar gsum dang bsres pa'i 'o thug gis bkang ba'i gser la sogs pa las byas pa'i snod du bzhag ste/ sngags dang phyag rgya de nyid kyis mtha' yas dang / nor rgyas dang / /'jog po dang / stobs kyi rgyu dang / pad+ma dang / pad+ma chen po dang / dung skyong dang / rigs ldan dang / lnga ldan dang / lnga ldan chen po dang / zla ba dang / gtsug tor dang / gtsug tor chen po dang /dbyig pa thogs pa dang / hu lu ta dang / dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo dang / rgya mtsho chen po dang / gdung ba dang / gdung ba chen po dang / (1byed/019

dpal 'od dang / 'od chen dang / rin po che'i 'od dang / gzugs bzang 1dang / gzugs chen dang / sbrul bzangs dang / gsus po che dang /dzi li dang / ma hā dzi li po ste/ oṃ ā gats+tsha ā gasgo sna/ ma hā nā a dhi pa ti sarba bhur byu bye bye bye phu/ rdo rje khu tshur bcings nas ni/ /mthe bong dang ni mje'u 4chung sbyar/ /dbus kyi sor mo dag brkyang nas/ /gdengs ka'i rnam par sbyar bar bya/ /de lta bu 'dis srin lag gzung ste gtad par zhebya'o/ /byang phyogs su chu bo la dor bar bya'o/ /klu'i gtor ma'o / / de nas nub phyogs su mngon par phyogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'gram na gnas pas tsan+dan dmar po la sogs pa las byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum me tog dmar po la sogs pas mdzes par byas la/ snga ma bzhin du zho dang sbrang rtsi dang bcas pa'i 'bras chan 7bdud rtsi lnga dang yang dag par ldan pa'i snod mdun du bzhag la snga ma bzhin du nor bu bzang po dang / gang ba bzang po dang / rgyal ba bzang po la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi bdag po rnams bos te/ rdo rje bsdams pa snying gar bcings la 7bzung zhing / oṃ nā gā bye pa ti ba ta 1 li hūṃ swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis mnyes par bya'o/ /de kho na bzhin du btang nas lho'i phyogs su shing gcig par dor bar bya'o/ /de ni gnod sbyin gyi gtor ma'o / /4yang de kho na bzhin du lho ru mngon par phyogs par gnas pa rdo rje'i 'gros 5dang ldan pas tsan+dan dmar po la sogs pa las byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 47—/020

me tog dmar po la sogs pa bkram par lha bshos la sogs pa yang phul te/ nya sha skam po dang / sgog pa dang / btsong dang / khrag dang / til dang /bag phye la sogs pa'i khur ba dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang / bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / btung ba dang / myang ba dang / gzhib pa rnam pa tha dad pa dang nya'i gzugs brnyan gyis gang ba'i snod 1mdun du bzhag la / sngags dang phyag rgya de rnams kyis snod la reg ste/ gdan bzhi pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i e ka bṛk+ṣa zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i sngags brjod la 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya bcings te mdzub mo gnyis lu gu rgyud byas la phyag rgya de dang / oṃ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa dzaḥphaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis mgu bar byas te btang la rnga la sogs pa'i sgra dang / dril bu'i sgra dang / 'byung po'i gtor ma yo byad kyi sngags dang / phyag rgya nyid kyis gang na dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi yod pa de la phyi rol gyi mtshams kyi phyogs brgyad du gtor ma dor bar bya'o/ /de ni 'byung po'i gtor ma'o / /5gtor ma de dag thams cad la/ /sngags pa bzang pos gtong dus su/ /dge bsnyen gyi ni spyi bo ru/ /lan gsum du ni bskor bar bya/ /gtor ma skyel byed dad ldan gang / /'phags pa 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /de la bsang gtor bya ba nyid/ /min na de rnams kyis zos 'gyur/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor dag gi ni/ /gtor ma dag 6gis rnal 'byor pas/ /dngos grub mchog ni 'grub 'gyur ba/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /sgyu ma'i rgyud las ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ /skra bshig rkang pa yis ni gar thabs 7byas/ /gcer bu lho 47—/02/

phyogs gnas pa'i bdag nyid kyis/ /thun mtshams kun du gtor ma rab sbyin bya//dang por phyogs ni brgyad rnams su/ /khro mo mkha' 'gro ma bsam bya/ /de rnams la ni blo rgya ches/ /bdud rtsi lnga ldan gtor ma sbyin/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /thun bzhi ru ni rab tu bya/ /snga dro rdo rje mkha' 'gro la/ /mkha' spyod rnams la nyin phyed na/ /mtshan dus sa spyod rnams la'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma la mtshan phyed na/ /g.yas brkyang gnas pas mkha' 'akro la/ /g.yon brkyang ba yis mkha' spyod la/ /sa spyod rnams la khyad par du/ /rkang pa mnyam par bya ba yin/ /pad+ma 1bskor ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /gcer bu gar dang yang dag ldan/ /drag po'i lta stangs dang ldan pa/ /mig ni g.yon pa dag gis blta/ /rus sbal phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /dpral ba'i steng du yang dag gzhag2 /skad cig rnam pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /te ru ka yi gzugs su bya/ /cig car sngags ni brjod bya zhing / /cig car phyogs ni rgyas gdab cing / /dur khrod dam ni chu bo'i 'gram/ /mtshan ma gcig gam bzhi mdo ru/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu rab ster ba/ /rnal 'byor rgyal pos rtag tu sbyin/ /bdud rtsis kha ni bkang nas su/ /rus gong steng dag gnas byas la/ /phyag rgya lnga ni 'ching ba yis/ /sngags ni brjod cing gtor ma sbyin/ /oṃ sarba gro dha ḍā ki n+ya i saṃ ba bo pra t+t+waṃ 4ts+tshan+tu hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas/ gtor ma dur khrod la sogs su / /rnal 'byor skyes mchog dag gis dor/ /de nas me tog mgor bzhag 5ste / /rang gi gnas su 'jug par bya/ /de ni nang gi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gtor ma'o / /677—/022

grangs ni bzhi ru gyur pa yi/ /rgyal chen ji ltar tshim gyur pa/ /gtor ma'i las ni yid 'ong ba/ /de yi rjes la bshad par bya/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor shar sogs kyi/ /phyogs rnams su ni 'khor lo bzhi/ /rnam par bsgoms nas gang ba'i snod/ /bzhi ni de ru gzhag 3par bya/ /yul 'khor skyong gi snod gang yin/ /de ni bza' ba chang spangs pas/ /yongs su gang bar rab tu bya/ /de bzhin rnam thos sras kyi ni/ /sha dang chang la sogs pas dgang / /de bzhin lus 'phags po yi snod/ /khrag gis gang bar gyur par bya//mig mi bzang gi snod dag ni/ /'o ma dag gis dgang bar bya/ /der ni snod kyi cho ga'i rim 1/ /byas nas rgyal po chen po ni/ /bskyed pa'i phyir ni bsgom par bya/ /dang po'i yi ge las byung ba'i/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi po ni/ /yi ge gsum gyis byin brlabs shing / /ye shes sems dpa' dang ldan bsgom/ /te ru ka yi skur gnas te/ /lag na rdo rje dril bu thogs/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos sngags 'di yis/ /de rnams so sor gtor ma sbyin/ /oṃ dh+ri ta rāṭ+wā ya gan+tar+bha se 4nā dhi pa ta ye i saṃ ba bo pra tīts+tsha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra āḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ na mo bai shra ba shā ya yak+ṣa se nā dhi pa ta ye i saṃ ba li pra tīts+tsha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra snyahūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bi rū chobhā kā ya ma hā ku be+e rā bye pa ta ye i saṃ ba lo pra tīts+tsha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra 26hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bi rū pāk+ṣu ya ma hā na gā 3dhi pa ta ye i mo ba bo pra tīts+tsha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra s+dzahūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/sngags tshig bla med 'di rnams kyis/ /snod bzhi byin gyis brlabs nas ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rim bzhin du/ /shar la sogs par dor bar bya/ /de ni rgyal po chen po bzhi'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o// //47—1023

bde mchog cho ga las gsungs pa'i/ /skye bo rnams ni mchod 'gyur ba/ /gtor ma 'byung po thams cad la/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad bya/ /dam tshig 'khor lo'i phyi rol du/ /hūṃ gi sa bon las byung ba/ /shing gcig dang bcas dur khrod brgyad/ /rnal 'byor rig pas bsam par bya/ /gnod sbyin srin po 'byung po dang / /de bzhin yi dwags sha za dang / /grul bum brjed byed mkha' 'gro 1dang / /mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs nyid dag /shing drung gcig ni brgyad po yi༄ / /rtse mor drag po rnams bsam bya/ /shing gi rtsa ru de mtshungs pa'i/ /'khor dag rnam par bsam par bya/ /khwa yi gdong can la sogs pa'i/ /'khor gyi rang gi gzugs dag ni/ /thams cad hūṃ las yang dag byung / /mtshon cha sna tshogs dag thogs pa/ /chang dang sha dang btsong snal sogs—/ /khu ba de bzhin sha yi gzugs/ /snod du bcug nas de nyid ni/ /bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin nyid du bya/ /sngar bzhin skra bshig la sogs ldan/ /g.yon brkyang la sogs sbyor byas pa/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos sngags 'di yis//de rnams nyid ni bod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a ra li ho dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ badz+ra ḍā ki be+e 4sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ byu hoḥ/ sngags 'di lan gsum brjod nas ni/ /rang nyid kyi ni snying gar yang / /snod kyi phyag rgya lan gsum du/ /bskor nas gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /mkha' spyod phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /khro tshig mtshan gcig 5 la sogs su/ /sgrub pa po yis sngags 'di yis/ /dogs pa med par gtor ma gtang 6/ /oṃ kha kha khā hi khā ti/ sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa byu ta pre ta pi sha 3tsod+ma da a ba sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya i saṃ ba lo kṛṇ+ḍin+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+d+ra ma ma sarba 77—/02/

sirnyim+me 1pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya dze+e bhe baṃ/ ya je ṣ+ṭi/ byuñja tha pi pa tha/ mā —ti kra ma tha ma ma sarba karta ya sata su kha 5bi shudha ye/ sa ha yi ka bha ban+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa 5 swā hā/ de 'dra'i sngags chen brjod byas nas/ /dur khrod du ni gtor ma sbyin/ /'jigs byed sems can drag po'i bdag /snying rjer ldan pas gtor ma dor/ /de lta bu yi rim 'di yis/ /'di ni 'byung po thams cad brjod/ /bgegs rnams zhi bar bya phyir yang / /gtor ma 'di ni bsngags khupa yin/ /de ni 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o// //gzhan yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /gur las gsungs pa'i gtor ma'i las /khams gsum dag tu cig ⑫car du/ /tshim par bya phyir yang dag bya/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su ni/ /chu skyes 'dab brgyad dbus su bsgom8/ /dbang po shar gyi 'dab mar bsam/ /gshin rje lho ru dgod par bya/ /chu lha nub kyi 'dab mar te/ /byang du gnod sbyin dgod par bya/ /me yi phyogs su me chen po/ /bden bral phyogs su bden bral te/ /rlung gi phyogs su rlung lha bsam—/ /'byung po'i bdag po dbang ldan du/ /zla ba nyi ma tshangs la sogs//tshangs ris dam pa rnams dang ni/ /tshangs pa'i 'dun na 'don bdag nyid/ /dga' ldan mtha' 9bral na gnas dang / /rgyal po chen po kun du skyes/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dag dang ni/ /'phrul dga' yi ni lha rnams dang / /gang dag gtsang ma'i gnas 'dug dang / /bde ba can na kun du gnas/ /'og min na ni gnas pa dang / /'od can 'jig rten khams gnas dang / /sum cu rtsa gsum na gnas pa/ /de dag thams cad steng du bsam/ /stobs rgyu 41byed/025

dang ni dung skyong dang / /mtha' yas de bzhin nor rgyas dang / /'jog po dang ni rigs 1ldan nyid/ /pad+ma che dang pad+ma ni/ /chos 'byung gi ni dbus na gnas / /lha ma yin dang sems dmyal dang / /chos 'byung gi ni 'og tu'o/ /oṃ las tshangs pa la sogs pa/ /yi ge hūṃ las dbang po sogs/ /a las stobs rgyu la sogs pa/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa'o/ /steng gi lha ni shin tu dkar/ /dbang po la sogs mdog sngon po/ /stobs rgyu la sogs shin tu dmar / /rang snang rig mas yan lag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bus phyag brel ba//g.yas brkyang ba yi gnas pas gnas/ /tshangs sogs rtag pas rgyas gdab cing //rdo rje can gyis brgya byin sogs/ /ltos 'gro la sogs gar dbang gis/ /thams cad rigs las byung ba yi/ /go rī yis ni dgug par bya/ /rkun mos gzhug par bya ba ste/ /ro langs ma yis zhags pas bcings — / /dril bu za phod mas 4dbang bya/ /de nas mchod yon zhal bsil dbul/ /de bzhin me tog bdug pa sogs/ /mnyam par gzhag 5pa'i sems kyis ni/ /sngags 'di yis ni tshim par bya/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gsang sngags 'di dag nyid kyis ni/ /sngar bzhin rdzas kyis gang ba yi/ /thod pa de rnams dag la dbul/ /mtshan gcig la sogs rnams su dor/ /gtor ma'i cho ga bzhin byas nas/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /de nas 'thor 'thung phul byas nas/ /sngags 'di yis ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra ḍā ki twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/su poṣ+yo me bha ba/ sarba sidhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ/ bha ga bān 7sarba ta thā ga ta mā me muñca ḍā ki bha ba ma hā/ sa 47—1026

ma ya satwa aḥmuḥ4/ de nas gtor ma'i las byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor rang gi yan lag la/ /bsdu ba byas nas sngar rim bzhin/ /ye shes 'khor lo gshegs su gsol/ /snga dro'i thun la de bzhin du/ /thams cad mnyam par gzhag pas ༄ bhebya/ /thun bzhi dag ni thams cad la/ /skad cig gis ni bsgom par bya/ /de ltar gur gyi rgyud gsungs pa/ /cig car 'byung po thams cad ni//tshim pa ru ni byed pa'i mchog /gtor ma bdag gis bshad pa yin/ /de ni dus gcig tu khams gsum pa tshim par byed pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o // // gang tshe rnal 'byor sngar bshad pa'i/ /gtor ma'i cho ga byed pas ni/ /gnod pa bya byed bgegs mthong ba/ /de tshe de rab zhi bya'i phyir/ /gtor ma bya ba de rim pa/ /dpal ldan rgyud dra dgyes rdo rje/ /rgyud gnyis kyi ni rjes 'brangs nas/ /bdag gis bzang por bshad par bya/ /re zhig dang por rnal 'byor pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsams te/ de nas ram̐ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hūṃ 4kha dog sngon po las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūṃ mdzad zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa 5phyag g.yas pa na ral gre dang / rdo rje dang / rtse gsum bsnams pa/ g.yon pa na dril bu dang / dgra sta dang tho ba bsnams pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/ ljags bskyod pa—/ dbu skra ser po thu/ spyan dmar po/ mgul pa sprul 7gyis brgyan pa/g.yon pa brkyang pas nasa'i steng mnan pa/ khro bo 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'phro ba/snying gar yi ge hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ ha ha zhes sgogs par bdag nyid bsgoms la/de nas mdun du ci nus par rdul tshon la sogs pas dkyil 'khor kun du bris 941—1027

te / bum pa srog chags med pa'i chu dri bzang po dang ldan pas yongs su bkang ba lcug mas kha rgyan byas pa/ gos kyis mgrin pa dkris lkupa/ nang du 'bru dang / rin po che dang / sman bcug pa bcu'am lnga'am gcig de nyid du bzhag 2la/ g.yon du mchod yon gyi snod dang / g.yas su me tog la sogs pa'i yo byad bzhag ste/ mchod yon gyi snod la rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'i sngags lan nyi shu rtsa 4gcig bzlas par bya'o/ /las thams cad pa'i snod la yang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags de kho na bzhin du yongs su bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas zla ba dang rdo rje la sogs pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus pas bum pa rnams su rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la thub 5pa'i gzugs bskyed la rje btsun gyi yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod nas oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis rdo rje yang dag par mchod de/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ra ṇa zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis mchod la spos kyis bdugs 6te/ oṃ badz+ra byeka 7ces bya ba la sogs pa'i sngags kyis bum pa dag spyan drang bar bya'o/ /de nas me tog dang spos dang yon chab dang dri dang lha bshos phul la / rang rang gi sngags rnams yi ge brgya pa 'don pa sngon du 'gro ba can rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas ‘bum pa rnams la brgya rtsa brgyad yongs su bzlas te ras la sogs pa la bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das khrus bya'o//ri mo bris pa rnams la ni me long la 1sku gzugs rnams 1 ni dngos su'o/ /sku khrus kyi yo byad 'bru la sogs pa rnams ni khrus kyi cho ga las bstan te de nyid las shes par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi sngags kyis dkyil 'khor gyi bum pa dag gis dbang bskur la dkyil 'khor mchod pa lnga la sogs pas mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i sprin nag po dang mtshungs pa'i gnod sbyin 41—1028

dang srin bo dang sha za la sogs pa lag na ral gri dang tho ba dang mda' bo )che la sogs pa thogs pa rnams bsams bye te/ nam mkha' la yang paṃ las byung ba'i pad+ma chen po de'i 'dab ma brgyad la 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad kha dog dang dbyibs dang cha byad ji lta ba bzhin dang ldan pa/ lte ba'i dbus su bgegs kyi rgyal po log 'dren mdog dmar po glang po che'i gdong can gdong gcig pa/lag pa bzhi pa/ lag pa g.yas na dgra sta dang ral gri thogs pa/ lag pa g.yon na phreng ba dang la du thogs pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba gar byed pa/tshangs pa'i ཿrgyab tu rkang pa gnyis kyis mnan pa/ glang po che'i sgras gang ba'i mchu'i rtse mo'i sgras phyogs bcu'i gtos kyi nang 'gengs pa/ me tog gi zhimache ba can gyi tshogs kyis rkang pa'i pad+ma gnyis la phyag byas pa rnam par bsgoms la/oṃ badz+ra a ra li ho dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma s+t+waṃ dṛ byu 7ho zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis bos la/ dkyil 'khor kyi phyogs bcu kun du bsam par bya'o/ /de nas yi ge hūṃ gi sgra 'jigs su rung ba brjod nas 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis nyungs kar byin gyis brlabs te bgegs thams cad la dmigs nas oṃ ri ri ti ti phaṭa swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags dang / oṃ sarba pā paṃ 9da ha na badzā ya swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis me'i snod du gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo dang snying ardza ka'i dog pa bzhin du 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /gal te dam tshig la gnas par mi byed na de'i tshe bag phye las bgegs rnams kyi gzugs brnyan byas /dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gsor ba'i rdo rjes phye mar byas na skad cig de nyid la de rnams dam tshig la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sum+bha — sum+bha zhes bya ba la sogs pas phur bu gdab cing / de bzhin du sngags rkang pa phyi mas brdung 41—/029

bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la sa la sogs pa'i bum pa'am phru ba tshad chen po dang ldan pa chus yongs su gang bar bya ste nya'i sha rlon pa dang / btsos pa dang /bsegs pa'i dbye ba rnam pa gsum dang / de bzhin du pri yang ku dang ko laṅga dang tsa na ka dang / 'breng bu'i chun po dang / 'bras yos dang / star ka'i 'bras bu dang / snum khur dang / sha dang / ma yo sta dang / thug pa dang / btsong dang / sgog skya dang / ke'u dang / khab dang / 'gron bu dang / snye ma'i 'bru dang / gong bu'i 'bru dang 3/ lan tshwa dang / sbrang rtsi dang / 'bru'i chang dang / rgun chang dang / gos sngon po dang / sgron bu'i tshogs kyis gang bar byas la khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad yongs su bzlas par bya'o/ /'dir sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badzā 1rde na mo badz+ra kro dha ya ma hā rda stsod ka ṭa bye ra bā ya/ a si mu sa la pa la 4shu pā sha hastu ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha / ban+dha ban+ta/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ gardza gardza/bi sgo ṭa ya/ bi sgo ṭa ya/ sarba bispyo bi nā ya kan ma hā ga ṇa pa ti dz+re bi ta an+ta ka rā ya swā hā/ de'i rjes la rje btsun yi ge brgya pas me tog dang spos rnams kyis mchod la/ g.yas brkyang ba'i 'dug stangs nye bar bcings te dril bu dkrol zhing rdo rje gsor bas sngags 'di 2brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ in+da6/ dza ma / dza la/ dzak+ṣa/ byu ta/ balbo3/ bā u/ rak+ṣa/ tsan+dasnye/ sudz+dza/mā da/ pabe+e/ ta la pā tā le/ asbyasabe+e swā hā9/ i rda ba lisgruñja/ dzigha/phul+la / dhū be+e/ māṃ sa/ dzi gha/ saṃbha/ sabe+e/ kadz+dza/ sā da/ khadhi/khu ṇi/ phe ḍa/ gā da / de bzhin du oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde 1ābyā 47—1030

nut+pan+da tā /'uta ta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ yang na sngags so sos snyegator ma sbyin par bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ oṃ in+de byeye swā hā/ dbang po'i phyogs su'o/ /be ba swa ye swā hā/ gshin rje'i phyogs su'o/ /oṃ a ṭ+wāṃ pa ta ye swā hā/ chu'i phyogs su'o/ /oṃ yak+ṣa bir+ya dha ri swā hā/ lus ngan po'i phyogs su'o/ /oṃ ru dā ya swā hā/ dbang ldan gyi phyogs su'o/ /oṃ aghā ya jeswā hā/ me'i phyogs su'o—/ /oṃ rak+ṣa sidhi pa ta ye swā hā/ bden bral kyi phyogs su'o/ /oṃ wa ya be swā hā/ rlung gi phyogs su'o/ /oṃ rka ka ri swā hā/ srin po rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ sha za rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ 'byung po rnams kyi'o—/ /oṃ ga ra la ye swā hā/ lha ma byeyin rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ ma ti bh+yo swā hā/ma mo rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ bi shudha swā hā ba hi snani swā hā/ dri za rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ yak+ṣa shra 3ya swā hā/ gnod sbyin rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ bi shā tsa ga ti swā hā/ sha za rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ gra te sardza prabha — bye ti ma ya swā hā/ rgyu skar rnams kyi'o/ /rim pa 'di kho na bzhin du sngags 'di rnams kyis chu snyim pa gsum sbyin par bya'o//de nas thams cad phur bu las thar tsobar 'gyur ro/ /'dir phyag rgya yang 'byung ste/ mdzub mo 'dus byas gung mo sbyar/ /mthe bong rdo rje brtan por sbyar—/ /de ni dpral ba'i dbus bzhag 1nas/ /bskor zhing bskor nas bskyod par bya/ /lho ru lus ni bltas byas nas/ /gcer bu skra ni bshig gyur cing / /drag cing khros pa'i sems ldan pas/ /thun gsum du ni gtor ma sbyin//yang na 2rked pa'i phyogs su lag pa g.yon pa nyu5dril bu dang bcas pa bzhag 1 snal g.yas pas bsnyems sketshul dang bcas pa'i rdo rje gsor zhing gtor ma sbyin par bya'o—/ /yang na gung mo dang srin lag dag bkug nas de dag gi rtsa bar mthe 41byed1031

bong bcug ste mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung dag lcags kyu'i rnam par bya zhing lag pa g.yon pa'i 1tshigs rgyab tu lag pa g.yas pa'i rgyab tshigs gzhag zhe ste snying ga'i gnas su gzhag par bya'o/ /de lta bu de yang gtor ma'i phyag rgya yin no/ /thun mtshams thams cad du rgyu'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i cho ga bzhin du gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas sgrub pa'i grogs mchog gis oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa ces pa'i sngags brjod pas sgrub pa pos srung ba byas nas 4thor tshugs bcing bar byas te 5shing gcig gam/ lam gyi bzhi mdo'am/ sum mdo'am/ mtshan ma gcig pa'am/ chu bo dag tu gtor ma dor bar bya ba'am bkres pa rnams la 6 sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon chu bo la dbo bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi ba'i phyi bas byugs la bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma bklag 7par bya'o/ /bsod nams yongs su bsngos te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas nas bskor ba byas te langs nas khyed kyis zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang / ngo mtshar gyi phyag rgyas btab la rang gi lha'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam rnam bzhi'i sgo nas ji ltar 'dod pas gnas par bya'o/ /de ni bgegs rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o// //gdon dang phyogs skyong tshim bya'i phyir/ /dpung bzangs rgyud las ji skad gsungs / /gtor ma'i las ni lung bzhin du/ /de nas dang por rab bshad bya/ /re zhig dang por sngar bshad pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba la sogs pa nye bar bsogs te cha gnyis su byas nas cha gcig la gdon rnams tshim par bya ba'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams brjod par bya'o/ /lha dang lha min 11—1032

gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang snalus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bdag cag pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni/ /thal sbyar khyed rnams la yang gsol 'debs na/ /bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa rnams / /gsan nas phan 'dogs slad du 'dir spyon cig /'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yul kun gnas dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang / /grong khyer kun na gang dag gnas pa dang / /chu bo kun dang chu bo'i ngogs bye rnams dang / /rin chen gnas na lhag par gang gnas dang / /rdzing dang mtsho dang lu ma lteng ka dang / /khron pa dang ni ngam grog chu mig dang / /grong dang phyugs lhas gdang ni nags tshal dang //khang stong dang ni lha yi khang pa dang / /gang dag gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas/ /so nam khyim dang glang po'i khang rnams dang / /gang dag rgyal po'i dkor khang gnas pa dang / /srang dang khyams dang grong dang 'dun sa dang //gang dag shing gcig drung dang lam chen gnas/ /dur khrod dang ni nags tshal che gnas dang / /seng ge glang chen dred kyi gnas rnams dang / /'jigs su rung ba'i dgon pa che gnas dang / /chu gling mchog dag tu ni gnas bcas dang / /gang dag 'brog dgon dur khrod gnas na gnas/ /dga' zhing mgu nas dri dang me tog phreng cho/ /spos dang me tog mar me gus phul ba/ /'di dag bsnams 5te so sor bzhes nas kyang / /las 'di dag gi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod—/ /gdon la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir de ltar bya ste/ de nas cha gcig la phyogs skyong rnams la mchod par bya ba'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams 41—1033

brjod par bya'o/ /shar phyogs rdo rje can te lha tshogs bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams ma lus sa yi klu dag dang / /ri yi lha dang gsang ba'i tshogs 'dus la/ /so so so sor gtor ma phul ba rnams/ /rang rang gi ni phyogs su bzhugs nas kyang / /rang gi bu smad gogs dang g.yog 'khor bcas/ /dpung dang sde bcas mnyes nas bzhes su gsol/ /spos dang me tog gtor ma lha bshos ni/ /'di dag bzhes shing so sor bsnams kyenas kyang / /bya ba 'di ni 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /'di ni bgegs nye bar zhi bar byed pa'i don du'am / dgos pa gzhan 'dod pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis bsgrub byepar bya'o/ /gtor ma 'di la sngags rnams ni/ /kun du 'byung ba med mod kyi/ /'on kyang tshigs bcad tsam gyis ni/ /'dir ni gdon sogs rim —par 'gyur/ /dka' thub mthu dang bden pa rnams/ /lhag par yang dag thob 'gyur ba/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' ༄srilung ni/ /'di ltar sngags dang mtshungs par 'dod / /slu ba med pa'i tshig gang yin/ /de ni gsang sngags nyid du 'dod//mu stegs kyis 6ni bstan pa'i sngags/ /de nyid phyir na tshad ma min/ /de bas dngos grub thob rnams kyi/ /tshig gang de sngags nyid yin te/ /spyod lam bzhi po de dag ni/ /phyag rgya nyid du bshad pa yin/ /de bas gtor ma'i las 'di la / /tshigs bcad gsang sngags nyid du 'grub/ /de bas 'dir ni swā hā sogs—/ /spel ba'i sngags ni dgos pa med/ /de ni gdon dang phyogs skyong rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga'o// //41—1034

dkyil 'khor thams cad tshim bya'i phyir/ /dus kyi 'khor lo las gsungs pa / /gtor ma'i las ni shin tu gsang / /de bzhin gshegs dang lha mo rnams—/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni 'khor rnams dang / /khro bo mkha' 'go ma rnams kyis/ /sum cu drug gi bar gsal bar/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad bya/ /dang po sbyor ba kyisogs dbye bas/ /ting nge 'dzin ni gsum du 'dod—/ /de yi mtha' — mar rnal 'byor pas/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor tshim par bya/ /ye shes 'khor lo rang ༄ snying nas/ /sna yi bu ga g.yas dang g.yon/ /gnyis nas kun du spro bya zhing / /dkyil 'khor la ni yang dag dgod/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyogs kyi mtha'/ /bzhi po las kyang mkha' 'gro sogs/ /gnas ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi las/ /rab tu gtum mo la sogs spro/ /khwa yi gdong can la sogs pa/ /thams cad za byed mkha' 'gro ma/ /rul ba'i dri ldan la sogs sgo/ /dur khrod rnams nas yang dag spro/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor nang du ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dkyil 'khor mchog /mthong nas mchod yon zhabs bsil sogs/ /sngar bzhin rnal 'byor so sor dbul/ /de nas sngar bzhin chu skyes sogs/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rnam par bsam/ /bdud rtsi lnga yang bsam par bya/ /rang gi sa bon byin brlabs shing / /'od kyi tshogs ni rnam par 'phro/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du/ /de dag brtul zhugs chen pos bsam/ /de nas sngurnam par sbyang ba la sogs pa'i sngags kyi tshig ni 'di rnams yin no/ /oṃ na maḥshrī badz+ra ḍā ki ya oṃ s+dzahūṃ/ yi ge oṃ gyis sbyang bar bya'o/ /yi ge t+payis spel 5bar bya'o/ /yi ge hūṃ gis khyebadud rtsir bya'o//41—1035

lag pa g.yon pas sbyang bar bya'o/ /lag pa g.yas pas rtogs par bya'o/ /thal mo bkab nas spar bar bya'o/ /nam mkha' lding gi skyaphyag rgyas zla ba zhu ba'i rang bzhin du bdud rtsir bya'o/ /de nas g.yon pa'i srin lag gis dbus nas thig le blangs te sa la chos 'byung gru gsum bya zhing / de'i nang du zlum po'i thig le'i gzugs can bya'o/ /de'i nang du me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin du gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi 'khor lo bsam zhing de tshim par bya'o/ /oṃ āḥ3hūṃ/a ā/ i slo u spru/ ṛ dzā/ lo shā 2/zhes bya ba ni rnam par shes pa la sogs pa'i phung po rnams dang nam mkha' la sogs pa'i khams rnams so/ /a ā / i yī/ e i/ ar ār/ o 6/ al stol/ oṃ āḥgehūṃ zhes bya ba ni dbang po drug go/ /ya yā/ ra rā/ wa wā/ la lā/ ha hā zhes bya ba ni thabs dang shes rab kyi sku can gyi khro bo bcu dang / las kyi dbang po dang zhe sdang rdo rje la sogs pa'i bdag nyid can dag go/ /ka kā kha khā ga gā gha ghā nga khyo / tsa tsā tsha tsā dza dzā dzha dz+nyā nya hā/ ṭa ṭā ṭha bye ḍa ḍā bha ṭ+wā ṇa ṇa/ pa pā pha pā ba bā bha bhā ma mā/ ta tā tha thā da dā dha dhā na nā/ sha shā ṣa ṣā sa sā ha hā tshu dzha ha hā/ ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā k+ṣa k+ṣu zhes bya ba ni thabs dang shes rab kyi rigs 6sum cu rtsa drug tshim par bya ba'i cho ga'i sngags so/ /de ltar brjod nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i mkha' 'gro ma tshim par bya ba'i phyir srin lag dang mthe bong dag gis thig le phul te/ dkyil 'khor rang gi yan lag la bsdu bar byas nas/ rang gi kha mtshan ma gcig par bdud rtsi lnga'i thig le mkha' 'gro ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa sngags 'dis gtor bar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba kro dha ḍā ka n+ya i oṃ ba lo pra tī ts+tshan+tu sa ma ya ma nu sma ra s+dzahūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas yongs su 41—1036

mnyes par bya ba'i don du yang sngags 'di brjod par bya ste/ oṃ di byān 7ne+e sa mā bye ༄ dh+ya na thraṇa snane swā hā/ de'i rjes la mkha' 'gro ma'i 'khor lo ma lus pa yongs su mnyes par gyur nas khams gsum pa yang de kho na bzhin du bsgom par bya'o / /de nas langs te ye shes kyi 'khor lo gshegs su gsol ba/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo nang du bcug ste/ smon lam btab la bsod nams yongs su bsngos te/ rang gi lha'i nga rgyal du dmigs la snang ba tsam gyis rang gi ngo bo'i chospyod lam rnams kyis gnas par bya'o/ /de ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag gi rim pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga'o// //gang gi ltalus ni rab rgyas shing / /bde ba chen po thob 'gyur ba/ /yi dwags tshim byed gtor ma ni/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad bya/ /dang po chu ni drag brug pa'i6/ /chu bo nub bltas song nas ni/ /lag pa la sogs bkrus nas ni/ /gus pa yis ni bzlas 7par bya/ /pad+ma'i phreng ba blangs nas ni—/ /mkhas pas brgya 87dang rtsa brgyad bzlas/ /sngags ni yi ge drug pa ste/ /dngos su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /oṃ dang ma ṇi pad+me dang / /hūṃ gi mtha' can sngags rgyal po/ /yi dwags rnams kyi bkres skom sogs/ /nyon mongs gdung ba 'joms byed pa/ /'o ma'i mtsho 9ltar dkar ba'i 'od/ /zhi ba 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /mchog sbyin chu skyes dag gis mtshan/ /thugs rje'i rang gi shugs kyis ni/ / gdung bar 'gyur ba'i yid mnga' ba/ /mtsho skyes chen po'i ge sar gyi/ /lte ba'i dbus na yang dag bzhugs/ /skyil 47—1037

krung phyed par bzhugs gyur pa/ /'od dpag med pas dbu rgyan byas/ /zla ba'i 'od kyis brgyan gyur cing / /'od kyi 'khor los rnam par brgyan/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyis sdug bsngal gyur/ /ma lus 'gro ba skyob brtson pa/ /rnal 'byor pas ni bdag nyid bsam/ /skrag 'gyur ri dwags gzhon nu ma'i/ /g.yo ba'i mig ni zil gnon mdzad/ /yid 'ong lha mo sgol ma ni/ /g.yas logs su ni bsgom par bya/ /g.yon du de bzhin ser por snang / /phyag byed pa la yang dag brtson/ /zla ba phyed pa dang mtshungs pa'i/ /dpral hūṃb dang ldan khro gnyer can/ /de nas snying gi'i snapad dbus su/ /yi ge tweḥ — ni yang dag bsam/ /de yi 'od kyis 'gro ba kun/ /gsal bar byas nas rab tu dgang / /'od zer mang po de nyid kyis/ /shin tu skem pa'i yi dwags ltar4 / /rang gi skra dang ba spus g.yogs/ /gsus pa ri bo dag dang mtshungs/ /mgrin pa'i be+e las byung ba yi/ /rnag ni 'thung bar kun du 'dod/ /rus pa snabs lud bkres zas 3nyen/ /rang gi mchu dang gog ma rnams/ /de rnams bltas nas bsod ldan pas/ /snying rje chen po bskyed 6byas nas/ /de rnams steng du lus 7byung ba'i/ /'od zer 'khor lo dbab par bya/ /de nas snying rje'i shugs kyis ni/ /lag pa dag las shin tu byung / /'o ma'i rgyun gyi 37de dag ni//snyim pa kha dang 'brel ba dgang / /de nas lo ma 'bras chan dang / /'o ma dang ni mngar gsum kyis/ /snod ni shin tu gang byas nas/ /de rnams 'di ltar bod par bya/ /oṃ ā tshoyan+tu ā —yan+tu ma hā 1sna pre ta sabhe shuṣ+ka ma kasgoṣā pū 7ta / k+ṣaṣ+pe pā sā wa shrī kri ta dhi ni tsit+ta/ i oṃ ba bo kṛṇ+ḍi ta dzi gha thutha pi pa tha khyuñja 15tha su khawa h+ye ra ma tha/ pun ra ku sha la bye ma ra tha swā hā/ sngags 41byed/038

'di yis ni yi dwags kyi/ /rigs chen po 17la de nas ni/ /gtor ma sbyin phyir sngags 'di ni/ /rnal 'byor pa —ni gsal bar brjod/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ya bhi ru ka te dzo rā dzā ya ta thā ga ta ya ar+ha te samyak+shi busgye ya/ tar+ya thā/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te/ bha ra bha ra/ sam+bha ra 4/sam+bha ra/ hūṃ dz+dza sarba pre ta ka la ni san+tar+ṣa ni swā hā/ de nyid kyi phyag rgya 'byung ste lag pa gnyis kyis thal mo kha cung zad phye ba byas la mdzub mo dag rna cha'i rnam par byas pa'i 5phyag rgya byas te/ yi dwags kyi gtor ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /de nas chu bo de nyid 'o mar 'brub bhepar bsams la de nyid du gtor ma de dor bar bya'o/ /yi dwags de rnams kyang lus yongs su rgyas pa 'od zer gyi tshogs de nyid kyi steng du bteg la/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'jig rten dbang phyug bzhin du pad+ma'i stan la nye bar gnas pa bsam gtan la dga' ba'i yid can du bsgom par bya'o/ /de ni yi dwags kyi gtor ma'o// //bdag nyid skal bzang sgrub 7pa dang / /rgyal po la sogs dbang bya'i phyir / /dri za'i gtor ma bsgrub pa ni/ /de nas gtor ma rab bshad bya/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi bya ste/ gla rtsi dang / ga pur dang / bzhi mnyam dang /gur kum dang / tsan+dan dang / si la ra sa dang / ba la 9la sogs pa rnams kyis nye bar byugs 7la dbus kyi gnas su a ka ru'i spos dud sna tshogs kyi dri bsrung 1yid du 'ong ba/ nor bu mthing shun rang bzhin can shin tu mtho ba/dngul dang byi ru dang gser las byas pa'i rtse mo gsum gyis nye bar mdzes pa'i gzugs can dri za'i rgyal po rnams rked pa'i cha sna tshogs la sna tshogs rgyan ldan 4/byed1039

dang / sna tshogs mthu ldan la sogs pa dri za'i rgyal pos rnam par brgyan pa'i ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang rnam par bsgoms la de'i steng du sngar bshad pa'i dri za'i bdag po lus rdzas dri zhim po dag gis nye bar byugs pa dri zhim po'i tshogs kyis phyogs bcur gtogs pa'i khong gang bar byas la/ lus lha'i me tog sna tshogs kyi 1phreng bas rnam par brgyan pa/ dri za'i bu mo nu ma'i ljid kyis dbyibs dgu pa la 'khyud pa las byung ba'i dga' ba dang ldan pa/ sa 'dzin pa la sogs pa klu'i bye brag glu yongs su len pa'i sgra snyan pas gog ma khyab pa dag rnam par bsgoms te dkyil 'khor gyi 'gram du gtor ma'i snod chu dri zhim po dang /zho dang / 'bras yos dang / sman thams cad dang / nyungs kar dang /tsan+dan dkar po dang / tsan+dan dmar po dang / gla rtsi dang 4/ gur kum dang / spang spos dang / dwa tshwa dang / a ka ru la sogs pa'i dri zhim po rnams kyis yongs su bkang la/ snod gzhan yang zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang /mar sar dang / sha kha ra dang / kha dha dang /5 bu ram dang / 'bras chan 6dag gis gang bar bya ste/ de rnams bod 7pa'i don du sngags 'di gsum brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ gan+dharba sarba a bye pa ta ye/ bi tsi tra aṅga dha dha ye/ ma ma ka t+ya sidhe ye/ i hā a yan+tu / sa sa ma yo pa la yan+tu/ bha ga bān 9 badz+ra dha ra shā sa ne+e tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ a tra san+ni hi ta bha ban+tu swā hā/ dri rdo rje ma'i phyag rgyas gtor ma'i snod yongs su rgyas btab ste sngags brjod par byazho /oṃ swa bhā ba shudhaḥ sarba dha drwaḥswa bhā ba shusgolha4haṃ/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma t+t+waṃ ār+ya sanube+en+da tāta glu.oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas gtor ma'i snod ri'i rtsa ru dor bar bya'o/ /khyod kyis zhes bya ba la sogs pas btang ste rnal 'byor pas gnas 47byed/0 /0
