ya / oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re swā hā/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi 1puju dhū pa ba bo i mo sarba u pa tsa ra saṃ parja/ kha ghā bye pa te/ kha kha khā hi khā hi sa ma ya ma nu sma ra āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod la/ snying gar pad+ma bskor ba la lan lnga byas te/rdo rje dang dril bu dkrol ba sngon du 'go ba can kyi snying po 'jug pa'i phyag rgya bcings la/ rta'i rgyal bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gtor ma dor ba bya ste/pad+ma'i mtsho 'gram mam/ rdzing chen po'i 'gram du gtor ma dor bar bya'o/ /de nas langs te/ oṃ bhak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i yi ge lnga'i sngags kyis lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams byin gyis brlabs la/ lag pa'i dbus su dbyangs drug pa rnam par bkod de/ de yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par bsgoms la/ de'i steng du ba'i 'o ma ltar mdog dkar po dang ldan pa'i yi ge haṃ rnam par bkod de/ lag pa des chu la mngon par bsngags la/ ku ru kupre'i sngags kyis gang gi kha ru chu blugs pa de skad cig de 4nyid la dug skyug 5par 'gyur ro/ /brtan pa'am ni g.yo ba'am/ /bcos pa yi ni dug kyang rung //mche ba'i dug gam dran pa'i dug /reg dang mthong ba'i dug la sogs/ /sbrul dag 6gis ni zos pa yi/ /dug ni skad cig de la 'joms/ /tha na drag po'i mgrin gnas pa'ang / /ma lus par ni 'joms byed na/ /kā 7la ku ṭa'ang 'joms pa ni/ /'gyur ba ru ni the tshom med/ /de bas mkha' lding mchod pa'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor pas 8ni gtor ma'i las/ /gzhan la phan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /brtson pa yis ni kun du bya/ /bza' btung khyad par can sogs dang / /gos dang rgyan dang byug pa yis/ /sems can khams ni ma lus pa/ /rab gsol 9las byung bsod nams gang / /bsod 7nams de ni 41byed/0/8

sems can gcig1/ srog ni yongs su bsrungs las byung / /de bas dug ni gzhom pa'i phyir/ /mkha' lding bdag po'i gtor mar 'dod/ /de ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las/ /bdag gis gtor ma'i cho ga gsal bar btus/ /mkhas pas sems can la ni phan gdags phyir/ /'bad pa yis ni rtag pa nyid du bya/ /dpal rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod kyi nang nas btus pa'i mkha' lding gi gtor ma'i cho ga'o// //ro langs gtor ma bsgrub pa ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud las gsungs/ /cho ga yis ni rim bzhin du/ /gsal bar de nas yang dag bshad/ /gtor ma'i las ni thams cad la/ /bsgoms 4pa'i stobs kyis 'byung po rnams/ /bskyed nas mgu bar bya zhes grags/ /rnal 'byor pas 'dir de bzhin min/ /dang por ro langs dag gi tshogs/ /sngags kyi mthu yis bslangs nas ni/ /de nas 'das sogs kun dris nas/ /snying 5rje chen pos gtor ma sbyin/ /re zhig dang por shin tu 'jigs/ /dur khrod ro yis 'jigs byed par/ /song nas dogs med sems kyis ni/ /mtshan mo ro ni btsal bar bya/ /rgyal pos nyes pa la brten nas/ /sgegs 6par gyur pa gang yin dang / /bsal shing la bskyon 7yan lag ni/ /ma nyams ro chen btsal bar bya/ /'khyud pa dang ni 'o byas te/ /de bzhin dpyang thag bya ba yis/ /dgyes gang bcom ldan 'das kyis ni/ /'di gsungs mā ma tī la gsungs/ /ro langs chen po bsgrub pa ni//de nas yang dag rab bshad bya/ /mar ngo'i brgyad dam bcu bzhi la/ /mtshan ma gcig gam bzhi mdo'am/ /shing gcig gam ni dur khrod dam/ /chu yi 47byed10 9

'gram dang ri bo ru/ /bya ba dag ni thams cad bsgrub/ /de bzhin ro langs bslang ba na/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /'gegs shesnanas shi ba gang yin pa/ /gdol pa'am ni g.yu mo'ang rung / /sdug cing mdzes la rma med pa/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis so dang ldan/ /lo ni nyi shu rtsa lnga lon/ /yang na btsa' ba'i dus su ni/ /shi ba'i bud med bslang bar bya/ /sngags dang sman —dang ldan pa yi/ /chu mdog dag gis khrus bya zhing / /tsan+dan dkar po gla rtsi yis / /de la rnam par byug par bya/ /spos dang me tog dag gis mchod/ /gtor ma sna tshogs sbyin par bya/ /til mar chen pos byugs nas ni/ /nyungs kar gyis ni gdong la rdeg4 /sgrub pa pos ni te ru ka /zhes bya'i 5dkyil 'khor de bri bya/ /zla ba phyed pa thod mtshungs pa/ /gzhu bdungs 6 pa yi rnam pa can/ /rig ma brgyad dang yang dag ldan/ /thod pa rnams kyis nye bar mdzes/ /gzhi ni thod pa dag yin te/ /thams cad kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ /spyan gsum drag po'i gzugs can te/ /spyan drug ral gri phyag bsnams pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'di yi phyi rol du/ /sgo srung 7dag ni rab tu brtag /ba lang sna dang glang po'i sna/ /bzhin bzangs de bzhin bzhin ngan pa/ /drag po'i zhags pa lcags kyu thogs/ /mi sdug rnam gcigs 'jigs rung ba/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa/ /spos dang me tog la sogs bri/ /rol cha rnam pa sna tshogs mchog /dkyil 'khor du ni rim bzhin bri/ /de nas dpa' bo sgrub pa po/ /te ru ka yi gzugs 'dzin pa/ /dung chen dag gis rnam par brgyan/ /kha na sha chen za byed pa/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /shin tu rnam gcigs 'jigs rung bas/ /de ru cang te'u brdung bya zhing / /gar kyis grong 47—10pya0

khyer 'jug par bya/ /lus la sngags kyis go bgos pas/ /der ni yi ge phaṭa brjod bya/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni sngar bzhin du/ /khrag chen po yis bsang gtor bya/ /he ru ka yi sngags chen po/ /sgrub pa pos ni bzlas par bya/ /khro bo bcas nas ro langs ni/ /'brug gi sgra ni sgrogs par 'gyur/ /sngags pas 'jigs par mi bya 17zhing / /he ru ka ni rjes dran bya/ /te ru ka ni 'jigs rung bshad/ /tshangs pa'i yul sa ze za byed brtson/ /drag po chen po lcags bskyod pa/ /'gro ba kun du sdud pa po/ /ha ha zhes ni sgrogs bshad pa/ /'jigs byed ji bzhin 'jigs rung ba/ /rgya mtsho'i gling gi me ltar 'bar/ /nyi ma bcu gnyis dang mtshungs 'od/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug gzugs can dpa'aka/khams gsum dag ni g.yo mdzad pa/ /sgom pa'i bdag ldan de yi 5gzugs/ /sgrub pa pos ni dbang po bsam/ /langs par gyur nas ro langs de6/ /sgrub pa po la 'di skad smra )/ /dpal chen bdag gis ci zhig bgyi/ /rdo rje can mchog bka' sprul cig /ral gri 9mig sman sa 'og dang / /mkha' spyod phan par bya ba dag /ji ltar bsgrub par 'dod bzhin bu 1/ /las de rab tu sgrub par byed/ /yid la 'dod pa'i las gang yin/ /sgrub pa pos ni de la brjod/ /de dag thams cad sgrub par byed/ /pad+ma rgya chen mā ma tī/ /de nas de yi kha las ni/ /'das dang ma 'ongs sogs zhes bya/ /rgyal po la sogs tshe tshad dang / /bdag nyid kyi yang de las yin/ /sha chen rgun chang zang zing dang / /skye ba bdun pa las byung ba/ /sha ni chen po dag gis kyang / /de nas de la gtor ma sbyin/ /yang na lus ni ma nyams pas/ /gzhon nu'i gzugs can yon tan ldan/ /ba lang mkha na ma tho med/ /rnyed nas gtor ma'i snod du 41—/051

gzhug /bdud rtsi dag gis kha bkang nas/ /he ru ka yi gzugs 'dzin cing / /sngags pa phyag rgya lnga 'chang ba/ /rdo rje dril bu snyems bcas pas/ /bshang gci khrag ldan bud med gos/ /bdud rtsi gu gul kyis thod par/ /ro bsregs me la spos gtul 1te/ /sgra yi mchod pa phyir ldan zhing / /de byas sor gdub dang ldan pas/ /'be+ebs par byed pa'i mchog 'gyur te/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ jur bhu ba swaḥri/ shrī he ru ka khā 5ya bid ma he/bit+yā 6rā dza yā bye ma he swā hā/ zhes bya 7de yis phab nas ni/ /mkha' spyod phyag rgya bcings nas su/ /blo gos chen pos ro langs la/ /lag pa gnyis su gtor ma sbyin/ /'di yi sngags ni 'di yin te/ /hūṃ badz+ra ka ra mu kha 1snaya na maḥshrī badz+ra rā ga sa ma yā na maḥkha ṭ+wāṃ ga badz+ra pra dza la ya ya na maḥshrī badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa tsa la yā ya na maḥ lag pa g.yas dang g.yon dag gis/ /sgeg bcas rtsed mo'i gar dag gis/ /bskal bzang rdo rje ha har bshad / gtor ma'i mumachod pa sbyin par bya/ /de ni rnal 'byor gyis bteg ste/ /che mchog las byung mchog 'dzin pas / /dpral ba ru ni bskor byas te/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu gzung bar bya / /de nas gar byed phab byas nas/ /lha mo'i rnal 'byor gyis glu dag /blang zhing phyag rgya brgyad kyis ni/ /de nyid gsang ba la sbyar bya/ /de ltar thams cad byas nas ni/ /gtor ma'i cho ga rab rdzogs nas/ /de nas ro langs de yid ni / /mgu bar rtogs nas gus bcas pas/ /de la rnal 'byor bde mchog gis / /tshig ni 'di skad brjod par bya/ /khyod kyi mgul nas zhags pa gang / /de ni grogs mchog nga la byin/ /kha nas byung bar gyur pa yin/ /pe ne+e 'di ni nga la byin/ /de nas zhags pa pe be+e dag /de yis de la ster bar 'gyur/ /7(7—10pya2

de dag blangs nas rnal 'byor pa'i/ /rmad chen las ni byed par 'gyur/ /zhags pa'i thal ba blangs nas ni/ /chu grang lhan cig 'thung byed gang / /brjed byed 'jigs pa chen po las/ /de ni skad cig gis grol 'gyur/ /gtsang 1ba'i don du gang zhig la/ /sngags pa gang gis pe ne+e byin/ /de ni lag tu be+er ldog par/ /'gyur ba ru ni the tshom rnged/ /de nas btang bar byas nas ni/ /rnal 'byor rang gi gnas 'gro bya/ /smon lam btab ste dge ba nyid/ /yongs su bsngos te bde bar gnas/ /de ni rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud las btus pa'i ro langs kyi 2gtor ma'i cho ga'o// //dpal ldan gdan bzhi'i rgyud gsungs pa'i/ /cho gas rgyas pa'i las la ni//chu yi las bya gtor ma'i las/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /ngo mtshar gyur pa'i lha thos te/ /chu yi sbyin sreg ji lta bu/ /de nyid chu yi sbyin sreg gi/ /mtshan nyid ji ltar shes par gyis / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa/ /chu sogs mtshan nyid yang dag pa/ /rdo rje de nyid yang dag byin/ /bla re dag ni rnam par bres/ /sna tshogs 4gos ni rab tu 'phyang 5/ /dri dag gis ni kun du byugs/ /gru bzhi shin tu rgya che ba/ /dbus su snod ni dkar po gzhag6 /rjas ni dkar pos byug 7par bya/ /chu ni 'o ma dang bsres shing / /gtsang ma'i chu yis yongs gang ba/ /dri yi chu yis kun du gang / /lcug ma dag gis brgyan gyur pa/ /bum pa brgyad po dag kyang ni/ /phyogs brgyad du ni gzhag 9par bya/ /skad byug rnam pas bskyed pa yi / /ye shes mkha' 'gro bdag nyid la / /spos dang me tog dri sogs kyis/ /bdag gi 1dngos po mchod par bya/ /47—/053

de nas phyi rol gnas su ni/ /chu yi las rnams bya ba yin/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /pad+ma'i rnam par gzung 1bar bya/ /oṃ ka ma la ye swā hā/ /pad+ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /chu'i dbus su pad+ma ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor brgyan pa dgod/ /gdugs ni dkar pos 3g.yogs pa yi/ /sa bon dbus su bsgom par bya/ /rang gi dbugs las byung gyur pa/ /sa bon gyis ni gzugs bskyed bya/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung bcas/ /rgyan ni thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ /phyag na rdo rje dbyug pa bsnams/ /sku mdog dkar por rab tu grags/ /bzhad jicing khro bo sgeg ldan pa/ /rab tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /dam tshig phyag rgya bstan bya zhing / /dam tshig sngags ni brjod par bya/ /lag gnyis phan tshun khu tshur bcas/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni rab brkyang zhing / /bkug cing mdud pa byas pa ni/ /dam tshig phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ /oṃ sa ma ye tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ dam tshig sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /shar gyi bum par nor bu bzang / /lho ru gang ba bzang po ste/ /nor sbyin nub kyi bum par ro/ /de bzhin byang du rnam thos sras/ /rna cha bzang po dbang ldan du/ /rtse ldan zhes bya me phyogs su/ /bden bral phyogs su phreng ldan nyid/ /mu cor smra ba rlung phyogs su/ /yang dang yang du mngon bsngags nas/ /dze+e bha la ni dbus su dgod/ /de ni bum pa dgod pa'o/ /nor 'dod pa yi rnal 'byor pas/ /de nas lag pa la dgod bya/ /lag pa dri yis byugs 5pa la/ /nor bu bzang sogs yang dag dgod/ /nor bu bzang po mdzub mo la/ /gang ba bzang po gung mo la/ /nor sbyin gnod sbyin srin lag la/ /rnam thos sras ni mje'u chung la/ /mje bong la ni rna cha bzang / /mkhrig 6mar rtse ldan phreng 41—10pya4

can dag /lag pa yi ni lag ngar la/ /kun du mu cor smra dbang phyug /yang dang yang du mngon bsngags te/ /dze+e bha la ni dbus su dgod/ /oṃ rdzu sum̐ hūṃ sa zhes bya ba'i sa bon rnams gung mo nas brtsams te mthe bong la thug pa la dgod par bya'o/ /de nas so so'i phyag mtshan ni/ /dam tshig phyag rgya bzhin du bstan/ /spos dang me tog la sogs dris/ /mkhas pa yis ni mchod par bya//rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /g.yon pa snying gar gzhag bya zhing / /g.yas pa gong du gzhag 7bya ba/ /rtsa yi phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ /oṃ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ /oṃ dzi hūṃ swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /me tog dkar po kun+da sogs / / drur ba mdun — du dbul bar bya/ /khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad pa ni//mkhas pas mgo bo'i steng du blugs/ /khyor 4ba re re zhing ni blugs/ /lan gcig 5brjod nas dbul bar bya/ /khri phrag gcig gis de yi las6 thams cad dag ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /me tog ka ra bī 7ra sogs/ /me tog kha dog dkar po'ang 8rung / /khyor ba khri phrag gcig phul na/ /khyim ni zhi bar byas par 'gyur/ / yam shing 9nā ga pube+e dag /'o ma dang bsres dbul bya zhing / /khyor ba khri phrag gcig phul na/ /de bzhin grong ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /las rnams kun la sbyar bya zhing / /pad+ma rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /khri phrag phul ba tsam gyis ni/ /yul ni zhi bar byas par 'gyur/ /pri yang ku dang bil ba dang / /ut+pa la dang ku mu da/ /rgyal po'i skyon la sbyar byas na/ /pha rol yul 'khor 'jig par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nang par brgya rtsa brgyad/ /chu la gtor ma spyin byed pa/ /sngags pa de la yid 'ong ba'i/ /nor dag rgyas par gyur pa yin/ /de nas snga ma bzhin du gser la sogs pa las byas pa'i snod dgu chu dri zhim pos 41byed/035

gang bar byas te de'i nang du 'bru dang rin po che dang sman dang de bzhin du ba'i 'o ma bcug la/ mo tog dang spos la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnam pa lngas yang dag pa )mchod de/ sngar bshad pa'i phyag rgyas kyang mngon par rgyas btab nas dril bu dkrol ba sngon du 'gro bas sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ dze+e bha la dza len+d+ra ya swā hā/ ji srid oṃ mu khe shwa rā ya swā hā zhes bya ba la thug pa'i sngags dgu brjod la spyan drang ste/ de rnams mngon sum du gyur par bltas la gtor ma sbyin pa'i phyir yang sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te rdza bha la dza lebye ya ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ i oṃ ba bo pra ṭīts+tsha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūṃ badz+ra dze+e phaṭa swā hā/ ma ma hi ra ju 4su bar+ṇa ma ṇi muk+ta rat+na he ma 5ni dha ni de hi māṃ6/dzi gh+ran+tu/ pi ban+tu kha dan+tu/ ma ma shādhi puje 7ku ru badz+ra dha ri ka ba bo pra tīts+tsha sa ma ya ma nu smar dze+e dze+e dze+e hūṃ rdzu dzi dza phaṭa swā hā zhes bya ba brjod la/ drag tu 'brub pa'i chu bo la gtor ma'i snod dgu po dag dor bar bya'o/ / de nas khyod kyis zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pas gshegs su gsol lo/ /de ni gdan bzhi pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i man ngag gi rim pa'i chu'i sbyin sreg gi chu'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ / de nas gtor ma bsgrub pa dang / /de'i bdag rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / /bu ste rnam thos sras kyi ni/ /de bas gzhan yang rab bshad bya/ /re zhig dang por rang gi khyem mam/ lha khang ngam mchod rten gyi gnas sam lha'i khang pa'am/gang yang rung bar gnas pas nyin zhag rtag tu bya ba'i rim pas gtor ma'ang bya'o / /bza' bar bya ba'i dang por yi ge dang po yongs su gyur pa las 77———/056

gnod sbyin ma chen mo 1'phrog ma gdong gcig pa lag pa gnyis pa kha'i nang mche ba gcigs pas 'jigs su rung ba kha na lce 'dril ba/ rkang pa'i cha mi'i pags pas g.yogs pa/ lag pa g.yon pas mi'i mgo bo bzung ba g.yas na ngo mtshar gyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa/ gar gyi 'gying tshul byas pa sna tshogs mdog can rnam par bsgoms la/ de bzhin du de'i bdag po rdo rje gnod sbyin de kho na bzhin du byung ba ste/ 'on kyang gcer bu skra bshig pa rnam par bsgoms te/de bzhin du de'i bu rnam thos sras yi ge dang po las byung ba mdog dmar po lag pa gnyis pa gdong gcig pa mche ba cung zad 4gcigs pa'i gdong can seng ge la zhon pa g.yon seng ge'i rgyal mtshan thogs pa/ g.yas na rin po che'i gter thogs pa/ dung gi gter dang / pad+ma'i gter gnyis 5sgeg pa dang bcas pa'i lag pa spyogayon dang g.yas pa na thogs pa'i rnga yab dkar po g.yob 7par yang rnam par bsgoms la/ de nas de rnams bod pa'i phyir ut+pa la'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /'dir sngags ni oṃ e bye hi ri te yā pa shu pu tra sha ta pa ri bā re badz+ra yak+ṣa pri ye asmin san+ni hi to bha ba swā hā/ bod pa'i sngags so/ /de nas zas kyi snod nas 'bras chan gyi 9chang bu gsum byas te sa la gzhag par bya'o / /chang dang sha la sogs pa ji ltar rnyed par cung zad tsam byin la sngags brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ ha ri tre+e ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye ha ra ha ra/ sarba pā 1 paṃ ni k+ṣiṃ sarba yak+ṣa ni pra be+e sha ta pa ri bā ra i mo ba lo kṛt+na kṛt+na hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa ru dra phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ be+e shra ba shā ya —swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la chu'i snod du bcug ste dbe+en par gzhag par bya'o/ /de ni rtag par bya ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /(7—/057

mkha' 1spyod gtor ma'i rim pa ni/ /cho ga rab gsal la brten nas/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud rjes 'brangs nas/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad bya/ /gtor ma'i las la bya rnams las/ /bya rog gi ni rigs rnams bsngags/ /'di ltar de dag mkhas rnams kyis/ /gtor zan nyid du bshad pa yin/ /sngags pas bza' ba'i sngon rol du/ /dur khrod chen por song nas ni/ /bya rog lha yi bdag nyid can/ /tshim phyir de ru gtor ma bya/ /mngon brjod bla ma'i rim pa bzhin/ /de ru dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /ge sar lte ba dang ldan pa'i/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bsam/ /de yi dbus su lha mo dgod/ /drag po'i gzugs can mdangs can ma/ /zhal gcig phyag ni bzhi pa ste/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 2ga yis brgyan/ /phyag na gri gug mgo bsnams nyid/ /lte ba'i dbus su bsgom par bya/ /spyan gsum smin ma kham ldan pa/ /rol pa'i 'dug stangs gar dang ldan/ /sgeg pa la sogs ro ldan pa/ /gar kyi sbyor ldan bsgom par bya/ /khro bo'i rgyal po stobs chen rnams/ /phyag rnams kun na tho sogs bsnams/ /mi sdug drag po 'jigs rung ba/ /'dab ma brgyad la rnam dgod bya/ /de nas rang rang sngags rnams dang / /spro dang sdud pa byed pa yin / /mkha' 4spyod phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /de nas kun du spyan drang bya/ /spos dang me tog mar me dang / /dri dang lha bshos lnga rnams dang / /mchod yon zhabs bsil rim gyis ni/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni mchod par bya/ /khwa yi gdong can mkha' 'gro mar/ /bdag nyid kyang ni bsam par bya/ /ji ltar dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bzhin/ /'khor rnams brgyad po bsam par bya/ /de 17—/058

nas shing rtse la gnas pa'i/ /bya rog tshogs rnams gus bcas pas/ /khwa 1 gdong cha byad gzugs can dag /rim pa la ni brten nas bsgom/ /de nas de yi sngags kyis ni/ /de rnams kyang ni spyan drang bya/ /rnal 'byor pas ni spyan drangs nas/ /de rnams la ni gtor ma dbul/ /zho dang 'bras chan yid 'ong bas/ /snod ni rab tu gang byas nas/ /blo ldan gyis ni chang bu ri dgus/ /gnyis pa yang ni dgang bar bya/ /mchod yon me tog sogs rnams kyis/ /sngar bzhin snod gnyis mchod par bya/ /de nas rnal 'byor mnyam gzhag pa/ /khā yi gdong can gzugs 'dzin cing / /dpa' bo'i sems ldan brtse 4bdag gis / /gtor ma'i sngags ni brjod par bya/ /de nas thugs kyi 'khor lo gnas—/ /mkha' 1spyod ma yi tshogs ji snyed/ /'ol ba bya rog gzugs nyid du/ /de dag thams cad der 'ong 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams gnas pa'i / /mkha' spyod dag ni ci 'dra dang / /ji snyed yod pa de dag kun/ /bya rog rnam par de gnas 'gyur/ /oṃ na maḥ6shrī badz+ra ḍā kā ya oṃ kā kā gye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa / de yis rab tu gang ba'i snod/ /snying gar rab tu bskor byas nas/ /de nas mdun sbyin rnam 7'byor pas/ /de ru mtshan ma brtag par bya/ /des ni sa rab g.yo bar gyur8/ /phyogs rnams las ni 'brug sgra 'byung / /gla rtsi mtsho skyes dag gi ( ni/ /dri bsung yid du 'ong ba'ang 'byung / /de yis be+er yang tshim bya zhing / /se gol bcu po dag gis ni/ /phyogs 7bcu bcings pa sngon 'gro bas/ /sdom brtson gyis ni sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki n+ya khe tsa ri ru ka kā pa su tsi la la ga ru ḍa i me ba bo kṛ k+ṇi tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ya dze+eṣ+ṭi 1rtasarba sedhi pra yats+tshan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas shing gcig drung du ni/ /gtor 47byed/059

ma chen po der dor nas/ /sngar bzhin gshegs su gsol byas te/ /bstod pa'i tshigs bcad 'di rnams brjod/ /kun du rtog pa'i 'ching ba bcad/ /'jig rten bya ba grub byed pa'i/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /de snyed rnams la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los snasgyur/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan pa/ /'gro ba skyob mdzad dpal ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ni mkha' spyod ma'i gzugs can gyi bya rog gi gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /gang gis sa spyod tshogs dag ni/ /mchog tu tshim par 'gyur ba yi/ /phyi'i gtor ma'i rim pa ni/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad bya/ /dgon pa chen po'i rnal 'byor ches/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bsam par bya/ /sngar bzhin 'dab brgyad dag gis ni/ /yongs su mdzes byas pad+ma ni/ /de dbus lha mo khye gdong can/ /snga ma bzhin du bsams nas ni/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdag nyid kyang / /de bzhin kho nar rnam par bsam/ /de nas mchod pa rnam lnga yang / /cho ga ji bzhin mchod byas nas/ /'bras chan sha dang khrag rnams kyis/ /gtor ma'i snod ni rab dgang bya/ /gtor snod yang dag mchod byas nas/ /phyogs bcing bar ni rab byas nas/ /phyag rgya bcings te bzlas byas la/ /de yis spyan drang nyid kyang bya/ /oṃ ā 4yan+t+ra yan+tu ḍā kin+ya sha na wa gā 5tra ma ho gra dz+nyā 6ma wa pu ṣa i saṃ ba bo bhuñja/ dzi gh+ra 7tha/ pi pa tha/grit+na two/ asmakai/ puṣ+ṭi/ ku ru sa ma ya ma nu sma ra ā ཿhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/sngags 'di yis ni spyan drangs pas / /phyogs bcu nas ni khye'i gzugs can/ /(7——/060

khye gdong sa spyod 'khor lo dang / /gtor ma bza' phyir mdun 'ong 'gyur/ /de rnams tshim par byas nas ni/ /smon lam btab nas gshegs gsol te/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag sgrub pa po1/ /ci 'dod gzugs kyis gnas par bya/ /yang na cho ga gzhan gyis ni/ /ji ltar 'jig rten thams cad la/ /'bras bu bde 'gro ster 'gyur ba/ /khyi rnams la ni gtor ma sbyin/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i don sgrub phyir/ /'pho zhag gnyis la brten nas ni/ /bza' ba'i sngon du gus bcas pas/ /khyi rnams la ni gtor ma sbyin/ /phyi dro khang pa'i sgo khang du / /tshon rtsi dkar pos dkyil 'khor ni/ /gru bzhi shin tu mdzes gyur pa4//ri mo brgyad par rab tu bya/ /kham phor 'bras chan dag dang gzhan/ /tshod ma yid 'ong de bzhin du/ /lha yi yo byad rnams kyis bkang / /sa las byas pa der gzhag 5bya/ /gnyis pa chang gis kun du dgang / /snod ni de yi 'gram du gzhag /gsum pa spos dang me tog sogs/ /snod ni g.yas kyi 'gram du'o/ /de nas khyi ni bos nas su/ /dkyil 'khor mdun du gzhag 7par bya /khyi gdong rtsa ba'i sngags kyis ni/ /de la bsang gtor kun du bya/ /de la me tog sngags sogs kyis/ /go rims bzhin du mchod par bya/ /de nas sngags ni 'di dag gis/ /gtor ma mdun du sbyin par bya/ /oṃ shwa na gye bhurtsa ri ye i me ba lo kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ji /srid mdun du khyi gtor za/ /de nas bzlas pa rab tu bya/ /zos 7pa yi ni tha ma ru/ /sngar bzhin rab tu gtang rta bar bya/ /gtor ma 'di ni nyin re bzhin/ /gal te sngags pas byas na ni/ / blo ldan de yi las rnams ni/ / thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba yin/ /tshogs pa med na sngar bshad pa'i/ /rim pa nyid la brtan par bya/ /yang na zla ba re re (7byed/06/

zhing / /yar gyi ngo yi bcu gnyis la/ /de ni sa spyod ma'i gzugs can gyi khyi'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /gang gis sa ni gser byugs kyepa/ /rnal 'byor pas ni 'grub 'gyur ba/ /sa 'og gnas pa'i gtor ma'i las/ /de nas nga yis bshad 5par bya/ /bsod nams 'bras chen thob bya'i phyir/ /nyin re zhing ngam bco lnga'am/ /bcu gnyis bar gyis gtor ma'i las/ /'di ni rnal 'byor dbang pos 4bya/ /chu bo'am rgya mtsho'i chu 'gram du/ /sa 'og gnas pa'i sems can rnams/ /tshim par bya phyir rdul tshon gyizhi/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni chen po bya/ /go rī 6nag mo phyag gnyis ma7/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /nya dang gri gug bsnams pa mchog /nya yi gdan can nya gsol ba/ /nya yi rgyan dag gis brgyan pa/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su dgod par bya/ /'dab ma gzhan la snga ma bzhin / /gar gyi 'gying tshul la brtson pa/ /ha ha hi hi zhes sgrogs 'jigs//khro bo'i gzugs dag rnam par dgod/ /de nas dkyil 'khor de nyid ni / /spos dang me tog lha bshos sogs/ /dri yis cho ga bzhin mchod nas/ /gtor ma'i las ni yang dag bya/ /go rī'i gzugs 'dzin rnal 'byor pa/ /sems dpa' gsum dag sgu 'dzin pas/ /skad cig gis ni sngar brjod nas/ /cig 9 car du ni phyogs bcing bya/ /skad cig tu ni bsgom par bya/ /de ni dbang rnon rim pa'o/ /de nas yi ge tha las byung / /nya rnams khyab 'jug gzugs can du/ /rnam par bsams nas sgrub pa pos/ /de rnams sngags kyis bod par bya/ /oṃ e bye hi ma hā ba la bir+ya rapa ra kra ma/ ma hā yo dza na sa hā sra pra tsho17—/062

lo ba wa pu ṣā 3/ ti li ti mi gi li/ ma hā ti mi gi li pra bhi ta yo ma hā ma ṇi — a bye pa ta ye/ a tra san ni hi to bha babye/ ma ma a bhi pre tārba sirnyi ma bi ta ran+tu swā hā/ de nas de rnams bod byas nas/ /kha ra khaṇ+ḍa ④'bras chan phye/ /la du glo kha sa sogs kyis/ /gtor ma'i snod ni rab tu dgang / /chu ni gtsang ma dri zhim pa tre/ /srog chags dag ni rnam spangs pa/ /khyab 'jug gis ni chang bsrung khyephyir/ /chang ma gtogs pa sbyin par bya/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil mchod nang du/ /byin nas me tog la sogs gzhug /byin nas sngags ni 'di nyid kyis/ /gtor ma'i snod ni dor bar bya/ /oṃ a ā i yī u spru/ ṛ dzā lo shā e be+e o oṃ e aḥswā hā/ de nas de dag sngar bzhin du/ /myur du btang ba byas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor gyi rgo rdul tshon de/ /dogs pa med par dor bar bya/ /de ltar byas nas sa 'og na/ /gnas pa rnams ni mgu bar 'gyur/ /de la mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs/ /dngos grub yid dz+wa'ong ster bar 'gyur/ /'dod chags bral ba stong phrag la/ /nyin re bza' ba mchog phul las/ /byung ba'i bsod nams gang yin de9/ /nya rnams tshim par byas las 'byung / /rang rgyal kyi ni dge 'dun la/ /bsod snyoms phul las dge gang 'byung / /nya rnams tshim par byas pa las/ /bsod nams de ni thob par 'gyur/ /de ni sa 'og na gnas pa'i gzugs can gyi nya'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o / /1 gang gi snaspyod lam rnam bzhi ru/ /rnal 'byor pa yis 'grub 'gyur ba/ /phyogs spyod gtor ma bsgrub pa ni/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad bya/ /rab tu grags pa'i bzhi mdo ru/ /rgyal po'i skyed mos tshal brten nas/ /rdul tshon 11—/063

kha dog lnga pa yis/ /de ru dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte bar bcas/ /pad+ma sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ /rnal 'byor pa yis der bri 1bya/ /dbus su thod pa bri bar bya/ /sdigs mdzub rdo rje 'gying bcas pas/ /shin tu mi bzad 'jigs mdzad pa/ /sprin ni sngon po'i mdog dang ldan/ /'bar ba sngon po rab tu khyab/ /go rī go rī'i bdag po yis/ /snying gar g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis mnan/ /lte ba'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad bsgom par bya/ /shar 'dab tshangs pa'i lha mo bsam/ /khyab 'jug gi ni lho na gnas/ /gzhon nu yi ni nub tu bsgom/ /gshin rje 4byang gi phyogs na gnas/ /srin po'i phyogs su lus ngan po/ /me yi phyogs su tsa muṇ+ḍi5//dbang ldan phyogs su dbang ldan ma/ /rlung gi lha mo rang phyogs gnas/ /zhal gcig spyan ni gsum pa ste/ /phyag gnyis gar la rab brtson pa/ /g.yas pa yi ni phyag rnams su/ /phreng ba de bzhin 'khor lo dang / /rtse gsum dbyug pa dbyug to dang / /ral gri mdung dang gos nyid de/ /phyag mtshan 'di rnams bsam par bya/ /spyi blugs dang ni pad+ma dang / /phreng ba dang ni de bzhin mgo//seng ke'i rgyal mtshan thod pa dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ngo mtshar gzhan/ /g.yon pa rnams su bsam par bya/ /dmar po ljang gu ser dang mtshungs7/ /sngon po dmar ngo/ dmar dkar 'od/ /in+d+ra byā la'i 'od ldan pa/ /mi mo mchog ni 'di rnams bsam/ /sngags dang dam tshig phyag rgya yis/ /de ru spyan ni drang bar bya/ /de nas gtor ma rgya chen po/ /sngags pas sbyin bya lung rje /bzhin/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra hūṃ ka ra/ dīḥbye sarba byu ta ni s+t+waṃ sabha ya swā hā/oṃ brah+ma ṇi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ be+eṇ+ḍa bī ye tweḥ—phaṭa/ oṃ kau mā rī ye dīḥhūṃ phaṭa/(7byed/06 /

oṃ ya mā — ye s+thāḥhūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ku bai rā ye byeḥhūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsā muṇ+ḍa 1ye s+thāḥhūṃ phaṭa/oṃ e ṣa bh+yo dhīḥhūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ba ya bye tweḥhūṃ phaṭa/ lag pa gnyis ni brkyang nas su / /gung mo'i rtsa bar mthe bong dag /thal sbyar tshig 'don sbyor ba ni/ /tshangs pa'i phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /mdzub mo rna cha'i dbyibs byas pa/ /khyab 'jug lha mo'i phyag rgya yin/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur gzhon nu ma'i/ /khu tshur gnyis ni gshin rje ma'i/ /gnyis kyis mchog sbyin nor sbyin ma'i/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcings byas nas/ /mdzub gnyis bsgreng ba tsā muṇ+ḍi'i / /mthe'u chung mthe bong dag bkug nas/ /gzhan dag bsgreng ba dbang ldan ma'i/ /gos kyi rol pas lag pa gnyis/ /spyi bo ru ni gzhag par bya/ /phyag rgya 'di ni rlung gi ste/ /de ni phyag rgya'i tshogs rim pa / /de nas snod ni gang ba dgu/ /khyad par du ni bdud rtsi ldan/ /snga ma bzhin du gzhag par bya/ /ba lang khyim bya las byung dang / /bong mi rus sbal rnga mo dang / /khyi dang ce spyang rta las byung / /sha rnams kyis ni go rims bzhin//rnal 'byor pa yis dgang bar bya/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /spos dang me tog sogs phul nas/ /sngar bshad sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /de rnams lam gyi bzhi mdor dor/ /ma mo rnams ni rang gnas su/ /de nas gshegs su gsol byas nas/ /bsod nams bsngos te rnal 'byor pa/ /skyes mchog ji ltar 'dod gnas bya/ /'gro ba'am ni 'greng yang rung / /gnyid log pa'am sad pa'ang rung / /mi gtsang ba'am gtsang yang rung / /ma mo rnams ni bsrung bar 'gyur/ /blo mchog rnams ni zhi rgyas sogs/ /las ni cung zad gang byed pa/ /de la gtor ma dag gis ni/ /mnyes nas de yi (7—/063

grogs byed 'gyur/ /de yi bka' nod la brtson pa/ /bgegs la sogs pa 'ga' yang rung / /de rnams kyang ni de nyid la/ /srung dang skyob dang sbed par 'gyur/ /mar ngo yi ni tshes brgyad dam/ /yang na tshes ni bcu bzhi la/ /mtshan phyed la ni gtor ma bya/ /de ni dus kyi cho ga'i shārim pa'o/ /de ni phyogs na spyod pa'i sgo nas ma mo rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga'o / / rtebyas na bsod nams mtha' yas pa/ /mi zad gang du 'byung 'gyur ba/ /gang zhig thang la spyod rnams kyi/ /gtor ma gzhan yang rab bshad bya/ /thang spyod rnams kyi nang nas ni/ /ba lang mchod pa rab tu bsngags/ /skyugs ldang byed pa'i lha yin pas/ /bde mchog las ni bcom ldan gsungs/ /sgrub pa pos ni yar ngo yi/ /bcu bzhi la ni sngar langs te/ /chu bo dri med chu ldan par//song nas khrus ni kun du bya/ /mdo las gsungs pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /lus ni rab tu bkru bar bya/ /sdom brtson gyis ni gdong la sogs/ /dben par bshang gci dor byas te/ /mtshan mar bdun dang 'phongs su bdun/ /lag par sa phur bdun blugs shing / /de nas chu yis bkrus nas ni/ /de nas lan gsum 'thor 'thung bya/ /rna sogs lte ba la thug thupar/ /lan bdun nye reg byas nas ni/ /dbang bskur byas pas lan gsum du/ /chu la byi zul 5 byas nas ni/ /khyor ba dag ni brgya rtsa brgyad/ /dze+e bha la la sbyin par bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor la'ang / /chu ni snyim pa gsum dag nyid/ /re re zhing ni rang sngags kyis/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dbul bar bya/ /de nas snyim par 6gsum gyis ni/ /yi ge brgya pas tshim par bsngo7/ /yi dwags 7(1—/066

rnams la chu snyim lnga/ /'jig rten dbang po'i sngags kyis ni/ /de nas langs te ba brgyad ni/ /khyu mchog mthon po dang ldan pa/ /'khor lo'i tshul du bzhag hūṃnas ni/ /dbus su khyu mchog mthon po gzhag /de nas 2mchod yon dag gi snod/ /ba'i rnam lngas dgang bar bya/ /drur ba'i chun pos bsangs nas ni/ /mkha' 'gro 4drag mo ro langs ma/ /de bzhin gzhan yang gtum mo dang / /seng mo stag mo 'ug pa mo/ /de bzhin gzhan yang ce spyang ma'i/ /sa bon de dag la dgod bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sa bon gyis/ /dbus su khyu mchog byin rlabs 5bya/ /de la sa bon ni 'di rnams yin te/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi sa bon ni yi ge hūṃ/ drag mo'i sa bon ni yi ge hūṃ/ /ro langs ma'i sa bon ni yi ge 6yī/ gtum mo'i sa bon ni yi ge hūṃ/ seng mo'i sa bon ni yi ge hūṃ/ stag mo'i sa bon ni yi ge n+d+ra7/ 'ug pa mo'i sa bon ni yi ge sdo ce spyang ma'i sa bon ni yi ge rgyu/ sa bon brgyad po de dag dang / /dgu pa ye shes sa bon ni/ /de dag snying gar bkod nas ni/ /de nas gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /'bras chan chang bu rnams kyis kyang / /snod ni dgu dag dgang bar bya/ /'o thug lan tshwa dang ldan pa/ /de rnams kyi ni nang du gzhug 9/de rnams logs su sa la ni/ /chu ni snyim pa gsum blugs bya/ /me tog spos la sogs rnams kyis/ /mnyam par gzhag pas mchod par bya/ /bdag nyid zhi bar mthu ldan pa/ /bcom ldan sgrol ma dbang phyug ma/ /ma du lung ga rtse gsum bsnams/ /khyu mchog la ni bcings rkapar bsgom/ /de nas gsang sngags 'di yis ni/ /gang gi sems can khams rnams ni/ /bde byed rnal 'byor pas 'grub 'gyur/ /gtor ma de yi mdun du sbyin/ /oṃ a ā saṃ a kā 41—1067

ro mu khaṃ sarba dhas+thā rde ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta1/ zhes bya ba yi sngags 'di yis/ /gtor ma'i snod ni gus bcas pas/ /lan gsum byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /de nas de rnams la sbyin bya/ /ji srid 2pa la za 'gyur ba/ /bzhi pa'i mthu ldan sgol ma yi/ /de nyid gsum dang yongs spel ba'i/ /sngags 'di de srid brjod par bya/ /oṃ tā re tut+tha re tu re āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ muḥ'i mtha' can sngags kyis ni/ /de nas sngags pas gshegs gsol bya/ /gus pa yis ni bza' ba dag /dge slong dge 'dun dag phul nas/ /dge ba bsngos te bstod pa dag /brjod nas sgrol ma'i rigs dag la/ /phyag byas na 4rgo kun langs te/ /de nas ji ltar 'dod bzhin gnas/ /de ni thang la spyod pa'i gzugs can gyi ba lang rnams kyi gtor ma'o / /5gang gis 6'khor lo gsum mkha' 'gro/ /sgrub pa po la kun du srung / /gzhon nu ma yi gtor sgrub pa/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad bya/ /re zhig dang por nam mkha' nyi ma'i steng gi zla ba'i mchod rten gyi dbus su yi ge rma las yongs su sprul pa gzhon nu ma'i gzugs can/ gser btso ma lta bu nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba stong phrag 'phro ba'i me tog ban+d+ra 9dzi ba ka dang / dza ba lta bu'i gos dang ldan pa/ ang ga rag dang stod g.yogs dmar po rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ lag gdub dang / rna rgyan dang / ske rags dang /rkang gdub dang / g.yer ka rnams kyi sgra dang / sor gdub kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dag gis rnam par brgyan pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu rgyan byas pa/ mgo la mya ngan med pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan pa/ phyag brgyad 11byed/068

pa / zhal gsum pa/ spyan gsum pa phyag g.yon pa rnams na gzhu dang /shing mya ngan med pa dang / skud pa dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams na rdo rje 'bar ba dang / khab dang / lcags kyu dang / mda' gsor ba la brtson pa/ zhal dang po zhi ba pad+ma kha rab tu bye ba lta bu gser rab tu ser po'i 1me tog can/ mig rab tu yangs pa/ mchu li khri'i phye ma bzhin du dmar ba sgeg cing rol pa dang bcas pa/ zhal g.yon pa phag gi gdong can khro ba dang bcas shing rnam par gatshigs pa la/ mi sdug cing drag po 'jigs su rung ba in+d+ra — la'i mdog dang mtshungs pa mthing shun ltar snang ba/ nyi ma stong phrag bcu gnyis dang mtshungs pa'i 'od dang ldan pa/ khro gnyer gatshigs pa dang bcas pa 'jigs par mdzad pa/ zhal g.yas pa pad+ma rā ga ltar shin tu dmar ba mchog tu 'bar ba'i nyi ma stong phrag ltar rab tu gsal zhing zhi ba mchod rten gye bum pa las byung ba'i shing mya ngan med pa'i me tog gis g.yogs pa/ de'i 'og tu rnam par snang mdzad ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan cing zhi ba/ gser rab tu ser po'i mdog ltar 'bar ba/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya dang yongs su ldan par bzhugs pa/ phag pa'i gdan la g.yon brkyang ba'i gnas pas gzhon nu ma'i 5tshod du bzhugs pa/ de'i 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor la yi ge ram̐ las yongs su sprul pa'i gza' chen po sgra gcan nyin 6dang /mtshan du zla ba dang nyi ma dag za bar byed pa rnam par bsgoms la/ rang gi sngags kyis bdag nyid byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ mā rī byi swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas mdun du khye'u gcig dang bu mo brgyad bkug ste go rims bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi rim pas rnam par bzhag —la/ / 41byed/069

de dag lo ni bcu gnyis lon pa'i mig yangs rab tu mdzes rnyed nas/ /sa phyogs dben par khrus legs byas shing gos ni gar dgar gon pa yi/ /gur kum dang ni gla rtsi la sogs byugs shing spos kyis rab bdugs 1la/ /de dag thams cad de kho na bzhin nye bar byugs te bdug byas nas/ /de'i mdun sa gzhi ba yi lci bas byugs te de nyid du bzhag la/ /gu gul bdug pa rab byin gsang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas bsgrub bya yi/ /snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par bkod de de yi steng du yi ge saṃ/ /rnam par bkod pas 'od zer can gyi nga rgyal rab tu bsnyems tshul kyis/ /dril bu'i sgra dang gu gul bdugs pas skad cig de nyid la 'bab 'gyur/ /'dir ni sngags kyang 'byung ba ste/ oṃ mā rī byi ā be+e sha ya ā be+e sha ya/ kai pa ke pa/ dhu na dhu na/ kṛt+na kṛt+na / t+t+waṃ mā rī byi swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis phab ste/ de nas de rnams la me tog dang spos la sogs pas ji ltar rjes su mthun pa nyid kyi sngags rnams kyis byin la/ me tog phreng ba gtsug phud kyi nang du bcug ste mdun du bza' ba dang bca' ba dang btung ba la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i snod gzhon nu ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa rnams oṃ mā rī me+e ba ra li ba da li/bat+ta 4li bā rā hā mu khā+e 5sarba duṣ+ṭa pra duṭ+wā 6māṃ mu khaṃ brnya brnya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ i saṃ bi bo 7pra ṭīts+tsha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra āḥhūṃ swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis sbyin par bya'o / /de nas ji srid gtor ma za ba de srid du bcom ldan 'das ma'i rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /zas kyi bya ba'i mtha' mar 'gron bu dang / star ka'i 9'bras bu dang / tshon sna lnga'i sgud pa sna tshogs pa dang / rna ba dang lag pa dang / mgul rgyan 7ci 'byor pa'i yo byad byin te/ khyed kyis zhes bya 47byed/070

ba la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad kyis btang ste/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo gshegs su gsol nas 'od zer can gyi nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /de ni gzhon nu ma'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o / /1 gang gis sa gzhi ji srid par/ /mchod rten rgyal ba'i gnas srung 'gyur//nag po chen po'i gtor ma'i rim/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad bya/ /lha gang la sogs zin nas ni/ /rab gnas rgyud las gsungs pa yi/ /cho gas de rab gnas byas te/ /de nas gtor ma kun du bya/ /rgyal ba'i gnas ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ /gtsug lag khang gi sgor gnas shing / /dri gtsang khang gi nang gnas par/ /nag po che dgod rnal 'byor pas/ /sku mdog nag po zhal bzhi pa/ /lto ba chen po phyag bcu pa/ /nam mkha'i gos can stag lpags kyis/ /smad kyi cha ni rab dkris pa/ /dbu la thod pa'i phreng bar ldan/ /mche ba gcigs shing mi bzad pa/ /thod pa'i phreng ba bkod pa yis/ /mgrin pa rkang pa rnam brgyan pa/ /smin ma kham pa'i smin 'khyug 4dang / /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par spras/ /dang po'i zhal ni nag po mtshungs/ /g.yas pa sngon por snang ba ste/ /g.yon pa dmar po shin tu mdzes/ /nyi ma khri dang mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /rgyab ni dri bcas du ba'i mdog /de yi gdong ni bsam par bya/ /ral gri dang ni tho 5ba dang / /rtse gsum rgyud mangs dag gi rgyud/ /sbreng 6ba la ni brtson 'gyur ba/ /de yi g.yas kyi phyag tu bsam/ /g.yon du thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /pi wang de bzhin gar byed pa7/ /mi yi pags pa khrag 'dzag pa/ /steng gi phyag dag na bsnams shing / /g.yas brkyang 'dug stangs gar byed pa/ /77byed/07/

mnyam par gzhag 1pas bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin du ni de yi 'khor/ /mi sdug gdong can mkha' 'gro ma/ /seng ge glang po 2dred dang sbrul/ /byi la khyi yi gdong can te/ /ha ha zhes sgrogs ca co'i sgras/ /rmongs pa rnams ni skrag byed pa/ /thod pa'i nang du blugs pa'i khrag /'thung byed pa ni bsgom par bya/ /de ltar bsams nas rnal 'byor dbang / /bdag nyid ma he la zhon cing / /drag po chen po gshin rje gshed/ /gdug pa thams cad 'joms mdzad pa/ /zhal drug dang ni zhabs drug dang / /phyag drug nyid kyis rnam brgyan — pa/ /lha dang lha min za byed pa/ /g.yas pa'i phyag rnams na tho ba/ /ral gri lcags kyu bsnams sdigs mdzub/ /zhags pa dang ni dril bu yis/ /g.yon pa rnams ni mdzes byas pa/ /g.yas brkyang ba dang g.yon brkyang dang / /de bzhin mnyam pa'i 'dug stangs kyis/ /lha yi tshogs rnams 4drug po yi5/ /stobs ni kun du mnan nas bzhugs/ /snying ga'i yi ge hūṃ las byung / /'od zer 'khor lo 'bar ba las/ /khro bo'i sprin gyi tshogs dag ni/ /cha byad mtshungs pa'i tshogs rnams spro/ /in+d+ra dī la ltar snang bsam/ /de 'dra'i gzugs su gnas nas ni/ /nag po chen po snying 'gas par/ /brtson par gyur pa'i sngags 'di yang / /khro bo'i tshig gis 6brjod par bya/ /oṃ dhīḥ ṣ+ṭṛḥbi kṛ 7tā na na sarba sha hūṃ nā sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de'i rjes la 8'di skad du bka' bsgo bar bya'o/ /sngar bshad pa'i sngags nyid kyis bkug ste bcings/ de dbang du byas nas gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor nyid kyis bka' bsgo bar bya ste/ kye nag po chen po gtsug / lag khang 'di ji srid gnas pa de srid du khyod kyis bsrung bar bya zhing 'khor dang bcas pa khyod kyis 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi bka' yang mnyan par 47—/072

bya'o / /de'i rjes la rnal 'byor pa de nyid kyis yongs su mnyes par bya ba'i phyir de la gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /zangs la sogs pa las byas pa'i snod tshad chen po dang ldan pa tsan+dan dmar po las byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bzhag ste / thug pa nag po dang / glo ba dang / 'o thug dang / rlon pa dang /btsos pa dang / bsregs pa'i dbye bas nya'i sha rnam pa gsum dang / khrag dang / zhag dang / klad pa dang / tshil rnams dang / rgun chang dang /'bru'i chang dang / nya'i gzugs brnyan dang / 'greng shābu'i chun po dang /sgog pa'i bye brag bdun dang / snum khur dang / nas dang / gro la sogs pa'i bye brag gi 'bru rnams dang / zangs dang / lcags las byas pa'i khab kyi natshogs kyis yongs su bkang la/ me tog dang spos la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnam pa lngas yongs su mchod de/ gshin rje gshed kyi phyag rgyas kyang mngon par btab la phyogs bcing ba bya ste/ khros pa'i sems dang ldan zhing dril bu dang rdo rje gsor ba la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pas sngags 'dis spyan drang bar bya'o / /oṃ ma hā kā la a ya ti ma hā bi ha ra pā la nā 4ya/ sarba ḍā ki byā yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa sa pa ri wā rā na tra sin+da hi 5to bha ba swā hā/ de'i rjes la sngags 'di dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i phyag rgyas tshim par bya ba'i phyir gtor ma byin gyis brlab 6par bya'o/ /oṃ yi da sha dika rngu dh+wa 7saṃ bya ba spru tā8/ sarba da sha dika lo ka dh+wa 9tu pa ra ma rku 7pa ran+ta ra ba ti sarba ba ti ka lo ka pā la/ ma hā kā la badz+ra ā yu dha mā yā 13badz+ra/ badzā na sal/ badz+ra kā la/ badz+ra mu sa la/ nā ga badz+ra/ badzā ni la/ badz+ra shoṇ+ḍa/ badz+ra bhe ra wa/ badz+ra gro dha/ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa le / badz+ra pra bha / mo na badz+ra/ be+e ma tsi tri/ thra thi 5be+e de ba tāmi/47—/073

sarba ikyu pa sarga u pa shān+ta ye/ sarba gan+dha put+pa sgru pa/ dī pa/ ne+e bi t+ya1/sarbo pa tra a lo ka ra di nash+tsa pra tīts+tsha/ u pa pū kwa bye/ sarba ṣa rgo/ kā ya wā ka tsi t+t+waṃ/ s+t+waṃ bha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ma ma sarba ā —shaṃ pa ri pū ra ya thā 5ya ba dā saṃ sā dzir/ ma ma sarba satā māṃ tsa/ sakhru kha sidha ye sa ha ya kā 7bha ban+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod la/ gtor ma'i snod sgrub pa'i grogs mchog thor tshugs bcings pa'i lag tu byin te dur khrod chen por dor bar bya'o/ /de nas nag po chen po ni/ /'khor dang bcas pa mnyes gyur nas/ /ji srid nam mkha' nyi zla dang / /ji srid skar ma dag dang sa/ /ji srid rgya mtsho dang ni gling / /ji srid 'gro ba rigs drug gnas/ /de srid rgyal bcas gtsug lag khang / /mchod rten bcas pa des srung 'gyur/ /de ni 'phags pa'i dge 'dun yang / /tshe ni ring por byed par 'gyur/ /me la sogs pa bgegs kyi tshogs/ /'byung ba de yis 'jigs par byed/ /rab gnas dus su rnal 'byor pas/ /gtor ma 'di ni yang dag bya/ /phan phyir bya ba'i rgyud las ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad gsungs/ /de ni nag po chen po'i gtor ma'o / /9 skye bo sdig pa byed pa rnams/ /gang gis bde 'gror skye 'gyur ba/ /'chi ba'i dus kyi gtor ma ni/ /bzang po de nas bshad par bya/ /blo gros chen pos bud med dam/ /skyes pa shi ba mthong nas ni/ /de tshe bdag nyid byang chub sems/ /phyag na rdo rje bsam par bya/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa/ /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab 'dra'i 'od/ /mche ba cung zad gatshigs pa ste/ /sgeg pa yi ni ro yis brgyan/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub dang ldan zhing //77—/07 /

g.yas pa rdo rje gsor mdzad pa/ /gar bcas de dag mtshungs nyid kyis/ /'dren pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor/ /sa snying la sogs sa bon gyis/ /yan lag drug gi go cha dgod/ /mig la sogs pa byin brlabs na/ /de nas lha yi mig sogs 'gyur/ /de yi mgo dang logs sogs su/ /de yis gshin rje'i pho nya mthong / /pag 1pa dbyug pa'i tho ba can/ /de nas mthong nas 'di ltar bsdigs—/ /gshin rje pho nya khyed rnams ni/ /'di ni mdun nas 'go bar gyis—/ /nga ni gnas pa 'di ru khyed/ /skad cig tsam yang gnas skabs med//de min rdo rje rnon po yis/ /khrag dang rnag rdzab 'jigs rung bar/ /khyod kyi mgo ni 'gas par bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de yi tshig 5de thos nas ni/ /mi bzad gshin rje'i pho nya sogs/ /phyogs rnams kun tu 'bros par 'gyur/ /de nas de yi snying ga nas/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba'i rlung dag dang / /rnam par shes 6pa tshim bya'i phyir/ /gtor ma dag 7ni bya ba yin/ /rna ba'i drung du sngags 'di ni/ /rnal 'byor rigs pas gsang 8nas ni/ /bzlas na de las rdor 'dzin dang / /mtshungs pa nyid du 'grub par 'gyur/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya arta te/samyak+shi bud+dhā 9ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ bh+yo ma bya bi ni/ byo ma ru spra ya/ sarba bh+ya bi de / shri ba ya hri/ brah+ma mā ha/ spyo biju da yi te/ hūṃ ru duk+ṣa bi sabe+e ni hūṃ ru tra sa ru pe/ hri nā dā 7ā ta ma ke/ hūṃ bin+d+ra sha rī re i shag saṃ ya dza ni ma bh+yo ma yo dza ni/ bī shā ta ke be+e 1 —phye pa de brad+ma bi bye na maḥ/ yī rja s+t+waṃ k+ṣe 5hūṃn mā tha oṃ oṃ ā+o 7a sum̐ bh+yo ma bya bi ni bh+ya phaṭa/ de nas gsang sngags 'di yis ni/ /mi skyod gnas ni nyams dga' ba/ /rga dang 'chi ba rnams snye47byed/075

—spangs par/ /rnam par shes pa byung nas 'gro/ /de yi tshangs pa'i sgo nas ni/ /rnam shes myur du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bzhin ni rab tu 'dzum byed cing / /ngo ni ngo mtshar phyag rgyar ldan/ /rlung rnams kyi sngags 'di yis ni/ /oṃ hūṃ pra nā ya swā hā/ oṃ i pā nā ya swā hā/ oṃ a sa mā nā ya swā hā/ oṃ sa u dha nā ya swā hā/ oṃ hā byu nā ya swā hā/ oṃ k+ṣ-i ud wa ha ya swā hā/ oṃ dz+re 1bi wa ha yā 2swā hā/ oṃ ge saṃ wa hā ya swā hā/ oṃ k+ṣaṣ+ṭa ni wa hā ya swā hā/ oṃ saṃ bi dz+nyā na ya a ru pi ni ga ga na rū pa ya/ e bye hi pra bhā swā hā swa 4bhā ba badz+ra dha ra byu pi ṇi t+t+waṃ bo shaṭa/ sngags mchog bzang po 'di rnams kyis3/ /tshigs dag nas ni rlung 'byung bas/ /skye bo bde bar byed par 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin du mar 'gyur/ /de'i rjes la nam mkhar srid pa bar ma'i yi ge hoḥ8snaganyis kyis brten pa rnam par bsgoms te de'i mngon sum kho nar shi ba'i ro bsreg / par bya'o/ /'phags pa 'khyel pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /byin gyis brlabs nas chus bsangs te/ /de nas chu bor khrus byas nas/ /ba yi rnam lngas dgang bar bya/ /de nas dri ma dag byugs te/ /kha ru go la gzhug par bya / /me tog spos la sogs rnams kyis/ /mchod byas nas ni spos kyis dkris / /glu dang rol mo yid 'ong bas/ /de la rab tu mchod par bya/ /yig sagasum byin brlabs me lha ni/ /sbyin sreg ri las bshad cho gas gzhag /tshig par gyur gyi bar du ni/ /mkhas pas lan brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ /stong ngam khri ni bzlas nas ni/ /'di ni shi ba'i chog rim pa/ /rus pa blangs nas dag byas te/ /rdul ni chu bo la dor bya/ /rdul tshon kha dog dmar po yis/ /khro bo'i gzugs can gshin rje gshed/ /dkyil 'khor de ru bri bar bya/ /khro (7byed/076

bya / /de la rim pa 'di yin te/ oṃ wa ra dhe dzi na go le ya sho te sarba budhe a byeṣ+ṭṛ te swā hā/ 'jim pa 1la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su bzlas te mchod rten bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā zhes byas pas skol phor du gzhug par bya/mchod rten 'byin pa na yang 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ oṃ dhan+d+ra dhā tu gasgo swā hā/oṃ a bhā ba swa bhā ba dhasgro —te swā hā/ oṃ pra marda nā ya 4swā hā/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha ta s+t+ra 5be+e swā hā/ oṃ na mo rat+na 6tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba te akhyo sgyu 7tshoya ta thā ga tā ya arta te samyak+shi bud+dhā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ na ma āt+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā 9ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā / oṃ tsi li ban+dha mi mi li ban+dha mi tsi li mi li brnya mi/ si saṃ brnya mi/ si saṃ de ba dāt+ta sh+tsa ma ka shin bya ti kra ma tu swā hā/ sngags 'dis nyungs kar la lan nyi shu rtsa gabyug yongs su bzlas te phyogs bcur gtor na phyogs bcing ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /des ni mchod rten rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la bdag dang gzhan bsrung ba'i sngon 5du sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma sh+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ta saye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa slota ye/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ma hā te dza ya/ ma hā te dza ya/ ma hā ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha/ bi ki ra ṇa bibye sa ya/ ba dra pa ya/ jo ṭi 1lo bo da ra/uts+tsha sma gro dha dhū phaṭa/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ dz+re baṃ ma ma de ba dat+ta su tsa sarba bai yo pa dra be+e bh+yaḥswā hā/ 'dis bdag bsrung ba dang / gzhan bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas langs te ci bder gnas par bya'o/ /'chi ba'i dus kyi gtor ma'i cho bkashes / / 5(7—/078

de nas zos pa'i mtha' 1ma ru/ /gang gi rnal 'byor zhi ba dang / /rgyas par 'gyur ba'i gtor ma ni/ /lhag ma zhes bya rab bshad bya/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lor zos pa yang / /yang na rang gis zos pa'i mthar bza' ba la sogs kun 'dus te/ /snod gcig tu ni gzhug par bya/ /chang dang 'bru yi chang lhag gang / /de yang gcig tu blugs par bya/ /de ru 'bras kyi phye ma yis / /de ni dkyil 'khor gru gsum bya/ /dbus su dang po'i dbyangs dgod cing / /zur gsum du ni yi ge gsum/ /bcom ldan 'khor ba las sgrol ba/ /dbus su sgol —ma bsam par bya/ /spyan ni rtag pa dang ldan pa/ /oṃ gyi grwa ru yang dag bsam/ /26yi grwa ru lha mo ni/ /gos dkar mo ni bsgom par bya/ /mi bskyod dang ldan mā ma kri/ /hūṃ gi grwa ru yang dag bsam/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab cing dag /gru gsum mkhas pas bsgom par bya/ /de yi dbus su bum 4pa ni/ /sa las byas pa la sogs gzhag /bza' dang bca' ba sogs gang de/ /bum pa de ru rab tu gzhug /de nas gru gsum mtha' 5ma ru/ /dur khrod chen po bsam par bya/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang mgo la sogs/ /thod pa rnams kyis yongs su brgyan/ /shing gcig dang ni ldan pa nyid/ /khro 6dang khyi sogs rnam 'jigs pa/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyis/ /nye bar spras pa'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ /keng rus mkha' 'gro ma nyid ni/ /dur khrod gnas par de bsgom bya/ /drag mo gri gug snod thogs 7pa/ /skra bshig spyan ni gsum pa ste/ /kha ni yi dwags za byed cing / /rgyas pa mi bzad gsus pa 'phyang / /stag gi pags pa'i gos kyis ni/ /smad kyi cha ni rnam par brgyan//mgo bo'i steng du rkang pa gnyis/ /gar gyi 'gying tshul la brtson pa/ /thod 41byed/079

pa'i phreng ba'i rgyan dang ldan/ /rgyu ma'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /yi dwags klad pa tshil dang zhag /rab tu byugs pa la dgyes pa/ /mi yi rus pa'i phreng ldan pa'i/ /ska rags khrag gi thig le can/ /lag 'gro chen po'i rna cha can/ /brang 'gro'i rkang gdub 'jigs rung ba/ /kha dog dmar po 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /gzi brjid thub par dka' ba yi/ /shin tu mi bzad khros pa yis/ /gnod sbyin la sogs sdigs 1byed pa/ /yak+ṣa chen po'i sgra sgrogs pa/ /sha za la sogs rnams kyis bskor/ /de bltas nas ni rtse gsum gyi/ /phyag rgya bcings nas rnal 'byor pas/ /spyan 'dren sngags ni bzlas bya zhing / /chang gi btung ba dbul bar bya/ /oṃ e bye hi thra shā na wa si ni ma ma sa pa ri bā ra l+ya rak+ṣ-i 2ku ru i ha san+ni hi to bha ba swā hā/ rang rang sngags kyis go rims bzhin/ /de nas rnge tog sogs phul nas/ /sngags kyi rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /de la gtor ma dbul bar bya/ /oṃ ku ru ku ru/ wat+ta li ma hā wat+ta choli/ sit+ta chomu khi thra shā na wa si ni/ pre ta wā 6da ni tsaṇ+ḍa ka rā 7li ru bye ra pri ye/ sa ma ya rak+ṣi ta/yo ga dha ri/ ki li ki li/ ra be+e badz+ra pri ti wa ma na dhe pū dza haṃ/ bat+ta gru ha na dru te/ hūṃ saṃ ga gra ri/ tsaṇ+ḍa ka rā 9li/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ i mo ustsoṣ+ṭa ba lo kṛt+na —sarba duṣ+ṭan bhak+ṣa ya/ ho bye phre phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i lhag ma'i sngags brjod la/ gtor ma'i snod lan gsum bskor la mtshan ma gcig par dor bar bya'o / /de nas langs te lag pa dang kha bkrus la dkyil 'khor phyis te/ snga ma bzhin du gshegs 1gsol la ci bder nyal bar bya'o/ /de ni lhag ma'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /41—/080

nyal ba'i dus sam rab gnas sam/ /sbyin sreg mthar yang rnal 'byor pas / /phyogs bcu tshim par bya ba'i phyir/ /khro bo'i rgyal po'i gtor ma bya/ /gshin rje mthar byed nas brtsams te/ /gnod mdzes rgyal po la thug pa/ /sgu 1mdog phyag mtshan cha lugs ni/ /ji bzhin khro bo bcu po bsgom/ /mdun du dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /yang na rdo rgyus dag gis bri k+ṣe / /mtsho skyes 'dab ma brgyad pa ste / /de la khro bo rnam par bsam/ /dbus su dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /gshin rje chogatsug tor la thug rnams/ /go rims bzhin du shar phyogs 5dang / /'og dang steng gi phyogs su bsam/ /sha dang 'bras chan chang btung bas/ /gang bar gyur pa'i snod bcu dag /rim pa bzhin du bzhag 6bya zhing / /mchod yon phul te de nas mchod/ /sngags 'di yis ni sgrub pa pos/ /de nas spyan ni drang bar bya/ /oṃ e bye hi bha ga bān/ i hā bhabh+ya tsa sa ma ye na tsa ar+ghaṃ put+pa pra tīts+tsha i rda pū dz+wadza wā bye pra sā da mi/ de nas rang rang gi sngags bcu po kho nas gtor ma'i snod rnams byen gyis brlab par bya'o / /oṃ na maḥs man+ta budhe bh+yo/ na mo badz+ra muṅga ra has+thā 9ya tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal a pro pa 7rā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ gshin rje gshed kyi'o/ /oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhi bh+yo/ ma ha na dha ra/ bi bi dha/ so ra so ra/ ba ra da na budhe/ nirma tha nirma tha hūṃ phaṭa/ shes rab mthar byed kyi'o/ /oṃ na maḥs man+ta budhe bh+yo hu lu hu lu/ma hā pad+ma a mi tā ku ru ma hā bi sha na u pad+ma mthar byed kyi'o/ /oṃ na maḥs man+ta budhe bh+yo/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā 1 ya/ ma hā rda t+tha kyi.uṅga te bye ra bā ya/ badz+ra san+dha ra pā ya/ a mṛ ta 1 kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ phaṭa/ bgegs mthar byed kyi'o/ /oṃ na maḥs man+ta budhe bh+yo/ ya ma daṇ+ḍa 7ya/ tu ru tu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ sarba duṣ+ṭa 41byed1081

mā ra rtaya hūṃ phaṭa/ dbyug pa sngon po can gyi'o/ /oṃ na maḥs man+ta buste bh+yo/na mo ma hā ba lā 2ya usgoṣ+ṭha kro dha rā dzā ya/ sarba nā ga māṃ z-i da 4ya hūṃ phaṭa/stobs po che'i'o/ /oṃ na maḥs man+ta budhe bh+yo/ na mo a tsa la ka na tse ṭa tse ṭa5/muṣ+ṭa muṣ+ṭa/ tu ṭa tu ṭa/ gha ta gha ta/ gha gha ghā 6ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ mi g.yo ba'i'o / /oṃ na maḥs man+ta budhe bh+yo/ oṃ ṭak+ki hūṃ dza/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i'o/ /oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha hūṃ/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛt+na 7hūṃ/ kṛsnra pa ya kṛt+tha pa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga bān 9bir+ya rā dzā hūṃ phaṭa/ gnod mdzes rgyal po'i'o/ /oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā —māṃ/ na maḥs man+ta dhas+thā t+t+waṃ / na maḥs man+ta saṃ ghā māṃ1 / o si tā ta pa tre / oṃ be+e ma la/ oṃ shaṃ ka ra/ oṃ pra t+yaṅgi ra/ badz+ra uspyo ṣa tsakra warti sarba yazlu man+d+ra tan+t+ra mū la karma/ ban+dha ṭ+wāṃ/ tā ḍa rgo/ khri la ṭaṃ wā7/ ma ma kṛ t+ya ya na ke na tsit+ta kṛ tai tat+par+pān+d+ra/ stson+da tsan+das/ bhin+da rnyin+da/ tsi ri tsi ri/gi ri gi ri/ ma ra ma raslo/ hūṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ k+shi hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i'o/ /thams cad srung 7bar byed pa'o/ /sngags mchog bzang po 'di rnams kyis/ /khro bo'i rgyal po bcu po ni/ /rdzogs par tshim par byas par 'gyur/ /de nas shar sogs phyogs rnams su/ /sngags kyi go rims ji bzhin du/ /khro bo rnams kyi go rims bzhin/ /gtor ma'i snod rnams dor bar bya/ /de yis nam yang rmi lam ni/ /ngan pa nyid ni mthong mi 'gyur/ /khro bo tshim las rnal 'byor dbang / /rmi lam bzang po nyid mthong 'gyur/ /rab gnas mtha' mar gtor ma 'dis/ /lha khang shin tu brtan par 'gyur/ /sbyin sreg mtha' ma mkha' 'gro ma/ /stobs chen ma dag rab mnyes/ 'gyur/ /gang phyir sna tshogs ma lus 'di/ /phyogs bcu'i sems 17byed/082

can dang bcas pa/ /khro rgyal gyis ni rang gi mthus/ /rtag tu pham par byas te gnas/ /de phyir de ni tshim byas pas/ /klu dang 'byung po drang srong dang / /gnod sbyin lha min bcas 'gro ba/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu tshim par 'gyur/ /rang gi 'dod lha'i rnal 'byor ram/ /rta yi rgyal po'i rim gyis ni/ /rtse gcig sems ldan sgrub pa pos/ /khro rgyal rnams la gtor ma dbul/ /des khro bo'i rgyal po bcu'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o / / 1gang zhig byas pas rnal 'byor dbang / /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid thob 'gyur / /nang gi gtor ma zhes bya ba/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad bya/ /bzhin bzangs mig ni rab yangs pa'i/ /si h+la ga pur dag gis brgyan/ /pang pa ru ni gzhag bya ste/ /nu ma gzung bar rab tu bsam/ /rdo rje pad+ma 4'o byas shing / /rdo rje bskyod pas mnye bar bya/ /rdo rje 'khyud pas 'khyud nas ni / /rdo rje mchu ni rab tu gzhib/ /rdo rje sor mo'i 5sbyor ba yis /6rdo je gnas ni rab tu bskyod/ /rdo rje sems ni rab phyung nas/ /rdo rje'i lce yis bza' bar bya/ /de nas de yi bde chen du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu gzhug /rdo rje bsdams 7pa'i spyor ba yis/ /rdo rje'i mchod pa rab tu brtsam //rdo rje sems dpa' thob pa na/ /brtul zhugs can gyis rdor sems spro/ /pad+ma'i me tog yang dag ldan/ /me tog dmar pos mchod par bya/ /pad+ma mnyes gyur rdo rje can/ /pad+ma dmar pos khyad par du/ /dri lnga yi ni spyor ba dang / /spos dang ga bur mchod pas so/ /'di yis rgyas par 'gyur ba ste/ /stobs dang mthu dang rtsal ldan 'gyur/ /bltas pa tsam gyis bskul nas ni/ /17—/083

'jig rten dag ni dbang du 'gyur/ /shes rab yan lag spyor ba yis/ /nang gi gtor ma'i rim 'di bshad/ /gzhan yang bza' ba'i sbyor bas kyang / /nang gi gtor ma bshad par bya/ /ji skad du dpal ldan lha mo bzhis chos kyi dbyings zhus pa las lha mo sgrol ma'i the tshom bsal ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis te/ rdzas kyi sgrub pa yan lag brgyad/ /chos rnams bsgrub pa bshad par bya / /mi dang glang po rta dang ni/ /ba lang khyi dang bong bu nyid/ /rnga mo dang ni ma he nyid/ /cha dag mnyam par byas nas ni/ /mthe bong gi ni rtse mo tsam/ /mnyam par mnyam pas nges par sbyar/ /bshang gci khrag dang khu ba dag /nas kyi 'bru yi tshad tsam yang / /sngags kyi sgo nas sbyar bya zhing / /byin gyis kyang ni brlab par bya/ /oṃ dang yi ge āḥdang ni/ /dbus su yi ge hūṃ nyid dang / /dz+wa la dz+wa la ya hri 1ste/ /'di ni dgu par rab tu grags/ /lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ /sngags 'di brjod pas gdags par bya/ /tshes brgyad dam ni bcu bzhi la/ /lnga lnga dang ni bsre bya zhing / /nyungs 2kar lnga yi tshad tsam gyis/ /de nas ri lu dag byas nas/ /pad+ma'i snod du bzhag nas su//stong phrag brgya ni bzlas par bya/ /nyin re bzhin du bza' bya zhing / /thun bzhi dag tu bsgoms byas na/ /bskal pa'i mtha' la thug pa ru/ /dngos grub rgya chen thob par 'gyur/ /ri lu chen po zos pa yis/ /mdog dang gzi brjid stobs dang mthu/ /lnga pa smon lam nyid dang ni/ /mngon par shes pa lnga thob 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de ltar nang gi gtor ma ni/ /rtag tu bya ba rnal 'byor pas/ /'dir ni dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /rga shi med pa'i gnas myur 'grub/ /de —ni nang gi gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /41—1084

6 ma tse 6 shā lā su tsa kuñja rā shā/ ye byu z-i t+t+waṃ tsi tra kṛ he ba sarnyi ra gnas dang glang chen bres gnas dang / /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang sum mdo byā su bī bhā 6 tsa tsa tā re 6/ ye rtsa ka dṛk+ṣe 6 ma hā pa the 6 ma hā thra shā ne+e dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal 6 ma hā ba ne 6/ sau he bha rik+ṣu byu ṣi tā su ye tsa ba sarnyi gho rā su ma hā chen po dang / /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar ṭa bī 6/ dī phe 6 di bye 6 kṛ tā la yash+tsa mai rorja shā ne+e ni ba sarnyi ye tsa/gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /dṛbyeḥ pra san+d+ra ཿsra dza ga rnya mā sum̐ dhū paṃ ba lo dhi ba bi byeñca bhas+t+ra—1 /rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas su/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug pa dang / /bstod dang gtor ma kṛ ṇ+ḍi n+tu bhu ñja n+tu pi wa n+tu tse da mi da ñca ka rma sa pha lo yu mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bzhes nas kyang / /bdag gi las 'di 'bras bu ṣartse / ma hā ba liḥ// 1 //mchis par mdzod/ /gtor ma chen po'o// //oṃ badz+ra yo gi byā s+thāḥru ru ru khaḥkhaḥkhaḥdze dze dze i e i oṃ oṃ oṃ ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bdag ma ma naḥsid+dhi pra yats+tsha ba bo grihā kṛṇ+ḍi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ shuklu ga ga na k+ṣe pā la yid bzhin dngos grub stsol gtor ma bzhes gtor ma bzhes/ nam mkha' dkar po la 'thor ba'i ba liḥ// 2 //gtor ma'o// //41—1101

oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa ri sarbo pa dra ba nā shi ni sarba ro ga pra sha ma ni sarba bha sha za ma ri khrod lo ma can nyer 'tshe thams cad sel ma/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed ma/ya bi nā shi ni i rda ba bo/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba duṣ+ṭa mā rān 'jigs pa thams cad sel ma/ gtor ma 'di zung zung zo zo zo shig zo shig gdug pa'i bdud thams cad mā ra mā ra/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ mā ra ya gso/da gso/da/ chings chings/ snun snun/ sregs sregs/ tshos tshos/ gsad par gyis mā ra ya/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ par+ṇa sha ba rī ba liḥ// 3 //gsad par gyis/ ri khrod lo ma can gyi gtor ma'o// //oṃ ma hā kā lā ya shā sa no pa kā ri ṇaphopasgyi ma kā lo ya mi rda rat+na tra yā pa kā nag po chen po bstan pa la phan 'dogs pa phyi ma ma yin pa'i dus 'di dang 'dir dkon mchog ri rde ya di pra ti dz+nyā sma ra si ta dā i rda ba bo kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/gsum 'a gnod pa byed pa gal te byung na/ de'i tshe dam bca' dran par gyis gtor ma 'di zung zung sarba duṣ+ṭa satā na/ mā ra mā ra/ kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍa/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/gdug pa'i sems can thams cad sod sod/ zung zung / chings chings/ snun snun/da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya mā ra ya/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa sregs sregs/ tshos tshos/ nyi ma gcig gis swā hā/ ma hā kā la ba liḥ// 4 //nag po chen po'i gtor ma'o// //oṃ s+dzahūṃ hoḥ.uṭī ṣa sum+bha rā dza ya mān+ta ka /pradz+nyān+ta ka /pad+mān+ta ka /gtsug tor gnod mdzes rgyal po/ gshin rje mthar byed/ shes rab mthar byed/ pad+ma mthar byed/41—1 sde02

bispyon+ta ka /a tsa la/ ṭak+ki rā dza/ nī la daṇ+ḍa/ ma hā ba le bh+yaḥ/bgegs mthar byed/ mi g.yo ba/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ dbyug sngon/ stobs po che rnams/sa pa ri bā re bh+yaḥ/ i rda ba lo/ gar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū paṃ/ dī pa.ā+oṃk+ṣa haṃ da dā ma he/'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'di gtor ma/ dri me tog bdug pa/ mar me ma nyams pa sbyin gyis de rnams te tsā ga t+ya sa pa ri wā rāḥ shī gh+ra mi rda ba bo kṛṇ+ḍan+tu khā dan+tu/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥkyang byon nas 'khor bcas myur bar gtor ma 'di gzung du gsol bzhes shig 'thung shig /yang dag par sadh+ribhā ma ma sarba satā nāñca shārnyi puṣ+ṭi rak+ṣu ba ra ṇa gup+ta kurban+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/tshim ste/bdag dang sems can thams cad la zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba ba mdzod/badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ da sha gro dha ba liḥ// 5 //rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin du/ /khro bo bcu'i gtor ma'o// //oṃ 26hūṃ hoḥ.i hā ba sbi te bh+yaḥk+ṣe tra pā le bh+yophon+ya bh+yash+tsa i rda gar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/'dir gnas pa'i zhing skyong rnams dang gzhan rnams la yang 'di dri dang me tog dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ma k+ṣa tai da dā ma he/ te tsā ga t+ya sa pa ri wā rāḥshī gh+ra mi rda ba bo bdug pa mar me dang ma nyams pa sbyin gyi de rnams kyang byon nas 'khor dang bcas pa rnams myur bar greṇ+ḍirtse khā dan+tu pi ban+tu dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sadh+ribhā ma ma sarba satā nāñca shāp+ta puṣ+ṭi rak+ṣu ba gtor ma 'di zung gsol 'thung kun du tshim ste bdag dang sems can thams cad la zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang ra ṇa gusto kurban+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ k+ṣe tra pā la bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba ba mdzod/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin du/ /zhing skyong gi ba liḥ 6 /gtor ma'o// //41—1103

oṃ na maḥsu rū pā ya ta thā ga tā yārta te samyaspru bud+dhā lha ya/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzugs mdzes la phyag ta r+ya thā / oṃ su ru su ru / pra su ru pra su ru /'tshal lo// /'di lta ste/ gzugs mdzes gzugs mdzes/ gzugs rab tu mdzes gzugs rab tu mdzes/ta ra ta ra/ bha ra bha ra/ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ sma ra sma ra/'od 'od/ gso ba gso ba/ yang dag par 'dzin pa yang dag par 'dzin pa/ dran pa dran pa/san+tarba ya san+tarba ya/ sarba pre tā māṃ swā hā/ a pa sa radh+wa ba tā kun du tshim par gyis kun du tshim par gyis/ yi dwags thams cad song zhig /glags lta ba rnams/ra prek+ṣi rte da dā mya haṃ sarba lo ka jo tu ni bā si māṃ pre tā nā mā hā ra mi ti/ pre ta sbyin gyis ngas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na gnas pa'i yi dwags rnams la bza' ba/ yi dwags kyi ba liḥ// 7 //gtor ma'o// //oṃ da sha disbya basbi te bh+yaḥ.i hā basbri te bh+yaḥsu ra ga ru ḍa kin+da ra phyogs bcur rnam par gnas pa rnams dang 'dir gnas pa'i lha dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ma ho ra ga bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsod+mā dā pa sma ra os+thā ra kā di stso/ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang 'byung po dang yi dwags dang sha za dang smyo byed dang brjed byed dang gnon po la ba bo dā pa ya mi/ i rda/ puṣ+pe/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gar+ghaṃ/ nai be+e byā di saṃ yuk+to sogs pa rnams la gtor ma sbyin gyis/me tog bdug pa mar me dri dang zhal zas la sogs ldan pa 'di bzung kṛ hi tā/ su kha so ma na su khā bhi nu bha ban+tu s+thā nañca ni ru pa dra baṃ kurban+tu sarba bud+dhā nas—/ bde ba dang yid bde ba thob par gyur te/ gnas su nye bar 'tshe ba med par mdzod/ sangs rgyas byejo ne ne ti/ oṃ āḥhūṃ i dam mṛ ta piṇ+ḍaṃ byughā ma ma sarba satā nāñca thams cad kyis byin gyi rlabs kyis/ bdud rtsi'i gong bu 'di zos nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad 41byed1104

shārnyi kurban+tu swa ste swā hā/ sa mā dzi kā māṃ sārba sgo ti ba liḥ// 8 //la/ zhi ba dang bde legs su mdzod cig /'dus pa pa rnams kyi 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'o// //ibye ba dz+re sa ha bhū ta saṃ ghi ri mañca kṛṇ+ḍin+tu ba bo be shi ṣ+ṭi /shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol//aghir+ya mo nai ṛ ti bhū pa tish+tsa a dzā pa tir+pā yu dha nā dhi pash+tsa/ yī shā nā me dang gshin rje bden bral 'byung po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung dang nor gyi bdag po dang / /dbang ldan lha byu tā dhi pa tish+tsa de bā sprudhañca tsan+d+rarka pi tā ma hash+tsa/ de bāḥs mā stu bhu bi ye tsa nā ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu//gā dha rā dha rā gu h+ya ga ne+eḥs me tāḥ/ pra ti bat+t+waṃ tweka ni be+e dañca swa ka swa ka swe ri yi lha dang gsang ba'i tshogs bcas la/ /sa sa so sor phul ba 'di dag kun/ /rab tu dgyes shing mgu ba di shā su bhū tāḥ/ kṛṇ+ḍin+tu tuṭ+wāḥs ba laḥs se t+yā sa pu tra mi tra swa dza naiḥbar gyur pa yis/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang / /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen sa me tāḥ/ puhūṃ ba lo dhū pa ni be+e da nañca bhuñjan+tu dzi gran+tu pi ban+tu tse da mi rda 'dun bcas/ /gtor ma me tog bdug pa 'bul lags na/ /'di dag gsol zhing bzhes te bsnams nas tsa ka rma sa pha lo yu ṣa n+tu / dikrāl ba liḥ// 9 //kyang / /bdag gi las 'di 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /phyogs skyong gi gtor ma'o// //oṃ tse dze dze dze hri hūṃ dzaḥ ba lo rak+ta put+pa kā ma rā dza sarba sirnyi pra yats+tsha gtor ma dmar po/ me tog 'dod pa'i rgyal po dngos grub thams cad stsol/ma ma bi rudhi tsit+ta kān bhasmi ku ru sap+ta pā ta la ga ha sha tūn pā da ta lo bdag la 'gal bar sems pa rnams thal bar gyis/ sa 'og rim pa bdun du dgra rnams rkang pa'i mthil du 41—1105

ku ru sarba dza no pa shārnyi ku ru phaṭa swā hā/ kā ma rā dza ba lo// 10 //gyis skye bo thams cad la nye bar zhi ba mdzod cig /'dod pa'i rgyal po'i gtor ma'o// //oṃ tweḥ.e bye ti kyi.e ka dza ṭī/ ma mo pa rtse tān shārnyi ku ru/ puṣ+ṭi ku ru/tshur byon ral gcig ma/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la zhi bar mdzod/ rgyas par mdzod/ma hā yak+ṣu dhi pa ta ye r+sha i rda ba bo kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi/ kṛṇ+ḍi pa ya kṛṇ+ḍi pa ya/ pa ra bi ṭ+wāṃ ā gnod sbyin gyi bdag po chen po/ 'di gtor ma zung zung / 'dzin du chug 'dzin du chug /gzhan gyi kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ spra ṭa mru ṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ u gra tā rā rig pa khug khug /chod chod/ choms chosas/ sgol ma drag mo'i ba liḥ / 11 //gtor ma'o// //oṃ āḥ1 ༈ ku ru kul+le sarba sat+t+waṃ ju — ba shaṃ ka ri/ sarba bha ya bha yo ka ri/rigs su byed ma sems can thams cad dbang du byed ma/ 'jigs pa thams cad 'jigs par i rda ba bo gar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe dhū 4paṃ dī pa.ā+oṃ k+ṣa tai da dā ma he sarba/ de 3ba nā ga yak+ṣa byed ma/ gtor ma dri dang me tog bdug pa mar me dang ma nyams pa 'di 'bul gyi/ lha klu gnod sbyin gan+dhar+pā su ra ga ru ḍa kin+da ra ma ho ra gā da yo/ ya dze+eṣ+ṭi byuñja tha/ khā da dri za lha min mkha' lding mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po la sogs thams cad/ ci 'dod zo shig /'cho tha pi ba tha dzi gh+ra tha ma ma ma naḥsidhi pra yats+tsha tha oṃ 26hūṃ dz+rī hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ku ru shig /'thungs dri snom/ bdag gi yid la dngos grub stsol cig /rigs su byed kube+e 'ub liḥ 12 //pa'i gtor ma'o// //41byed1106

oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shrī tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa shā ya/ de bā su ra na ra tā sa nā ya/bcom ldan 'das dpal gtum po 'jigs rung chen po/ lha dang lha ma yin dang mi rnams skrag par sa ka la mā ra ba la bi nā sa nā ya a ta sī ku su ma wa pu ṣe a mdzad pa/ bdud dpung mtha' dag gi stobs rnam par 'joms pa/ gzar ma'i me tog lta bu'i sku can/ mi k+ko bh+ya kṛ ta she ṣa rā ya/ i rda ba lo kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi ma ma sarba bismyon tsa bskyod pas cod pan mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtor ma 'di zung zung / bdag gi bgegs thams cad turmā rān+ni bā ra ya ni bā ra ya/ tā sa ya tā sa ya/ bhā ma bhā ma/ stso( sgyun+da/bdud bzhi po rnams bzlog par gyis bzlog par gyis/ skrag par gyis skrag par gyis/ skor skor/ chod chod/bhin+da rnyin+da/ nā sha nā sha /tā pa tā pa/ sho ṣa sho ṣa/ ts+tsha da ts+tsha da/ bhe da phug phug /bshig bshig /sregs sregs/ skoms skoms/ chod chod/ phye bhe da/ duṣ+ṭas tān ma ma bi rudha tsit+ta kān bhasmi ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/phye—/ gdug pa'i sems can bdag la 'gal bar sems pa rnams thal bar mdzod/tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ba liḥ// 13 //gtum po 'jigs rung chen po'i gtor ma'o// //oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ya/ ma hā dha nā ya ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye i rda ba bo rmugs 'dzin chu'i dbang po/ nor chen po/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po la/ bdud rtsi pa.ā+oṃ mṛ tai kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi kha kha khā hi khā hi sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/lnga'i gtor ma 'di/ dam tshig rjes su dran par gyis/dzam+bha la ba liḥ// 14 //rmugs 'dzin gyi gtor ma'o// //41—1107

oṃ rak+ta mu ku ṭā ya/ rak+ta dza ṭā ya/ rak+ta mu khā ya/ rak+ta sha rī rā ya/cod pan dmar po/ ral pa dmar po/ zhal dmar po/ sku lus dmar po/rak+ta bhu dzā ya/ rak+ta hā ra ba li mā khā ya/ rak+ta ra tha sa mā rū ṭ+wā ya/ rakyā na nā ya/phyag dmar po/do shal phreng ba dmar por ldan pa/shing rta dmar po la yang dag par bzhugs pa gdong dmar/ragh+ra bha ra ṇa khyu ṣi tā ya/ i rda ba lo kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi ma ma sarba bispyon/ ha ra ha ra/rgyan cha dmar pos brgyan pa la/ gtor ma 'di zung zung / bdag gi bgegs thams cad/ phrogs phrogs/tsa turmā ran/ ni bā ra ya ni bā ra ya/ tā sa tā sa/ khyu ma bhā ma/ khyun+da stson+da/bdud bzhi rnams bzlog par gyis bzlog par gyis/ skrag par gyis skrag par gyis/ skor skor/ chod chod/bhin+da bhin+da/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ ts+tsha da ts+tsha da/ bhe da bhe da phug phug /nyams par gyis nyams par gyis/ skoms shig skoms shig /chod chod/ phye phye/hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ partswata pra h+ye she na tsā ra ye tra// //de nas cha shas so sos brjod par bya ste// //oṃ ibye ya na maḥtweḥ/ ya mā ya na maḥsmiḥ/ ba ru shā ya na maḥbi/ ku be+e rā ya dbang po 'a 'dud/ gshin rje la 'dud/ chu lha la 'dud/ lus ngan na maḥkṛ/ asna ye na maḥta/ yī shwa rā ya na maḥ.ā/ nai rje ta ye na maḥn/la 'dud/ me lha la 'dud/ dbang phyug la 'dud/ bden bral la 'dud/bā ya be+e na maḥn/ tsan+d+ra ya na maḥhūṃ/ arku ya na maḥhūṃ/ brah+ma ṇi na maḥphaṭa/rlung lha la 'dud/ zla ba la 'dud/ nyi ma la 'dud/ tshangs pa la 'dud/ba su dhā rā ma na maḥphaṭa/ be ma tsi tri be+e na maḥswā/ sarba bhū te bh+yo na maḥhā/nor rgyun ma la 'dud/ thags bzangs ris la 'dud/ 'byung po rnams la 'dud/ha hā hi ṭī/ hu snu/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rak+ta ya mā ri ba liḥ// 15 //gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i gtor ma'o// //41—1108

oṃ badzā rakhra hoḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki n+yaḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ/ badzāñja s+thā rdo rje rtsibs 'phur rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams dam tshig nyid la ltos/ rdo rje thal mo kha sprurja bi ka tsa yā ba bo da t+yāt+pa ni shādzha ke/ oṃ kha kha khā nyi khā ti sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa gyen du phye bas mtshan phyed na gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /gnod sbyin dang srin po dang sa bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsod+mā dā pasmra ra ḍā ka ḍā ki t+yā da ya i rda ba lo kṛṇ+ḍan+tu 'byung po dang yi dwags dang sha za dang sbyo byed dang brjed byed dang mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma la sogs sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sidhi pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya be+e baṃ/ ya theṭaṃ/pa thams cad/ dam tshig srungs shig /bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol cig /bhuñja tha khā da tha pi ba tha dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya sakhru bdag la rnam pa thams cad du/kha bi bṛdha ye sa hā ya kā bha wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭā phaṭa swā hā/ tsakra saṃ ba ra dam pa'i bde ba rnam par 'phel ba'i ched du stong grogs mdzod cig /'khor lo sdom pa'i ba liḥ// 17 //gtor ma'o// //oṃ na mo bha ga wa tre+e rak+ta de tā yi ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye ma ma sarba sha tū hūṃ bcom ldan 'das ma spyan dmar ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag na rdo rje gtum po la bdag gi dgra sarba ga tā ṇi/ saṃ ko tsa ya saṃ ko tsa ya/ bhañja ya bhañja ya/ mo ṭa ya mo ṭa ya/thams cad kyi lus rnams thams cad yang dag par skums skums/bha ga wa ti badz+ra gri kha le badz+ra pā ṇi nā ka tsūr+ya/ ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya tsagrurban+ta bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ phyag na rdo rje/ lha yul pa phye mar gyis la 41—1110

na ma ཿ sa ma n+ta bu dha māṃ / na ma ཿ sa ma n+ta dha rmā ṭ+wāṃ /kun nas sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun nas chos la phyag 'tshal lo /na maḥs man+ta saṃ ghā ṭ+wāṃ/ oṃ si tā ta pa tra/ oṃ bi ma la/ oṃ shaṃ ka ra/kun nas dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdugs dkar po/ dri ma med pa/ bde byed/oṃ pra bye gi ra/ badz+ra uṭī ṣa tsakra brti sarba yan+t+ra man+t+ra spru la karma phyir bzlog pa/ rdo rje gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ 'khrul 'khor dang sngags dang rtsa ba'i las ba rnya māṃ tī la nas+thā/ ma ma kṛ te ye na ke ni tsit+tha tai tat+ma rban/thams cad dang bcings pa bsnun pa phur bus btab pa'am/ bdag la byed pa gang ci yang rung bas byed stson+da stson+da/ bhin+da byen+da/ tsi ri tsi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ ma ra ma ra/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ pa de dang de thams cad dang /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭu phaṭā phaṭā/ uspyo ṣa tsakra brti ba liḥ// 21 //gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i gtor ma'o// //oṃ āḥsarba rgya dh+wa dza gadrwa sha di klo ka dhā tānan+ta ga ga na sa mu dra me gha blu ha dus gsum pa'i 'gro ba phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi pra sa ra pa ra ma rku ra dzo ma ṇ+ḍa la pa ra dza rā dha rga ta sa mā bkod pa rab 'byam gyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi dkyil 'khor gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i nang du paṣ+ṭha ba sbri tā dharma dh+wa tu sa ma ba sa ra zla ā kā sha dhā tu sa ma ba gnas shing snyoms par 'jug pas gnas pa/ chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par 'jug pa nam mkha'i khams sā nāḥ sa rba rgya dh+wa dza ga drwa sha diklo ka dhā tā na rnya blu ha dang mnyam par gnas pa/ thams cad dang dus gsum pa'i 'gro ba phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' pra sa ra ga ga na sa māḥ sa rba lo ka pā lāḥ sa rba sa tā ñca /yas pa'i bkod pa rab 'byam nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad dang sems can 41—1112

tar+ya thā/ badzā yu dha badz+ra kā la nā ga badz+ra badz+ra bye ra ba badzā thams cad la/ 'di lta ste/ rdo rje mtshon cha dang rdo rje dus dang rdo rje glu dang rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / rdo rje na la badz+ra mu sa la badzā ni la kro dha badz+ra mo na badz+ra mā yā badz+ra me dang rdo rje gtun shing dang rdo rje rlung dang / khro bo rdo rje dang / thub pa rdo rje dang sgyu ma rdo rje dang /badz+ra shoṇ+ḍa badz+ra pra bha badz+ra kro dha be+e ma tsi ṭī rdo rje glang sna dang / rdo rje 'od dang / rdo rje khro bo dang / thags bzangs ris dang /khru thi bī de ba tāḥs pa ri bā rā i rda ba lo puṣ+pe dhū paṃ dī paṃ gar+ghaṃ nai be byā di saṃ yuk+to sa'i lha rnams 'khor dang bcas pas/ gtor ma me tog bdug spos mar me dri dang zhal zas la sogs pa ba skru pa hā ram̐ pra tīstso pa bhu bye ma ma sarba bispyo bi nā ya kān dang ldan pa'i gtor ma'i mchod pa 'di bzhes shing longs spyad de/ bdag gi bgegs dang log 'dren dang /sarba du ṣ+ṭhan pra du ṣ+ṭan ma nu t+yān ma nu byān dzam+bha ya ta stam+bha ya ta gdug pa dang rab tu gdug pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams thams cad/ rmugs par gyis rengs par gyis ban+dha ya ta pi dh+wad+ma ya ta/ ma ma hi ra rgya su bar+ṇa dha na dh+wa r+sā yu yo chings—/ rnam par choms/ bdag gi dbyig dang gser dang nor dang 'bru dang tshe dang lang tsho ba nā ro gya sarlu khā ni ma hā su kha bi z-i dzha ye yā ba dā bo dhi dang nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa rnams dang bde ba chen po rnam par 'phel ba'i ched dang ji srid byang maṇ+ḍa pazlas rto ka ya ta ma ma sa hā ya t+t+waṃ shārnyi puṣ+ṭi rak+ṣuñca ku ru oṃ umadzi oṃ hūṃ swā hā/chub snying po'i mthar thug par bdag gi stong grogs mdzod cig /mañju badz+ra bā ṭā shwa ra ba liḥ// 22 //'jam pa'i rdo rje ngag gi dbang phyug gi gtor ma'o// //oṃ e bye hi bha ga wa ti badz+ra yo gi nī sathā shā pa ri pū ri ke tshur byon tshur byon bcom ldan 'das ma/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs 41—1113

bha ga wa ti ba ra de na ma ste pu na ra pi na ma ste ma ma de bī mā par mdzad ma/bcom ldan 'das ma mchog sbyin ma khyod la 'dud/slar yang khyod la 'dud/yum lha mo bdag ta ra nu gra ha ku ru i rda ba bo kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye swā hā/la dgong sa shing rjes su gzung du gsol/ rdo rje rnam pa ra snang mdzad ma/a tsa la kaspoghā sāsnyo ṣa ḍa k+ṣa ra badz+ra yo gi nī ba liḥ// 23 //mi g.yo ba'i brtag pa las gsungs pa phyed bcas yi ge drug gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma'o// //oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūṃ hūṃ phe phe hūṃ phaṭā phaṭā swā hā/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig rjes su dran par gyis/raghā ga ga na k+ṣe pā ba liḥ// 24 //nam mkha' dmar po la 'thor ba'i gtor ma'o// //oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki — i rda ba bo dz+rī hri ha ho haṃ haḥphaṭā ma ma sarba satā nāñca shāk+ṣiṃ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gtor ma 'di bdag dang sems can thams cad la zhi bar mdzod cig /ku ru swā hā/ aṣ+ṭa rgyu tsa tud+dhā shā mi ya me ba dā ta byā/ sha wa ra pā dī ya 'di brgyad dang bcu bzhi kho na la sbyin par bya'o/ /sha wa ri'i zhal snga nas kyi rim kra ma badz+ra yo gi byā ba liḥ// 25 //pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma'o// //oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki — i rda ba bo kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi haḥhaḥhaḥhaḥkha ya kha ya kha ya kha ya mkha' 'gro ma gtor ma 'di zung zung /aḥ.aḥ.aḥ.aḥm ma sirnyi pra yats+tsha hūṃ phaṭā swā hā/ shrī ma da dwa ya pā dī ya badz+ra yo gi nī bdag la dngos grub sprul cig /dpal gnyis med zhabs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 41byed1114

ba liḥ// 26 //gtor ma'o// //oṃ a ra pa tsa nā ya ku ma ti da ha na dāk+ṣa ya tsan+d+ra kārnya mā la pra bhā ya kharge 'khor ba sreg par byed pa blo gros ngan pa sreg par mkhas pa chu shel gyi phreng ba'i 'od can ral gri pusta ka bya gra has+thā ya mdzi bā m+bi ba ra pra dā ya/ i saṃ ba lo gar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe dang glegs bam phyag na bsnams pa/ 'jam par gsung ba/ mchog stsol ba/ gtor ma dang dri dang me tog byu paṃ dī paṃ ma dhu sharka rā di sa hi tai kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi kha kha khā hi khā nyi/ ma ma shāṅgi puṣ+ṭi dang bdug pa dang mar me dang sbrang rtsi dang ka ra sogs dang bcas pa 'di bdag la zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang rak+ṣu ba ra ṇa gup+ta ku ru ku ru oṃ stosadhīḥhūṃ swā hā/ a ra pa tsa na ba liḥ// 27 //bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba bar mdzod cig /a ra pa tsa na'i gtor ma'o// //oṃ ma hā shri ye tram̐ hūṃ spyo/ oṃ i rda ba bo kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa/ tre+e lokya saṃ sā rā ya dā dpal chen mo 'jig rten gsum gyi 'khor ba'i ri dru ga rdza bi dā ra ya sarba duṣ+ṭa pra duṭ+wān bhañja ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ bha ga wa ti dbul ba'i glang po rnam par 'joms pa/ gdug pa dang rab tu gdug pa rnams bcom ldan 'das ma ma ma ni dhi de hi swā hā/ ma hā shrī tā rā ba liḥ// 28 //bdag la gter stsol cig /sgrol ma dpal chen mo'i gtor ma'o// //oṃ bha ga wa ti aṣ+ṭa ma hā bha ya tā ri ṇi shādhi puṣ+ṭi ba bye kā ri ṇi bcom ldan 'das ma 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgrol ma zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang du byed ma pa ra yan+t+ra man+t+ra bi ṣa tsūr+ṇa bi nā shi ni ma hā yo ge shwa ri ma ma gzhan gyi 'khrul 'khor dang sngags dang dug gi bye ma rnam par sel ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen mo bdag 41—1115

sarba sa tā nāñca rashā ku ru aṣ+ṭa ma hā dā ru ṇa bha ye bh+yas+thā ra ya tā ra ya/dang sems can thams cad la bsrung ba mdzod cig /'jigs pa mi bzad pa chen po brgyad las sgrol cig /di bya rū pi ṇi sau mya mu khi i rda ba lo kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi kha kha khā hi khā nyi swā hā/ aṣ+ṭa ma hā lha'i gzugs can zhi ba'i zhal ma 'jigs pa chen po bha ya tā ra ba liḥ// 29 //brgyad 'a/sa sgrol ma'i gtor ma'o// //oṃ bha ga wa ti ts+tshan+da ma ste pra sha ste/ oṃ sarba burnya ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra bcom ldan 'das ma dbu bcad ma rab bsngags ma/ sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje bai ro tsa byā ye i rda ba bo kṛṇ+ḍi kṛhā kha kha khā hi khā hi ma ma bi rudha tsit+ta kān bhasmi rnam par snang mdzad ma bdag la 'gal bar sems pa rnams thal bar mdzod sa 'og bdun du gnas ku ru sap+ta pā tā la ga ta sha t+pān pā da ta lo sarba tra ma ma shārnyi puṣ+ṭi rak+ṣu ba ra ṇa pa'i dgra rnams rkang 'og tu gyis thams cad du bdag la zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang bsrung ba dang gubye ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭu phaṭa swā hā/ tri kā ya badz+ra yo gi nī ba liḥ// 30 //bskyab pa dang sba ba mdzod/ sku gsum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma'o// //oṃ sarba dharmā badzā bye kā ra badz+ra ma hā kā la shā sa na ta la ga ma no pa kā ra ka chos thams cad rdo rje lhag par byed pa rdo rje nag po chen po bstan pa'i gzhi la ha hūṃ dz+rī spyo i saṃ ba bo kṛhā kṛṇ+ḍi kha kha khā nyi khā ti sarba duṣ+ṭa satwa da ma ka ha hā hi tī 'gro zhing phan 'dogs pa gdug pa'i sems can thams cad 'dul ba hu tū he hai ho ho haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ badz+ra ma hā kā la ba liḥ// 31 //rdo rje nag po chen po'i gtor ma'o// //41byed1116
