༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ 2nā ga ba bo bi dhiḥje bod skad du/ klu gtor gyi cho ga /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /yang dang yang du bsgoms chobyas la/ /mdun du paṃ las pad+ma ni/ /kha dog dmar po 'dab brgyad steng / /phuḥtrebargyad las ni klu brgyad bskyed/ /de nas snying ga'i 'od zer dang / /oṃ phe phu zhes pas klu chen brgyad/ /'khor dang bcas pa bkug la bstim/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsir bcas/ /dam tshig ye shes klu rnams mchod/ /de nas gtor ma byin brlabs te/ /snod ni haṃ las rin po che/ /shin tu mdzes shing blta 7na sdug /yangs la rgya ni che bar bsam/ /rin chen snod mchog de nang du/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsir bcas/ /snod ni shin tu gang bar bsam/ /de yi steng du yi ge 41—1273

gsum / /kha dog dri dang ro sbyangs nas/ /bdud rtsi'i ro mchog brgya dang ldan / /g.yas pa mchog sbyin phyag rgya la/ /ha ho hri shepaṃ dag las ni/ /dpag bsam shing ni bsam byas la/ /lo ma yal ga thams cad la/ /rin chen bum pa bdud rtsis bkang / /dpag tu med pa bsams nas ni/ /zlo 2las bdud rtsi'i char bab pas/ /gtor mas —yongs su gang bar bsam/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes lan gsum brjod/ /mgron rnams thams cad lce las ni/ /hūṃ las rdo rje'i sbu gus rngub/ /oṃ a nan+ta ba lo i rda kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ tak+ṣa ka/oṃ ku 4li ka /oṃ bā su ki5/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā la/ oṃ ma hā pad+ma/ oṃ ba ru ṇa/oṃ nan+da nā ga rā dzā ya/ oṃ phe klu'i rgyal po sog ma med/ /ba bo i rda kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mtha' yas dang ni 'jog po dang / /stobs kyi rgyu dang rigs 6ldan dang / /nor rgyas dang ni dung skyong dang / /pad+ma dang ni chu lha dang / /dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo7/ /rgya mtsho dang ni rgya mtsho che/ /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /gzugs chen sbrul bzangs stobs po che/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes/ /mdzes pa'i dkar gsum gtor ma 'di/ /mngar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtshor bcas//rin chen phreng ba'i be+em skas can/ /klu yi gnod pa skyob byed pa/ /mthun pa'i rdzas su 'di gyur cig /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms 4la/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /klu las gyur pa'i nad rnams ni/ /mthong ba'i dug dang kha zas dug /bsams pa'i dug la sogs pa kun/ /de dag thams cad zhi gyur cig /bdag pas gces /pa'i rdzas khyer la/ /bdag la gnod pa ma byed par/ /rtag tu byams pa'i sems dang ni/ /pha ma 4 7—127

lta bu'i sems kyis ltos/ /gzhan yang las las skyes pa yi1/ /bka' dang dam las ma thogs pa'i/ /gdug pa can gyi klu tshogs kun/ /bka' yi pha 'bab 'di snoms 2la/ /so so rang rang 1gnas su dengs/ /de'i rjes la gtor ma gtang —/ bden pa bdar/ chos bshad bya'o/ /klu'i gtor chen sgol ma'i zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa'i mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa sdogs so// //lo tsā 5ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1273 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe〉〉glu gtor gyi cho ga bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7a ba/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7rā dza/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ ye〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgom/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdza/1274 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsū/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sras/ lta〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ti/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'ag 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉raga'o/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasnoms/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thes/1275 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga ma phabs 'di bsnoms/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉re'i/ 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatang / 5〈〈pe 〉phro/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tsha/41—1275
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (24༷6)41wa 1276

༄rgya/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so//1༄4/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis gang zhig rgyal ba rnams kyi chos kyi sku/ /gcig nyid dang ni du ma 2nyid kyang rnam spangs pa'i / /ma gos gzugs med rdul dang bral ba gang yin pa'i/ /bkra shis de yis khyed la rtag tu bde legs shog /bkra shis gang zhig sangs rgyas sras kyis yongs bskor zhing / /longs spyod rdzogs sku dam chos kyi ni gsung dang bcas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos yongs su brgyan gyur pa/ /bkra shis de yis khyed la rtag tu bde legs shog /bkra shis gang zhig nags kyi me ni mched pa ltar / /'jug dang 'bar dang yongs su mya ngan 'das pa yis/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog gzhan gyi don ni mdzad pa po/ /bkra shis de yis khyed la rtag tu bde legs shog /bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun la phan byed pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnam dag blo ldan nyes pa'i tshogs dang bral/ /shes rab yan lag 41—/277

'dus pas mdzes pa bde ba'i bdagasna /bkra shis de yis khyed rnams la ni dbang mchog bskur ba'o/ /bkra shis gang zhig lha dang lha min mis mchod pa/ /de yi 2bstan pa'i dam chos bla na med pa ni/ /bdag med 'jig rten gsum la rab tu grags pa yi/ /bkra shis de yis khyed rnams la ni dbang mchog bskur//bkra shis gang zhig rab mchog dam chos rtag tu 'dzin/ /bzang po'i sar zhugs sangs rgyas sras po tshogs kyi mchog /rnam pa kun du sems can don mdzad bkra shis bzang / /bkra shis de yis khyed rnams la ni dbang mchog bskur / /zhes bya ba ni slob dpon snang byed zla bas mdzad pa sangs rgyas sku gsum chos dang dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa'o// //717—/278
bsdur mchan/1277 7mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod/ 〈〈〈snar 〉sngaram/1278 9①〈〈snar 〉〉〉gi/ rngu 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (24༷7)41 wa 1279

༄/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/2༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ pañca ta thā ga ta saṃ ga la gā thā/ bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad ye shes dam pa mtsho chen ldan / /zla ba nya 'dra'i sku mnga' srid pa'i mthar phyin pa/ /dgongs pa mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /mi 'khrugs rgyal po srid dang gti mug rnam snasbyong ba/ /mgon po yon tan thams cad rdzogs pas bkra shis pa/ /dge mnyam bsam sems ldan pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /sangs rgyas yon tan kun gyi rgyan gyis rgyan mdzad cing / /yang dag bden pa'i 'byor pa sbyin mdzad mi slu ba/ /rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bya'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog / 77—/280

༄༅/ /bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs/sna ༄4/ /dpal rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad rgyal ba mi bskyod pa/ /rin chen 'byung ldan 'od dpag med dang don yod grub/ /rigs lnga bde gshegs rnams kyi bkra shis gang yod pa/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bkra shis shog /rdo rje sems ma dang ni rin chen sems ma dang / /chos kyi sems ma dang ni las kyi sems mar bcas/ /bcom ldan yum mchog rnams kyi bkra shis gang yod pa/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bkra shis shog /rdo rje sems dpa' dang ni rdo rje rgyal po dang /rdo rje chags pa dang ni rdo rje legs par bcas/ /bcom ldan mi bskyod 'khor kyi bkra shis gang yod pa/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bkra shis shog /41—1282

rdo rje rin chen dang ni rdo rje lkugazi brjid dang / /rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang ni rdo rje bzhad par bcas/ /bcom ldan rin 'byung 'khor gyi bkra shis gang yod pa/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bkra shis shog /rdo rje chos rab dang ni rdo rje rnon po dang / /rdo rje 'khor lo dang ni rdo rje smra bar bcas/ /bcom ldan snang mtha'i 'khor gyi bkra shis gang yod pa/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bkra shis shog /rdo rje las rab dang ni rdo rje srung ba —dang / /rdo rje gnod sbyin dang ni rdo rje khu tshur bcas/ /bcom ldan don grub 'khor gyi bkra shis gang yod pa/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bkra shis shog /lha mo sgeg mo dang ni lha mo phreng ba ma/ /lha mo glu rngum dang ni lha mo gar mar bcas /nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo'i bkra shis gang yod pa/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang ding 'dir bkra shis shog /lha mo bdug spos ma dang lha mo me tog ma/ /lha mo mar me ma dang lha mo dri mar bcas/ /phyi yi mchod pa'i lha mo'i bkra shis gang yod pa/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang ding 'dir bkra shis 4shog /sgo ba lcags kyu dang ni sgo ba zhags pa dang / /sgo ba lcags sgog dang ni sgo ba dril bur bcas / /bcom ldan sgo srung 5rnams kyi bkra shis gang yod pa/ /bkra shis )dam pa des kyang ding 'dir bkra shis shog /dpal rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa rdzogs so// //47—/283

sngag /bkra shis brgyad pa/rmye༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ ga la aṣ+ṭa ka /bod skad du/ bkra shis brgyad pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam pa'i dpal dang 'jig rten mgon po rgyal ba mchog gi cod pan dang ni dzam+bha 3la/ /rdor sems byams pa phyag na rdo rje lag na ut+pal bzang skyong dang ni sgra gcan 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la sogs sa gsum phyag rgyas 4nyes pa ma lus zad gyur pa/ /dgyes pa rnams kyis dri med yid bde don kun grub pa'i bkra shis khyod la sprul du gsol/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad phyugs bdag 'dul byed rdo rje dril bu pad+ma'i lag pa can dang ni/ /ha khā ha lā ser po dag 5dang dgra yi tshogs 'joms ḍak+ki'i 6rgyal po bdag nyid che/ /mi bskyod 7pa dang spos kyi glang po rin chen tog dang rab 'jigs mi g.yo gshin rje'i dgra/ /dgyes pa rnams kyis dri med yid bde don kun grub 41byed1285

pa'i bkra shis khyod la stsal du gsol/ /yon tan tshogs mnga' byang chub sems kyis sems brgyan dge 'dun 'jig rten gsum gyis phyag byas dang / /dga' ba rab grub sangs rgyas rtsod pa'i dri ma las rgyal he ru ka dang dbyig sngon can/ /sangs rgyas sā 1la'i dbang po rgyal po rgyal ba'i yon rigs sems can kun la rjes brtse ba/ /dgyes pa rnams kyis dri med yid bde don kun grub pa'i bkra shis khyod la sprul na du gsol/ /shes rab skul byed sgol ma dag dang ye shes tshogs ni bsags par gyur pa'i khro gnyer can/ /bdud kyi bdud gyur 'od zer can ma zhal gsum mdog ser 'jigs pa mtha' dag rab 'joms ma/ /rma bya chen mo mā ma kri dang dgra yi tshogs 'joms gos dkar mo dang sangs rgyas spyan / /dgyes ma 4rnams kyis dri med yid bde don kun grub pa'i bkra shis khyod la stsal du gsol/ /gan+dha ri dang lag na ltos 'gro zhags pa lcags kyu ral gri 'dzin byed dug sel ma/ /rdo rje lag 5pa ma dang phag 6mo dgra sta ral gri 'dzin byed chos kyi dbang phyug ma/ /bde mchog las byung ye shes dpa' bo dpung rgyan phyag drug rgyal mtshan rab tu 'chang byed pa/ /dgyes pa rnams kyis 7dri med yid bde don kun grub pa'i bkra shis khyod la sprul du gsol/ /rgyal ba mchod byed pi wang phreng ma glu ma dang ni ri khrod bdug spos rdo rje ma/ /ro langs mar me dri yi rdo rje rab tu bzhad gdong bde 'gro dag dang mi pham ma sangs rgyas byang chub dpal mo dang ni rgyal ba mtha' dag mnyes par byed pa'i dbyangs can ma/ /dgyes ma 8rnams kyis 9 dri med yid bde don kun grub pa'i bkra shis khyod la srul du gsol/ /rgyal ba mchog gis chos 'khor bskor gyur yangs pa can dang bya rgod phung po'i ri bo dang / /lum bi ni dang mnyan yod 47byed/286

dang ni sa yi steng gnas ko ka med dang byang chub shing / /dpal gyi be+e'u dang a shad 'dab ma zhol )'bras me tog dpal 'bras dung dang 'khor lo can/ /dgyes pa rnams kyis dri med yid bde 37don kun grub pa'i bkra shis khyod la stsal du gsol/ /gdugs dang drur ༄ ba pad+ma dang ni rgyal mtshan dag dang nya dang pi 4wang sil snyan 'dzin/ /pheg lhapa dag dang rab gang bum pa thub pa gsung mchog rdo rje dril bu'i sgra dang ni/ /sangs rgyas cho 'phrul 'jo sgeg bzhad 6 'gros rnam par rol pa lha dang mi yis phyag byas pa/ /dgyes pa rnams kyis dri med yid bde don kun grub pa'i bkra shis khyod la sprul du gsol/ /rje btsun 'phags ma sgol mas gsungs pa'i bkra shis brgyad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar kyi mkhan po bi na dz+waya shrī mi tra dang / lo tsā ba ldan 8ma tshul khrims seng ges bsgyur ba'o// //9 4/—1287

sngag /bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa// sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ ga la gā thāsne/ bod skad du/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam pa tog dkar dga' ldan pho brang dam pa ru/ /mi pham mgon la rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur 1zhing / /'dzam gling nyid du glang chen thal ka ltar gshegs gang //bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer dam par zas gtsang sras/ /bud med skyon bral g.yo sgyu spangs pa lha mdzes yum/ /lhums su zla bcur blo gros ldan pa shākya'i rigs/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lum bi'i tshal ni zidabe+en zhing nyams dga' bla k+ṣa yi5/ /yal ga nas bzung trebaltams gyur tshangs dang brgya byen 'dudadz+wa/ /mkha' la gshegs te phyogs bcur pad+ma byung gyur gang / /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /gzhal med khang 41—1289

mdzes dam par drang srong 'dun mdzad nas/ /mtshan ltas shis par brjod de ston par 'byung 'gyur dang 1/ /shāka rigs bud med 'khor ldan kun bsus rgyan btags gang / /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /gzhon nu'i stobs ni sgyu rtsal yig rtsis 'phong la sogs/ /kun las mthar byung lha mi la sogs kun gyis mchod/ /shākya'i rigs 'khrungs log rtog bsal phyir btsun mo'i 'khor/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ /pho brang nas byung rga na shi ba la sogs gzigs/ /mi rnams rmongs mdzad lha yis mdun bdar mkha' la ni/ /srid gsum dag las rgal phyir mthon mthing dbu skra byegs/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lha rnams rdzu 'phrul gyes ni ngur smrig gos rnams phul/ /ne+e rañja na'i chu bor dka' thub ma lus rdzogs/ /thub pa bsam gtan las bzhengs bkra shis 'o thug bzhes / /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /pad+ma las byung khyu mchog byang chub shing drung du/ /skyil mo krung bcas mi g.yo mchog gis 4bdud btul nas/ /tho rangs bdud btul mi 'gyur phun sum sangs rgyas pa/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog / bā rā ṇa sbor 5chos kyi 'khor lo mgon pos bskor/ /kun shes la sogs lnga sde bzang la bden bzhi bstan/ /lha klu lha min mi dang mi min 'dun gyur gang / /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /nga rgyal snyems par ldan pa'i ston pa drug btul cing / /glang chen rab sbyo 7mi bzad lha sbyin gyis rbad btul/ /drang srong mchog la spre'u 9rgyal cang shes sbrang rtsi phul/ /bkra shis dam pa 7des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /pad+mo gzhon nu lta bu'i 47—/290

mtshan ltas shākya'i rigs/ /zas gtsang sras su rgyal rigs 'khor los 1sgyur rgyal du/ /bltams pa nas bzung lha yi tshal du ma lus rdzogs/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /byams pa'i stobs ni 'gro ba ma lus sgrol mdzad cing / /sems can mtha' yas zhi bde'i lam la bkod gyur te / /grong khyer rtswa mchog dam par dgongs pa yongs rdzogs gang / /bkra shis 2dam pa des kyang deng 5'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1289 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tha/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamal/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'i tshal/ 5〈〈pe 〉zodagar bla k+ka 'i/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dgar bla kraṣi/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdzazung / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatud/129༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoraphongs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉smrigs/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉gi/lha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉 ra ṇa sir/ 6〈〈snar 〉thasnyems/ )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉smyon/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉twen gyis sbad/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spre/ rka〈〈snar 〉〉gidam pa/1291 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bo/ 3 〈〈snar 〉〉 pa// 〈〈snar 〉〉des/41—1291
